- `backend/src/modules/areas/areas.controller.ts` — spread `{...summary, success: true}` al root (frontend ya esperaba este shape).
- `backend/src/modules/view-engine/services/view-query.service.ts` — token resolver `__TODAY__` y `__LIMA_TODAY__` → `(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::date` literal en SQL (no como param).
- `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/produccion/page.tsx` — `limaToday()` reemplaza `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)`.
- `mobile/app/(app)/forms/index.tsx` — usa `currentArea?.areaSlug` desde `useAreaStore`; permite fetch sin área (admin/owner ven todo por fallback backend).
- `infra/postgres/init/021_seed_view_definitions_produccion.sql` — 5 vistas: `produccion_partes_hoy` (tabla), `produccion_por_proceso_hoy` (bar), `produccion_throughput_turno` (pie, en realidad por operation_id), `produccion_merma_dia` (metric), `produccion_por_dueno_mp` (bar). Todas activadas en `tenant_perufrost.tenant_views`.

**Commits pushed**:
- backend: 520a715 (fix forms + KPIs producción + __TODAY__ resolver)
- frontend: 37503ff (limaToday produccion dashboard)
- mobile: 47d7d5e (forms con currentArea, sin bloquear admin)
- infra: c4ecdcb (seed vistas con schema real)

**Learned**:
- `production_batch` NO tiene columna `shift_code` (no hay concepto de turno en el modelo). El sub-agent que escribió el seed la inventó. Fix: vista "throughput por turno" pasó a "throughput por operación" (ING/SAL/REG).
- `ViewQueryService` exige que TODA columna usada en `defaultFilters` esté declarada en `schema.columns[]` con `filterable: true`. Si no, error "Filtro sobre columna desconocida 'X'".
- **GOTCHA importante**: el cache de vistas vive en Redis con TTL LONG (`view:schema:*` y `view:query:*`). Re-seedear `view_definitions` y restartear backend NO invalida. Hay que hacer `redis-cli DEL view:*` manualmente o exponer un endpoint de invalidación. Pendiente: agregar invalidación automática al re-seedear o un script.
- VM workflow: `/home/rodrigo/deploy-backend.sh` y `deploy-frontend.sh` hacen git pull + docker compose build --no-cache + up; el seed SQL NO corre solo (init/*.sql solo en fresh DB) — aplicar manual via `docker exec -i postgres psql < seed.sql`.

observations.title: Bug CORS: respuestas de error pre-handler no llevan headers CORS
observations.content:
**What**: Cuando `TenantMiddleware` (o cualquier middleware de NestJS) tira `next(err)` antes de llegar al handler, la respuesta de error del `HttpExceptionFilter` NO incluye los headers CORS (`access-control-allow-origin`, `vary: Origin`), aunque el preflight OPTIONS sí los lleva. Browser bloquea la lectura con "blocked by CORS policy" incluso si el origen está permitido.

**Why**: Reproducido contra la VM (34.31.70.3:3000):
- GET `/health` con Origin → 200 + CORS headers OK
- GET `/dashboard` con `x-tenant-id` válido → 404 + CORS headers OK
- GET `/dashboard` SIN tenant → 400 (TENANT_NOT_IDENTIFIED) + **SIN CORS headers** ❌

`@fastify/cors` setea headers en `onRequest`, pero cuando un middleware NestJS lanza vía `next(err)`, Fastify dispatcha al error handler de Nest sin pasar por los hooks que aplicarían CORS al reply.

**Where**:
- `backend/src/core/errors/http-exception.filter.ts` — el filter usa `reply.status().send()` sin re-aplicar CORS.
- `backend/src/core/tenant/tenant.middleware.ts:66` — DomainError TENANT_NOT_IDENTIFIED es el caso típico que dispara el bug.
- `backend/src/main.ts:44-63` — `app.enableCors()` está bien configurado, no es problema de config.

**Learned**:
- En NestFastify, los hooks de @fastify/cors no se garantizan en errores de middleware. Fix sugerido: en `HttpExceptionFilter.catch()`, leer `request.headers.origin` y re-emitir `access-control-allow-origin` + `access-control-allow-credentials` + `vary: Origin` manualmente si el origen está permitido.
- No urgente: en uso real, los clientes (mobile/frontend) siempre mandan `x-tenant-id` o usan subdominio, así que el path TENANT_NOT_IDENTIFIED rara vez se ve en flujos normales.

observations.title: Mobile fixes: login permanente + docs YELLOW/RED obligan observación + bug validación isCamaraAsset + mock pesaje
observations.content:
**What**: 4 fixes quirúrgicos en mobile (typecheck verde, sin push aún):

1. **Login permanente**: eliminado el SessionExpiredModal del flujo. Cuando un 401 es irrecuperable, el interceptor llama `useAuthStore.clearSession()` (nueva acción que limpia sin POST /auth/logout). El AuthRouter en `_layout.tsx` ya redirige al login automáticamente al ver isAuthenticated:false. Eliminados: `sessionExpired`/`setSessionExpired` del store, subscripción a `authEventEmitter` en _layout, render del modal. SessionExpiredModal.tsx queda como noop (return null) para no romper imports.

2. **Documentos botón amarillo + observación obligatoria YELLOW/RED**: `submitBtn.backgroundColor` → `#d97706` (amber-600). Nueva validación: docs con `semaphore_status === 'YELLOW' || 'RED'` y `review_observation` vacía → `canConfirmDocOk = false`. Agregado `vesselWarnings` state que reúne warnings de barcos anidados vía `onWarningsChange` callback en VesselDocsSection. Hint en footer cuando hay warnings sin observación. Texto del botón cambia a "Faltan N observaciones" cuando aplica.

3. **Validación campos ocultos en barco directo**: bug en `isCamaraAsset` que usaba `parent_camara_asset_id === null` — esto también marcaba a BARCO DIRECTO como cámara (también tiene parent null) y ocultaba la sección "Datos Adicionales por Embarcación" (eslora, plantas, fechas, arte de pesca, INMARSAT, equipo satelital). Fix: `asset.asset_role === 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'`. La lógica de pre-fill ya estaba correcta (usa transport_type_code), solo el render escondía los campos.

4. **Pesaje mock con matching real**: cuando `balanzaError` se muestra botón "Usar datos de prueba". `MOCK_PESADAS_RAW` son 3 pesadas sin matchedAssetId. Al activar, `matchPesadas(raw, arrivals)` aplica mismo algoritmo del backend: normaliza proveedor + matricula/placa (trim + lowercase + colapsa espacios) y compara contra `arrival.supplier_name` + `asset.asset_registration` de los arrivals del día. Badge "MODO PRUEBA" en header de sección. Botón close para salir del modo.

**Why**: Pedidos del usuario en sesión 2026-06-26:
- "el funcionamiento es el siguiente el usuario entra x primera vez se logea nunca mas tiene que volver a logearse nada de sesion expirada"
- "falta que sea necesaria la observacion cuando el documento tiene estado amarillo o rojo"
- "validacion por ejemplo cuando es una embarcacion no muestra todos los datos que tiene que mostrar"
- "en pesaje necesito unos datos de prueba" + "se tiene que hacer match al que tenga el mismo proveedor y embarcacion"

**Where**:
- mobile/stores/auth.ts (clearSession nueva acción, removido sessionExpired)
- mobile/lib/api.ts (removido authEventEmitter import, 401 irrecuperable llama clearSession)
- mobile/app/_layout.tsx (removido SessionExpiredModal + suscripción evento)
- mobile/components/SessionExpiredModal.tsx (noop)
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx (botón amber + hasUnobservedWarnings + handleVesselWarnings)
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx (línea 337: isCamaraAsset → asset_role === 'CAMARA_ANCHOR')
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/pesaje/index.tsx (matchPesadas + MOCK_PESADAS_RAW + useMockData state + UI)

**Learned**:
- `pnpm -F mobile exec tsc --noEmit` → 0 errores tras todos los cambios.
- El backend tiene refresh token de 7 días — con uso regular nunca llega al login. Si los dos tokens mueren, va al login normalmente sin modal invasivo.
- `parent_camara_asset_id === null` NO es discriminador de cámara: tanto CAMARA_ANCHOR como DIRECT lo tienen null. El discriminador correcto es `asset_role`.
- Las pesadas mock usan `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` para fecha de hoy → si los proveedores/matrículas no matchean con arrivals reales, aparecen con badge "Sin match" (UX correcta).
- NO se hizo push ni commit; cambios en working tree de mobile (repo separado mobil-escorpia/master).

observations.title: Bot WhatsApp acopio antibalas: multiformato, modelo gemma-4, resiliencia LLM
observations.content:
**What**: Endurecimiento "antibalas" del bot de WhatsApp de llegadas de acopio (workflow n8n traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio + backend ChatWspAcopioService). 6 mejoras: (1) Nodo "Extraer y autorizar" reescrito: lee texto de conversation/extendedText/captions imagen-video-documento/respuestas de botones-listas, desenvuelve wrappers (ephemeral/viewOnce/edited/deviceSent/docWithCaption), y resuelve el teléfono real con senderPn/participantPn cuando llega LID (@lid). (2) Rechazo amable de audio/sticker/ubicación: nueva rama Switch "unsupported" → nodo "Rechazo no-texto" → Enviar WhatsApp (antes silencio total / desperdicio de LLM). (3) Confirm/cancel robusto: normaliza sin diacríticos/puntuación, acepta emoji (👍✅🆗 / ❌🚫👎), multipalabra ("ok dale", "si correcto"), pero NO dispara si hay dígitos o >3 tokens (evita pisar una llegada que empieza con "Dale"). (4) Modelo cambiado openai/gpt-4o-mini → google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (verificado en OpenRouter: soporta response_format+structured_outputs, multimodal, ~4x más barato $0.06/$0.33 por M). (5) Resiliencia: retryOnFail(3, 3s) en OpenRouter/resolve/commit + continueOnFail en OpenRouter (degrada a "no entendí, reenviá" en vez de cortar). (6) TTL 1h del pending en confirm. Backend: parseTime ahora entiende mediodía/medianoche/"HH.MM"/"HH y media"; guard kg→tn si quantityTn>=1000 (divide y avisa). Prompt endurecido para coma decimal y kg→tn.

**Why**: Usuario pidió que el bot funcione en todas las casuísticas/formatos y "aguante todo". El bot solo leía conversation+extendedText (silencio ante fotos, audios, captions, LID, confirmaciones con puntuación/emoji), y un fallo de OpenRouter dejaba al usuario sin respuesta.

**Where**: infra/n8n/traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio.json (nodos Extraer y autorizar, Tipo de mensaje, Rechazo no-texto[nuevo], Preparar prompt, OpenRouter parsear, Backend resolve/commit, Cargar pendiente); backend/src/modules/chat-wsp-acopio/services/chat-wsp-acopio.service.ts (parseTime + guard kg); spec.ts (+2 tests). 12/12 tests OK, build OK.

**Learned**: Editar el JSON del repo NO cambia el n8n vivo — hay que REIMPORTAR el workflow en la instancia n8n para que tome los cambios (pendiente de deploy). gemma-4-26b-a4b-it existe en OpenRouter con sufijos :free y normal. parseTime debía convertir punto a colon solo entre dígitos (\d.\d) para no romper "a.m.". Confirm/cancel debe excluir mensajes con dígitos para no confundir llegadas con confirmaciones.

observations.title: CIERRE SESIÓN 2026-06-26 — 4 fixes mobile commiteados a master (login permanente + docs YELLOW/RED + bug validación + mock pesaje)
observations.content:
## Goal
Arreglar 4 puntos del mobile de Escorpia Traza (tenant perufrost, módulo Acopio): login permanente, observación obligatoria en docs YELLOW/RED, bug de campos ocultos en validación de barco directo, datos de prueba para pesaje cuando balanza falla.

## Instructions (preferencias usuario)
- Login: "el usuario entra x primera vez se logea nunca mas tiene que volver a logearse" — Opción A confirmada: redirect limpio al login si ambos tokens mueren, sin modal.
- Observación REQUERIDA cuando semáforo del doc es YELLOW o RED.
- "intervencion quirurjica" → no romper nada adicional.
- Mobile NO se deploya a la VM (solo backend/frontend/postgres/redis viven en 34.31.70.3). Distribución mobile = npx expo start (dev) o EAS (prod futura).
- Responder rioplatense, código/comentarios en español neutro.

## Discoveries
- **Bug isCamaraAsset (validacion/[arrivalId].tsx:337)**: `parent_camara_asset_id === null` NO discrimina cámara — BARCO DIRECTO también tiene parent null. Discriminador correcto: `asset_role === 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'` (CAMARA_ANCHOR/DIRECT/VESSEL). Por eso barco directo nunca veía eslora, plantas, fechas, INMARSAT, arte de pesca.
- **Flujo 401**: interceptor api.ts intentaba refresh; si moría, emitía `auth:unauthorized` → activaba SessionExpiredModal (invasivo, aparecía hasta en cold launch). Solución: 401 irrecuperable → `useAuthStore.getState().clearSession()` (acción nueva sin POST /auth/logout) y AuthRouter redirige al login al ver isAuthenticated:false.
- **Backend refresh TTL**: 7 días. Con uso regular nunca llega al login.
- **Repos**: mobile = R0DR0X/mobil-escorpia/master, independiente de backend/frontend/infra. Había 4 archivos sin commitear de sesiones previas (app.json metro bundler, DocumentSemaphore.tsx export SemaphoreRules ya consumido, package.json pin worklets) — commiteados en commit separado de cleanup.
- **Mock matching**: para que pesadas mock se comporten igual que API real, usar mismo algoritmo del backend — norm(string) = trim + lowercase + colapsa espacios; comparar proveedor===supplier_name Y (matricula||placaVehicular)===asset_registration.

## Accomplished
- ✅ Fix 1 Login permanente: stores/auth.ts (clearSession, removido sessionExpired) + lib/api.ts (sin authEventEmitter, llama clearSession) + app/_layout.tsx (sin SessionExpiredModal/suscripción) + components/SessionExpiredModal.tsx → noop.
- ✅ Fix 2 Documentos: botón amber #d97706 + hasUnobservedWarnings extiende canConfirmDocOk. VesselDocsSection reporta warnings via prop onWarningsChange. Hint footer + texto botón "Faltan N observaciones".
- ✅ Fix 3 Validación: 1 línea (isCamaraAsset → asset.asset_role === 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'). Pre-fill ya estaba correcto, solo el render escondía campos.
- ✅ Fix 4 Pesaje: MOCK_PESADAS_RAW (3 pesadas sin matchedAssetId) + matchPesadas(raw, arrivals) con normalización. UI: botón "Usar datos de prueba" cuando balanzaError + badge "MODO PRUEBA" + botón close.
- ✅ `pnpm -F mobile exec tsc --noEmit` → 0 errores.
- ✅ Commits + push a mobil-escorpia/master:
  - f8b1d3f chore: cleanup pendientes (SemaphoreRules + metro bundler + pin worklets)
  - 6254b23 fix(mobile): 4 fixes principales
- ✅ NO se tocó backend/frontend; VM SIN redeploy necesario (mobile no vive ahí).

## Next Steps
- Usuario: `cd mobile && git pull && npx expo start --clear` para verificar en device.
- Probar 4 escenarios: (1) cerrar+abrir app → entra al dashboard sin re-login; (2) doc YELLOW/RED → botón confirmar deshabilitado sin observación; (3) BARCO DIRECTO → header "EMBARCACIÓN:" + sección completa datos adicionales; (4) balanza falla → botón "Usar datos de prueba" + pesadas mock matcheadas contra arrivals reales del día.
- DEUDA TÉCNICA opcional: pre-fill (líneas 102-192 validacion/[arrivalId].tsx) también usa `parent_camara_asset_id === null` — funcionalmente correcto (está dentro de switch por transport_type_code) pero por consistencia podría migrarse a asset_role.

## Relevant Files
- mobile/stores/auth.ts — clearSession nueva acción, sin sessionExpired
- mobile/lib/api.ts — 401 irrecuperable → clearSession() sin emit
- mobile/app/_layout.tsx — sin SessionExpiredModal ni authEventEmitter
- mobile/components/SessionExpiredModal.tsx — noop (return null)
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx — botón amber + obs obligatoria YELLOW/RED
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx — fix isCamaraAsset (línea 337)
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/pesaje/index.tsx — MOCK_PESADAS_RAW + matchPesadas + UI mock
- mobile/components/acopio/DocumentSemaphore.tsx — export SemaphoreRules (cleanup commit)

observations.title: Bot WhatsApp acopio: producto en confirmación + prompt conversacional (probado vs gemma-4 real)
observations.content:
**What**: Segunda tanda de mejoras al bot WhatsApp acopio. (1) PRODUCTO en la confirmación: el LLM ahora extrae `product` (pota/perico/merluza/etc), el backend lo matchea al catálogo (bestProductMatch) o cae al default POTA y SIEMPRE devuelve productId+productName+productAssumed; el resumen n8n muestra columna `Prod` en ambas tablas (POTA por defecto, dicho explícitamente). **Where**: backend/src/modules/chat-wsp-acopio/services/chat-wsp-acopio.service.ts (resolve carga listProducts+default POTA, resolveEntry resuelve producto, bestProductMatch nuevo, ResolvedEntry +productId/productName/productAssumed); dto/chat-wsp-acopio.dto.ts (ResolveEntryDto.product, CommitEntryDto.productName); spec.ts (14/14 tests, +product); infra/n8n/traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio.json (Preparar prompt +product/conversacional/few-shot2; Guardar pendiente+resumen columna Prod + productId/productName en commit).

**Learned**: gemma-4-26b-a4b-it discierne muy bien create/update y formatos en español-peruano sin few-shot extra pesado. La API key de OpenRouter está en infra/.env (PRUEBAS, no rotar). Build+14 tests verdes. PENDIENTE: reimportar el workflow en n8n vivo (editar JSON no actualiza la instancia).

observations.title: Deploy completo: 13 commits + rebuild VM (mobile + dashboard + 140 archivos backend WIP)
observations.content:
**What**: Commiteado, pusheado y deployado batch grande acumulado: 140 archivos backend + 11 frontend en 13 commits temáticos atómicos. VM rebuild de backend+worker+scheduler+frontend, sistema operativo.

**Why**: Usuario detectó que mejoras dashboard previas + mobile bottom tab bar nunca fueron commiteadas ni deployadas — todo estaba como working changes locales (backend tenía 6318/2259 sin commitear).

**Where**:
- Backend (10 commits): chore(infra) schemas+core+runtime → refactor(auth) → feat(acopio+chat-wsp) → feat(produccion) → feat(document-engine) → feat(admin+tenant-admin) → feat(gerencia+trace+shipping) → feat(engines form/view/integration) → feat(misc sync/tools/vertebra) → chore(db) client. HEAD: feb0e1e.
- Frontend (3 commits): feat(dashboard) orden vivo tabla → feat(acopio) busqueda catalogos normalizada → feat(ui) mobile bottom tab bar. HEAD: 92f2ee1.

**Learned**:
- **Estrategia de commits para WIP masivo**: cuando acumulás 100+ archivos sin commitear, lo único realista es agrupar por dominio (acopio, produccion, admin, etc.) en orden de dependencias: schemas/types primero, core/runtime después, módulos arriba. 9-10 commits es el sweet spot — menos = no atómico, más = ruido.
- **Verificar antes de commitear**: SIEMPRE `pnpm build` + `pnpm test` antes del primer commit. Si rompe, el orden de los commits importa menos que tener algo funcional.
- **Incidente VM**: tenía working changes en chat-wsp + package-lock.json que bloqueaban `git pull`. Solución: verificar md5 de los archivos en VM vs mi HEAD remoto — si idénticos, descartar con `git checkout -- .` es seguro. NUNCA stash drop sin verificar md5/diff primero.
- **package.json idéntico (mismo md5) + package-lock.json diferente** = cambios cosméticos del lockfile (alguien hizo `npm install` en la VM). El Dockerfile regenera deps en el build, descarte seguro.
- **Deploy backend = 3 containers**: backend + worker + scheduler comparten código de `produccion-back` con Dockerfiles distintos. Rebuild SIEMPRE los 3 juntos. Solo backend = worker/scheduler quedan con código viejo.
- **Build SSH se cuelga ~5min pero completa**: no abortar, abrir nueva sesión SSH y verificar con `docker compose ps` que containers están "Up X minutes (healthy)". 4 containers tardaron ~12 min total.
- **Verificación post-deploy obligatoria**: `docker compose ps` (healthy) + logs grep "Nest application successfully started" + `curl /health` (200) + verificar worker/scheduler estén ejecutando jobs (no solo arrancados).
- **VM layout**: `/opt/traceexport/produccion-{back,front,infra}` son 3 repos git separados. Compose en uso: `produccion-infra/docker-compose.vm.yml` (NO prod.yml).

**Resultado verificado**:
- backend → Up 12min (healthy), Nest started, /health=200
- worker → Up 12min, ejecutando alert-evaluation jobs cada 5 min
- scheduler → Up 12min, cron heartbeat + Encolando jobs
- frontend → Up 12min, / = 307 (redirect a login, correcto)

observations.title: Proposal: add-observability-stack
observations.content:
# Proposal: Add Observability Stack (Phase 1)

## Why
TraceExport is feature-complete and entering hardening/scaling, but production is blind: backend exposes no `/metrics` (Prometheus scrape returns 400), Prometheus+Grafana declared in `docker-compose.prod.yml` are NOT running (live stack is `infra/produccion-infra/docker-compose.vm.yml`), Redis cache hit ratio is 35% with zero keys under expected prefixes, and Postgres has high seq_scan on Acopio tables. Every later phase (Redis split, Postgres tuning, cache fixes) is guesswork without measurement.

## What changes
- Backend: new `MetricsModule` (`@willsoto/nestjs-prometheus` + `prom-client`) exposing `/metrics`. Instruments: HTTP request-duration histogram (route/status/method), BullMQ per-queue gauges (waiting/active/failed/completed, all 9 queues incl doc-extraction + alert-evaluation), CacheService hit/miss on remember()/get(), DB pool gauges via postgres.js. Wired in app.module.ts.
- Infra (docker-compose.vm.yml, the RUNNING one): prometheus (127.0.0.1:9090), grafana (127.0.0.1:3002 — 3001 taken by frontend), postgres-exporter + redis-exporter (internal only).
- Prometheus scrape config (backend + 2 exporters, 15s).
- Grafana provisioning: Prometheus datasource + 'TraceExport Overview' dashboard (API latency p50/p95 by route, BullMQ queue depth, Redis memory + hit ratio).
- docs/ops/observability.md (SSH tunnel + read guide).

## Impact / Affected Areas
- backend/src/core/metrics/{metrics.module.ts,metrics.controller.ts} (New)
- backend/src/app.module.ts (Modified — wire MetricsModule)
- backend/src/core/cache/cache.service.ts (Modified — hit/miss)
- backend/src/queues/queue.module.ts (Modified — gauge hooks)
- infra/produccion-infra/docker-compose.vm.yml (Modified — 4 services)
- infra/produccion-infra/prometheus/prometheus.yml (New)
- infra/produccion-infra/grafana/provisioning/{datasources,dashboards}/ (New)
- docs/ops/observability.md (New)
Repos touched: backend/ and infra/ (separate git repos). frontend/ and mobile/ NOT touched.

## Non-goals
pg_stat_statements (needs PG restart), alerting/notifications, nginx/TLS/firewall (Phase 2), Redis cache-vs-queues split (Phase 3), PG config tuning (Phase 4), frontend/mobile instrumentation (Phase 5), public Grafana exposure (SSH tunnel only), migrating to docker-compose.prod.yml.

## Risks
- Instrumentation latency: use default responseTimeBuckets, NO high-cardinality labels (generic route, never tenantSlug).
- Grafana port conflict: frontend uses host 3001 → bind Grafana 127.0.0.1:3002, internal container port default.
- Prometheus 15-day retention fills disk (VM at 72%) → coordinate Phase 0 cleanup, consider retention/size cap.
- prom-client is pure-JS → verify backend Dockerfile needs no change.
- Backend rebuild must include worker+scheduler (shared code) to avoid drift.

## Rollback
Revert MetricsModule wiring + rebuild backend/worker/scheduler; stop & rm the 4 monitoring services and remove config. No schema/data changes — fully reversible. Zero downtime (up -d only, no down).

## Capabilities
New: `observability` (metrics exposure, scraping, exporters, dashboards). Modified: none.

## Status
Proposal artifact (hybrid). File: openspec/changes/add-observability-stack/proposal.md. Next phase: design.

observations.title: Design: add-observability-stack
observations.content:
# Design: Add Observability Stack (Phase 1)

## Technical Approach

Add a self-contained, global `MetricsModule` in `backend/src/core/metrics/` registering `prom-client` collectors and exposing `GET /metrics`. Instrument HTTP via one Fastify `onResponse` hook (route-template labels, no tenant), poll BullMQ counts every 10s, wrap `CacheService` hit/miss, emit DB-pool gauges from `postgres.js` (best-effort). Worker and scheduler run their own minimal `/metrics` listener on container port `9464`. Extend live `infra/docker-compose.vm.yml` (network `app_net`) with prometheus, grafana, postgres-exporter, redis-exporter, provisioned as code. Deploy rolling `up -d` only.

## Key Architecture Decisions
1. Lib: `@willsoto/nestjs-prometheus` + `prom-client` (pure-JS, no Dockerfile change).
2. `@Global() MetricsModule` exports collector providers.
3. HTTP: single Fastify `onResponse` hook in main.ts (no per-controller decoration).
4. Route label: `request.routeOptions.url` template; fallback `__unmatched__`.
5. BullMQ: singleton polling `Queue.getJobCounts()` every 10s, all 9 queues; labels queue,state.
6. Cache: counter on get/remember, labels operation,outcome; NO tenant label.
7. DB pool: best-effort from postgres.js; if not cleanly readable, ship node_* defaults + document gap.
8. /metrics: `@Public()` + TenantMiddleware `.exclude()` + `@SkipThrottle()`; scraped over app_net only.
9. Worker/scheduler: minimal HTTP `/metrics` on container 9464 (they use createApplicationContext, no HTTP today); separate scrape jobs; internal only.
10. Prometheus retention: `--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d --storage.tsdb.retention.size=2GB`.

## Topology
- Network: `app_net` (bridge). prometheus 127.0.0.1:9090, grafana 127.0.0.1:3002:3000, exporters NO host port.
- postgres-exporter: DATA_SOURCE_NAME=postgresql://trace_app:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/erp_exportadores?sslmode=disable
- redis-exporter: REDIS_ADDR=redis://redis:6379, REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD}
- Volumes: prometheus_data, grafana_data. Grafana env: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD from .env.
- Healthchecks: prom /-/healthy, grafana /api/health, exporters /metrics.

## Dashboard PromQL (3 panels)
- p95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
- BullMQ depth: sum(bullmq_jobs) by (queue, state)
- Redis: redis_memory_used_bytes; hit ratio = rate(hits[5m]) / (rate(hits[5m]) + rate(misses[5m]))
Dashboard JSON hand-written minimal (budget).

## Files
New: core/metrics/{metrics.module,metrics.controller,metrics.collectors,bullmq-metrics.service,http-metrics.hook}.ts; infra/prometheus/prometheus.yml; infra/grafana/provisioning/{datasources/prometheus.yml,dashboards/dashboards.yml,dashboards/traceexport-overview.json}; docs/ops/observability.md.
Modify: main.ts (hook), app.module.ts (import + exclude metrics), cache.service.ts, queue.module.ts, worker.ts, scheduler.ts, docker-compose.vm.yml.
VM path infra/produccion-infra/ maps 1:1 to local infra/.

## Deploy / Rollback
Deploy: build local → commit backend+infra repos separately → push → VM git pull both → up -d --no-deps --build backend worker scheduler && up -d the 4 monitoring services. No down.
Rollback: revert commits, rebuild backend trio, stop+rm the 4 services. No schema/data change.

## Risks (carryover + new)
- Carryover: instrumentation latency (default buckets), Grafana port (3002 free, confirmed), retention disk (2GB cap), Dockerfile (pure-JS), worker/scheduler drift (rebuild 3 together).
- NEW: worker/scheduler need an HTTP listener they don't have today (bind after context init, internal only).
- NEW: postgres.js lacks stable pool-stats API → may fall back to node_* defaults.
- NEW: route-template accessor may differ by Fastify version (routeOptions.url vs routerPath) — pin at apply.

## Open Questions
- Confirm Fastify version exposes request.routeOptions.url vs legacy request.routerPath in running backend.

observations.title: Spec: add-observability-stack (observability)
observations.content:
# Observability Specification

## Purpose

Production metrics exposure, Prometheus scraping, sidecar exporters, and Grafana dashboards for API, queue, cache, and DB health in the TraceExport VM stack.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-001 — Backend `/metrics` endpoint

The backend MUST expose `GET /metrics` on port 3000 returning Prometheus text exposition format. The endpoint MUST be public (`@Public()`), bypass `TenantMiddleware`, and skip `ThrottlerGuard`. It MUST include at minimum `http_request_duration_seconds_*`, `bullmq_jobs`, `cache_operations_total`, plus `prom-client` defaults.

#### Scenario: Prometheus scrapes backend metrics

- GIVEN the backend is running on `app_net`
- WHEN Prometheus scrapes `http://backend:3000/metrics`
- THEN it receives HTTP 200 with valid Prometheus exposition containing `http_request_duration_seconds`, `bullmq_jobs`, and `cache_operations_total` series

#### Scenario: No auth or tenant required

- GIVEN no `Authorization` header and no `x-tenant-id` header
- WHEN a request hits `GET /metrics` from inside `app_net`
- THEN the response is 200 (not 401 or 403)

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-002 — HTTP request histogram

The system MUST record a histogram `http_request_duration_seconds` with labels `method`, `route`, `status_code`. The `route` label MUST use the Fastify route template; unmatched routes MUST use `__unmatched__`.

#### Scenario: Route template aggregation

- WHEN two requests hit `/forms/uuid-1/submit` and `/forms/uuid-2/submit`
- THEN both produce metrics under `route="/forms/:id/submit"` (single series)

#### Scenario: Unmatched route label

- WHEN a request hits a nonexistent path
- THEN metrics record `route="__unmatched__"`

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-003 — BullMQ queue gauges

The system MUST maintain a gauge `bullmq_jobs` with labels `queue` and `state` (waiting, active, completed, failed, delayed). Counts MUST be polled every 10s for all 9 queues. Polling MUST run in backend, worker, AND scheduler processes.

#### Scenario: Waiting job reflected in gauge

- GIVEN a job is enqueued to queue `sync-offline` and not yet picked up
- WHEN ~10s elapses
- THEN `bullmq_jobs{queue="sync-offline",state="waiting"}` reflects the increment

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-004 — Cache hit/miss counters

The system MUST increment counter `cache_operations_total` with labels `operation` (get | remember) and `outcome` (hit | miss) inside `CacheService.get()` and `CacheService.remember()`. There MUST NOT be a tenant label.

#### Scenario: Miss then hit on remember

- GIVEN a non-cached key
- WHEN `remember()` is called → `outcome="miss"` increments
- AND the same key is called again → `outcome="hit"` increments

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-005 — Worker and scheduler metrics

Worker and scheduler MUST each expose `/metrics` on internal container port `9464`. The listener MUST bind AFTER NestJS context init and MUST NOT block BullMQ processing. No host port SHALL be mapped.

#### Scenario: Worker metrics reachable internally

- WHEN `curl http://worker:9464/metrics` is run from inside `app_net`
- THEN it returns 200 with valid Prometheus exposition

#### Scenario: Scheduler metrics reachable internally

- WHEN `curl http://scheduler:9464/metrics` is run from inside `app_net`
- THEN it returns 200

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-006 — Monitoring containers

`docker-compose.vm.yml` MUST define services `prometheus`, `grafana`, `postgres-exporter`, `redis-exporter` joined to `app_net`. Named volumes `prometheus_data` and `grafana_data` MUST persist data. Host bindings: prometheus `127.0.0.1:9090:9090`, grafana `127.0.0.1:3002:3000`. Exporters MUST NOT have host ports. Healthchecks MUST be defined for prometheus and grafana.

#### Scenario: All monitoring services healthy

- GIVEN `docker compose up -d` is run
- WHEN 60s elapse
- THEN all four monitoring services report `Up (healthy)`

#### Scenario: Loopback-only binding

- WHEN `ss -tlnp` runs on the VM
- THEN ports 9090 and 3002 appear ONLY on `127.0.0.1` (not `0.0.0.0`)

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-007 — Prometheus scrape configuration

Prometheus MUST scrape 5 targets: `backend:3000`, `worker:9464`, `scheduler:9464`, `postgres-exporter:9187`, `redis-exporter:9121` at 15s intervals. Retention MUST be `--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d` AND `--storage.tsdb.retention.size=2GB`.

#### Scenario: All targets UP

- GIVEN Prometheus has been running for >1 minute
- WHEN querying `/api/v1/targets`
- THEN all 5 targets show state `up`

#### Scenario: Retention flags present

- WHEN inspecting the prometheus container command
- THEN both `--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d` and `--storage.tsdb.retention.size=2GB` are present

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-008 — Grafana provisioning and dashboard

Grafana MUST provision a datasource `Prometheus` pointing to `http://prometheus:9090`. A dashboard `TraceExport Overview` MUST be provisioned as code (JSON) with panels: (1) API latency p50+p95 by route, (2) BullMQ depth by queue/state, (3) Redis memory + hit ratio. Admin credentials MUST come from env vars `GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER` / `GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD`.

#### Scenario: Dashboard renders without manual import

- GIVEN Grafana is accessed via SSH tunnel
- WHEN the operator opens the UI
- THEN `TraceExport Overview` is listed and all 3 panels render data

#### Scenario: PromQL matches design contract

- THEN the p95 panel uses `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`
- AND the BullMQ panel uses `sum(bullmq_jobs) by (queue, state)`

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-009 — Zero-downtime deploy and rollback

Deploy MUST use `docker compose up -d --no-deps --build` for backend trio, then `up -d` for monitoring services. `docker compose down` MUST NOT be used. Rollback MUST revert commits, stop+rm the 4 monitoring services, and rebuild the backend trio. No DB schema or data change SHALL be introduced.

#### Scenario: Rolling restart preserves availability

- WHEN deploy runs
- THEN the existing backend is replaced; `/health` is interrupted for at most a few seconds

#### Scenario: Rollback removes monitoring cleanly

- WHEN rollback is executed
- THEN the 4 monitoring services are removed and backend serves requests without tenant data loss

---

### Requirement: REQ-OBS-010 — Operations documentation

`docs/ops/observability.md` MUST document: SSH tunnel command, Grafana URL and login source, how to read each panel, and how to rotate the Grafana admin password.

#### Scenario: New operator reaches dashboard

- GIVEN a new operator with SSH access
- WHEN they follow `docs/ops/observability.md`
- THEN they reach the Grafana dashboard within 5 minutes

observations.content:
**What**: Plan completo de overhaul del sistema de roles, permisos y usuarios de TraceExport. Diseñado para ser ERP-Next style pero con las tecnologías del proyecto.

**Why**: El sistema actual tiene code muerto (role_permissions sin usar), falta user_permissions (excepciones individuales), multi-rol roto en el service, user_area_item_access sin enforcement en API, y bug en cache key de roleAccess.

**Where**: infra/postgres/tenant-template/ (SQL), backend/src/core/auth/ (guards, types, service), backend/src/modules/admin/ (service, controller, dto), todos los controllers con @RequiresTool/@RequiresWrite, frontend/src/app/[tenant]/admin/roles/ y /usuarios/.

**Learned**: VM y local IDÉNTICOS (mismo commit hash). Re-provisionar desde cero — datos de prueba son descartables. Bug crítico en refreshToken(): copia payload viejo sin recomputar permissions.

---

DECISIONES CONFIRMADAS (no debatir — ya decididas):
- Granularidad: acciones granulares (view/create/edit/delete/approve/export) por tool
- Multi-rol: real M-M, permisos acumulativos (OR entre roles)
- Fuente de verdad: role_permissions (ELIMINAR role_tool_access)
- Nueva tabla: user_permissions (grant/revoke directo por usuario)
- Guards: JWT lleva permissions: string[] computados al login (O(1), sin DB en guard)
- Área enforcement: user_area_item_access enforced en API (403 real)
- Migración: re-provisionar schemas desde cero
- Refresh: recomputa permissions desde DB en cada refresh

ECUACIÓN:
efectivos = UNION(role_permissions de todos los roles) + user_permissions[granted=true] - user_permissions[granted=false]
JWT: permissions: ["forms:view", "forms:create", "trace:view", ...]

ACCIONES CANÓNICAS POR TOOL:
forms: view, create, edit, delete, approve, export
trace: view, export
views: view, export
documents: view, create, edit, delete, export
reports: view, export
acopio: view, create, edit, delete, approve, export
produccion: view, create, edit, delete, approve, export
integrations: view, create, edit
admin: view, create, edit, delete

ÉPICAS (orden: A→B→C→D→E→F):
A: DB schema — modificar 001/011/026/024 SQL, agregar user_permissions, script reprovision-all-tenants.sh
B: Backend core — auth.types (permissions[]), auth.service (compute+refresh fix), nuevo @RequiresPermission decorator, roles.guard (JWT-based O(1)), area.guard (DB query con cache), fix cache-keys bug, Drizzle schema update
C: Admin CRUD — multi-rol endpoints (POST/DELETE /admin/users/:id/roles/:roleId), user_permissions endpoints (GET/PUT/DELETE /admin/users/:id/permissions), updateRolePermissions usa role_permissions con actions, invalida cache de usuarios afectados
D: Actualizar ~15 controllers: @RequiresTool/@RequiresWrite → @RequiresPermission(tool, action)
E: Frontend — matriz roles con acciones granulares, multi-rol UI, nueva página /admin/usuarios/[userId]/permisos, tools dinámicos desde API
F: Smoke tests, script reprovision en VM, verificar auditoría SQL

observations.title: PR-A1 Review: observability-metrics-foundation — BLOCKER issues identified
observations.content:
**What**: Adversarial review of PR-A1 (observability-metrics-foundation) identified 1 CRITICAL and 2 HIGH issues blocking merge.

**Why**: This is a judgment-day blind review to catch architectural, TDD, and test isolation issues before the code reaches main. The metrics stack is foundational; issues now will cascade through PR-A2 and PR-A3.

**Where**: 
- backend/test/metrics.controller.e2e-spec.ts (test isolation, assertion gaps)
- backend/src/core/metrics/metrics.module.ts (forward-compat comments)
- backend/src/app.module.ts (correctly excludes /metrics from TenantMiddleware)

**Learned**:
- **prom-client registry is a global singleton**. When PrometheusModule.register() is called, it invokes prom-client.collectDefaultMetrics() which adds collectors to a module-level register. If two NestApplications are instantiated in the same Jest process (metrics.e2e-spec.ts + app.e2e-spec.ts both importing MetricsModule), the second attempt to register default metrics will fail with "Histogram with name process_cpu_seconds_total already exists".
- **Test assertions do not prove implementation correctness**. The test only asserts presence of ANY prom-client default metric, not that @Public() / @SkipThrottle() decorators are honored, or that custom collector providers can be injected.
- **PrometheusModule controller pattern is underdocumented**. Passing MetricsController to PrometheusModule.register() assumes the library respects @Public() and @SkipThrottle() decorators—this is never tested.
- **Forward-compat gap**: Collector tokens are exported but no integration test proves they can be injected by future services (PR-A2/A3). This could hide wiring errors until later PRs.

observations.title: Apply progress: add-observability-stack (PR-A1 + judgment fixes)
observations.content:
**What**: Applied 4 surgical judgment-day fixes on PR-A1 slice of add-observability-stack. New commit `40fdd96` on `feat/observability-metrics-foundation` on top of `7b4eee3`.

**Why**: Judgment-Day dual review found: (1) prom-client global registry pollution risk, (2) weak e2e assertions that wouldn't catch missing custom providers, (3) @Public() undocumented as forward-compat marker, (4) path declared in two places (@Controller + PrometheusModule.register).

**Where**: 
- `backend/test/metrics.controller.e2e-spec.ts` — registry isolation (register.clear + collectDefaultMetrics), 3 new HELP-line assertions, full-AppModule describeWithDB suite
- `backend/src/core/metrics/metrics.controller.ts` — @Controller() empty, expanded JSDoc
- `openspec/changes/add-observability-stack/specs/observability/spec.md` — REQ-OBS-001 implementation note (outside git repo)
- `openspec/changes/add-observability-stack/apply-progress.md` — Judgment-Day Fixes section added

**Learned**: 
- ROOT CAUSE Fix 1: PrometheusModule.register() runs at class decoration time (Jest import), NOT inside compile(). collectDefaultMetrics() fires on import. register.clear() in beforeAll wipes defaults AFTER import. Must call collectDefaultMetrics({ register }) again after clear() and BEFORE compile().
- Custom metric providers (makeHistogramProvider etc.) are lazy — they register on prom-client global register when NestJS resolves them inside compile(). After register.clear(), compile() re-registers custom metrics automatically, but NOT the defaults.
- @Controller() (empty) is correct when PrometheusModule owns the path via Reflect.defineMetadata. Path arg in @Controller creates misleading dual declaration silently overridden at runtime.
- Test counts: Suite 1=6 (3 original+3 HELP-line), Suite 2=4 (describeWithDB). 163/163 unit tests, build exit 0.

observations.title: Session summary: PR-A3 add-observability-stack complete
observations.content:
## Goal
Implement PR-A3 slice of add-observability-stack: BullMQ polling service, worker/scheduler metrics HTTP listener on port 9464, and full e2e assertions.

## Discoveries
- @willsoto/nestjs-prometheus creates tokens as 'PROM_METRIC_<NAME_UPPERCASE>' — must use @InjectMetric() not @Inject(name). In tests: getToken(name) from @willsoto/nestjs-prometheus.
- @Global() does NOT eliminate explicit imports in child modules. QueueModule must import MetricsModule explicitly even though AppModule also does.
- 3 pre-existing failures in app.e2e-spec.ts (user_area_assignments relation) — confirmed pre-existing.
- pollAll() resilience: Promise.all() with per-queue try/catch — one Redis timeout doesn't stop others.

## Accomplished
- ✅ BullMqMetricsService created with @InjectMetric(BULLMQ_GAUGE), 9 queue injections, 10s interval, boot poll
- ✅ QueueModule: MetricsModule import + BullMqMetricsService in providers/exports
- ✅ worker.ts + scheduler.ts: http.createServer on 0.0.0.0:9464 with /metrics handler
- ✅ metrics.controller.e2e-spec.ts Suite 2: 4 new PR-A3 assertions
- ✅ 190/190 unit + 14/14 e2e PASS. Build exit 0.

observations.title: Exploration: AI agent WhatsApp acopio (wsp-agent-acopio)
observations.content:
**What**: Exploración completa del flujo WhatsApp acopio actual y diseño del agente IA de reemplazo en paralelo.

**Why**: El bot actual corre íntegramente en n8n (Static Data para debounce y pending batch) con OpenRouter para parsear texto libre. El objetivo es reemplazarlo con un agente IA conversacional con tool calling real, que corra dentro del backend NestJS y mantenga historia de conversación en Redis.

**Where**: 
- `backend/src/modules/chat-wsp-acopio/` — módulo existente (NO tocar)
- `infra/n8n/traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio.json` — workflow existente (NO tocar)
- Nuevo: `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/`
- `openspec/changes/wsp-agent-acopio/exploration.md`

**Learned**:
- **MESSAGES_UPSERT está deshabilitado globalmente** en docker-compose.vm.yml (WEBHOOK_EVENTS_MESSAGES_UPSERT: 'false'). Los mensajes llegan a n8n vía webhook per-instancia configurado en Evolution API REST. El global webhook del backend solo recibe connection.update + qrcode.
- **Debounce actual vive en n8n Static Data** (RAM del proceso n8n) — no sobrevive reinicios. El pending batch también es volátil.
- **Tenant hardcodeado**: x-tenant-id: perufrost en ambos HTTP nodes de n8n. El agente necesita mapeo instancia→tenant via env var.
- **Framework recomendado: Vercel AI SDK** (ai + @ai-sdk/openai) con baseURL de OpenRouter. Sin overhead de LangChain, soporta tool calling tipado, compatible con Gemma 4 27B.
- **Redis disponible vía @nestjs-modules/ioredis** con CacheService. El agente usa prefijo wsp-agent: en DB 0.
- **Estrategia paralela**: modo shadow first — el agente procesa pero no responde por WhatsApp hasta validar equivalencia. Feature flag: WSP_AGENT_ENABLED.
- **Tools mínimos**: search_catalog, create_arrival, update_arrival, get_arrivals_today — llaman directamente AcopioCatalogService y AcopioArrivalsService (imports directos).
- **El x-tenant-id no viene de Evolution API**: mapear instancia→tenant por env var WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP.

observations.title: sdd/wsp-agent-acopio/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: WhatsApp AI Agent for Acopio (wsp-agent-acopio)

## Intent
Replace the fragile n8n acopio bot (debounce/batch in n8n Static Data lost on restart, hardcoded tenant perufrost, one-shot LLM parse into /chat-wsp-acopio resolve+commit) with a real conversational agent: typed tool calling, durable Redis session, per-phone permissions, multi-tenant — running inside the backend.

## Scope
### In Scope
- New additive NestJS module backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/.
- New webhook endpoint (second endpoint; Evolution API config untouched).
- Vercel AI SDK (ai + OpenRouter, Gemma 4 27B) agent loop with tool calling.
- Redis session: history per phone+tenant, 30min TTL (CacheService, prefix wsp-agent:).
- Redis atomic debounce: 60s burst grouping per phone+tenant.
- Phone permission model: per-tenant table phone -> role -> allowed tools.
- Modular tool registry (per-tenant/per-role). Initial: search_catalog, create_arrival, update_arrival, get_arrivals_today.
- Confirmation flow: interpret -> read tools -> summarize+ask -> on confirm -> commit tools -> reply.
- Outbound-only group notifications.
- Shadow mode flag WSP_AGENT_ENABLED per tenant.
- Env vars in docker-compose.vm.yml only.

### Out of Scope
- Touching chat-wsp-acopio, n8n workflows, Evolution API config.
- Inbound group message processing.
- Removing n8n bot (runs in parallel until validated).
- New docker container / structural docker changes.
- Document generation / future tools (registry-ready only).

## Capabilities
### New
- wsp-agent-acopio: conversational agent (webhook, debounce, AI SDK loop, confirmation).
- wsp-agent-session: Redis history + burst debounce per phone+tenant.
- wsp-agent-permissions: per-tenant phone->role->tool authorization.
- wsp-agent-tools: modular per-tenant/per-role tool registry (4 initial acopio tools).
- wsp-agent-notifications: outbound-only WhatsApp group alerts.
### Modified
- None. produccion-* specs and chat-wsp-acopio untouched.

## Approach
Additive module. Webhook resolves tenant via WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP, buffers messages with Redis atomic debounce key (60s). On flush, load history from Redis, run Vercel AI SDK loop with tools authorized for phone role, call read tools, summarize+ask, on confirm call commit tools (AcopioCatalogService/AcopioArrivalsService via direct imports). Reply via Evolution API only when WSP_AGENT_ENABLED; else shadow-log. Tenant data access wrapped in withTenantDb.

## Affected Areas
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/ (New)
- infra/postgres/tenant-template/*.sql (Modified — new wsp_agent_phone_permissions table)
- infra/docker-compose.vm.yml (Modified — env vars only)
- backend/src/app.module.ts (Modified — wire module)

## Risks
- Wrong/duplicate vs n8n (Med) -> shadow mode off until validated.
- LLM commit hallucination (Med) -> read-then-confirm flow.
- Redis session loss (Low) -> 30min TTL, degrade to fresh.
- Unconfigured phone access (Low) -> default deny/read-only.
- OpenRouter/Gemma latency/outage (Med) -> debounce buffer + timeout; n8n parallel.

## Rollback Plan
Set WSP_AGENT_ENABLED=false for all tenants — agent stops sending; n8n stays live (never disabled during change). Full revert: remove webhook registration + unwire module from app.module.ts. New tenant table is additive/harmless; drop only if clean rollback required.

## Dependencies
- Redis + CacheService (@nestjs-modules/ioredis).
- AcopioCatalogService / AcopioArrivalsService (direct imports).
- OpenRouter API key (Gemma 4 27B).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Agent processes debounced burst, correct tool calls in shadow mode matching n8n.
- [ ] History + corrections across messages within one session (Redis).
- [ ] Phone permissions enforced: unconfigured number denied/read-only.
- [ ] Group outbound alert fires on new arrival / status change.
- [ ] WSP_AGENT_ENABLED toggles live sending without affecting n8n path.

observations.content:
# Delta Specs: wsp-agent-acopio (5 New Capabilities)

All specs are FULL (new domains, no existing specs to delta against).

## Domain: wsp-agent-acopio

### Requirement: Inbound Webhook Ingestion
POST endpoint receives Evolution API MESSAGES_UPSERT. MUST respond 200 immediately, process async. MUST reject unknown instances (silent discard). MUST resolve tenant via WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP. MUST ignore non-text messages.
- Scenario: Valid message → 200 + enqueue debounce
- Scenario: Unknown instance → 200 + no processing
- Scenario: Non-text message → 200 + silent discard

### Requirement: Conversational Agent Loop
MUST load history before LLM. MUST use only role-authorized tools. MUST summarize + ask confirmation before commit tools. MUST handle corrections within session.
- Scenario: Read-then-confirm (search_catalog → summary → ask)
- Scenario: User confirms → commit tool called → reply
- Scenario: User corrects → re-reason → updated summary
- Scenario: Unauthorized tool → role-appropriate denial

### Requirement: Shadow Mode
WSP_AGENT_ENABLED controls replies. false → process fully, DB writes on confirm, reply logged not sent. true → DB writes + real WhatsApp reply. SHOULD toggle without restart.
- Scenario: Shadow → DB writes + log only
- Scenario: Live → DB writes + WhatsApp reply

## Domain: wsp-agent-session

### Requirement: Message Debounce
MUST buffer per phone+tenant in Redis, 60s sliding window. Concurrent messages MUST extend window atomically (no duplicate jobs). On expiry, flush batch to agent.
- Scenario: Single message → 60s timer → flush
- Scenario: Burst extends window → timer reset → flush together
- Scenario: Concurrent arrivals → exactly one job created

### Requirement: Conversation History
MUST persist history in Redis, 30min TTL per phone+tenant. MUST load before each agent invocation. MUST survive across debounce windows within TTL. SHOULD degrade gracefully on expiry.
- Scenario: History within TTL → full context loaded
- Scenario: TTL expired → fresh conversation, no error

## Domain: wsp-agent-permissions

### Requirement: Phone Authorization
Table wsp_agent_phone_permissions: phone_e164, role, allowed_tools[], is_active. MUST deny (silent ignore) for absent or inactive phones. Tenant resolved before lookup.
- Scenario: Active phone → authorized → proceed
- Scenario: Unknown phone → silent discard
- Scenario: Inactive phone → silent discard (same as unknown)

### Requirement: Role-Based Tool Access
Role maps to allowed_tools[]. MUST filter LLM tools to phone's list. OPERATOR SHOULD get read+create. SUPERVISOR SHOULD get read+create+update.
- Scenario: OPERATOR → 3 tools available
- Scenario: SUPERVISOR → 4 tools available

## Domain: wsp-agent-tools

### Requirement: Declarative Tool Registration
Each tool: name, description, Zod schema, handler, requiredRole. Registry filters by role. New tool MUST NOT require agent core changes.
- Scenario: Registered tool appears in filtered list
- Scenario: New tool file added → available without core changes

### Requirement: Initial Acopio Tools
4 tools: search_catalog, create_arrival, update_arrival, get_arrivals_today. Handlers import services directly (no HTTP). MUST use withTenantDb.
- Scenario: search_catalog resolves provider
- Scenario: create_arrival writes record
- Scenario: get_arrivals_today returns today's list

## Domain: wsp-agent-notifications

### Requirement: Outbound Group Alerts
sendGroupAlert(tenantId, groupJid, message) via Evolution API REST. Group JIDs configurable per tenant. MUST respect WSP_AGENT_ENABLED.
- Scenario: Alert sent on arrival creation (live mode)
- Scenario: Alert logged not sent (shadow mode)

### Requirement: Inbound Group Message Rejection
MUST ignore all messages from group JIDs (@g.us). No debounce, no processing, no response.
- Scenario: Group message → silent discard, no debounce timer

observations.title: sdd/wsp-agent-acopio/design
observations.content:
# Design: wsp-agent-acopio (WhatsApp AI Agent for Acopio)

## Technical Approach
Additive NestJS 11 module (ESM, .js import suffixes). Second webhook, separate from chat-wsp-acopio (untouched). Evolution API posts MESSAGES_UPSERT -> controller returns 200, fires async. KEY: processing runs OUTSIDE the HTTP request -> NO TenantMiddleware. Module resolves tenant from WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP, builds TenantContextData, wraps all data access in tenantCtx.run(...) so TenantDbService sets search_path (replicates middleware contract manually). History + burst debounce in Redis via CacheService (prefix wsp-agent:). Agent loop = Vercel AI SDK generateText vs OpenRouter (Gemma). Tools call AcopioCatalogService/AcopioArrivalsService directly (no HTTP). All outbound gated by WSP_AGENT_ENABLED (shadow mode).

## Architecture Decisions
- Tenant context off-request: manual tenantCtx.run(data, fn) in WspAgentService (async flow has no request; keeps withTenantDb/search_path invariant).
- Permissions table in PUBLIC schema with tenant_id col (per orchestrator) vs tenant-template (proposal) -> OPEN QUESTION. Public chosen for cross-tenant phone lookup before tenant data access.
- Debounce: Redis SET NX EX lock + buffer list + setTimeout(60s) flush (CacheService wraps ioredis; SET NX = exactly-one-scheduler; BullMQ is upgrade path for restart durability).
- Outbound HTTP: native fetch (Node 20+), NOT @nestjs/axios (not installed).
- Tool registry: declarative array filtered by allowedTools, mapped to AI SDK tool(). New tool = new file + registry entry, zero core changes.
- Confirmation gate: system-prompt enforced; read tools run free, create/update require a prior confirmation turn in history.

## File Changes (all under backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/ unless noted)
- wsp-agent-acopio.module.ts (Create) imports AcopioModule, CacheModule, TenantModule, DatabaseModule
- wsp-agent-acopio.controller.ts (Create) @Public() + WspAgentSecretGuard, returns 200, fires async
- dto/evolution-webhook.dto.ts (Create)
- services/wsp-agent.service.ts (Create) generateText loop + system prompt + tenantCtx.run wrapper
- services/wsp-session.service.ts (Create) Redis history 30min + atomic debounce 60s
- services/wsp-permissions.service.ts (Create) phone->role->allowedTools (public schema)
- services/wsp-notifier.service.ts (Create) Evolution REST outbound, gated by WSP_AGENT_ENABLED
- tools/tool-registry.ts + tools/{search-catalog,create-arrival,update-arrival,get-arrivals-today}.tool.ts (Create)
- guards/wsp-agent-secret.guard.ts (Create) x-wsp-agent-secret timing-safe (mirrors ChatWspSecretGuard)
- backend/src/db/schema/public/wsp-agent.ts (Create) + export in public/index.ts
- infra/postgres/init/*.sql (Modify) DDL for both tables
- backend/src/app.module.ts (Modify) register WspAgentAcopioModule
- infra/docker-compose.vm.yml (Modify) WSP_AGENT_* env vars
- backend/package.json (Modify) add deps: ai, @ai-sdk/openai, zod

## Drizzle schema (public)
wspAgentRoleEnum = pgEnum('wsp_agent_role', ['OPERATOR','SUPERVISOR','ADMIN'])
wsp_agent_phone_permissions: id uuid pk, tenant_id uuid FK tenants.id, phone_e164 text, role enum, allowed_tools text[] default [], is_active bool default true, created_at/updated_at tz. uniqueIndex(tenant_id, phone_e164).
wsp_agent_group_targets: id uuid pk, tenant_id uuid FK, group_jid text, label text, event_types text[] default [], is_active bool, created_at tz.

## Redis keys (CacheService)
wsp-agent:buffer:{tenantId}:{phone} (list TTL 65s), wsp-agent:debounce:{tenantId}:{phone} (SET NX EX 60), wsp-agent:history:{tenantId}:{phone} (JSON TTL 1800s).

## Agent loop
generateText({ model, system, messages, tools, maxSteps:6 }). AI SDK runs tool round-trips internally; each handler executes inside active tenantCtx.run. result.text = reply. Corrections: full history reloaded per window -> re-reason without dup writes.

## Env vars (docker-compose.vm.yml only)
WSP_AGENT_ENABLED=false, WSP_AGENT_SECRET, WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP=traceexport:perufrost, WSP_AGENT_OPENROUTER_API_KEY, WSP_AGENT_OPENROUTER_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, WSP_AGENT_EVOLUTION_URL=http://evolution-api:8080, WSP_AGENT_MODEL=google/gemma-2-27b-it.

## Rollout
Shadow-first: tables additive, deploy ENABLED=false (processes+writes on confirm, logs replies not sent), n8n parallel. Flip true per validation. Rollback = flag false (n8n untouched) -> full revert unwires module.

## Open Questions
- Permissions table public vs tenant-template (confirm before SQL).
- Gemma model id google/gemma-2-27b-it vs Gemma-3/4 on OpenRouter (verify tool-calling support).
- setTimeout debounce restart durability vs BullMQ delayed job now (buffer survives in Redis; scheduler volatile).

## Conventions verified in codebase
- ESM imports with .js suffix mandatory.
- @Public() decorator + secret guard pattern from chat-wsp-acopio.
- No @nestjs/axios installed -> use native fetch.
- ai/@ai-sdk/openai/zod NOT installed -> new deps.
- TenantContext.run(data, fn) signature; TenantContextData = {tenantId, tenantSlug, schemaName, countryCode?, glnPrefix?, userId?, companyId?, isSuperadmin?}.

observations.title: Fixed 6 issues in wsp-agent-acopio module
observations.content:
**What**: Applied 6 surgical fixes to the wsp-agent-acopio WhatsApp agent module.
**Why**: Judgment-day review found critical bugs: DTO had no class-validator decorators (all webhooks 400'd), JID not normalized to E.164 (permission lookups always failed), guard failed open without secret, debounce lock never released, history unbounded, CacheService accessed via `as any` cast.
**Where**:
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/dto/evolution-webhook.dto.ts — added full class-validator + class-transformer decorators
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/wsp-agent-acopio.controller.ts — added normalizeJid() helper, applied before processIncoming()
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/guards/wsp-agent-secret.guard.ts — guard now throws UnauthorizedException when WSP_AGENT_SECRET not configured
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-session.service.ts — removed `as any` cast, uses typed CacheService methods, added clearDebounce(), history capped at 20 messages
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-agent.service.ts — calls clearDebounce() in finally block after runAgentWindow()
- backend/src/core/cache/cache.service.ts — added setNx(), rpush(), lpush(), lrange(), expire() typed methods
**Learned**: normalizeJid strips @*.net with regex /@[^@]+$/ (covers both @s.whatsapp.net and @c.us). Debounce lock TTL=60s meant stranded messages up to 60s without explicit clearDebounce(). History trim must be slice(-20) BEFORE saving, not after loading.

observations.content:
**What**: Migración del frontend de VM Docker a Vercel + nginx como único punto de entrada público en la VM para backend/n8n/grafana bajo escorpia.com.

**Why**: El usuario quería sacar el frontend de la VM y exponer los servicios con HTTPS real bajo dominio propio.

**Where**: infra/docker-compose.vm.yml, infra/nginx/nginx.conf, frontend/next.config.ts, frontend/src/middleware.ts, frontend/.env.production

**Learned**:
- output:standalone en next.config.ts rompe el routing dinámico en Vercel (404 en [tenant] routes). Solo para Docker.
- proxy.ts con función proxy() NO corre como middleware de Next.js — necesita src/middleware.ts que exporte { proxy as middleware, config }.
- NEXT_PUBLIC_* se hornean en build time en Vercel — .env.production debe estar commiteado (solo vars públicas) o seteado en Vercel dashboard.
- Cloudflare modo Full SSL exige HTTPS 443 en el origen. Self-signed cert wildcard *.escorpia.com generado en /opt/traceexport/produccion-infra/nginx/certs/ (gitignoreado).
- nginx cachea IPs de upstream al inicio — recrear n8n/grafana DESPUÉS de nginx da 502 hasta reiniciar nginx.
- proxy_params ya tiene proxy_http_version y proxy_read_timeout — duplicarlos en un location block da error fatal de nginx.
- compose real de producción: docker-compose.vm.yml (no docker-compose.prod.yml).
- Arquitectura final: Cloudflare proxy ON → nginx :80/:443 → backend:3000 / n8n:5678 / grafana:3000. Frontend en Vercel app.escorpia.com. Solo nginx expuesto públicamente.
- Para Vercel custom domain: CNAME app → cname.vercel-dns.com con proxy CF OFF (gris).
- Commits backend locales sin push aún (sesiones anteriores pendientes).

observations.title: Judgment Day mobile/ — offline-first audit y fixes
observations.content:
**What**: Auditoría SDD completa del directorio mobile/ + 7 fixes aplicados + 6 tests nuevos. 4 rondas de Judgment Day con jueces ciegos en paralelo.

**Why**: El usuario pidió auditar mobile/ para verificar que el modo offline funciona correctamente.

**Where**:
- mobile/app/(app)/forms/[formId].tsx — rama offline muerta + race condition toast/alert
- mobile/components/forms/fields/TimeField.tsx — MINUTES 12 entradas → 60
- mobile/stores/sync.ts — formId y operationType en batch
- backend/src/modules/sync/dto/sync-flush.dto.ts — operationType opcional, formId nuevo
- backend/src/modules/sync/sync.service.ts — formId threaded
- backend/src/queues/processors/sync-offline.processor.ts — guard MISSING_FORM_ID, formId? opcional
- backend/src/queues/processors/sync-offline.processor.spec.ts — 6 tests processGenericForm (19/19 passing)

**Learned**:
- La rama `else { submit() }` era código muerto porque `else if (!targetEndpoint || targetEndpoint === '/noop')` es el complemento exacto del `if` anterior — ningún valor de targetEndpoint puede llegar al else. Fix: quitar `!targetEndpoint ||` del else if.
- formId nunca viajó en el batch de /sync/flush — hardcodeado como '' en sync.service.ts. Backend lanzaba FORM_NOT_FOUND críptico. Fix: agregar formId al DTO + service + SyncOfflineJobData.
- operationType '' con @IsNotEmpty() en el DTO rechazaba forms genéricos a nivel de validación. Fix: @IsOptional().
- setSubmitted(true) ANTES del showAlert offline causa toast de éxito + alert simultáneos + auto-dismiss de 1.5s en paralelo. Fix: setSubmitted solo en mode === 'online'.
- La infraestructura SQLite/NetInfo/syncAll es correcta y bien diseñada — el único punto de falla era la lógica de routing del form screen.
- DateField firstDayOffset (getDay()+6)%7 ES correcto para ISO week — Judge B estaba equivocado.
- Pendientes no críticos: conditions.ts hide+require conflict, form_queue no se limpia en logout, PhotoField base64 inline en vez de R2 URL.

observations.title: Exploración: contrato extracción-validación acopio (validacion-extraccion-contrato)
observations.content:
**What**: Full exploration of the extraction-validation contract in the acopio module. Field role taxonomy, contract map, save path audit, pre-fill audit, cross-check coverage, and approach comparison.

**Why**: User requested a formal exploration before proposing a fix for the broken contract between n8n extraction, semaphore evaluation, mobile validation UI, and metadata save.

**Where**: 
- `openspec/changes/validacion-extraccion-contrato/exploration.md` (full artifact)
- `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx` (DOC_FIELDS, pre-fill, save)
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` (saveValidation)
- `backend/src/modules/document-engine/document-engine.service.ts` (review - the right path)
- `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/008-012*.sql` (catalog)
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/resolvers/acopio-context-resolver.ts` (all 5 refs resolve OK)

**Learned**:
- CRITICAL: saveValidation() NEVER calls DocumentEngineService.review(). The semaphore is evaluated once on n8n callback and NEVER re-evaluated after human correction. human_corrected_json = NULL in all 51 production rows.
- CRITICAL BUG: `numero_permiso` in mobile DOC_FIELDS is a phantom field — not in catalog extraction_fields, never extracted by n8n, will always be empty.
- 17 catalog fields are NOT shown in mobile (all CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA fields except GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA).
- All 5 `equals` cross-check rules resolve correctly via AcopioContextResolver.
- Pre-fill conflict risk: muelle_descarga/punto_partida/codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria_muelle are pre-filled from acopioConfig for BARCO directo. Safe today because BARCO_DIRECTO_DOC_TYPES filters GUIA_REMITENTE, but brittle.
- DocumentEngineService.review() is fully implemented and correct — just never called from the mobile save path.
- Recommended approach: Phase 1 (fix phantom field + wire semaphore re-evaluation via review()), Phase 2 (add field_role to ExtractionField DSL, make mobile catalog-driven).
- trace_event_log is NOT affected by this change. Confirmed out of scope.

observations.title: Propuesta Phase 1 validacion-extraccion-contrato
observations.content:
# Proposal: Validación de extracción — contrato Phase 1

> Change: validacion-extraccion-contrato (Phase 1) · Store: hybrid · Project: backend · TDD: ON

## Intent
El semáforo documental se evalúa una sola vez en el callback de n8n y nunca se recalcula al corregir un campo. saveValidation() escribe solo a acopio_arrival_assets.metadata y nunca llama a DocumentEngineService.review() (human_corrected_json = NULL en las 51 filas de producción). 17 campos extraídos son invisibles en mobile; numero_permiso es campo fantasma nunca extraído. Phase 1 cierra el contrato sin cambios de esquema.

## Scope
### In Scope
- Eliminar campo fantasma numero_permiso de DOC_FIELDS (PERMISO_PESCA).
- Cablear saveValidation() -> DocumentEngineService.review() por documento, pasando solo campos RELLENO; recalcula semáforo y escribe human_corrected_json.
- Mostrar los 17 campos extraídos en mobile según rol: CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA read-only; RELLENO editable.
- CRUCE: indicador match/mismatch desde validation_results_json existente. VIGENCIA: card "vence en X días". Sin re-fetch.
- Constante única backend (campos RELLENO por tipo de doc) + contract test que falla si mobile desincroniza.
### Out of Scope
- Phase 2 (catalog-driven, field_role en DSL, storage_key); FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE en UI; edición CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA; override de cruce; cambios en prompts n8n.

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- acopio-document-validation: contrato entre extracción n8n, evaluación de semáforo, UI de validación mobile y persistencia de metadata; roles de campo (RELLENO/CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA) y re-evaluación de semáforo en cada save.
### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Approach
Approach 4 (fase 1) del exploration: reutilizar DocumentEngineService.review() (ya implementado, dead code desde acopio). saveValidation() mantiene escritura a metadata (backward-compat) y además itera documentos del asset llamando review(documentId, rellenoFields, userId). El mapeo "campos RELLENO por tipo de doc" vive en constante backend (single source of truth), consumida por mobile vía endpoint o validada por contract test.
DECISION PENDIENTE (design): clasificación de numero_guia y placa_furgo (aparecen en AUDITORIA y RELLENO). Regla: RELLENO si se persiste en metadata para consumo downstream; AUDITORIA si solo alimenta required del semáforo. Auditar consumidores reales antes de spec.

## Affected Areas
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx — Modified — DOC_FIELDS, render por rol, quitar fantasma
- backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts — Modified — saveValidation() llama review()
- backend/src/modules/document-engine/document-engine.service.ts — Reused — review() ya existe
- backend/src/modules/acopio (nueva constante) — New — mapa RELLENO por doc type + contract test

## Risks
- Semáforo cambia color en 51 filas existentes (Med): metadata sigue canónica; ambos se actualizan, sin pérdida.
- human_corrected_json no acumula/overwrite (Med): documentar; metadata sí acumula vía ||.
- Mobile DOC_FIELDS desincroniza de catálogo (Med): contract test falla en CI.
- Clasificación ambigua RELLENO/AUDITORIA (Low): auditar downstream en design antes de spec.

## Rollback Plan
Revertir el commit: saveValidation() vuelve a escribir solo metadata; mobile recupera DOC_FIELDS anterior. Sin migración nueva ni cambio de esquema -> no hay estado que deshacer. human_corrected_json queda como estaba.

## Dependencies
- DocumentEngineService.review() (existente, sin cambios funcionales).
- AcopioContextResolver (resuelve los 5 refs equals, confirmado OK).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Cada campo extraído por n8n visible en su bloque de documento en mobile.
- [ ] CRUCE muestra valor locked + check/X según validation_results_json.
- [ ] VIGENCIA muestra "vence en X días" / "venció hace X días".
- [ ] Tras guardar, semáforo en entry_documents se recalcula con valores corregidos (verificable API/DB).
- [ ] numero_permiso ya no aparece en PERMISO_PESCA.
- [ ] human_corrected_json se escribe por documento tocado.
- [ ] acopio_arrival_assets.metadata conserva todas las keys actuales (backward-compat downstream).
- [ ] Sin cambios en trace_event_log ni hash GS1.

observations.title: Spec Phase 1 validacion-extraccion-contrato
observations.content:
# acopio-document-validation Specification

## Purpose

Defines the contract between n8n document extraction, semaphore evaluation,
mobile validation UI, and metadata persistence for the acopio arrival workflow.
Covers field role classification (RELLENO / CRUCE / VIGENCIA / AUDITORIA),
display rules per role, save behavior, semaphore re-evaluation, and
mobile–backend synchronization guarantees.

Out of scope: FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE, editing CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA fields,
override policies for cross-check mismatches, Phase 2 catalog-driven mobile.

---

## Requirements

### Requirement: Field Role Taxonomy

Every extracted field for each document type MUST be assigned exactly one role:
RELLENO (operator-editable, persisted to metadata), CRUCE (cross-check read-only),
VIGENCIA (expiry date read-only), or AUDITORIA (audit read-only).
The canonical mapping MUST be a single TypeScript constant in backend consumed by
`saveValidation()`; mobile `DOC_FIELDS` MUST mirror it and a contract test MUST
fail CI if either side diverges.

`numero_guia` and `placa_furgo` from GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA are classified RELLENO
because downstream consumers (trace export PDF, GS1 callback) require them in
`acopio_arrival_assets.metadata`.

#### Scenario: Contract test catches mobile drift

- **Given** the backend RELLENO constant lists `numero_guia` under GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA
- **When** a developer removes `numero_guia` from mobile `DOC_FIELDS` without updating the backend constant
- **Then** the contract test fails CI with a message listing the diverging field

#### Scenario: Contract test passes when both sides match

- **Given** the backend RELLENO constant and mobile `DOC_FIELDS` list identical RELLENO fields per document type
- **When** the contract test runs
- **Then** the test passes

---

### Requirement: CRUCE Field Display

A field classified CRUCE MUST be rendered read-only with its extracted value visible.
The system MUST display a match indicator (green check) when the extracted value equals
the reference value in `validation_results_json`; a mismatch indicator (red ✗) when
they differ.

#### Scenario: CRUCE match — matricula equal

- **Given** a SANIPES_EMBARCACION document where extracted `matricula` = "PL-67291-CM" and `vessel.registration` = "PL-67291-CM"
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** `matricula` renders as read-only with value "PL-67291-CM" and a green check indicator

#### Scenario: CRUCE mismatch — matricula differs

- **Given** a SANIPES_EMBARCACION document where extracted `matricula` = "PL-99999-XX" and `vessel.registration` = "PL-67291-CM"
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** `matricula` renders as read-only with value "PL-99999-XX" and a red ✗ indicator

---

### Requirement: VIGENCIA Field Display

A field classified VIGENCIA MUST be rendered read-only as a date with a human-readable
countdown. The system MUST show "vence en X días" when the date is in the future,
"venció hace X días" when past, and a deterministic null label when the date is absent.

#### Scenario: Future expiry

- **Given** `fecha_vencimiento` = today + 30 days
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** the field displays "vence en 30 días" below the date value

#### Scenario: Past expiry

- **Given** `fecha_vencimiento` = today − 5 days
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** the field displays "venció hace 5 días" below the date value

#### Scenario: Null expiry

- **Given** `fecha_vencimiento` is null or absent in the extracted data
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** the field displays "sin fecha de vencimiento"

---

### Requirement: AUDITORIA Field Display

A field classified AUDITORIA MUST be rendered read-only showing its extracted value.
No indicator, countdown, or edit control is shown.

#### Scenario: AUDITORIA renders extracted value

- **Given** a ZARPE document with extracted field `puerto_zarpe` = "Arica"
- **When** the validation screen loads
- **Then** `puerto_zarpe` renders as read-only text "Arica" with no edit affordance

---

### Requirement: RELLENO Field Display and Local Edit

A field classified RELLENO MUST be rendered as an editable text input pre-filled with
the extracted value. Local state MUST update as the operator types; no auto-save occurs.

#### Scenario: Pre-filled on initial render

- **Given** a GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA document with extracted `numero_guia` = "GR-00123"
- **When** the validation screen first loads
- **Then** the `numero_guia` input shows "GR-00123" as its initial value

#### Scenario: Local state update on edit

- **Given** the `numero_guia` input is showing "GR-00123"
- **When** the operator changes the value to "GR-00456"
- **Then** the input displays "GR-00456" and the pending save payload reflects the new value

---

### Requirement: Phantom Field Removal

The field `numero_permiso` MUST NOT appear in the PERMISO_PESCA document block in the
validation UI. It MUST NOT be included in any save payload or persisted to
`acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` by new code paths.

#### Scenario: numero_permiso absent from UI

- **Given** a PERMISO_PESCA document with its catalog-defined extracted fields
- **When** the validation screen renders the PERMISO_PESCA block
- **Then** no field labeled or keyed `numero_permiso` is visible

---

### Requirement: Backward Compatibility of Existing Metadata

Existing rows in `acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` MUST NOT be modified, migrated,
or have keys removed by this change. Any key present in metadata before the change
MUST remain accessible unchanged after deployment.

#### Scenario: Legacy numero_permiso key preserved

- **Given** an arrival asset whose metadata contains `{ "numero_permiso": "P-2024-001", ... }` from before this change was deployed
- **When** a read query fetches that asset's metadata
- **Then** the `numero_permiso` key and its value are returned unchanged

---

### Requirement: Save Endpoint — Separation by Field Role

`POST /acopio/arrivals/:id/save-validation` MUST accept `{ arrivalAssetId, extractedFields, manualFields }`.
Only RELLENO fields from `extractedFields` MUST be passed to `DocumentEngineService.review()` for each document in the asset.
Non-RELLENO fields MUST NOT be forwarded to `review()`.
All RELLENO fields plus `manualFields` MUST be merged into `acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` along with `validated_by`, `validated_at`, and `batch_number`.

#### Scenario: Save routes only RELLENO to review

- **Given** an asset with a GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA document and extracted fields including RELLENO `numero_guia` and AUDITORIA `rut_transportista`
- **When** the operator saves the validation form
- **Then** `review()` is called with only `{ numero_guia }` and NOT with `rut_transportista`

#### Scenario: Save merges all fields into metadata

- **Given** the operator saves with RELLENO field `numero_guia` = "GR-00456" and `manualFields` = `{ "batch_number": "LOT-99" }`
- **When** save completes
- **Then** `acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` contains `numero_guia`, `batch_number`, `validated_by`, and `validated_at`

---

### Requirement: Semaphore Re-evaluation on Every Save

`DocumentEngineService.review()` MUST be called for every document in the asset on every save, regardless of the document's current `semaphore_status`.
After `review()` completes, `validation_results_json` and `semaphore_status` in `entry_documents` MUST reflect the values computed from the corrected RELLENO fields.

#### Scenario: Review called even when semaphore is already GREEN

- **Given** an asset whose document has `semaphore_status` = GREEN
- **When** the operator saves without changing any RELLENO field
- **Then** `review()` is still invoked for that document (verifiable via spy/mock)
- **And** `semaphore_status` remains GREEN

#### Scenario: Semaphore re-evaluated after operator correction

- **Given** a document with `semaphore_status` = RED due to a missing required field
- **When** the operator fills in the missing RELLENO field and saves
- **Then** `review()` is called with the corrected value and `semaphore_status` updates to GREEN

---

### Requirement: human_corrected_json Written Per Changed Document

For each document in the asset where the operator changed at least one RELLENO field, `human_corrected_json` MUST be written with the corrected field values.
Documents where no RELLENO field was changed MUST NOT have `human_corrected_json` written or overwritten by this save call.

#### Scenario: human_corrected_json written on change

- **Given** an asset with two documents: GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA and ZARPE
- **When** the operator changes `numero_guia` in GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA and saves
- **Then** `human_corrected_json` is written for GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA
- **And** `human_corrected_json` for ZARPE is NOT touched

#### Scenario: No write when no RELLENO change

- **Given** an asset with a CERT_PROCEDENCIA document
- **When** the operator saves without modifying any RELLENO field in CERT_PROCEDENCIA
- **Then** `human_corrected_json` for CERT_PROCEDENCIA is NOT written or overwritten

---

### Requirement: All Documents of Asset Reviewed Before Response

All documents belonging to the asset MUST be reviewed by `review()` before the save response is returned.
A partial save MUST NOT reach the client as a success response.

#### Scenario: All documents reviewed before success

- **Given** an asset with three documents (ZARPE, SANIPES_EMBARCACION, GUIA_REMITENTE)
- **When** the operator saves
- **Then** `review()` is called for all three documents before the HTTP 200 response is sent

#### Scenario: Partial failure does not return success

- **Given** an asset with two documents where `review()` throws for the second document
- **When** the save request is processed
- **Then** the response is an error (HTTP 4xx or 5xx) and neither document's state is committed

---

### Requirement: No Modification to trace_event_log or GS1 Hash

This change MUST NOT write to `trace_event_log`, modify any GS1 hash input, or affect any GS1/EPCIS data flow.

#### Scenario: trace_event_log untouched after save

- **Given** a tenant with existing `trace_event_log` rows
- **When** any operator saves a validation form
- **Then** the row count and content of `trace_event_log` are identical before and after the save

---
