observations.title: Design Phase 1 validacion-extraccion-contrato
observations.content:
# Design: Validación de extracción — contrato Phase 1

## Technical Approach
Wire saveValidation() into the already-implemented (never-called) DocumentEngineService.review() so the documental semaphore re-evaluates on every save. Split incoming fields by role (RELLENO/CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA) from a single backend constant mirrored in mobile, guarded by a contract test. Mobile renders all 17 extracted fields read-only-by-role; RELLENO stays editable. No schema change (human_corrected_json exists, schema line 177). Reuses review(), ValidationRuleEngine, SemaphoreCalculator, AcopioContextResolver.

## Architecture Decisions (D1-D10 resolved)
- D1 Atomicity: Add reviewMany(items,userId) on DocumentEngineService wrapping loop in ONE tenantDb.transaction(queryFn); refactor review() to delegate to private reviewWithQuery(queryFn,...). Rationale: review() uses tenantDb.query() which opens its OWN pg.begin() and CANNOT join an outer tx. Injecting queryFn (shape transaction() exposes) gives one BEGIN/COMMIT + true rollback on partial failure (R11). Single-doc review() keeps signature.
- D2 When to call review per doc: diff RELLENO (string-coerced) vs latest corrected (human_corrected_json[key]) else ai_extracted_json[key]; skip empty-diff docs. Honors R10 (no write when unchanged). Helper hasRellenoDiff(doc,relleno).
- D3 Constant shape: Record<DocumentTypeCode, Record<FieldKey, FieldRole>>, FieldRole='RELLENO'|'CRUCE'|'VIGENCIA'|'AUDITORIA'. File backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts. Disposable in Phase-2.
- D4 Contract test: standalone tests/contracts/acopio-field-roles.contract.ts importing both constants, asserting per-doc-type RELLENO-set equality; CI step. Avoids cross-package Jest imports.
- D5 getFieldRole(docType,key): pure fn over constant; undefined=>dropped. Drops CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA from client (UI read-only, defensive) — keeps non-RELLENO out of review() (R8).
- D6 Mobile FieldDef: replace source with role. New MANUAL_FIELDS block unchanged (eslora, fechas, batch). DOC_FIELDS=per-doc extracted-with-role.
- D7 Display: new ExtractedFieldDisplay (mobile/components/acopio/) {role,value,ruleResult?}: CRUCE->locked+check/X from validation_results_json entry field===key (passed); VIGENCIA->daysUntil() countdown; AUDITORIA->locked text; RELLENO->TextInput. daysUntil(dateStr) in mobile/lib/lima-date.ts, America/Lima.
- D8 Backwards compat read: no change. metadata=COALESCE(metadata,'{}')||$1::jsonb preserves untouched keys (R7).
- D9 Migrations: NONE. human_corrected_json column already exists (schema 177).
- D10 Test coverage (TDD red-first): acopio-documents.service.spec.ts (RELLENO->review, metadata merge, drops non-RELLENO); field-roles.spec.ts (getFieldRole per pair); acopio-field-roles.contract.ts; add to document-engine.service.spec.ts: "review no diff => no human_corrected_json write" + reviewMany rollback.

numero_guia & placa_furgo (GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA)=RELLENO (downstream PDF/GS1). numero_permiso removed from PERMISO_PESCA (phantom).

## Data Flow
Mobile renders doc blocks by role -> edit RELLENO -> POST /acopio/arrivals/:id/save-validation {arrivalAssetId,extractedFields,manualFields} -> saveValidation(): (1) split via getFieldRole -> relleno/dropped; (2) load asset docs; (3) tenantDb.transaction(qf): reviewMany(qf) for each doc with hasRellenoDiff -> review writes human_corrected_json + re-runs rules + semaphore_status; (4) UPDATE metadata ||= relleno+manual+validated_by/at+batch_number; (5) COMMIT -> {success, reviewed_document_ids}.

## Interfaces
type FieldRole='RELLENO'|'CRUCE'|'VIGENCIA'|'AUDITORIA';
export const ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES: Record<string,Record<string,FieldRole>>;
export function getFieldRole(docType:string,key:string): FieldRole|undefined;

## Goal
Implement PR 1 (WU-1 + WU-2) of `validacion-extraccion-contrato` change in Strict TDD mode.

## Instructions
- Strict TDD: write failing test FIRST, run to confirm RED, then implement GREEN
- Comments in Spanish, identifiers in English
- Conventional commits, no Co-Authored-By
- Commits stay LOCAL (deploy is manual to VM)
- artifact store: hybrid (engram + openspec/tasks.md with [x] marks)

## Discoveries
- The backend has its own git repo at `backend/` — commits must be done from inside `backend/`, not from the monorepo root (which has a fresh empty git repo initialized separately)
- `pnpm -F backend test --no-coverage` fails with "Unknown option: coverage" — use `pnpm -F backend test` (jest handles no-coverage itself)
- `pnpm -F backend build` times out (>2min) in this environment — TypeScript type check via `tsc --noEmit` also times out; tests are the primary correctness gate
- `TenantDbService.transaction()` signature: `fn: (queryFn: (text, params?) => Promise<R[]>) => Promise<T>` — the queryFn is the pg transaction context, not a Drizzle tx
- `TenantDbService.query()` opens its own `pg.begin()` each call — cannot join an outer tx. That's why reviewWithQuery(queryFn) pattern is needed
- Mock for `transaction()` in tests: `jest.fn(async (fn) => fn(queryFn))` where queryFn is the same mock used for `query` — both share the callQueue

observations.title: SDD apply: consultar fuente externa antes de transcribir contrato
observations.content:
**What**: El sub-agente sdd-apply de PR 1 de `validacion-extraccion-contrato` inventó 16 campos fantasma y omitió 5 campos reales al rellenar `ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES` — exactamente el bug que la propuesta atacaba (`numero_permiso` fantasma) pero multiplicado por 7 doc types. El sdd-verify no lo atrapó porque comparó contra el design (taxonomía abstracta) en lugar de contra la BD real. Costo: un commit fix (245984f) con 20 tests nuevos de paridad exacta.

**Why**: Cuando un design declara un contrato externo (catálogo en BD, API tercera, schema de n8n) y el apply tiene que transcribirlo, el agente no consulta la fuente — rellena por intuición/nombres comunes (ej. usó `rut_transportista` chileno cuando Perú usa `ruc_transportista`).

**Where**:
- Bug origen: `backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts` (creado por commit 6e1431c, corregido por 245984f)
- Comando que reveló la verdad: `ssh rodrigo@34.31.70.3 'docker exec produccion-infra-postgres-1 psql ... -c "SELECT code, jsonb_pretty(extraction_fields) FROM document_type_catalog WHERE ..."'`

**Learned**:
- Regla SDD: cuando el design referencia un contrato externo concreto (BD, API), el prompt del sdd-apply DEBE incluir el comando exacto para consultar la fuente Y la instrucción "no transcribas de memoria, lee la BD". El orchestrator también puede pasar el resultado de la consulta directamente en el prompt.
- Regla sdd-verify: cuando el spec/design referencia un contrato externo, el verify DEBE leer la fuente real, no comparar implementación vs design (ambos pueden ser igualmente falsos).
- Mitigación a futuro: el test de paridad (`expect(mapKeys).toEqual([...realKeys].sort())`) hardcoded contra la BD es la red de seguridad. Si la BD cambia, el test rompe → migración SQL forzada.
- Esta sesión: el contract test del WU-7 (mobile↔backend) detectaría drift entre paquetes pero no detectaría "ambos paquetes coinciden y ambos están mal vs BD". El test de paridad backend↔BD agregado en el fix cierra ese gap.

**Why**: W1 warning from PR 2 verify: spec R9 said semaphore must be re-evaluated for ALL docs on every save, but implementation (D2) only called reviewManyWithQuery for docs with RELLENO diff — leaving unchanged docs with potentially stale semaphores.

**Where**:
- backend/src/modules/document-engine/document-engine.service.ts — new private evaluateAndPersistSemaphore(); new public reevaluateSemaphoreWithQuery(queryFn, docId), reevaluateSemaphore(docId), reevaluateSemaphoreManyWithQuery(queryFn, docIds[]); reviewWithQuery refactored to reuse helper
- backend/src/modules/document-engine/document-engine.service.spec.ts — 9 new TDD tests
- backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts — saveValidation now produces reviewItems (RELLENO diff) + reevalDocIds (no diff), both dispatched in same transaction
- backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.spec.ts — 4 new R9 tests (zero diff / mixed / all diff / shared queryFn)
- openspec spec R9 rewritten, tasks.md W1 section added
- Commit: e52bdf2, Test count: 278/278

**Learned**: Private helper evaluateAndPersistSemaphore was the key design choice — it avoids SQL duplication across both paths (review writes human_corrected_json then calls the helper; reevaluate calls the helper only). The shared queryFn test (same reference) is the most rigorous atomicity assertion.

observations.title: Verify report PR 3 — validacion-extraccion-contrato
observations.content:
## Verification Report — PR 3 FAIL

**Verdict**: FAIL — CRITICAL regression in `_manual` suffix rename.

### CRITICAL: C1 — `_manual` suffix breaks exportMpPerufrost()
- `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx` writes `muelle_descarga_manual`, `codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria_muelle_manual`, `punto_partida_manual`, `fecha_acta_manual` to state (BARCO arrivals).
- `isExtractedKey()` correctly routes them to `manualFields` (not in ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES).
- `saveValidation()` merges `manualFields` into `acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` under the `_manual` key names.
- `acopio-arrivals.service.ts:1258` reads `aa.metadata->>'muelle_descarga'` and `aa.metadata->>'codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria_muelle'` (no suffix) → NULL for all post-PR3 BARCO arrivals.
- MP Perufrost Excel export will show empty Muelle + Cod. Hab. Muelle columns for BARCO arrivals.

### Fix required
Revert `_manual` suffix in `[arrivalId].tsx` lines 203-206 and 584-615. Use canonical key names without suffix.

### All other checks PASS
- Backend↔mobile parity: 28/28 fields identical
- TypeScript typecheck: 0 errors
- R2 CRUCE, R3 VIGENCIA, R4 AUDITORIA, R5 RELLENO, R6 numero_permiso: all compliant
- R7 existing rows: unaffected

### WARNING: W1 — SANIPES extractKey parity unverified
buildDocFields() never sets extractKey. If n8n extracts with a different key name for SANIPES, the pre-fill will silently show blank.

### Report persisted at
openspec/changes/validacion-extraccion-contrato/verify-report-pr3.md

observations.title: Contract test cross-package: usar ts-node CommonJS, no nodenext
observations.content:
**What**: El contract test cross-package (backend ↔ mobile) necesita un tsconfig propio con `module: "commonjs"` y `moduleResolution: "node"`.

**Why**: El tsconfig del backend usa `module: "nodenext"` que exige extensiones `.js` en imports estáticos. Al importar `../../../mobile/constants/acopio-field-roles` (que tiene su propio tsconfig Expo), el nodenext falla con resolución cross-package. CommonJS resuelve sin extensiones y ts-node lo maneja sin configuración extra.

**Where**: backend/tests/contracts/tsconfig.json

**Learned**: Siempre crear un tsconfig dedicado para scripts de contract/utilities cross-package en monorepos con tsconfigs heterogéneos. `ts-node` ya estaba instalado como devDependency — no instalar `tsx` si `ts-node` ya existe.

## Implementation Summary
### Commits Delivered (all deployed to 34.31.70.3)

**Backend (back-escorpia)**:
1. `6e1431c` feat(acopio): add field-role taxonomy constant for document validation
2. `c84fca3` refactor(document-engine): extract reviewWithQuery, add reviewMany with shared transaction
3. `245984f` fix(acopio): align field-roles map with real n8n catalog (fix 16 phantom fields)
4. `b659193` feat(acopio): wire saveValidation to reviewMany with role-based diff
5. `e52bdf2` feat(document-engine): add reevaluateSemaphore to close R9/R10 gap

**Mobile (mobil-escorpia)**:

### Key Decisions During Implementation
1. **Field Role Categories**: RELLENO (operator-editable, persisted), CRUCE (cross-check read-only), VIGENCIA (expiry date read-only), AUDITORIA (audit read-only).
2. **Atomic Save**: DocumentEngineService.reviewMany() opens ONE transaction for all docs; fails entirely or commits all—no partial saves (R11, D1).
3. **RELLENO Diff Logic**: Only call review() for docs with changed RELLENO fields; preserves R10 (no spurious human_corrected_json write).
4. **Hybrid Semaphore**: Added reevaluateSemaphore methods to honor both R9 (always re-evaluate) and R10 (no write on no-change). Resolves design conflict between apply and verify feedback (W1 from PR2 report).
5. **Source of Truth**: Backend constant `ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES` + contract test enforces mobile parity (prevents drift, closes the "applied phantom fields" gap).

### Bugs Found and Fixed
1. **16 Phantom Fields** (WU-1 apply agent created fields from intuition, not DB catalog)

   - Fixed in commit `245984f` with 20 new parity tests
   - Root cause: sdd-apply didn't query the external BD catalog; assume-and-implement instead of verify-first
   - Mitigation: Added learning #198 for future SDD cycles; added backend↔BD parity tests

2. **`numero_permiso` Phantom** (original bug that started the change)
   - Never extracted by n8n; exists in old DOC_FIELDS
   - Removed via R5 (Phantom Field Removal requirement)
   - Verified in commit `7f96c4f`

3. **`_manual` Suffix Rename** (PR 3 C1 CRITICAL)
   - Apply agent renamed BARCO pre-fill keys with `_manual` suffix
   - Broke downstream: exportMpPerufrost reads canonical keys (no suffix) → empty columns
   - Fixed in commit `91e9735` (revert to canonical names)
   - Test: contract test + manual smoke verified DB state

4. **R9/R10 Conflict** (spec vs design mismatch)
   - Spec R9: review() MUST be called for EVERY doc on every save
   - Design D2: skip docs with empty RELLENO diff (honors R10)
   - Resolved via reevaluateSemaphore split: review() for docs with diff; reevaluateSemaphore() for unchanged docs
   - Commit `e52bdf2` added both paths in same transaction

### Production Issues Discovered & Fixed
1. **human_corrected_json Dead Code** — Never written before this change
   - Wired via saveValidation → reviewMany → review()
   - Now persists corrected RELLENO values per document
   
2. **Semaphore Never Re-evaluated After Correction**
   - Previously: evaluated once on n8n callback, then frozen
   - Now: re-evaluated on every save (both via review and reevaluateSemaphore)

### Test Results at Close
- **Backend**: 22 suites / 278 tests — all green
- **Mobile**: TypeScript `tsc --noEmit` — 0 errors
- **Contract**: 8 doc types / 28 fields — all match between backend and mobile
- **Full suite**: 226/226 baseline tests still passing (no regression)

### PR 3 (WU-4 + WU-5 + WU-6)

**Verdict**: PASS
- Contract test: 8/8 doc types, 28/28 fields match backend↔mobile
- Backend test suite: 278/278 pass
- Manual smoke (DB): entry_documents.human_corrected_json populated; semaphore_status updated; acopio_arrival_assets.metadata persisted correctly

## Source of Truth Updated
The following spec now reflects the new behavior:
- `openspec/specs/acopio-document-validation/spec.md` — 13 requirements, 40 scenarios

## SDD Cycle Complete
The change has been:
- ✅ Fully explored (exploration.md, 6 doc types audited, 5 catalog ref cross-checks)
- ✅ Formally proposed (proposal.md, scope + approach + risks + rollback)
- ✅ Specced (spec.md, 13 requirements + 40 scenarios)

observations.title: Session summary: validacion-extraccion-contrato Phase 1 SDD cycle complete
observations.content:
## Goal
Ciclo SDD completo de `validacion-extraccion-contrato` Phase 1 — formalizar el contrato de extracción de documentos acopio, conectar semáforo con correcciones humanas, sincronizar mobile con el catálogo real de la BD.

## Discoveries
- `human_corrected_json` era columna muerta — nunca se escribía. Ahora se escribe vía reviewMany.
- El semáforo NUNCA se re-evaluaba post-corrección. Ahora siempre en saveValidation.
- 16 campos fantasma en field-roles.ts inicial (apply agent no consultó BD). Fix: 20 tests de paridad exacta contra `document_type_catalog.extraction_fields` en producción.
- `_manual` suffix rename rompió `exportMpPerufrost` (columna Muelle vacía). Root cause: colisión inexistente (BARCO nunca recibe GUIA_REMITENTE). Fix: revertir en commit 91e9735.
- `DocumentEngineService.review()` abre su propia transacción — no se puede anidar. Solución: reviewWithQuery(queryFn) + reviewManyWithQuery como métodos transaccionales.
- R9/R10 conflictuaban → solución híbrida: diff→reviewWithQuery; sin diff→reevaluateSemaphoreWithQuery.
- Build Docker VM puede colgar SSH pero completa. Si conflict de container names: docker rm -f de los 3 containers antes de rebuild.
- LECCIÓN CLAVE (#198): apply agent DEBE consultar fuente externa real (BD, API) antes de transcribir cualquier contrato. Verify también debe comparar contra fuente real, no solo contra design.

## Accomplished
- PR 1: field-roles constant (28 campos reales) + reviewMany — 246 tests
- PR 2: saveValidation rewrite con diff + reviewManyWithQuery — 265 tests
- Fix W1: reevaluateSemaphore híbrido — 278 tests

- Fix C1: revertir _manual suffix
- PR 4: contract test pnpm -F backend contracts → OK 8 tipos, 28 campos

- FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE en UI de validación

- backend/src/modules/document-engine/document-engine.service.ts — reviewManyWithQuery + reevaluateSemaphore

observations.title: Master plan: 5 SDD chain for win-comerce landing v2 + analytics + creatives + hub
observations.content:
**What**: Master roadmap dividido en 5 SDD secuenciales (no paralelos, cada uno depende del anterior) para transformar win-comerce en plataforma completa de landings + creativos + analytics + hub Meta Ads.

**Why**: Estado actual — A10 landing genera un blob HTML monolítico sin imágenes reales, no hay captura de leads en DB (form va directo a WhatsApp y se pierde), A7 solo genera texto (no imágenes), no hay admin para editar landings, no hay integración con Meta Ads. Usuario pide: landings viviendo en win-comerce.pages.dev/l/{slug}, editor visual por secciones (imagen + copy editables, con notas para regenerar), pixel Meta configurable, publicar/ocultar landing, creativos como imágenes con copy overlay + carruseles (videos NO en esta fase), hub central que muestre branding+copy+ángulos+landings y proyecte performance conectando con Meta Ads.

**Where**: /home/rodrigo/Documentos/ecomerce/win_comerce_link/

**Decisiones tomadas**:
- Slug de landing: AUTOGENERADO desde nombre-producto + país (ej cinturon-masaje-pe), sufijo corto si colisión. Sin edición manual → evita links rotos en ads ya publicados.
- URL de landing: win-comerce.pages.dev/l/{slug} servido por Worker que lee HTML de R2.
- Imágenes: Ideogram (ya integrado en _shared/ideogram.ts v2). No videos en fase 1.
- Storage: R2 bucket STORAGE (ya existe), path cc/{project_id}/landing-assets/ y cc/{project_id}/ad-creatives/{concept_id}/.
- DB: nuevas tablas landings, leads, landing_events.
- Ejecución 100% secuencial (SDD-1 desbloquea 2, 2 desbloquea 3, etc.).

**Plan de 5 SDD**:

SDD-1 — Landing v2: secciones estructuradas + imágenes generadas
  - Refactor A10 de "LLM emite HTML blob" a orquestador 4 fases: image gen → sections JSON → template render → deploy
  - Genera hero.png (16:9), benefit_1-3.png (1:1), avatar_1-3.png (1:1) via Ideogram
  - Output sections[] con tipos: hero, benefits, pricing (packs existentes), testimonials, faq, cta
  - Nueva tabla landings (id, project_id, slug UNIQUE, sections_json, pixel_id, published, timestamps)

SDD-2 — Landing Admin: editor + publish + pixel
  - Nueva página LandingsPage (lista) + LandingDetailPage con tabs: Preview (iframe), Editor secciones (SectionBlock x6 con imagen+textos+nota regeneración), Config (pixel_id, wa number, toggle publish), Analytics (placeholder para SDD-3)
  - Endpoints: GET /api/landings, GET/PATCH /api/landings/:id, POST /api/landings/:id/regen-section
  - Worker route /l/:slug que sirve HTML de R2 solo si published=1

SDD-3 — Analytics: leads + funnel
  - Script tracking embebido en HTML: winTrack('pageview'|'form_start'|'lead'|'wa_click')
  - Tablas: leads (nombre, celular, direccion, ciudad, utm_*) y landing_events (event_type, session_id, utm_*)
  - Endpoints: POST /api/track, POST /api/leads (captura ANTES de redirigir a WA)
  - Analytics tab con funnel visual + tabla de leads + KPIs (conv rate, leads hoy, top source)

SDD-4 — Creativos con imágenes: flujo paso a paso + carruseles
  - Flujo UX: A7 genera N conceptos texto → UI muestra tarjetas → usuario selecciona 1-3 → puede agregar notas + tipo (estático 1:1 o carrusel 4 slides) → botones "Generar previa" / "Generar final"
  - Carrusel 4 slides: problema/pain → producto solución → prueba social → CTA+precio pack B
  - Storage: cc/{project_id}/ad-creatives/{concept_id}/
  - Creative Pack con botones Descargar todo / Aprobar / Regenerar con notas

SDD-5 — Hub central + Meta Ads (fase 2)
  - Dashboard hub unificado: kit branding, tu landing (link+preview+estado), banco copy, ángulos con ICE, creativos generados
  - Conectar Meta (OAuth o token manual) → sync ad performance
  - Botón "Generar análisis" → AI lee creative_performance + angle_performance → recomienda Mantener/Cortar/Nuevos ángulos
  - Loop retroalimentación: top ángulos por CTR/hook_rate disparan generación de variaciones nuevas en A7

**Learned**:
- Ideogram integrado ya existe (v2), path _shared/ideogram.ts. Se puede reutilizar tal cual para SDD-1 y SDD-4.
- El pipeline de 11 agentes YA funciona end-to-end. El problema es la calidad del output final (landing genérica, sin imágenes, leads perdidos).
- Cada SDD es deployable independientemente (arquitectura tipo work-unit).
- User quiere modo interactivo paso a paso: mostrar conceptos, dejar elegir, generar previas antes del final.

observations.title: wsp-agent-acopio: fix pérdida de datos + patrón propose_arrival determinístico
observations.content:
**What**: Activé y probé localmente el agente wsp-agent-acopio con OpenRouter (modelo `google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it`, confirmado que existe en el catálogo de OpenRouter). Encontré y arreglé 3 bugs reales de pérdida/corrupción de datos, y rediseñé el flujo de confirmación para que sea determinístico.

**Why**: El usuario pidió activar el bot y "entrenarlo" para que no pierda información al crear llegadas. Testing end-to-end reveló que SÍ perdía datos.

**Bugs encontrados y arreglados**:
1. `create-arrival.tool.ts` no tenía `plateNumber` en su schema JSON aunque `AcopioArrivalsService.quickCreate()` sí lo soporta — la placa se perdía siempre. Fix: agregado el campo.
2. El `SYSTEM_PROMPT` era estático, sin fecha/hora actual — el modelo inventaba fechas pasadas (ej: 2025-05-14 cuando "hoy" era 2026-07-01). Fix: `buildSystemPrompt(now, tz)` inyecta fecha/hora real en America/Lima vía Intl.DateTimeFormat (mismo patrón que ya usaba chat-wsp-acopio.service.ts).
3. **CRÍTICO**: en el flujo de confirmación de 2 turnos (operario pide algo → bot pide confirmar → operario dice "sí"), el modelo (Gemma-4-26B) a veces respondía "¡Listo! registrado" en texto SIN invocar ninguna tool de escritura — alucinación de éxito reproducible incluso con historial limpio. Causa raíz: confiar en que el modelo re-derive el JSON estructurado desde su propio resumen en texto libre es frágil.

**Fix arquitectónico (no solo prompt tuning)**:
- Nuevo tool `propose_arrival` (reemplaza `create_arrival` como tool expuesto al modelo) — el modelo lo llama con TODOS los datos estructurados + un `summaryText`. La ejecución de este tool NO escribe en la BD: solo guarda el `PendingArrival` en Redis (`WspSessionService.savePendingArrival/getPendingArrival/clearPendingArrival`, TTL 10min, key `wsp-agent:pending:{tenant}:{phone}`).
- En `WspAgentService.runAgentWindow`, ANTES de llamar al LLM: si hay un pending Y el mensaje nuevo matchea un regex simple de confirmación (`CONFIRM_REGEX`: sí/dale/confirmo/ok/listo/...) o cancelación (`CANCEL_REGEX`: no/cancela/...), se ejecuta/descarta en código directamente vía `executeConfirmedArrival()` — sin pasar por el modelo. Solo si el mensaje no matchea ninguno de los dos (ej. una corrección) sigue al LLM normal, que puede volver a llamar `propose_arrival` con los datos actualizados.
- `ToolServices` (tool-registry.ts) extendido con `session`, `tenantSlug`, `remoteJid` para que las tools puedan leer/escribir estado de sesión scopeado a la conversación.

**Where**:
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/tools/propose-arrival.tool.ts` (nuevo, reemplaza create-arrival.tool.ts — eliminado)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/tools/tool-registry.ts` (ToolServices extendido)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/tools/index.ts` (import actualizado)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-agent.service.ts` (buildSystemPrompt, CONFIRM_REGEX/CANCEL_REGEX, executeConfirmedArrival, logging de result.steps)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-session.service.ts` (PendingArrival + savePendingArrival/getPendingArrival/clearPendingArrival)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/README.md` (allowed_tools actualizado: create_arrival → propose_arrival)
- `backend/.env` local: agregadas vars WSP_AGENT_* (WSP_AGENT_ENABLED=false shadow mode, WSP_AGENT_MODEL=google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, debounce reducido a 10s solo para testing local)

**Learned**:
- `result.toolCalls`/`result.toolResults` de `generateText` con `maxSteps>1` SOLO reflejan el ÚLTIMO step — para ver todas las tools invocadas en la ventana hay que usar `result.steps.flatMap(s => s.toolCalls)`. Un chequeo ingenuo de `result.toolCalls?.length` da falsos negativos.
- Modelos abiertos tipo Gemma son notablemente menos confiables que GPT/Claude para re-invocar tools en un turno de confirmación separado — no confiar en que "recuerden" reconstruir JSON desde su propio texto. Patrón correcto: el estado que importa para escribir en BD vive en el backend (Redis), no en el historial de chat.
- La migración SQL `infra/postgres/init/022_wsp_agent.sql` no estaba aplicada en la BD local — hubo que aplicarla manualmente para poder testear (`docker exec -i traceexport_postgres psql ... < 022_wsp_agent.sql`).
- Filas existentes en `wsp_agent_phone_permissions` con `allowed_tools` conteniendo `'create_arrival'` deben migrarse a `'propose_arrival'` antes de activar en cualquier ambiente.
- La key de OpenRouter que el usuario pegó en el chat (sk-or-v1-656a...) quedó comprometida por estar en texto plano en la conversación — está SOLO en `backend/.env` local (gitignored) para testing. Antes de tocar `infra/docker-compose.vm.yml` o deployar, el usuario debe rotarla en openrouter.ai.
- Bug preexistente no relacionado: Test 5 del smoke test (evento `connection.update`) devuelve 400 en vez de 200 — el DTO de validación probablemente rechaza ese payload. No bloqueante, pendiente de investigar.

**Pendiente / próximos pasos**:
1. Probar flujo BARCO (no solo CAMARA) y casos de corrección ("no, son 20 toneladas") antes de dar por completo el tuning.
2. Rotar la key de OpenRouter antes de tocar la VM.
3. Migrar filas reales de `wsp_agent_phone_permissions` (si las hay en prod) de `create_arrival` a `propose_arrival`.
4. Conectar con Evolution API real (webhook per-instancia) — el diseño ya soporta esto, falta configurar el lado de Evolution.
5. Extender el patrón (tool registry + ToolServices) para nuevas herramientas no relacionadas a acopio, reusando el mismo chat/número.

observations.title: SDD-1 proposal: landing-v2-sections — structured sections + real images
observations.content:
# Proposal: landing-v2-sections (SDD-1 of 5)

## Intent
A10 (functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts, 640 lines) makes the LLM emit one monolithic HTML blob (maxTokens 8000): generic, no real product images (only brand logos), no section structure, no editability. This SDD-1 refactors A10 into a deterministic orchestrator: real Ideogram product images + structured-copy JSON + section-based vibe templates, and introduces a `landings` D1 table as the editable source of truth plus a public serving route. It is a fresh, narrower, corrected re-scope of the prior `sdd/landing-v2` round (id 134/136/137, kept as historical reference).

## Scope

### In Scope
- Refactor A10 into orchestrator: (1) asset gen (Ideogram: hero + benefit images + testimonial avatars, 3-5 total) → R2 `cc/{project_id}/landing-assets/`; (2) structured copy gen (LLM JSON only, maxTokens 4000, awareness-aware PAS/BAB/AIDA); (3) section JSON assembly (`sections[]`: hero/benefits/pricing/testimonials/faq/cta); (4) deterministic HTML render from vibe template + sections JSON; (5) persist landing.html + gracias.html + offer.json to R2 AND a `landings` D1 row (slug, sections_json, published=0).
- `landings` D1 table (migration 0011): id, project_id, slug (UNIQUE, autogen from product-slug + country, short-suffix on collision, NOT user-editable), sections_json, pixel_id (nullable), published (0/1 default 0), created_at, updated_at.
- Public serving route `GET /l/:slug` (functions/l/[slug].ts) → serves R2 HTML only if published=1, else 404. Rate-limited via RATE_LIMIT KV.
- Extract pricing.ts (FLETE_POR_PAIS, FULFILLMENT_POR_PAIS, roundPsychological, pack math) BYTE-FOR-BYTE from run.ts.
- Extend _shared/ideogram.ts for product photography (aspect ratios 4:5/9:16, reference image_urls, REALISTIC style) — extend, not replace.
- Keep 11-section vibe template system + 4 vibes (Bold/Premium/Warm/Clinical) from prior design.

### Out of Scope (and why)
- CF Pages auto-deploy — SUPERSEDED by R2 + `/l/:slug` serving; removes CF_PAGES_API_TOKEN/CF_ACCOUNT_ID and project-per-slug quota question.
- Video / Bernini / fal.ai — future (SDD-4). Images only.
- Lead capture / CRM Kanban / leads table / POST /api/leads — deferred to SDD-3.
- Section editor UI, Meta Pixel wiring beyond nullable pixel_id column — SDD-2.
- Analytics/tracking script — SDD-3. Meta Ads integration — SDD-5.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `landing-assets`: Ideogram-based product image generation (hero + benefits + avatars) stored in R2.
- `landing-sections`: structured copy JSON + section-based vibe template rendering.
- `landing-registry`: `landings` D1 table as editable source of truth (slug, sections_json, published).
- `landing-serving`: public `GET /l/:slug` route serving published R2 HTML.

### Modified Capabilities
- `landing-generation` (A10): output contract changes to assets + structured copy + deterministic render + landings row. Pack math preserved verbatim.

## Approach
Split A10 into a thin orchestrator delegating to new modules (run.ts is already 640 lines): `landing/pricing.ts` (pack math verbatim), `landing/assets.ts` (Ideogram via extended _shared/ideogram.ts → R2 webp), `landing/copy.ts` (LLM JSON via callLLM, jsonMode, wrapUserData guard), `landing/sections.ts` (assemble sections[]), `landing/templates/` (selectVibe → deterministic HTML). Persist via writeCCText/writeCC (existing pattern) + INSERT into `landings`. Serving route reads R2 HTML by slug, gated on published=1.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts` | Modified | Thin orchestrator; keep pack math call, drop monolithic LLM HTML |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/pricing.ts` | New | Pack math extracted byte-for-byte |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/assets.ts` | New | Ideogram product images → R2 |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/copy.ts` | New | LLM structured copy JSON |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/sections.ts` | New | sections[] assembly |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/templates/*.ts` | New | selectVibe + 4 vibe renderers + country-data |
| `functions/l/[slug].ts` | New | Public GET /l/:slug serving route |
| `functions/_shared/ideogram.ts` | Modified | Add ratios, reference image_urls, REALISTIC style |
| `functions/_shared/command-center.ts` | Modified | landing-assets R2 key helper (optional) |
| `functions/_shared/types.ts` | Modified | Landing types (sections, landings row) |
| `migrations/0011_landings.sql` | New | landings table + UNIQUE(slug) + idx(project_id) |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| OpenRouter free-model rate limits | High | Copy-only small prompt (4000 tok), MODEL_CHAIN fallback, keep fallback template render |
| Ideogram latency/failure within agent budget | Med | 3-5 images, retry (existing), graceful fallback to placeholder/reference image |
| Slug collision | Med | UNIQUE constraint + short-suffix retry on collision |
| Public /l/:slug abuse/scraping | Med | RATE_LIMIT KV, published=1 gate, 404 on unpublished |
| Pack math regression during extraction | Med | Byte-for-byte copy + parity unit test vs pre-refactor |
| No git repo initialized | High (for later PRs) | Blocker for PR phases only; NOT for proposal. Init git before SDD apply/PR. |

## Rollback Plan
Changes isolated to landing agent + one new public route + one additive migration. Revert: git-revert run.ts to monolithic generator, drop new landing/ modules, remove functions/l/[slug].ts. 0011_landings.sql is additive (DROP TABLE landings to fully revert). R2 artifacts stay backward-compatible (landing.html/gracias.html/offer.json unchanged keys).

## Dependencies
- IDEOGRAM_API_KEY (existing secret).
- OPENROUTER_API_KEY (existing).
- Upstream CC: onboarding/avatar/copies/brand/targeting (A1/A2/A5/A6/A9).
- NO new secrets (CF Pages API removed vs old design).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] A10 emits sections[] + real Ideogram R2 images (not logos), no monolithic LLM HTML.
- [ ] pricing.ts parity: identical pack prices/margins vs pre-refactor for PE/MX/CO/AR/CL/ES.
- [ ] `landings` row created per generation with autogen UNIQUE slug and published=0.
- [ ] `GET /l/:slug` serves HTML when published=1, returns 404 otherwise.
- [ ] Rendered landing keeps conversion elements (hero/benefits/3-pack pricing w/ MÁS VENDIDO badge/testimonials/faq/cta), mobile-first, LCP < 2.5s.

## Assumptions (delegated executor, no interactive round)
- Section granularity: reconcile old 11-section list into implementable sections[] (hero, benefits, pricing, testimonials, faq, cta at minimum) without losing conversion elements; vibe template owns visual structure.
- Slug format: `{product-slug}-{country}` lowercase kebab, short random suffix only on collision; never user-editable in SDD-1.
- Serving route lives at functions/l/[slug].ts (root-level Pages routing, sibling to api/, NOT under the api/agents auth middleware).
- pixel_id column exists but stays nullable/unused until SDD-2.
- git init is a prerequisite for SDD apply/PR phases, tracked as a blocker there.

observations.title: SDD-1 spec: landing-v2-sections — delta specs
observations.content:
# landing-v2-sections — Delta Specs (SDD-1 of 5)

---

## Domain: landing-assets (NEW)

### Requirement: Product Image Generation via Ideogram

The agent MUST call Ideogram API to generate product images: 1 hero (ASPECT_16_9 or ASPECT_4_5), 3 benefit images (ASPECT_1_1), and 3 testimonial avatars (ASPECT_1_1). Total: 7 images maximum per run.
The agent MUST store each image under `cc/{project_id}/landing-assets/{type}-{index}.webp` in R2 using the existing `r2Key` sanitization pattern.
Image prompts MUST use REALISTIC style_type and include brand category, product name, and country context. Prompts MUST be system-built and wrapped via `wrapUserData` guard — never direct user input.
On Ideogram failure, the agent MUST NOT abort the overall generation. It MUST fall back to `brand.logo_ideogram_references[0]` as hero placeholder and omit benefit/avatar images, logging the error.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| R2 key pattern | `cc/{project_id}/landing-assets/{hero\|benefit-1..3\|avatar-1..3}.webp` |
| Ideogram model | V_2 (existing) |
| MAX_RETRIES | 2 (existing pattern) |
| Fallback | reference image URL from brand.json, no abort |

#### Scenario: All images generated successfully

- GIVEN a project with valid onboarding, brand, and IDEOGRAM_API_KEY present
- WHEN assets.ts calls generateImages for hero + 3 benefits + 3 avatars (7 total)
- THEN all 7 R2 keys exist under `cc/{project_id}/landing-assets/`
- AND the returned `assets` object carries each R2 key + original Ideogram URL

#### Scenario: Ideogram API returns 429 or network error

- GIVEN IDEOGRAM_API_KEY is valid but API is rate-limited (429 response)
- WHEN generateImages exhausts MAX_RETRIES (2 attempts)
- AND assets.ts catches the IdeogramResult.error !== null
- THEN the asset phase MUST return `{ hero: brand.logo_ideogram_references[0], benefits: [], avatars: [], fallback: true }`
- AND the orchestrator continues to copy phase without aborting

---

## Domain: landing-sections (NEW)

### Requirement: Structured Copy JSON Generation

The agent MUST call the LLM with jsonMode=true and maxTokens=4000 to produce a `GeneratedCopy` JSON object (no HTML).
The system prompt MUST select copy framework based on `avatar.nivel_consciencia`: Unaware→PAS, Problem-aware→BAB, Solution/Product/Most-aware→AIDA.
The prompt MUST include: `awareness_level`, `punto_a`, `punto_b`, `big_domino` (product's single largest claim), `top_dolores` (top 3), `angulos_de_venta`, brand voice from `brand.tone_of_voice`.
The prompt MUST be wrapped in `wrapUserData` with label `landing_specs`.

| GeneratedCopy field | Type | Notes |
|--------------------|------|-------|
| headline | string | Above-fold H1 |
| subheadline | string | Supporting line |
| hero_cta | string | Primary button text |
| dolores_bullets | string[4] | Pain points from avatar |
| big_domino_copy | string | Core promise statement |
| solucion_copy | string | Solution paragraph |
| beneficios | string[5] | Feature/benefit bullets |
| testimonios | Array<{texto, autor, ciudad}>[3] | Synthetic, avatar-based |
| faqs | Array<{pregunta, respuesta}>[6] | Objection-busting FAQs |
| cta_final | string | Bottom CTA text |
| garantia | string | Guarantee / risk-reversal line |

#### Scenario: Copy generated for Problem-aware avatar

- GIVEN `avatar.nivel_consciencia` = "Problem-aware"
- WHEN copy.ts calls callLLM with jsonMode=true, maxTokens=4000
- THEN parseLLMJson returns a valid `GeneratedCopy` with all 11 fields populated
- AND the framework used in the prompt was BAB (Before–After–Bridge)

#### Scenario: LLM returns malformed JSON

- GIVEN callLLM returns non-JSON or truncated content
- WHEN parseLLMJson throws LLM_JSON_PARSE_ERROR
- THEN copy.ts MUST fall back to mapping `copies.landing` fields into `GeneratedCopy` shape
- AND the orchestrator continues; the fallback MUST NOT abort the pipeline

### Requirement: Section Array Assembly

The agent MUST assemble a `sections[]` array from `GeneratedCopy` + `PackCalculation[]` + `assets`. Each section object MUST be self-contained for template rendering (no external lookups at render time).

| Section id | Required fields |
|-----------|----------------|
| hero | headline, subheadline, hero_cta, hero_image_url, vibe |
| benefits | big_domino_copy, solucion_copy, beneficios[5] |
| pricing | packs[3] (unidades, precio_sugerido, etiqueta, recomendado), moneda, currency_symbol |
| testimonials | testimonios[3] (texto, autor, ciudad, avatar_url) |
| faq | faqs[6] (pregunta, respuesta) |
| cta | cta_final, garantia, hero_cta |

#### Scenario: Section array assembled from valid upstream data

- GIVEN GeneratedCopy, PackCalculation[3], and assets all resolved
- WHEN sections.ts assembles the sections[]
- THEN sections[] has exactly 6 entries in order: hero, benefits, pricing, testimonials, faq, cta
- AND pricing section contains pack with `recomendado: true` at index 1 (2-unit pack)

### Requirement: Vibe Template Selection

The agent MUST auto-select one of 4 vibes (Bold, Premium, Warm, Clinical) from `brand.tier` and `brand.brand_personality`.

| Vibe | Trigger condition |
|------|-----------------|
| Bold | tier=budget OR personality includes "energético", "urbano" |
| Premium | tier=premium OR personality includes "exclusivo", "lujo" |
| Warm | personality includes "familiar", "natural", "cálido" |
| Clinical | nicho=salud/higiene OR personality includes "médico", "científico" |

Default fallback: Bold.

#### Scenario: Vibe selected from brand personality

- GIVEN `brand.tier` = "premium" and `brand.brand_personality` includes "exclusivo"
- WHEN selectVibe(brand) is called
- THEN returned vibe = "Premium"

#### Scenario: No personality matches any vibe

- GIVEN brand.tier = "mid" and brand_personality = ["moderno"]
- WHEN selectVibe(brand) is called
- THEN returned vibe = "Bold" (default fallback)

---

## Domain: landing-registry (NEW)

### Requirement: landings D1 Table (Migration 0011)

The system MUST create the `landings` table via migration `0011_landings.sql` with the following schema:

```sql
CREATE TABLE landings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sections_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  pixel_id TEXT,
  published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_landings_slug ON landings(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_landings_project ON landings(project_id);
```

`pixel_id` MUST be nullable. `published` MUST default to 0 (unpublished). `sections_json` MUST store the serialized `sections[]` array.

#### Scenario: Migration applied cleanly on existing DB

- GIVEN migrations 0001–0010 are already applied
- WHEN migration 0011_landings.sql is applied via `wrangler d1 migrations apply`
- THEN `landings` table exists with UNIQUE constraint on slug and index on project_id
- AND no existing tables are affected

### Requirement: Slug Generation Algorithm

The system MUST generate slugs as `{product-slug}-{country}` where `product-slug` is the kebab-case of `onboarding.product` (lowercase, replace spaces and special chars with `-`, max 40 chars).
On UNIQUE constraint collision, the system MUST append a 4-char random alphanumeric suffix: `{product-slug}-{country}-{suffix}`.
Slug MUST NOT be user-editable in SDD-1. The system MUST retry up to 3 times on collision before returning a 500 error.

| Step | Rule |
|------|------|
| Base | `kebab(product.slice(0,40))-{country.toLowerCase()}` |
| Collision | append `-{nanoid(4)}`, retry D1 INSERT |
| Max retries | 3 |
| Character set | `[a-z0-9-]` only |

#### Scenario: Slug generated for new product

- GIVEN `onboarding.product` = "Faja Reductora Premium" and `pais` = "PE"
- WHEN generateSlug is called
- THEN slug = "faja-reductora-premium-pe"
- AND INSERT into landings succeeds (no collision)

#### Scenario: Slug collision on first attempt

- GIVEN slug "faja-reductora-premium-pe" already exists in landings
- WHEN generateSlug retries with suffix
- THEN a 4-char suffix is appended: e.g. "faja-reductora-premium-pe-k7m2"
- AND the second INSERT succeeds

#### Scenario: Three consecutive collisions

- GIVEN 3 retry attempts all hit UNIQUE constraint violations
- WHEN generateSlug exhausts max retries
- THEN the agent returns a 500 error: "Slug generation failed after max retries"
- AND no landings row is inserted

---

## Domain: landing-serving (NEW)

### Requirement: GET /l/:slug Public Route

The route `functions/l/[slug].ts` MUST handle `GET /l/:slug` requests.
On hit: read `landings` D1 row by slug. If `published = 1`, read `cc/{project_id}/landing.html` from R2 and return it as `text/html; charset=utf-8` with status 200.
If `published = 0` OR slug not found: return 404 HTML page (minimal, no internal details exposed).
The route MUST NOT require authentication. It MUST sit outside `functions/api/` to avoid the agent auth middleware.
Rate limiting MUST use `checkRateLimit(env.RATE_LIMIT, ip, 'read')` (60 req/min per IP, existing `read` limit type).

#### Scenario: Published landing served correctly

- GIVEN slug "faja-reductora-premium-pe" exists in landings with `published = 1`
- WHEN GET /l/faja-reductora-premium-pe is requested
- THEN response is 200 with Content-Type: text/html
- AND body is the landing.html stored in R2 under `cc/{project_id}/landing.html`

#### Scenario: Unpublished landing returns 404

- GIVEN slug "faja-reductora-premium-pe" exists in landings with `published = 0`
- WHEN GET /l/faja-reductora-premium-pe is requested
- THEN response is 404
- AND no HTML content from the landing is exposed

#### Scenario: Unknown slug returns 404

- GIVEN slug "nonexistent-slug" does not exist in landings table
- WHEN GET /l/nonexistent-slug is requested
- THEN response is 404

#### Scenario: Rate limit exceeded

- GIVEN the same IP has made 60 requests within the current 60-second window
- WHEN request 61 arrives at GET /l/:slug
- THEN checkRateLimit returns `allowed: false`
- AND route returns 429 with Retry-After header

---

## Domain: landing-generation (MODIFIED)

### Requirement: Landing Generation Agent (A10) Orchestrator

(Previously: monolithic LLM HTML blob at 8000 tokens; single-phase; no structured sections; no Ideogram; no D1 landings row.)

A10 MUST execute phases in order with explicit status updates:
1. **pack-math** — calculate PackCalculation[3] from FLETE/FULFILLMENT tables (byte-for-byte from current run.ts lines 22–201)
2. **assets** — call assets.ts (Ideogram → R2); graceful fallback on failure; never abort
3. **copy** — call copy.ts (LLM JSON, maxTokens 4000, awareness-aware); graceful fallback to copies.landing
4. **sections** — call sections.ts to assemble sections[]; call selectVibe for template
5. **render** — call vibe template renderer (deterministic HTML from sections[])
6. **persist** — write landing.html + gracias.html to R2 via writeCCText; write offer.json via writeCC; INSERT into landings (slug, sections_json, published=0)

A10 MUST call `updateRunStatus` at each phase transition. Target completion: ≤ 90 seconds total.
A10 MUST validate all upstream CC files (onboarding, avatar, copies, brand, targeting) before starting. Missing files MUST return 400 with specific names.
A10 MUST NOT call the LLM for HTML generation. HTML is produced deterministically by the vibe template renderer.

#### Scenario: Full happy-path generation

- GIVEN all upstream CC files exist and IDEOGRAM_API_KEY + OPENROUTER_API_KEY are valid
- WHEN POST /api/agents/landing is called with valid project_id
- THEN phases execute in order: pack-math → assets → copy → sections → render → persist
- AND R2 contains landing.html, gracias.html, offer.json at `cc/{project_id}/`
- AND landings D1 row exists with published=0 and valid slug

#### Scenario: Ideogram fails mid-run (graceful fallback)

- GIVEN IDEOGRAM_API_KEY is valid but Ideogram returns 500 on all retries
- WHEN assets phase completes with fallback=true
- THEN copy → sections → render → persist continue normally
- AND hero_image_url in sections[hero] uses brand.logo_ideogram_references[0]
- AND final response still returns 200 with offer and file paths

#### Scenario: Missing upstream CC file

- GIVEN `targeting` CC file does not exist in R2 (A9 not yet run)
- WHEN A10 validates upstream files
- THEN A10 returns 400: "Faltan: targeting (A9)"
- AND no LLM calls, R2 writes, or D1 inserts are made

### Requirement: Pack Math Parity

`pricing.ts` MUST be extracted byte-for-byte from `run.ts` lines 22–201 (FLETE_POR_PAIS, FULFILLMENT_POR_PAIS, roundPsychological, PackCalculation interface, pack1/2/3 logic, AOV, ROAS, margin calculations). No behavioral changes allowed.
Pack B2 price guard (`precioSugB2 >= precioSugB1 * 1.9` → adjust to `precioSugB1 * 1.85`) MUST be preserved exactly.

#### Scenario: Pack math produces identical results pre/post extraction

- GIVEN PE country: cogs=50, flete=20, fulfillment=4, cpa_objetivo=30
- WHEN calculatePacks (new pricing.ts) and old inline run.ts logic both run with same inputs
- THEN all 3 pack prices, margins, and AOV are byte-identical

#### Scenario: Pack B2 price guard triggers

- GIVEN inputs where costoB2/(1-0.50) rounded >= precioSugB1 * 1.9
- WHEN calculatePacks runs
- THEN precioSugB2 is adjusted to roundPsychological(precioSugB1 * 1.85)
- AND the adjusted value is < precioSugB1 * 1.9

---

## Totals
- 5 domains: 4 new full specs, 1 modified delta
- 13 requirements
- 18 scenarios (happy paths: 9, failure/edge: 9)
- All scenarios are testable without UI (unit/integration level)

observations.title: SDD-1 design: landing-v2-sections — technical design
observations.content:
# Design: landing-v2-sections (SDD-1 of 5)

## Technical Approach

Refactor A10 (`landing/run.ts`, 640 LOC) into a thin phase orchestrator that delegates to new pure modules. LLM stops emitting HTML — it emits `GeneratedCopy` JSON only (jsonMode, 4000 tok). HTML is produced deterministically by per-vibe TS renderers from a self-contained `sections[]` array. Adds real Ideogram product images (R2), a `landings` D1 table as editable source of truth, and a public `GET /l/:slug` route. Pack math is extracted byte-for-byte (spec: parity contract). All new work reuses existing shared helpers (callLLM chain, wrapUserData guard, writeCCText/writeCC, checkRateLimit).

## Architecture Decisions

| # | Decision | Choice | Rejected | Rationale |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | R2 keys outside CC_FILES enum | Raw `env.STORAGE.put()` in assets.ts via exported `landingAssetKey(projectId,type,i)` helper + `r2SafeId()` (mirrors `r2Key` sanitization in command-center.ts:29-33). NO cc_files D1 row for assets. | Extend CC_FILES enum | CC_FILES is a fixed 1:1 key→filename map with a UNIQUE(project_id,file_key) upsert; 7 dynamic per-run asset keys don't fit that shape and would pollute cc_files. Assets are addressed by derived key, not registry lookup. |
| 2 | Ideogram 4:5 support | Add `'ASPECT_4_5'` to `IdeogramConfig.aspectRatio` union; Ideogram v2 `image_request.aspect_ratio` accepts the literal `ASPECT_4_5`. Add optional `styleType?: 'DESIGN'\|'REALISTIC'` (default keeps `'DESIGN'`) and optional `imageUrls?: string[]` for reference. EXTEND, don't replace. | New ideogram2.ts | One client, backward-compatible defaults; logo gen (DESIGN, 1:1) unaffected. |
| 3 | New types.ts interfaces | Add `GeneratedCopy`, `LandingSection` (discriminated union on `id`), `LandingAssets`, `LandingRow`. See Interfaces. | Inline in run.ts | Shared by copy/sections/templates/serving; types.ts is the canonical home. |
| 4 | Template renderer arch | `templates/{bold,premium,warm,clinical}.ts` each `export function render(sections: LandingSection[], ctx: RenderContext): string`. `templates/index.ts` exports `selectVibe(brand): VibeName` and `renderVibe(vibe, sections, ctx): string` (switch dispatch). `templates/country-data.ts` for trust stores/currency symbol. Matches spec selectVibe table (tier + brand_personality → Bold/Premium/Warm/Clinical, default Bold). | Single mega-template with vibe flags | Per-vibe files keep each renderer readable; shared section partials via helpers in index.ts avoid duplication. |
| 5 | `/l/[slug].ts` | `onRequestGet`: derive ip from `CF-Connecting-IP`; `checkRateLimit(env.RATE_LIMIT, ip, 'read')` → 429 via `rateLimitResponse`. `SELECT project_id, published FROM landings WHERE slug=?1`. Not found OR published=0 → 404 minimal HTML. Else `env.STORAGE.get('cc/'+r2SafeId(project_id)+'/landing.html')` → 200 text/html; missing object → 404. No auth (lives outside functions/api/, sibling to it). | Serve sections_json rendered on the fly | R2 HTML already persisted at generation; serving is a cheap read. |
| 6 | Slug generation | `slugify(product)`: NFD normalize + strip combining marks (`\u0300-\u036f`) to transliterate AR/ES accents (á→a, ñ→n) to ASCII, lowercase, `[^a-z0-9]+`→`-`, trim/collapse `-`, slice(0,40). Base = `${slug}-${country.toLowerCase()}`. Insert loop: try INSERT; on `UNIQUE`/`constraint` error caught, append `-${nanoid4()}`, retry ≤3, else throw → 500. Catch-on-violation (not pre-SELECT) — avoids TOCTOU race. | Pre-check SELECT then insert | Race-prone under concurrency; UNIQUE(slug) is the real guard. |

## Data Flow

A10 `onRequestPost` orchestrator, phases with `updateRunStatus`:

    validate upstream (readCC ×5) ──> 400 if missing
      │
      1. pack-math   → calculatePacks(inputs): PackCalculation[3]   (pricing.ts, verbatim)
      2. assets      → generateLandingAssets(env, projectId, brand, onboarding): LandingAssets
                        (ideogram.generateImages ×7 → env.STORAGE.put webp; fallback→brand refs)
      3. copy        → generateCopy(env, {avatar, brand, packs}): GeneratedCopy
                        (callLLM jsonMode 4000 tok; parseLLMJson; fallback→copies.landing map)
      4. sections    → assembleSections(copy, packs, assets, moneda): LandingSection[6]
                        selectVibe(brand): VibeName
      5. render      → renderVibe(vibe, sections, ctx): landingHtml ; generateGracias(brand)
      6. persist     → writeCCText(landing_html) + writeCCText(gracias_html) + writeCC(offer)
                        generateSlug + INSERT landings(id,project_id,slug,sections_json,published=0)
                        recordAgentOutput / updateRunStatus('completed')

Serve path:  GET /l/:slug → rate-limit → D1 slug lookup → published gate → R2 landing.html → 200/404/429

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts` | Modify | Thin orchestrator; drop LLM-HTML prompt + inline pack math + fallback HTML; call new modules |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/pricing.ts` | Create | Pack math byte-for-byte from run.ts:22-201 (tables, roundPsychological, calculatePacks) |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/assets.ts` | Create | Ideogram ×7 → R2 webp via landingAssetKey; graceful fallback |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/copy.ts` | Create | LLM GeneratedCopy JSON, awareness→framework, fallback to copies.landing |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/sections.ts` | Create | assembleSections + selectVibe re-export |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/templates/index.ts` | Create | selectVibe, renderVibe, shared partials |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/templates/{bold,premium,warm,clinical}.ts` | Create | 4 vibe renderers `(sections,ctx)=>string` |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/templates/country-data.ts` | Create | trust stores + currency symbol per country |
| `functions/l/[slug].ts` | Create | Public GET /l/:slug (no auth), rate-limited, published gate |
| `functions/_shared/ideogram.ts` | Modify | Add ASPECT_4_5, styleType, imageUrls (backward-compatible) |
| `functions/_shared/types.ts` | Modify | Add GeneratedCopy, LandingSection, LandingAssets, LandingRow |
| `migrations/0011_landings.sql` | Create | landings table + UNIQUE(slug) idx + project_id idx |

## Interfaces (types.ts)

```ts
export interface GeneratedCopy {
  headline: string; subheadline: string; hero_cta: string
  dolores_bullets: string[]        // 4
  big_domino_copy: string; solucion_copy: string
  beneficios: string[]             // 5
  testimonios: Array<{ texto: string; autor: string; ciudad: string }>  // 3
  faqs: Array<{ pregunta: string; respuesta: string }>                  // 6
  cta_final: string; garantia: string
}

export interface LandingAssets {
  hero: string                     // R2 key or reference URL
  benefits: string[]; avatars: string[]
  fallback: boolean
}

export type LandingSection =
  | { id: 'hero'; headline: string; subheadline: string; hero_cta: string; hero_image_url: string; vibe: VibeName }
  | { id: 'benefits'; big_domino_copy: string; solucion_copy: string; beneficios: string[] }
  | { id: 'pricing'; packs: Array<{ unidades: number; precio_sugerido: number; etiqueta: string; recomendado: boolean }>; moneda: string; currency_symbol: string }
  | { id: 'testimonials'; testimonios: Array<{ texto: string; autor: string; ciudad: string; avatar_url: string }> }
  | { id: 'faq'; faqs: Array<{ pregunta: string; respuesta: string }> }
  | { id: 'cta'; cta_final: string; garantia: string; hero_cta: string }

export type VibeName = 'Bold' | 'Premium' | 'Warm' | 'Clinical'
export interface RenderContext { brand: BrandCC; waNumber: string; pais: string }
export type VibeRenderer = (sections: LandingSection[], ctx: RenderContext) => string

export interface LandingRow {
  id: string; project_id: string; slug: string
  sections_json: string; pixel_id: string | null
  published: 0 | 1; created_at: number; updated_at: number
}
```

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | Test | Approach |
|-------|------|----------|
| Unit | pricing parity | Golden inputs PE/MX/CO/AR/CL/ES → assert identical pack prices/margins/AOV vs captured pre-refactor snapshot |
| Unit | B2 guard | Force costoB2 path where precioSugB2 ≥ B1×1.9 → assert adjusted to round(B1×1.85) |
| Unit | selectVibe | Table cases (premium+exclusivo→Premium; salud→Clinical; moderno→Bold default) |
| Unit | slugify | Accented AR/ES ("Faja Reductora Premium"→"faja-reductora-premium"; "Niño"→"nino"); 40-char cap |
| Unit | vibe coverage | Each renderer output contains all 6 section ids/markers; mobile-first (16px min, hero eager) |
| Integration | /l/:slug | Miniflare local D1+R2: 200 published, 404 unpublished, 404 unknown, 429 on 61st req |
| Integration | migration | `wrangler d1 migrations apply --local` clean; landings table + UNIQUE(slug) present, 0001-0010 intact |

## Migration / Rollout

Additive only. 0011_landings.sql creates one table; no destructive change to existing schema. New modules are net-new files; run.ts change is internal. No new secrets (IDEOGRAM/OPENROUTER already provisioned). Rollback = git-revert run.ts to monolithic generator + drop new landing/ modules + remove functions/l/[slug].ts; `DROP TABLE landings` reverts migration. Existing R2 keys (landing.html/gracias.html/offer.json) unchanged → backward compatible.

## Open Questions

None blocking. All 6 spec-flagged decisions resolved above.

## Conventions grounded in codebase

- R2 key sanitization: reuse `r2Key` pattern (command-center.ts:29-33) → export `r2SafeId()` for assets + serving.
- LLM: reuse `callLLM` model-chain fallback + `wrapUserData` + `parseLLMJson` (openrouter.ts:33-41,109-166) — copy.ts label `landing_specs`.
- Ideogram: extend existing `generateImages` retry/safety (ideogram.ts:26-74, MAX_RETRIES=2) — no new client.
- Persistence: reuse `writeCCText`/`writeCC` upsert (command-center.ts:66-125) for html/offer; raw put only for per-run assets.
- Rate limit + IP: `checkRateLimit(kv,ip,'read')` + `rateLimitResponse` + `CF-Connecting-IP` (rate-limit.ts:15,51; sibling win-comerce _middleware.ts:109).
- Slug id: reuse `nanoid()` (command-center.ts:194) for row id; 4-char suffix via `crypto.randomUUID().slice`.
- CF Pages file routing: `functions/l/[slug].ts` = `onRequestGet`, param via `context.params.slug`, outside api/ = no agent middleware.

observations.title: wsp-agent-acopio v2: reemplazo de tool-calling agéntico por extracción+resolve/commit determinístico (mirror n8n)
observations.content:
**What**: Reescribí `WspAgentService` para abandonar el diseño de tool-calling agéntico (propose_arrival, confirmación vía regex + ejecución directa) y en su lugar replicar EXACTAMENTE el patrón ya probado en producción por el flujo n8n legacy (`infra/n8n/traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio.json`), reusando `ChatWspAcopioService` (ya usado por n8n vía HTTP) por inyección directa de dependencias.

**Why**: El usuario compartió capturas reales de WhatsApp del grupo "ACOPIO DE PESCA" con el formato real de mensajes: ráfagas de 5-10 llegadas en un solo mensaje, mismo proveedor con 2-3 camiones/embarcaciones distintos el mismo día (Zevallos x2 placas, Olaya x3 embarcaciones), estados "en planta" (CAMARA) / "en muelle" (BARCO) que disparan UPDATE en vez de CREATE, y líneas de ruido (saludos, totales) que no son llegadas. El diseño anterior (agente conversacional 1 llegada a la vez) no soportaba nada de esto. El usuario indicó explícitamente revisar el flujo n8n como referencia de entrenamiento probado.

**Diseño nuevo (3 pasos, ningún paso deja que el modelo decida si algo se escribe)**:
1. **EXTRACCIÓN**: `generateObject()` (AI SDK) con un schema `jsonSchema<ExtractionResult>` (NO zod — ver Learned) convierte el texto libre del buffer completo en `entries[]` estructuradas. El modelo NO conversa, NO decide, solo parsea. Prompt adaptado 1:1 del nodo "Preparar prompt" de n8n (mismo few-shot, misma fecha/hora dinámica ya resuelta).
2. **RESOLVE (determinístico)**: `ChatWspAcopioService.resolve()` — matchea contra catálogo (fuzzy), infiere fecha/hora, busca la llegada existente a actualizar. Cero LLM involurado.
3. **Resumen en tablas + pendiente en lote**: se arma un resumen ÚNICO listando TODAS las llegadas del lote (embarcaciones y cámaras en tablas separadas), se guarda `PendingBatch { entries: CommitEntryDto[], ts }` completo en Redis (TTL 10min), y se pide UNA sola confirmación para todo el lote.
4. **CONFIRMACIÓN determinística**: un "sí"/"no" simple (regex `CONFIRM_REGEX`/`CANCEL_REGEX`) NUNCA vuelve a llamar al modelo — ejecuta `ChatWspAcopioService.commit()` directo contra el lote guardado, o cancela. Reporta resultado por-entrada (creadas/actualizadas/fallidas).

**Bug real encontrado y arreglado (compartido con n8n)**: `AcopioArrivalsService.findArrivalAssetForUpdate` matcheaba la llegada a actualizar SOLO por `supplierId + date` — con 2+ camiones del mismo proveedor el mismo día (caso real: Zevallos, Olaya), podía actualizar la llegada EQUIVOCADA. Fix: nuevo parámetro opcional `plate` que exige coincidencia exacta de placa para CAMARA cuando viene informada (BARCO ya desambiguaba por `vesselAssetId`). `ChatWspAcopioService.resolveEntry` ahora pasa `entry.plate`. Probado end-to-end: 2 camiones "Sipan" con placas CCC-333/DDD-444, un "en planta placa CCC-333" actualizó exactamente el arrival_asset_id de CCC-333, dejando DDD-444 intacto en PROGRAMADO.

**Bug menor encontrado y arreglado**: `ResolvedEntry` (interfaz de retorno de `resolve()`) no incluía el campo `plate` — el resumen en tabla de n8n siempre mostraba "-" en la columna Placa (bug cosmético preexistente en producción). Agregado `plate: entry.plate ?? null` al resultado de `resolveEntry`.

**Where**:
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-agent.service.ts` (reescrito completo: extracción + resolve/commit, sin tool-calling)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-session.service.ts` (PendingArrival → PendingBatch con `entries: CommitEntryDto[]`)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/tools/` (ELIMINADO completo — propose-arrival, search-catalog, get-arrivals-today, update-arrival, tool-registry, index — ya no se usan)
- `backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/wsp-agent-acopio.module.ts` (importa ChatWspAcopioModule)
- `backend/src/modules/chat-wsp-acopio/chat-wsp-acopio.module.ts` (exports: [ChatWspAcopioService] — antes no se exportaba)
- `backend/src/modules/chat-wsp-acopio/services/chat-wsp-acopio.service.ts` (ResolvedEntry.plate agregado; findArrivalAssetForUpdate recibe plate)
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-arrivals.service.ts` (findArrivalAssetForUpdate: nuevo param opcional `plate`, SQL filtra por plate_number cuando viene)

**Learned**:
- `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (dependencia de `ai@4.3.16`) tipa `generateObject()` contra zod v3 (`z.Schema<OBJECT, ZodTypeDef, any>`). El proyecto usa zod@4 — aunque zod@4 expone un subpath `zod/v3` de compatibilidad, la inferencia de tipos genéricos de TS seguía fallando (`object` quedaba `unknown`, TS matcheaba el overload equivocado de `generateObject`). Fix real: usar `jsonSchema<T>({...})` de `ai` (el mismo helper que ya usaban las tools legacy de este módulo) en vez de un schema zod — evita el problema de raíz sin depender de compatibilidad de versiones.
- Mismo hallazgo de la sesión anterior sigue vigente: NO confiar en que un LLM (mucho menos uno abierto tipo Gemma) decida cuándo escribir en la BD. El patrón correcto — ya probado en producción por n8n — es: LLM = parser de texto a JSON, TODO lo demás (matching, pendiente, confirmación, escritura) es código determinístico.
- El flujo n8n legacy (`infra/n8n/traceexport-chat-wsp-acopio.json`) es la fuente de verdad de cómo debe comportarse el bot — antes de rediseñar cualquier parte de wsp-agent-acopio, revisar ese JSON primero.
- Tests de `chat-wsp-acopio.service.spec.ts` (14 tests) verdes después de todos los cambios — el nuevo parámetro `plate` es opcional y no rompe compatibilidad con llamadas existentes sin placa.

**Pendiente**:
1. Probar mensajes 100% textuales de las capturas reales (con encabezados "camara"/"embarcacion" implícitos, abreviaciones, "tnB", etc.) para afinar el prompt de extracción.
2. El bot NUNCA debe procesar mensajes de grupo — el usuario confirmó que las capturas eran solo ejemplos de formato, el flujo real es DM 1 a 1. El filtro `rawJid.endsWith('@g.us')` en el controller ya está correcto, no tocar.
3. Decisión pendiente del usuario: "siempre responder algo" incluso cuando no hay llegadas — ya implementado (mensaje "No entendí ninguna llegada...").
4. Rotar la key de OpenRouter antes de tocar la VM (sigue pendiente de la sesión anterior).
5. Conectar Evolution API real cuando el flujo esté afinado.

observations.title: PR3 selectVibe priority order and shared partials pattern
observations.content: **What**: selectVibe() priority order: Premium → Clinical → Warm → Bold (default). Shared HTML partials (htmlHead, whatsappButton, avatarImg, esc) live in index.ts and are imported by all 4 renderers. **Why**: Priority prevents ambiguous brand combinations from landing on the wrong vibe. Shared partials saved ~120 lines vs duplicating across 4 vibes, kept total implementation at 879 lines vs ~1000+ without sharing. **Where**: functions/api/agents/landing/templates/index.ts — selectVibe(), renderVibe(), htmlHead(), whatsappButton(), avatarImg(), esc() **Learned**: - `codigo_categoria` on BrandCC is the nicho field to check for Clinical (salud/higiene), NOT the `nicho` field on OnboardingCC (that's available via CC files, not brand). - avatarImg() must return a div-based initials circle when avatar_url is '' — never return an with empty src. - ciudad conditional must use ternary/template guard — never interpolate empty string into HTML that produces visible separators (", " or " - "). - tsconfig.json `include: ["src"]` means `tsc --noEmit --strict` only checks src/ by default; functions/ files need explicit path or tsconfig override for CI purposes.

observations.title: CSS injection hardening in templates/index.ts (PR4a)
observations.content:
**What**: Added sanitizeCssValue() to templates/index.ts and applied it in htmlHead() to all color_palette.* and typography.* before interpolation into <style> :root block.

**Why**: PR3 review flagged that color_palette/typography values from BrandCC are user-controlled CC data interpolated unescaped into a CSS <style> block. A malicious or corrupted brand.json could inject CSS (e.g. `{};` to break out of :root, `/*` comments, or `<style>` injection). Opted to fix in PR4a (low effort, ~34 lines) rather than defer to PR4b since /l/[slug].ts public route ships in PR4b.

**Where**: `functions/api/agents/landing/templates/index.ts` — sanitizeCssValue() strips {}; /* */ < > and whitespace from CSS value strings. Applied in htmlHead() for cp.primary/secondary/accent/neutral/cta and fonts.display/body.

**Learned**: Valid CSS color/font values don't need {}; or /*. Stripping those chars is safe and covers the main injection vectors without over-escaping. Named colors (red, blue), hex (#ff0000), rgb()/hsl() all pass through cleanly.

observations.content:
## Goal
Activar y probar el bot conversacional WhatsApp (wsp-agent-acopio) con Vercel AI SDK + OpenRouter, comparándolo contra el flujo n8n de referencia y conectándolo a Evolution API real (local primero, luego VM de producción 34.31.70.3).

## Instructions del usuario
- Rotar SIEMPRE cualquier API key pegada en el chat en texto plano (pasó 2 veces con OpenRouter).
- Probar en real (WhatsApp real) antes de dar por bueno un fix.
- PENDIENTE SIN RESOLVER: el usuario se puso nervioso cuando pausé el workflow n8n y cambié webhooks de Evolution — pidió explícitamente "no romper n8n ni Evolution que están funcionando". Confirmar en la próxima sesión si quiere n8n operativo EN PARALELO (instancias/números distintos) en vez de reemplazado.
- ÚLTIMA ALERTA SIN RESOLVER: "estás respondiendo desde un número que no se estaba usando" — sugiere mismatch entre las 2 instancias Evolution (traceexport vs traceexport-test) y cuál es la que el usuario realmente mensajea. No alcancé a investigar (comando abortado por el usuario). PRÓXIMA SESIÓN: correr GET /instance/connect/<instance> en ambas y comparar contra el campo "instance" del payload real que llegó al webhook (mirar logs de produccion-infra-backend-1 del mensaje REAL del usuario, no mi test manual con "instance":"traceexport" hardcodeado a mano).

## Discoveries clave
1. **Bug crítico de producción (encontrado y arreglado)**: el DTO del webhook asumía `data.messages[]` (array) pero Evolution API v2 manda `data` como EL MENSAJE DIRECTAMENTE (data.key, data.message). Evolution reintentaba 10 veces con 400, el usuario nunca recibía respuesta. Confirmado en logs reales de Evolution (AxiosError status 400).
2. **Segundo bug relacionado**: ValidationPipe global (whitelist:true, forbidNonWhitelisted:true) rechaza CUALQUIER campo extra no declarado — payloads reales de WhatsApp traen decenas de campos variables imposibles de enumerar. observations.title: Fix wsp-agent SDK: preservar LID @lid como destino Evolution (bug 400 exists:false)
observations.content:
**What**: Arreglado el bug que impedía que el bot wsp-agent-acopio (Vercel AI SDK) respondiera por WhatsApp. El pipeline recibía y procesaba bien (extracción Gemma OK), pero el ENVÍO a Evolution fallaba con 400 `{"exists":false,"jid":"84104183808020@s.whatsapp.net"}`.
**Why**: `normalizeJid()` en wsp-agent-acopio.controller.ts convertía el LID de WhatsApp (`84104183808020@lid`) a `+84104183808020`. Al responder, Evolution le pegaba `@s.whatsapp.net` → ese "número" no existe (un LID NO es teléfono). Mismo problema LID que ya había pegado en n8n (obs #122).
**Where**: backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/wsp-agent-acopio.controller.ts (commit fefa708, main, deployado en VM). Tabla wsp_agent_phone_permissions (perufrost): fila cambiada de `+84104183808020` a `84104183808020@lid`.
**Learned**:
- Evolution v2 `message/sendText/{instance}` ACEPTA tanto el número real (`51932543404`) como el LID crudo (`84104183808020@lid`) — ambos dan status 201/PENDING. Lo que NO acepta es `+84104183808020` (LID con +, lo interpreta como phone → @s.whatsapp.net → exists:false → 400).
- El fix: normalizeJid preserva `@lid` intacto (sirve de identidad estable Y de destino de envío); los números reales siguen a E.164.
- El identificador se usa para 3 cosas a la vez: lookup permisos, clave sesión Redis, destino reply — por eso debe ser sendable.
- El LID es estable por cuenta de WhatsApp (mismo LID en instancias traceexport y traceexport-test).
- Test E2E: POST webhook simulado a http://backend:3000/wsp-agent-acopio/webhook desde el container n8n (localhost:3000 dentro del backend da connection refused), header x-wsp-agent-secret=$WSP_AGENT_SECRET. Debounce 60s antes de procesar.
- Verificado: 400 → 201 tras el fix. Falta que el usuario confirme recepción física en WhatsApp y decidir apagar traceexport-test (937075149) para dejar solo traceexport (915118307).

observations.title: Fixed 502 en api.escorpia.com por IP de backend cacheada en nginx
observations.content:
**What**: app.escorpia.com (frontend en Vercel) mostraba "Network Error" porque las llamadas a api.escorpia.com devolvían 502. Se recargó nginx (`nginx -s reload`) y volvió a 200.
**Why**: El container produccion-infra-backend-1 fue recreado y Docker le asignó nueva IP (172.19.0.6), pero nginx tenía cacheada la IP vieja (172.19.0.7) desde el arranque → connect() failed (111 Connection refused) → 502. Bug clásico: nginx resuelve el upstream hostname una sola vez al cargar la config.
**Where**: VM 34.31.70.3, produccion-infra nginx vhost api.escorpia.com, docker-compose.vm.yml
**Learned**: Arquitectura actual: frontend en Vercel (app.escorpia.com), backend detrás de Cloudflare (api.escorpia.com) → nginx en VM → backend:3000. Cada rebuild/recreate del backend rompe nginx hasta hacer reload. Fix de raíz pendiente: usar `resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=10s;` + `set $upstream backend:3000; proxy_pass http://$upstream;` para re-resolución en runtime.

observations.title: Proposal: landing-admin (SDD-2 of 5)
observations.content:
# Proposal: landing-admin (SDD-2 of 5) — UPDATED after 5 user answers

## Intent
SDD-1 persists a `landings` D1 row (`published=0`) with structured `sections[]` + real images, but NO admin surface to view/edit/publish. SDD-2 adds authenticated admin layer: LandingsPage + LandingDetailPage (Preview/Editor/Config/Analytics-placeholder) + REST endpoints so operators review copy/images, regen a single section, set pixel_id + per-landing WA number, flip published. Closes Warning 3, folds Warning 1 (sanitizeCssValue in generateGraciasPage run.ts:135).

## Scope
### In Scope
- REST (session auth, per-user ownership like projects/index.ts): GET /api/landings (list, admin=all), GET /api/landings/:id, PATCH /api/landings/:id (persist edits + re-render/rewrite R2), POST /api/landings/:id/regen-section (single section, quota-gated).
- Frontend: LandingsPage, LandingDetailPage (4 tabs), SectionBlock. Config tab exposes REQUIRED per-landing WA number field. Reuses ProtectedRoute, inline styles, src/lib/api.ts.
- Migration 0012: nullable wa_number on landings + new landing_regen_log counter-source table.
- Warning 1: sanitizeCssValue() on color_palette.primary in generateGraciasPage().
- Publish control over SDD-1 /l/:slug gate (route unchanged).
### Out of Scope
- Analytics (SDD-3). Slug editing (immutable). Full-landing regen (A10). Creatives/Meta/hub (SDD-4/5).
- Warning 2 fallback unit tests: REMOVED from SDD-2 — handled as SDD-1 tech debt by parallel workstream, NOT SDD-2 scope.

## Capabilities
### New
- `landing-admin-api`: REST list/read/patch/regen-section, per-user ownership + admin override + per-plan regen quota.
- `landing-editor-ui`: LandingsPage + LandingDetailPage + SectionBlock.
### Modified
- `landing-registry`: +nullable wa_number (0012, per-landing, NO project fallback); rows editable via PATCH.
- `landing-generation`: generateGraciasPage() hardened; assets.ts/copy.ts reused by regen-section (extracted helpers).

## Approach
Routes under functions/api/landings/ OUTSIDE functions/api/agents/ (no plan middleware; requireSession + ownership). PATCH re-renders via renderVibe/generateGracias, rewrites R2 via writeCCText.
PER-PLAN REGEN QUOTA (reuses existing pattern): live code enforces limits by counting source rows in a CALENDAR-MONTH window vs a key in plans.agent_limits_json (-1=unlimited), exactly as validateSession() derives usage.pipelines_this_month from pipeline_runs / audits_this_month from daily_reports. SDD-2 follows THAT pattern (NOT the dead usage_counters table): add max_landing_regens to agent_limits_json; regen-section inserts into new landing_regen_log, counts caller's rows in current month before regenerating; when count >= max_landing_regens (not -1) return existing upgrade_required 403 shape (mirror _middleware.ts), no image generated. Reset = calendar month.

## Affected Areas
functions/api/landings/{index,[id],[id]/regen-section}.ts (New); functions/_shared/session.ts (Modified: max_landing_regens + landing_regens_this_month); functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts (Modified: sanitizeCssValue L135); assets.ts/copy.ts (Modified: extract regen helpers); functions/_shared/types.ts (Modified: LandingRow.wa_number + request types); migrations/0012 (New: wa_number + landing_regen_log); src/pages/{LandingsPage,LandingDetailPage}.tsx (New); src/components/SectionBlock.tsx (New); src/App.tsx + src/lib/api.ts (Modified).

## Risks
- IDOR (High): ownership via landings.project_id -> projects.user_id, admin bypass only.
- PATCH desync sections_json vs R2 (Med): re-render + rewrite atomically, bump updated_at.
- regen-section LLM/Ideogram failure (Med): return prior section + error flag; DO NOT log regen against quota on failure.
- Regen quota bypass/miscount (Med): count within [monthStart,monthEnd) like pipelines_this_month; -1 = unlimited; count only successful regens.
- Publish unfinished (Med): explicit toggle, default 0, confirm dialog, owner-only.
- Missing per-landing wa_number (Med): Config field required; block publish/CTA until set, NO silent project fallback.
- 0012 on live rows (Low): additive nullable + new table.

## Rollback
Additive. Remove functions/api/landings/, drop pages/components + wiring, git-revert one-liner + session.ts regen additions. 0012: DROP COLUMN wa_number + DROP TABLE landing_regen_log. SDD-1 /l/:slug + A10 untouched.

## Dependencies
SDD-1 shipped. Existing plan/usage system: plans.agent_limits_json, subscriptions, validateSession() monthly-count pattern. Existing auth (requireSession, role RBAC, WIN_API_KEY). No new secrets.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] GET /api/landings returns only caller's landings (admin=all); unauth -> 401.
- [ ] PATCH persists edits + rewrites R2; /l/:slug reflects when published.
- [ ] Owner-only publish toggle flips published; /l/:slug 200 when 1, 404 when 0; confirm dialog.
- [ ] Config requires per-landing wa_number (no projects.wa_number fallback); CTA uses it.
- [ ] regen-section regenerates single section honoring note, no cross-section effect.
- [ ] Regen blocked with upgrade_required 403 once plan max_landing_regens month quota hit; -1 never blocked; failed regens don't consume quota.
- [ ] Editing another user's landing -> 403/404 (no IDOR).
- [ ] generateGraciasPage() uses sanitizeCssValue() on color_palette.primary.

## Resolved Decisions (5 answers, replaced Open Questions)
1. Publish permission: OWNER-ONLY (single-user-per-project dashboard, no multi-role yet). Keep UI confirm dialog.
2. WA number: PER-LANDING, admin-specified manually in Config tab, required, NO fallback to projects.wa_number. (Changed from earlier project-inherit assumption.)
3. regen-section: per-SUBSCRIPTION/PLAN quota on IMAGE regen COUNT. Reuses existing calendar-month-count pattern (validateSession + agent_limits_json), NOT dead usage_counters table. New key max_landing_regens + new landing_regen_log source table. Monthly reset. Exhausted -> upgrade_required 403.
4. Spec filesystem gap: being resolved in parallel by another agent (backfill openspec/specs/ + clean landing-v2/). No action here.
5. Warning 2 fallback tests: removed from SDD-2 scope; done as SDD-1 tech debt in parallel.
