observations.title: Fix extracción wsp-agent: json_object supera a generateObject (calidad = n8n)
observations.content:
**What**: El bot wsp-agent-acopio (Vercel AI SDK) extraía PEOR que n8n con el mismo mensaje/prompt/modelo. Sobre un bloque con 2 barcos ("Keiko\nEp don Benja\n8pm llegando\n200tn\n5pm alan 200tn ep Kelvin jesus"), el SDK sacaba 1 solo barco sin toneladas ni hora; n8n sacaba los 2 completos.
**Why**: El prompt de n8n y del SDK eran IDÉNTICOS (verificado exportando el workflow vivo jkywdfOYZCx6uttR). La diferencia estaba en CÓMO se llama al modelo: el SDK usaba `generateObject()` del AI SDK (modo json_schema estructurado), que DEGRADA a Gemma vía OpenRouter. n8n usa llamada HTTP cruda con `response_format: { type: 'json_object' }` + few-shot + parseo manual.
**Where**: backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-agent.service.ts (commit bd6187c, main, deployado VM). Se reemplazó generateObject por método privado extractEntries() (fetch a OpenRouter, json_object) + función parseExtractionJson() tolerante. Se eliminó ExtractionResultSchema/jsonSchema/createOpenAI/generateObject/CoreMessage.
**Learned**:
- REGLA CLAVE: para extracción con Gemma (y probablemente otros modelos open vía OpenRouter), `response_format: json_object` + ejemplo few-shot en el prompt EXTRAE MEJOR que generateObject() con json_schema. generateObject fuerza structured output que estos modelos manejan mal → truncan entries y omiten campos.
- Verificado con test directo a OpenRouter (test-extract.py): json_object → 2 entries completas; generateObject daba 1 incompleta.
- El workflow n8n vivo (jkywdfOYZCx6uttR) se exporta con `docker exec produccion-infra-n8n-1 n8n export:workflow --id=<id> --output=/tmp/wf.json`. El prompt está en el nodo code "Preparar prompt", el modelo en "OpenRouter parsear".
- parseExtractionJson es tolerante: quita fences markdown, extrae primer {...} balanceado si hay texto extra, coacciona números/strings/enums, nunca tira (devuelve entries:[] si falla).
- Método de test E2E del SDK: POST webhook a http://backend:3000/wsp-agent-acopio/webhook desde container n8n con header x-wsp-agent-secret, remoteJid con @lid, esperar 60s debounce, leer logs "Extracción para ...: N entries".

**Learned**: The only non-migration files mentioning usage_counters were PROGRESO_CRM.md (historical checklist) and openspec/changes/landing-admin/proposal.md (explicitly calling it dead). No TypeScript types, Drizzle schemas, or Zod validators referenced it. No migration tests exist in this project.

observations.title: sdd/landing-admin/spec
observations.content:
# Specs: landing-admin (SDD-2 of 5)

---

## Domain: landing-admin-api (NEW)

### Requirement: GET /api/landings — Ownership-Scoped List

The endpoint MUST require `requireSession`. Regular users MUST receive only landings whose `project_id` belongs to their own projects. Admin users MUST receive all landings. Unauthenticated requests MUST return 401.

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| Auth | `requireSession` (session cookie) |
| Scope | `landings.project_id → projects.user_id = caller.id` (or admin bypass) |
| Response | `200 { landings: LandingRow[] }` |
| Unauth | `401` |

#### Scenario: User lists their own landings
- GIVEN a logged-in user with two projects, each with one landing
- WHEN GET /api/landings is called
- THEN response is 200 with exactly 2 landing rows
- AND no other user's landings appear in the list

#### Scenario: Admin lists all landings
- GIVEN a session with `role = "admin"`
- WHEN GET /api/landings is called
- THEN response is 200 with all landings across all users

#### Scenario: Unauthenticated request
- GIVEN no valid session cookie is present
- WHEN GET /api/landings is called
- THEN response is 401

---

### Requirement: GET /api/landings/:id — Single Landing Read

The endpoint MUST return the full `LandingRow` including parsed `sections_json`, `pixel_id`, `wa_number`, `published`, and `slug`. If the landing's `project_id` does not belong to the caller, MUST return 404 (no IDOR leak).

#### Scenario: Owner reads their landing
- GIVEN a landing with id "land-abc" belonging to the caller's project
- WHEN GET /api/landings/land-abc is called
- THEN response is 200 with `{ id, slug, sections, pixel_id, wa_number, published }`
- AND `sections` is a parsed array (not raw JSON string)

#### Scenario: User attempts to read another user's landing (IDOR)
- GIVEN landing "land-xyz" belongs to a different user's project
- WHEN GET /api/landings/land-xyz is called by another user
- THEN response is 404
- AND no landing data is disclosed

---

### Requirement: PATCH /api/landings/:id — Persist Edits + Re-render

The endpoint MUST accept partial updates for `sections_json`, `pixel_id`, `wa_number`, and `published`. After persisting to D1, it MUST re-render `landing.html` and `gracias.html` and rewrite them to R2. `updated_at` MUST be bumped atomically. `published` toggle MUST be owner-only.

| Rule | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Ownership | `landings.project_id → projects.user_id`; admin bypass |
| Re-render | Always after any field change |
| Atomicity | D1 write + R2 rewrite in same handler; `updated_at = unixepoch()` |
| `published` | Only set by owner or admin; confirmed in UI before sending |

#### Scenario: Owner edits section copy
- GIVEN owner sends PATCH with updated `sections_json`
- WHEN handler processes the request
- THEN D1 row is updated with new `sections_json` and bumped `updated_at`
- AND R2 keys `cc/{project_id}/landing.html` + `gracias.html` are rewritten

#### Scenario: Owner publishes their landing
- GIVEN owner sends PATCH with `{ published: 1 }` and `wa_number` is set
- WHEN handler processes the request
- THEN D1 `published` is set to 1
- AND GET /l/:slug returns 200

#### Scenario: Non-owner attempts PATCH (IDOR)
- GIVEN a landing belonging to user A
- WHEN user B sends PATCH /api/landings/:id
- THEN response is 403 or 404
- AND no D1 or R2 write occurs

#### Scenario: PATCH without wa_number when publishing
- GIVEN a landing with `wa_number = null`
- WHEN PATCH is sent with `{ published: 1 }`
- THEN response is 400 with error indicating `wa_number` is required before publishing

---

### Requirement: POST /api/landings/:id/regen-section — Quota-Gated Single Section Regen

The endpoint MUST regenerate exactly one section using extracted helpers from `assets.ts`/`copy.ts`. Before generating, it MUST count the caller's rows in `landing_regen_log` for the current calendar month. If count ≥ `max_landing_regens` (and ≠ -1), MUST return `{ error: "upgrade_required" }` with status 403. On LLM/Ideogram failure, MUST NOT insert into `landing_regen_log`.

| Rule | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Quota key | `plans.agent_limits_json.max_landing_regens` |
| Unlimited | `-1` → never blocked |
| Count window | `[monthStart, monthEnd)` calendar month |
| Count source | `landing_regen_log` rows for caller in current month |
| On failure | Return prior section + error flag; no quota consumed |
| 403 shape | `{ error: "upgrade_required", message: "...", limit: N, used: N }` |

#### Scenario: Regen within quota
- GIVEN caller has used 2 regens and plan allows 5
- WHEN POST /api/landings/land-abc/regen-section with `{ section_id: "hero", note: "..." }`
- THEN hero section is regenerated and `landing_regen_log` gains one new row
- AND response is 200 with `{ section: { id: "hero", ... } }`

#### Scenario: Regen quota exhausted
- GIVEN caller has used 5 regens and plan allows 5
- WHEN POST regen-section is called
- THEN response is 403 `{ error: "upgrade_required", limit: 5, used: 5 }`
- AND no LLM/Ideogram call is made and `landing_regen_log` is NOT modified

#### Scenario: Unlimited plan (-1)
- GIVEN plan has `max_landing_regens = -1`
- WHEN regen-section is called any number of times
- THEN quota check is skipped and regen always proceeds

#### Scenario: LLM/Ideogram failure during regen
- GIVEN Ideogram returns 500 on all retries
- WHEN regen-section fails after all retries
- THEN response is 200 with `{ section: <prior section content>, error: "generation_failed" }`
- AND no row is inserted into `landing_regen_log`

---

## Domain: landing-editor-ui (NEW)

### Requirement: LandingsPage — Authenticated Landing List

`LandingsPage` MUST render behind `ProtectedRoute`. It MUST fetch from GET /api/landings on mount and display each landing as a card. An empty state MUST be shown when no landings exist.

#### Scenario: User with landings sees list
- GIVEN the user has two landings
- WHEN LandingsPage mounts
- THEN two landing cards are rendered with slug and published badge

#### Scenario: User with no landings sees empty state
- GIVEN the user has no landings
- WHEN LandingsPage mounts
- THEN an empty-state message is shown

#### Scenario: Unauthenticated access redirected
- GIVEN no valid session exists
- WHEN the user navigates to `/landings`
- THEN ProtectedRoute redirects to the login page

---

### Requirement: LandingDetailPage — Four-Tab Detail View

`LandingDetailPage` MUST fetch from GET /api/landings/:id on mount and render four tabs: Preview, Editor, Config, Analytics (placeholder). Navigation between tabs MUST NOT re-fetch the landing.

| Tab | Content |
|-----|---------|
| Preview | HTML render of `landing.html` (read-only) |
| Editor | `SectionBlock` per section in `sections[]` |
| Config | `pixel_id`, `wa_number` (required), publish toggle |
| Analytics | Placeholder: "Analytics coming in SDD-3" |

#### Scenario: Detail page loads and defaults to Preview tab
- GIVEN a valid landing id in the URL
- WHEN LandingDetailPage mounts
- THEN GET /api/landings/:id is called once and Preview tab is shown

#### Scenario: User switches to Editor tab
- GIVEN LandingDetailPage is loaded
- WHEN the user clicks the Editor tab
- THEN a SectionBlock is rendered per section
- AND no new network request is made

#### Scenario: 404 from API
- GIVEN the API returns 404 for the requested id
- WHEN LandingDetailPage mounts
- THEN an error state "Landing not found" is shown

---

### Requirement: SectionBlock — Editable Section Component

`SectionBlock` MUST render section image and text fields as editable inputs. It MUST expose a "Regenerate" button calling POST regen-section. On `upgrade_required` 403, MUST show an upgrade prompt (not a generic error).

#### Scenario: User triggers section regen (within quota)
- GIVEN quota allows more regens
- WHEN user clicks "Regenerate" on a SectionBlock
- THEN POST regen-section is called and button shows loading state
- AND on success the section content updates in place

#### Scenario: Regen blocked by quota
- GIVEN the plan quota is exhausted
- WHEN user clicks "Regenerate"
- THEN SectionBlock shows an upgrade prompt (not a generic error)

---

### Requirement: Config Tab — Publish Control and Required WA Number

The Config tab MUST expose `pixel_id` (optional) and `wa_number` (required) as editable fields. The publish toggle MUST be owner-only with a confirm dialog. Publishing MUST be blocked in the UI if `wa_number` is empty.

#### Scenario: User sets wa_number and publishes
- GIVEN `wa_number` is filled and the user is the owner
- WHEN user toggles publish ON and confirms the dialog
- THEN PATCH is called with `{ wa_number, published: 1 }`

#### Scenario: Publish blocked when wa_number is empty
- GIVEN `wa_number` field is empty
- WHEN user attempts to toggle publish ON
- THEN the publish action is blocked with a validation message
- AND no PATCH request is sent

#### Scenario: Confirm dialog shown before publish
- GIVEN wa_number is set and landing is currently unpublished
- WHEN user clicks the publish toggle
- THEN a confirm dialog appears before the PATCH is sent
- AND if user cancels, no request is made

---

## Domain: landing-registry (DELTA)

### MODIFIED Requirement: landings D1 Table (Migration 0011 + 0012)

(Previously: table had no `wa_number` column; no `landing_regen_log` table.)

Cumulative schema after 0011 + 0012: `wa_number TEXT` (nullable) added to `landings`; `landing_regen_log` created (append-only counter source for regen quota).

#### Scenario: Migration 0012 adds wa_number on live DB
- GIVEN migration 0011 is already applied with existing rows
- WHEN migration 0012 is applied
- THEN `wa_number` column exists as nullable on all existing rows
- AND `landing_regen_log` table is created

#### Scenario: wa_number stored per-landing (no project fallback)
- GIVEN a landing row with `wa_number = "+51999999999"`
- WHEN the landing's CTA is rendered
- THEN the WhatsApp link uses the landing's own `wa_number`
- AND `projects.wa_number` is NOT consulted as a fallback

### ADDED Requirement: Row Editability via PATCH Endpoint

Landing rows MUST be mutable after creation via PATCH. `slug` and `project_id` MUST remain immutable. Each successful PATCH MUST bump `updated_at`.

#### Scenario: PATCH updates mutable fields
- GIVEN a landing row exists with `wa_number = null`
- WHEN PATCH sends `{ wa_number: "+51999999999", pixel_id: "px-123" }`
- THEN D1 row reflects the new values and `updated_at` is bumped

---

## Domain: landing-generation (DELTA)

### MODIFIED Requirement: Landing Generation Agent (A10) Orchestrator

(Previously: SDD-1 6-phase pipeline. Modified in SDD-2: render phase hardened with `sanitizeCssValue()` in `generateGraciasPage()`.)

Phase 5 render: `generateGraciasPage()` MUST pass `color_palette.primary` through `sanitizeCssValue()` before embedding in CSS. All other phases unchanged from SDD-1.

#### Scenario: gracias.html rendered with unsafe color_palette.primary
- GIVEN `color_palette.primary` = "red; background: url(evil.com)"
- WHEN render phase calls `generateGraciasPage()`
- THEN `sanitizeCssValue()` strips unsafe tokens
- AND the rendered gracias.html embeds the sanitized value only

### ADDED Requirement: Single-Section Regen Helpers

`assets.ts` and `copy.ts` MUST expose single-section helpers callable by regen-section without running the full A10 pipeline.

| Helper | Source | Output |
|--------|--------|--------|
| `regenAssetForSection(section_id, context, note?)` | assets.ts | Updated asset URLs for that section |
| `regenCopyForSection(section_id, context, note?)` | copy.ts | Updated copy fields for that section |

#### Scenario: Regen helper regenerates hero section copy
- GIVEN valid project context and section_id = "hero"
- WHEN `regenCopyForSection("hero", context, "Make it more urgent")` is called
- THEN returned object contains updated `headline`, `subheadline`, `hero_cta`
- AND no other section is affected

#### Scenario: Regen helper falls back on Ideogram failure
- GIVEN Ideogram returns 500 on all retries
- WHEN `regenAssetForSection("hero", context)` is called
- THEN returns `{ hero_image_url: brand.logo_ideogram_references[0], fallback: true }`
- AND error is logged but not thrown

observations.title: sdd/landing-admin/design
observations.content:
# Design: landing-admin (SDD-2 of 5)

## Technical Approach
Authenticated admin layer over SDD-1 `landings` registry. New REST endpoints in `functions/api/landings/` (OUTSIDE `functions/api/agents/` so agent plan-middleware never intercepts), guarded by `requireSession` + per-row ownership. PATCH persists to D1 then re-renders landing.html/gracias.html and rewrites R2 via the SAME primitives as run.ts (`renderVibe`, `generateGraciasPage`, `writeCCText`). regen-section reuses extracted helpers from assets.ts/copy.ts, quota-gated by counting `landing_regen_log` rows in calendar month vs `plans.agent_limits_json.max_landing_regens` — mirrors validateSession() `pipelines_this_month` (NOT dropped usage_counters). Frontend: LandingsPage/LandingDetailPage/SectionBlock in existing React Router tree under ProtectedRoute, inline styles, src/lib/api.ts.

## Architecture Decisions
- Endpoint location: functions/api/landings/ (NOT under agents/, which enforces plan gates + X-Agent-Model). Keeps SDD-1 untouched.
- Method dispatch: per-verb exports onRequestGet/onRequestPatch/onRequestPost (matches projects/index.ts). onRequestPatch is NEW to this repo but native CF Pages handler.
- Dynamic route: functions/api/landings/[id].ts + [id]/regen-section.ts (single-segment [id], not [[id]] catch-all; id is always one segment).
- Ownership: landings.project_id -> projects.user_id = caller.id per request; admin bypass. Body project_id is attacker-controlled -> verify server-side (IDOR).
- Quota source: new landing_regen_log counted per calendar month (follows live validateSession count-source pattern; append-only, easy rollback).
- Re-render inputs: D1 sections_json + R2 brand.json/onboarding.json. Zero schema growth; RenderContext {brand,waNumber,pais} reconstructable; vibe already in sections_json[0].vibe.

## File Changes
- functions/api/landings/index.ts (Create): onRequestGet ownership-scoped list (admin=all), 401 unauth
- functions/api/landings/[id].ts (Create): onRequestGet IDOR-safe 404 + onRequestPatch edit+re-render+R2 rewrite
- functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts (Create): onRequestPost quota-gated regen
- functions/_shared/session.ts (Modify): add max_landing_regens to agent_limits; compute usage.landing_regens_this_month from landing_regen_log
- functions/_shared/types.ts (Modify): LandingRow.wa_number; PATCH/regen req+resp types; agent_limits.max_landing_regens
- functions/api/agents/landing/assets.ts (Modify): extract regenAssetForSection(section_id, ctx, note?) fallback-safe
- functions/api/agents/landing/copy.ts (Modify): extract regenCopyForSection(section_id, ctx, note?)
- functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts: sanitizeCssValue already at L135 -> VERIFY ONLY (Warning 1 already fixed in code)
- migrations/0013_landing_regen_log.sql (Create): wa_number on landings + landing_regen_log table
- src/pages/LandingsPage.tsx, src/pages/LandingDetailPage.tsx (4 tabs), src/components/SectionBlock.tsx (Create)
- src/App.tsx (Modify): routes /landings, /landings/:id + nav; src/lib/api.ts (Modify): landings.list/get/patch/regenSection

## Migration 0013 (next after 0012_drop_usage_counters.sql)
ALTER TABLE landings ADD COLUMN wa_number TEXT;
CREATE TABLE landing_regen_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, landing_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, section_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()));
CREATE INDEX idx_regen_log_user_month ON landing_regen_log(user_id, created_at);
Quota count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM landing_regen_log WHERE user_id=? AND created_at>=? AND created_at<? (same [monthStart,monthEnd) as pipelines_this_month). max_landing_regens=-1 -> unlimited. Add default in BOTH session.ts fallback branches.
403 shape (mirror agents/_middleware.ts): {error, upgrade_required:true, current_plan, limit, used}, status 403.

## PATCH Atomicity & Rollback
D1 and R2 have no cross-store txn. Order: D1 FIRST (source of truth = sections_json), then R2 re-render (derived).
- R2 rewrite fails after D1 commit -> return 502 {stale_render:true}; DO NOT roll back D1 (reverting loses operator edit; stale only visible when published=1). Retry PATCH re-renders idempotently from persisted sections_json (re-sending same body safe).
- D1 update fails -> nothing written, 500, no inconsistency.
- Publish gate: {published:1} with wa_number=null -> 400, no write. Render must succeed before publish considered final.
Idempotency is the safety net: re-render derives purely from persisted D1 + immutable R2 CC files, so retries converge. regen-section exception: must NOT insert landing_regen_log until generation succeeds (failed regens never consume quota); it does NOT rewrite R2 — returns new section for client to PATCH.

## Testing Strategy
- Unit: quota logic (< / = / > limit, -1 unlimited, month boundary) over mocked D1 count; regen helper fallback on Ideogram 500 (no throw, fallback:true).
- Integration (miniflare D1+R2): PATCH atomicity (D1+both R2 files rewritten, updated_at bumped); IDOR (user B on user A -> 403/404, stores unchanged); publish gate 400 no write; regen quota exhausted -> 403 + NO log insert + NO LLM call.

## Open Questions
None blocking. onRequestPatch new verb for repo but native CF Pages; establishing it here.

observations.title: Fix conversacional wsp-agent: edición de borrador + único número activo
observations.content:
**What**: Tercera mejora del bot wsp-agent-acopio (Vercel AI SDK): edición conversacional del borrador de llegadas. Antes, si el operario mandaba una corrección en lenguaje natural sobre un borrador pendiente ("cambia la hora de keiko a las 9pm y son 180 toneladas"), el bot corría extracción de llegadas NUEVAS sobre ese texto y respondía "No entendí ninguna llegada. Reenvía el mensaje." Ahora entiende correcciones, agregados y borrados sobre el borrador ya mostrado.
**Why**: Pedido explícito del usuario tras las 2 correcciones previas (LID + json_object): "el objetivo es poder hablarle normal y que pueda entender y cambiar lo necesario del borrador".
**Where**:
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/dto/extraction.dto.ts (NUEVO) — ExtractedEntry/ExtractionResult movidos acá desde wsp-agent.service.ts para evitar import circular con wsp-session.service.ts.
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-session.service.ts — PendingBatch gana campo opcional `draftEntries?: ExtractedEntry[]` (forma pre-resolución). savePendingBatch acepta el draft.
- backend/src/modules/wsp-agent-acopio/services/wsp-agent.service.ts (commit 8a35805, main, deployado VM) — nuevo método `editDraft()` (llamada OpenRouter json_object con prompt de edición `buildEditPrompt`), nuevo método `resolveSummarizeAndReply()` (unifica resolve+resumen+guardado, usado tanto por extracción inicial como por edición). En runAgentWindow: si hay pending.draftEntries y el mensaje no es confirm/cancel → editDraft() en vez de extractEntries().
**Learned**:
- Patrón de diseño clave: el borrador se guarda en DOS formas — `entries` (CommitEntryDto[], ya resuelto con IDs, listo para commit) y `draftEntries` (ExtractedEntry[], forma pre-resolución, editable por LLM). La edición opera sobre draftEntries, nunca sobre el commit ya resuelto — así el pipeline de resolve (matchear catálogo, inferir fecha/hora) sigue siendo el único punto de verdad, sin duplicar esa lógica en el prompt de edición.
- editDraft() recibe el draft completo + la instrucción, y devuelve la LISTA COMPLETA actualizada (no un diff) — más simple de razonar para el modelo y de aplicar en código.
- Guard: si el modelo de edición devuelve entries vacío (error/alucinación), se conserva el draft original en vez de perderlo — el usuario puede usar "no" para cancelar explícitamente si quiere descartar.
- Verificado end-to-end contra Redis directo (no solo logs): mensaje "keiko son 150 toneladas y llega 10pm" sobre un borrador de 200tn/8pm → resultado exacto quantityTn:150, time:"10pm"→arrivalTime:"22:00", resto de campos (proveedor, barco, fecha) intactos.
- El commit final SIGUE siendo determinístico por CONFIRM_REGEX/CANCEL_REGEX — la edición nunca escribe en BD, solo modifica el borrador en Redis.
- Test E2E de flujos multi-turno: usar script /tmp/send-webhook.sh en la VM (evita infierno de escapes de comillas anidadas al mandar JSON con \n vía ssh) — toma (conversation, msgId) como args, arma el payload Evolution v2 y postea con el secret real.

**Cierre de la tarea de hoy — único número activo**:
- Instancia `traceexport-test` (51937075149) DESACTIVADA: logout de WhatsApp (`DELETE /instance/logout/traceexport-test`, state=close) + webhook deshabilitado (enabled:false, con el `url` incluido — Evolution v2 rechaza el PUT si falta ese campo aunque solo se quiera togglear enabled). Instancia NO borrada, reversible.
- `WSP_AGENT_INSTANCE_TENANT_MAP` en VM .env reducido a `traceexport:perufrost` (antes tenía ambas instancias). Backend/worker/scheduler recreados (`--force-recreate`, sin rebuild — solo cambió una env var) para tomar el mapping nuevo.
- Único número activo del bot: `traceexport` / 51915118307.
- Commits de la sesión completa: fefa708 (LID), bd6187c (json_object), 8a35805 (edición borrador). Todos en main, pusheados y deployados en VM (34.31.70.3, /opt/traceexport/produccion-back).

**What**: SDD-2 (landing-admin) archive report finalized. The original archive (#241, 02:28) was created BEFORE Judgment Day fully closed — Round 2 review (02:43) and Round 3 fixes (02:49) ran AFTER the archive, leaving it stale. This observation supersedes that gap: ran Round 3 fresh re-judge (2 blind judges), found 2 CRITICAL + 1 confirmed WARNING(real), fixed all 3, re-judged Round 4 (found 1 new CRITICAL: promotion-before-persist ordering moved, not fixed), fixed it, re-judged Round 5: both judges clean on the core criteria (Judge B: CLEAN; Judge A: only single-judge suspects, no confirmed CRITICAL/real WARNING). **JUDGMENT: APPROVED**.

**Why**: User flagged that Judgment Day may not have fully closed before archiving. Verified true — fixed properly instead of leaving prod-facing quota/data-integrity bugs live.

**Where**: /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce
- functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts — atomic D1 batch (sections_json UPDATE + regen_log INSERT), promotion moved to AFTER batch success
- functions/api/agents/landing/assets.ts — regenAssetForSection stages hero image to temp R2 key instead of writing live key directly
- functions/api/agents/landing/copy.ts — UNSUPPORTED_REGEN_SECTIONS set (pricing, testimonials)
- src/lib/api.ts, src/components/SectionBlock.tsx — unsupported_section handling, stale_render parity
- 4 new test files in functions/api/agents/landing/__tests__/
- Commits: 2fa0f29 (archive/spec sync), be20acf (Round 3-4 fixes)
- All 271 tests pass, tsc clean

**Learned**:
- CRITICAL bug found only by ONE judge can still be real — I (orchestrator) triaged by reading the actual code directly (2 files, within inline-read threshold) rather than trusting "single judge = suspect, skip." Both turned out to be genuine.
- A fix can appear to resolve a bug but just move the failure window (Round 4: R2 promotion still ran before D1 persist confirmed, just relative to a different step). Always re-judge with FRESH eyes after every fix, never assume a targeted fix closed the class of bug.
- Carried-forward warnings for SDD-3+ (not blocking, single-judge or theoretical):
  1. stale_render/promotion-failure recovery messaging is misleading (tells user to retry, but no retry path actually completes the promotion — only a brand-new regen works)
  2. Tests are still isolated logic mirrors, not exercising the real onRequestPost handler — recurring gap across SDD-1/2/3 rounds, same root cause: CF Pages Functions handlers are hard to invoke directly in node:test. Worth a dedicated slice (Vitest + Miniflare or wrangler pages dev + supertest-like harness) in a future SDD.
  3. Lost-update race: concurrent regens of different sections on the same landing can silently clobber each other (no optimistic concurrency on sections_json UPDATE)
  4. Staged R2 objects (.staged/ prefix) are abandoned on failure paths with no lifecycle cleanup — needs an R2 lifecycle rule
  5. Hero fallback edge case: if prior hero was a fallback URL (never wrote finalKey), a promotion failure after D1 commit leaves D1 pointing at a hero key that never existed (hard 404, not just stale)

**SDD Cycle Status**: SDD-2 landing-admin now GENUINELY complete. Ready for SDD-3 (Analytics: leads + funnel).

observations.title: Judgment-day round3 fix2: regen-section quota/R2/unsupported-section bugs
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed 3 confirmed judgment-day issues in the landing section regen flow (win-comerce repo).
1. CRITICAL — log-insert-before-persist ordering: `landing_regen_log` INSERT and `sections_json` UPDATE now committed atomically via `env.DB.batch([updateSectionsStmt, insertLogStmt])` in regen-section.ts, so a transient D1 error on the UPDATE can never leave quota consumed while sections_json stays stale.
2. CRITICAL — silent live R2 overwrite: `regenAssetForSection` (assets.ts) now writes the regenerated hero image to a staged/unique R2 key (`landingAssetStagedKey`, under `.staged/` sub-path with crypto.randomUUID()) instead of the live deterministic `landingAssetKey`. Returns `{ fields, promotion? }` (AssetRegenResult) instead of a bare partial object. regen-section.ts only promotes staged→final (get+put+delete) AFTER the `copyFailed||assetFailed` check passes, right before the atomic D1 persist. On failure the staged object is simply abandoned.
3. WARNING — pricing/testimonials always failed: added `UNSUPPORTED_REGEN_SECTIONS` exported Set (`pricing`,`testimonials`) in copy.ts. regen-section.ts checks it right after section_id validation, BEFORE the quota check, returning `{ error: 'unsupported_section' }` (200, distinct from `generation_failed`) with zero quota consumption. Frontend (SectionBlock.tsx) added `unsupported_section` regen state + `UNSUPPORTED_REGEN_SECTION_IDS` check to hide the Regenerate button and show a non-misleading message for those two sections.

**Why**: Judgment-day dual review found these via code audit of functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts + functions/api/agents/landing/{assets,copy}.ts.

**Where**: functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts, functions/api/agents/landing/assets.ts, functions/api/agents/landing/copy.ts, src/lib/api.ts, src/components/SectionBlock.tsx. New tests: functions/api/agents/landing/__tests__/{regen-atomic-persist,regen-asset-staging,regen-unsupported-section}.test.ts

**Learned**: D1 `.batch()` runs statements as a single transaction (all-or-nothing commit) — same pattern already used in audit/upload.ts. Existing tests in this dir use an "isolated-mirror" technique (reproduce decision tree locally with fakes, `node:test` + `tsx --test`) rather than mocking real CF bindings, since `mock.module()` isn't reliably usable in `tsx --test` mode. Full repo suite: 266 tests across 16 files, all passing; `tsc --noEmit` clean. `crypto.randomUUID()` already used elsewhere in command-center.ts for nanoid.

observations.title: Reordered D1 batch before R2 promotion in regen-section.ts
observations.content:
**What**: Reordered functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts so `await env.DB.batch([updateSectionsStmt, insertLogStmt])` runs BEFORE the staged→final R2 hero image promotion (`env.STORAGE.put(finalKey,...)` + `delete(stagedKey)`), instead of after. Wrapped the promotion block in its own try/catch that returns a distinct `stale_render: true` / 502 response (mirroring the existing R2 re-render-failure contract) if promotion fails post-D1-commit, instead of falling into the generic outer catch's `generation_failed`.
**Why**: Judgment-day round 4 CRITICAL finding — previously promotion ran before the D1 batch, so a transient D1 batch throw would leave the outer catch reporting `generation_failed` (implying quota not consumed / nothing persisted) while the live deterministic R2 hero key had ALREADY been overwritten and the staged copy already deleted — unrecoverable silent live-site corruption with zero D1 record.
**Where**: functions/api/landings/[id]/regen-section.ts (~lines 173-260); new test functions/api/agents/landing/__tests__/regen-promotion-ordering.test.ts (3 scenarios: D1 failure leaves live key untouched, D1 success + promotion failure returns stale_asset/502 distinct from generation_failed, D1 success + promotion success happy path; plus 2 source regression guards).
**Learned**: sections_json can safely be persisted to D1 with the *final* deterministic hero_image_url path even before the actual R2 bytes are promoted, because the key is deterministic/known upfront — the split between "data record" and "asset bytes" is intentional and lets D1-first ordering work without a two-phase commit. All 271 project tests pass; tsc --noEmit clean.

observations.title: SDD-3 landing-analytics spec
observations.content:
**What**: Wrote delta/new specs for SDD-3 landing-analytics: lead-tracking (NEW), analytics-dashboard (NEW), utm-parsing (NEW), landing-serving (MODIFIED), landing-editor-ui (MODIFIED).
**Why**: Proposal left 3 open questions for spec phase (rate limit, session_id, sync/async lead capture) — resolved all three per proposal's own recommendations, no deviation.
**Where**: openspec/changes/landing-analytics/specs/{lead-tracking,analytics-dashboard,utm-parsing,landing-serving,landing-editor-ui}/spec.md (full G/W/T specs); condensed index below for Engram size budget.

# Spec: landing-analytics (SDD-3)

## lead-tracking (NEW)
- POST /api/track: public, no auth. `event_type` in {pageview, form_start, lead, wa_click}. 404 if landing missing/unpublished. Rate limit 10 req/min/IP/landing_id → 429. Inserts `landing_events`.
- POST /api/leads: public, no auth. Requires nombre, celular, landing_id. 404 if unpublished. **Sync insert before 200** (lead guaranteed persisted before WA redirect). Same rate limit.
- session_id: client-side localStorage, reused across funnel steps. No server cookie.
- Scenarios: happy path, unpublished 404, invalid event_type 400, missing fields 400, rate-limit 429.

## analytics-dashboard (NEW)
- GET /api/landings/:id/analytics/{funnel,leads,kpi}: requireSession, ownership-scoped (project_id→user_id, admin bypass), 404 on IDOR.
- funnel: counts + conversion_rate. leads: paginated (50/200 max), created_at DESC. kpi: leads_today, avg_leads_per_day, top_utm_source (null if none).

## utm-parsing (NEW)
- Client extracts utm_* from query string; missing params omitted, no error. Server persists present fields, absence=NULL. pageview/lead utm values may legitimately differ.

## landing-serving (MODIFIED)
- landing.html render injects window.winTrack(eventType) script (render-time). Fires pageview/form_start/lead/wa_click, fire-and-forget. wa_click before WA redirect. Preserved on PATCH re-render.

## landing-editor-ui (MODIFIED)
- Analytics tab placeholder → real AnalyticsTab (funnel chart, sortable/paginated leads table, KPI cards). Fetches only when tab active. Ownership enforced server-side.

## Key Decisions
1. Rate limit: 10 req/min/IP/landing_id (no deviation from proposal).
2. session_id: client-side localStorage (no deviation).
3. Lead capture: synchronous insert before 200 (no deviation).
4. Unpublished landing: /api/track and /api/leads both return 404 (new decision, consistent with GET /l/:slug 404 behavior).

**Learned**: Ownership IDOR pattern across all specs returns 404 (not 403) to avoid leaking existence — matches landing-admin-api convention.

observations.title: sdd/landing-analytics/design
observations.content:
# Design: landing-analytics (SDD-3)

## Technical Approach
Reuse existing ownership-JOIN pattern (landings→projects.user_id), existing KV checkRateLimit helper, existing renderVibe→renderAndPersistLanding pipeline. Two new append-only D1 tables (leads, landing_events), two new public write endpoints, three new authenticated read endpoints. Tracking script injected into the same HTML string vibe renderers already produce.

**Correction**: migrations dir highest file is 0013_landing_regen_log.sql (no 0014 exists). Next migrations are 0014_leads.sql and 0015_landing_events.sql (not 0015/0016 as task premise assumed).

## Key Decisions
1. Rate limiting: reuse KV checkRateLimit (functions/_shared/rate-limit.ts), add `track: {10,60}` to LIMITS, call with limitType=`track_${landingId}` (baseType split('_')[0] naturally scopes per-landing+IP). No new D1 counter/in-memory state (Workers isolates don't persist memory).
2. Lead double-submit: client-side disable-on-click; accept rare duplicates (matches proposal's no-honeypot/no-CAPTCHA "single-tenant COD tool" philosophy). No server idempotency key.
3. UTM: read location.search fresh inside winTrack() on every call (not cached) — gives pageview-vs-lead UTM divergence for free per spec. Only session_id persisted in localStorage.
4. GAP FOUND: no lead `<form>` exists anywhere in templates (bold/premium/warm/clinical) — only `<a href="wa.me/...">` anchors. Solution: shared leadCaptureModal() partial in templates/index.ts + swap anchor href→data-wa-href/js-wa-cta class, intercepted by injected script; avoids duplicating form markup across 4 files.

## Schema
- leads(id, landing_id, nombre, celular, direccion, ciudad, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term, created_at) + idx(landing_id, created_at)
- landing_events(id, landing_id, event_type, session_id, utm_*, created_at) + idx(landing_id, created_at)
- No FK constraints (matches landing_regen_log convention).

## Contracts
POST /api/track (public): {event_type, session_id, landing_id, utm_*} → 200|400|404|429
POST /api/leads (public): {nombre, celular, landing_id, direccion?, ciudad?, utm_*} → 200{id}|400|404|429 (sync insert before 200)
GET /api/landings/:id/analytics/{funnel,leads,kpi} (requireSession, ownership JOIN, 404 on IDOR)
RenderContext gains `landingId: string` field.

## Files
New: migrations/0014_leads.sql, 0015_landing_events.sql; functions/api/track.ts; functions/api/leads.ts; functions/api/landings/[id]/analytics/{funnel,leads,kpi}.ts; src/components/AnalyticsTab.tsx
Modified: functions/_shared/types.ts, functions/_shared/rate-limit.ts, functions/api/agents/landing/templates/{index,bold,premium,warm,clinical}.ts, functions/api/landings/_shared/render-landing.ts, src/pages/LandingDetailPage.tsx, src/lib/api.ts

Full doc: openspec/changes/landing-analytics/design.md
**Learned**: Always verify migration numbering claims against actual `ls migrations/` — task premise about 0013/0014 already used was stale; only 0013 existed. Also: spec assumed a lead form existed in templates when it doesn't — codebase reading caught this gap before implementation.

observations.content:
**What**: JUDGMENT DAY ROUND 1 FIX PASS — applied 5 confirmed issues from the dual-review of SDD-3 landing-analytics against repo /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce. MERGES prior PR1+PR2+PR3+Phase6 state (obs #252) with this fix pass. All fixes verified via `npx wrangler pages functions build` (the only reliable check for functions/ import resolution, since tsconfig `include` excludes functions/).

**Why**: Judgment-day dual reviewer pass found 1 CRITICAL (undeployable build) + 4 WARNING issues in the already-implemented feature.

**Where / fixes applied**:
| # | Sev | File(s) | Fix | Commit |
|---|-----|---------|-----|--------|
| 1 | CRITICAL | functions/api/leads.ts, functions/api/track.ts | Broken imports `./_shared/...` → `../_shared/...` (these files live directly in functions/api/, one level above functions/_shared/, NOT under functions/api/agents/landing/ which needs `../../_shared`). `npx wrangler pages functions build` failed before, succeeds after. | 24fc1c6 |
| 3 | WARNING | functions/api/leads.ts, functions/api/track.ts | Added max-length checks in isValidBody: nombre≤120, celular≤30, direccion/ciudad≤200, session_id≤128, utm_*≤255. New test file functions/api/__tests__/leads-track-validation.test.ts. | 50ebcd2 |
| 2 | WARNING | functions/api/agents/landing/templates/index.ts (trackingScript) | Lead form submit handler now gates `winTrack('lead')` on `response.ok` from `/api/leads` POST — previously fired unconditionally in `.then()`, recording fake lead events + redirecting to WA even on 400/404/429 failures. WA redirect still always proceeds (visitor never trapped); console.warn on failure. Added assertion test in templates.test.ts. | 1e91c33 |
| 4 | WARNING | functions/api/landings/[id]/analytics/kpi.ts | leads_today/avg_leads_per_day day boundaries switched from raw UTC flooring to a fixed UTC-5 offset (documented in-line as a temporary approximation, no per-user timezone system exists). | cee9ae3 |
| 5 | WARNING | functions/_shared/rate-limit.ts, functions/api/leads.ts | /api/leads now uses its own rate-limit bucket key `leads_${landing_id}` (new explicit `leads` LIMITS entry, same 10/60 threshold) instead of sharing `track_${landing_id}` with /api/track — prevents pageview/event traffic from a shared NAT/CGNAT IP starving real lead submissions. Updated track-rate-limit.test.ts scenario (a) which had asserted the now-removed shared-bucket behavior. | f790afd |

**Verification**: `npx tsx --test` → 318/318 passing (306 baseline + 12 new: 2 leads-track-validation describe blocks + 1 templates.test.ts case, minus rewritten scenario (a) net). `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=/tmp/wrangler-build-final` → "Compiled Worker successfully", zero errors — this is the fix that actually proves #1 is resolved since tsc doesn't check functions/.

**Commits**: 5 local commits (not pushed), one per issue: 24fc1c6 (import fix), 50ebcd2 (length caps), 1e91c33 (response.ok gating), cee9ae3 (UTC-5 kpi), f790afd (rate-limit bucket split).

**Learned**:
- Root tsconfig.json `include: ["src"]` means `npx tsc --noEmit` NEVER catches import errors inside functions/ — the only reliable check for Pages Functions import resolution is `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=<tmp>`. This should be part of the standard pre-commit/CI check for any functions/ change, not just this fix pass.
- fetch() promises only reject on network failure, never on 4xx/5xx HTTP status — any fire-and-forget tracking/analytics call chained off fetch() must explicitly check `response.ok` before treating the call as a success, or it silently records false-positive events.
- Deferred/out-of-scope per this fix pass (explicitly not touched): Phase 6.4-6.7 integration/E2E tests (still require real D1/browser), pagination, modal dismiss UX, and any other theoretical/suggestion-level findings from the dual review not in the 5 confirmed issues above.

observations.title: CRITICAL discovery: tsc --noEmit never checks functions/ (Pages Functions) — wrangler build is the only real check
observations.content:
**What**: root tsconfig.json has `"include": ["src"]` only — `npx tsc --noEmit` NEVER typechecks anything under `functions/` (Cloudflare Pages Functions backend). Every SDD-1/2/3 apply and verify phase that reported "tsc --noEmit clean" was only checking the frontend, never the backend.

**Why**: Discovered because SDD-3's track.ts/leads.ts had broken relative imports (`./_shared/rate-limit` instead of `../_shared/rate-limit` — functions/api/track.ts is one level shallower than functions/api/landings/[id]/... which uses `../../_shared`). tsc reported clean 5+ times across multiple fresh-context gatekeeper reviews. Ran `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=/tmp/...` directly and it failed with "Could not resolve './_shared/rate-limit'" — confirming the feature was completely undeployable despite "clean" typecheck and 306/306 passing tests.

**Where**: /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce/tsconfig.json, functions/api/track.ts, functions/api/leads.ts

**Learned**: `npx tsc --noEmit` is NOT sufficient to validate Cloudflare Pages Functions code in this project. `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=<tmp>` (esbuild-based, same bundler Cloudflare uses at deploy time) is the only check that actually resolves `functions/` imports. From now on, every SDD apply/verify/gatekeeper phase touching `functions/` MUST run a wrangler build check, not just tsc --noEmit + node:test. This is a process gap across the whole win-comerce SDD chain (SDD-1, SDD-2, SDD-3 all only ran tsc --noEmit on functions/ code, never actually build-verified it) — should be added as a standing check in the sdd-verify/sdd-apply skill instructions for this project.

Round 1 fixes (commits 24fc1c6, 50ebcd2, 1e91c33, cee9ae3, f790afd):

CRITICAL — broken relative imports (`./_shared/...` instead of `../_shared/...`) in functions/api/track.ts and leads.ts made the ENTIRE feature undeployable. `npx wrangler pages functions build` failed. observations.title: sdd/landing-creatives/design
observations.content:
# Design: landing-creatives (SDD-4)

## Technical Approach
Wrap A7's text concepts with an interactive image-generation layer mirroring SDD-2's regen-section quota/atomicity pattern but with a corrected, stricter ordering: promote R2 first, persist D1 second. New `functions/api/creatives/` REST surface, two new D1 tables (migration 0016), new CreativesTab on LandingDetailPage. `generateImages()` only accepts one prompt per call — carousel generation fans out 4 parallel calls instead of a literal single multi-prompt batch call.

## Architecture Decisions

1. **Commit flow promotes R2 first, writes D1 second** (opposite of regen-section.ts's D1-first order). Rationale: regen-section's live hero key is actively referenced by published HTML (so D1-first with retryable stale_render is acceptable there); creative packs' `final/` path is dormant until `status='approved'` flips in D1, so R2-first is strictly safer and satisfies the spec's harder "no quota without full promotion success" requirement.
2. **Carousel generation = 4 parallel `generateImages()` calls** (`numImages:1` each) via `Promise.allSettled`, wrapped in one `generateCarouselImages()` helper. `IdeogramConfig.prompt` is a single string — there is no native multi-prompt batch API (verified in `ideogram.ts`). This satisfies the spec's "single batch call" requirement at the call-site level while matching `assets.ts`'s existing per-image-call precedent, parallelized.
3. Any failure during **preview** generation (Ideogram call) discards the whole attempt — no partial preview staged, no log row (mirrors regen-section's full-failure rule).
4. `ad_creatives.landing_id` is required (not just `project_id`) because `landings.project_id` is not unique (a project can have multiple landings); carousel slide copy/pricing is sourced from one specific landing's `sections_json`.

## Data Model (migration 0016_ad_creatives.sql)
- `ad_creatives`: id, project_id, landing_id, concept_id, format('static'|'carousel'), status('draft'|'preview'|'approved'), created_at, updated_at. Indexes: project_id, (status, updated_at) for TTL cron.
- `creative_pack_log`: id, pack_id, project_id, user_id, event('select'|'preview'|'commit'|'regenerate'), note, created_at. Indexes: (user_id, created_at) mirrors idx_regen_log_user_month; (pack_id, event).
- Quota source: count `creative_pack_log` rows with `event='commit'` per calendar month vs `plans.agent_limits_json.max_creative_generations` (-1 = unlimited). Add to session.ts usage as `creatives_this_month`.

## R2 Layout
- Preview: `cc/{project_id}/ad-creatives/{concept_id}/preview/{image_1_1.jpg | slide_1..4.jpg}`
- Final: `cc/{project_id}/ad-creatives/{concept_id}/final/{same files} + creative_pack.json`
- Preview objects are copied (not moved) to final on commit and are NEVER deleted by the commit flow (success or failure) — only the 7-day TTL cron deletes preview/ objects, and only for packs still in "preview" status.

## Atomic Commit Sequence (commit.ts)
1. requireSession + ownership (ad_creatives.project_id -> projects.user_id), 404 on IDOR.
2. Check preview objects exist in R2; 410 preview_expired if purged by TTL cron.
3. Quota check (event='commit' count vs max_creative_generations) BEFORE any R2 write; 403 upgrade_required if exhausted.
4. R2 promotion: for each expected file (1 static / 4 carousel + creative_pack.json), get(preview key) -> put(final key). If ANY fails -> return 500 {error:'commit_failed', failedSlides:[...]}, D1 is NEVER touched, status stays 'preview', no quota consumed. Partially-copied final/ objects from the failed attempt are harmless orphans (unreferenced until status flips) that a retry silently overwrites.
5. Only after ALL R2 writes succeed: single `env.DB.batch([UPDATE ad_creatives SET status='approved', INSERT creative_pack_log(event='commit')])`.
6. Retry after failed commit does not double-charge (preview/ objects preserved, quota untouched until full success).

## Endpoint Contracts
- POST /api/creatives/select-and-preview { landingId, conceptIds[1-3], format, notes? } -> 200 {packId, previewUrls, status:'preview'} | 502 on any slide fail (no log row) | 422 missing pricing for carousel.
- POST /api/creatives/commit { packId } -> 200 {status:'approved', finalUrls} | 403 upgrade_required | 410 preview_expired | 500 commit_failed.
- POST /api/creatives/:id/regenerate, GET /api/creatives, GET /api/creatives/:id (404 IDOR), GET /api/creatives/:id/download-zip (409 if not approved).

## Testing Strategy
Unit: buildCarouselPrompts fixed order + Pack B (packs[1]) lookup + missing-pricing error; quota math. Integration: preview->commit happy path, IDOR 404s, partial-slide-failure->no-quota, retry-no-double-charge (miniflare D1+R2, mocked Ideogram). E2E: Playwright CreativesTab flow. **Build gate: every functions/ change MUST pass `npx wrangler pages functions build`, not just tsc --noEmit (SDD-3 discovery — type errors invisible to tsc alone surface only at Pages Functions build time).**

## Files
New: migrations/0016_ad_creatives.sql, functions/api/agents/landing/carousel-builder.ts, functions/api/creatives/{select-and-preview,commit,regenerate,index,_cleanup}.ts, functions/api/creatives/[id]/{index,download-zip}.ts, src/components/{CreativesTab,CreativePackView}.tsx. Modified: functions/_shared/types.ts, functions/_shared/session.ts (max_creative_generations, creatives_this_month), src/pages/LandingDetailPage.tsx, src/lib/api.ts.

## Open Questions
- Confirm plan-tier max_creative_generations values with product before plans UPDATE step.
- Pack B = packs[1] (second pricing tier) index convention — confirm A10 always orders packs[] this way.

observations.title: SDD-4 landing-creatives apply-progress (Judgment Day Round 2 fix)
observations.content:
**What**: Round 2 Judgment Day fix — closed a second, deeper race in regenerate.ts left open by Round 1's fix #2/#5 (see prior revision of this topic, obs #266). 1 local commit (96047aa), not pushed, stacked on 09cc847.

**Issue fixed (CRITICAL)**: regenerate.ts's final `UPDATE ad_creatives SET status = 'preview', updated_at = unixepoch() WHERE id = ?` (added in Round 1 to fix the expired-pack dead end) was unconditional. The Round 1 409 `already_approved` guard only checks status BEFORE the multi-second Ideogram generation calls — it cannot see a commit that happens WHILE generation is in flight. Reachable sequence: pack is 'preview' → user clicks "Regenerar" (passes 409 guard, generation starts) → while generation runs, "Generar final" is still enabled → user clicks it → commit.ts approves (quota charged, 1 commit log row) → regenerate finishes and its unconditional UPDATE silently demotes the now-approved pack back to 'preview' → user clicks "Generar final" again → commit.ts's own `AND status != 'approved'` guard (from Round 1 fix #3) sees status='preview' again and lets it through → SECOND commit log row → permanent double quota charge, plus silent mid-flight demotion of an approved pack.

**Fix**: Guarded the demote UPDATE the same way commit.ts guards its approve UPDATE: `... WHERE id = ? AND status != 'approved'`. Check `updateResult.meta.changes` — if 0, a concurrent commit won the race: return 409 `{error: 'already_approved'}` instead of the normal success response, and do NOT insert the 'regenerate' log row (moved the INSERT to run only after the guarded UPDATE succeeds, reordering it after the UPDATE instead of before). Freshly-generated preview R2 objects are left as harmless orphans (same "orphan is fine" pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase, e.g. commit.ts's partial-promotion failure path).

**Frontend (cheap defense-in-depth)**: CreativePackView.tsx's commit button now also disables while `regenerating` is true (`disabled={committing || regenerating}`), reducing how often the race is actually hit — not a substitute for the backend fix.

**Where**: functions/api/creatives/[id]/regenerate.ts (guard + reorder), src/components/CreativePackView.tsx (commit button disabled state), functions/api/creatives/__tests__/regenerate-concurrent-commit.test.ts (new — isolated-mirror test with a "BUGGY behavior" test that documents the pre-fix bug plus a "FIXED behavior" test, following atomic-commit.test.ts's convention), functions/api/creatives/__tests__/regenerate-status.test.ts (updated one existing regex-match test whose assertion was against the old unguarded SQL string — would have failed otherwise).

**Verification (all 3 gates)**: `npx tsx --test` (full repo): 403/403 pass. `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean. `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=/tmp/opencode/sdd4-r2-fix-build`: Compiled Worker successfully, zero errors.

**Learned**: A guard added to close one race (Round 1's top-of-handler 409 check) does not automatically protect a later mutation in the same handler once the handler does slow async work (Ideogram generation) between the guard and that mutation — every D1 write reachable after an await gap needs its own concurrency guard, not just the entry check. This is the same `meta.changes`-gating pattern from Round 1 fix #3, now applied a second time in the same file family (commit.ts approve UPDATE, regenerate.ts demote UPDATE) — worth treating as this codebase's standard idempotent-status-flip pattern for any future D1 status transition here.

**Status**: Judgment Day Round 2 fix COMPLETE — the one confirmed critical issue resolved, test added, all 3 gates green. Not pushed.

observations.title: Judgment Day PR1 verify: landing-creatives backend
observations.content:
**What**: Fresh-context gatekeeper review of SDD-4 PR1 (backend) in win-comerce. Independently ran `npx tsx --test` (329/329 pass, 0 fail — confirmed real), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx wrangler pages functions build` (zero errors). Verified baseline at ad55abb (pre-PR1) = 292 tests via git worktree, matching PR1's own claimed baseline math (292+37=329). Note: SDD-3's own archive/verify reports (#256/#261) claimed "306/306" at that same commit — that number does not match what's actually in git history (292). This is a pre-existing SDD-3 reporting inconsistency, NOT something PR1 caused; PR1's math is internally correct against actual git state.
**Why**: Orchestrator requested PR1 validation before proceeding to PR2 (frontend).
**Where**: functions/api/creatives/**, migrations/0016_ad_creatives.sql, openspec/changes/landing-creatives/*
**Verdict**: PASS WITH CONCERNS.
- commit.ts: correctly R2-first/D1-second, all-or-nothing, no partial quota consumption — verified by reading source.
- ownership.ts: correctly mirrors 404-not-403 IDOR pattern with admin bypass.
- Deviation (b) confirmed real: Cloudflare Pages Functions genuinely have no native `scheduled` export (Workers-only capability) — claim is accurate. But confirmed via grep that NOTHING invokes `_cleanup.ts` in production (no wrangler.jsonc cron config, no external scheduler wired) — the TTL cleanup is currently a no-op in production, just an inert endpoint. Not blocking (no correctness break) but should be tracked as follow-up before this matters (R2 storage cost accumulation).
- Deviation (c) — the more serious one: spec (ad-creative-storage) says cleanup "deletes preview/ R2 objects plus the ad_creatives row itself." PR1 instead keeps the row status='preview' forever, only deleting R2 objects. This is NOT the "spec self-contradiction" the code comment claims — a correct alternative existed (use creative_pack_log to distinguish expired-vs-never-existed while still deleting the ad_creatives row, satisfying both scenarios literally). Confirmed via reading index.ts and [id]/index.ts that GET /api/creatives and GET /api/creatives/:id return raw D1 rows with no R2-existence check — so expired-but-retained rows will be served forever as status='preview' pointing at dead R2 keys (stale/broken references), and the table grows unbounded with phantom entries. Recommend corrective fix before PR2 ships a UI that lists/renders these packs: either (a) flip status to a distinct terminal value like 'expired' on purge instead of leaving 'preview', or (b) actually delete the row and use creative_pack_log lookups in commit.ts for the 410 distinction.
**Learned**: When a PR claims "the spec is self-contradictory" as justification for a deviation, verify that claim directly against spec text — in this case the spec was internally consistent and satisfiable without deviation; the claimed contradiction only exists if you assume a single-flag design instead of using the existing audit-log table.

observations.title: Session summary: ecomerce

Judgment Day Round 1 surgical fix pass on SDD-4 landing-creatives backend (repo: /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce) — fix 6 confirmed issues from dual-review, no refactoring beyond scope.

## Discoveries
- D1Result.run() exposes `meta.changes` for rows-affected checks — no prior precedent in this codebase for conditional-write-then-conditional-log patterns.
- Root tsconfig.json only includes `src/` — `npx tsc --noEmit` does NOT type-check `functions/`; `npx wrangler pages functions build` is the real signal for functions/ type errors.
- Old source-regression tests that grep for a literal string (e.g. `env.DB.batch([`) are fragile — a comment mentioning that string kept a stale regression guard "passing" after the real code no longer used it. Assert on actually-changed behavior/regex patterns, not loose substrings.

- ✅ Issue #2 (CRITICAL): regenerate.ts now always flips status back to 'preview' after successful regen (fixes expired-pack-can-never-commit-again dead end).
- ✅ Issue #3 (CRITICAL): commit.ts's unconditional batch replaced with conditional UPDATE (`AND status != 'approved'`) + conditional INSERT gated on `meta.changes > 0`, preventing double commit-log rows / double quota charge under concurrent commit requests.
- ✅ Issue #4 (WARNING): commit.ts's idempotent already-approved branch now includes computed `finalUrls`.
- ✅ Issue #5 (WARNING): regenerate.ts returns 409 `already_approved` immediately after ownership check.
- ✅ Issue #6 (WARNING): select-and-preview.ts now appends notes to both static and carousel prompts (mirrors regenerate.ts's existing pattern).
- ✅ Added/updated tests: storage-keys.test.ts (new), regenerate-status.test.ts (new), notes-prompt.test.ts (new), atomic-commit.test.ts (updated regression guards + new concurrent-race describe block).
- ✅ All 3 gates green: `npx tsx --test` 368/368 pass, `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npx wrangler pages functions build` compiled successfully.
- ✅ 5 local commits (not pushed): 737319b, 824a77b, 3b07fd0, 3c18578, 09cc847.
- ✅ Confirmed CreativePackView.tsx/CreativesTab.tsx need no frontend changes — backend now returns the shape they already expect.

## Next Steps

- functions/api/creatives/assets/[[path]].ts — serving route parses 5 path segments incl. packId

observations.title: SDD-4 landing-creatives — Judgment Day ESCALATED (user-accepted, 2 known races remain)
observations.content:
**What**: Judgment Day (2 blind judges) on SDD-4 landing-creatives, 3 rounds. Rounds 1-2 found and fixed 4 CRITICAL + 3 real WARNINGs (all re-verified PASS). Round 3 found 1 more CRITICAL (same unconditional-update race pattern, now in _cleanup.ts) + 1 real WARNING (regenerate+commit R2-layer slide mixing). User explicitly chose to STOP after 2 fix iterations (per Judgment Day protocol's mandatory 2-iteration check-in) rather than continue fixing. **JUDGMENT: ESCALATED (user-accepted)** — shipping with 2 documented known risks, not silently approved.

**Why**: Protocol requires asking the user after 2 fix iterations with remaining issues. User chose to stop and archive with the risks documented rather than pursue further fix/re-judge cycles.

**Where**: /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce

**Fixed (rounds 1-2, re-verified clean)**:
1. R2 keys lacked packId → cross-pack collision/overwrite for same concept+format (storage.ts + all callers)
2. regenerate.ts never flipped status back from 'expired' → permanent dead-end on commit (410 forever)
3. commit.ts unconditional UPDATE/INSERT → concurrent double-commit could double-charge quota (fixed: guarded UPDATE + meta.changes-gated INSERT)
4. commit.ts idempotent-approved response missing finalUrls → frontend crash on retry
5. regenerate.ts allowed on approved packs (no guard) → wasted credits, UI-only enforcement
6. select-and-preview.ts ignored user notes (never reached Ideogram prompt)
7. regenerate.ts's demote-to-preview UPDATE was ALSO unconditional (same race pattern as #3, discovered one guard-fix later) → could silently demote a pack approved mid-flight, enabling double charge via a second path. Fixed with the same guarded-UPDATE pattern.

**NOT FIXED — known risks carried forward for SDD-5 or a dedicated hardening pass**:
1. CRITICAL — `functions/api/creatives/_cleanup.ts` (TTL purge cron) has the SAME unconditional-update race as the two already-fixed endpoints: it SELECTs stale preview packs, then loops UPDATE-ing status='expired' with no `AND status='preview' AND updated_at < cutoff` guard and no `meta.changes` check. A pack approved concurrently with the cleanup sweep can be silently demoted from 'approved' to 'expired', re-enabling the double-charge pattern via a third path (regenerate → commit again). Fix is the identical one-line guard pattern already applied twice in this SDD — should be quick to apply whenever picked up.
2. WARNING (real) — regenerate.ts and commit.ts can interleave at the R2 layer (not just the D1 status layer): regenerate overwrites preview/ objects one slide at a time over several seconds; a concurrent commit reading preview/ objects mid-overwrite can promote a MIX of old and new slides into a single committed final/ pack — logically inconsistent creative, no error surfaced, one legitimate quota charge but wrong/inconsistent images shipped. Requires a locking/versioning mechanism (e.g. optimistic version column) to close properly, not a one-line fix like the others.

**Learned**:
- The "unconditional UPDATE with no status/rows-affected guard" bug pattern appeared 3 SEPARATE times in this one feature (commit.ts approve, regenerate.ts demote, _cleanup.ts expire) — anywhere a status-machine transition writes to a row that another concurrent handler might also be transitioning, the guarded-UPDATE + meta.changes-check pattern must be applied by default, not just where a judge happens to catch it. Worth adding as a standing design principle for SDD-5.
- Judgment Day protocol's "ask after 2 fix iterations" rule did its job here — a 3rd round found a near-identical bug to what was just fixed twice, which is a signal to pause and get human judgment on cost/benefit rather than keep autonomously iterating.

**SDD Cycle Status**: SDD-4 landing-creatives archived with 2 documented known-risk carry-forwards (not blocking, low-probability races, no data loss — worst case is a demoted/inconsistent pack, self-healing via regenerate).

observations.content:
## SDD-4 landing-creatives Archive Report

**Change**: landing-creatives (SDD-4 of 5)

**Archive Path**: `openspec/changes/archive/2026-07-02-landing-creatives/`

## Executive Summary

SDD-4 landing-creatives is fully implemented and verified **with an ESCALATED status** — not a clean PASS. All 6 phases (backend migration/types/endpoints/tests, frontend client/tab) are complete per tasks.md, with justified skips on frontend test phases (no test runner in project). **Judgment Day (3 rounds, 2 fix iterations by user decision) found 7 confirmed issues, 4 were fixed and re-verified clean. 2 known risks remain documented and carried forward** — both low-probability concurrency races with no data loss, accepted by the user rather than continued fixing.

- Atomic commit sequencing: R2-first, then D1 status flip, then quota log (not D1-first as in prior SDD-2 regen-section)

---

## Verification Status

### Task Completion Gate: ✅ PASS

### Judgment Day Verdict: ESCALATED (user-accepted, 2 known risks remain)

**Rounds 1-2 Issues Found & Fixed (all re-verified PASS)**:
1. **R2 cross-pack collision** — Key structure lacked packId, same concept+format could collide/overwrite. Fixed in storage.ts + all callers.
2. **Regenerate dead-end** — `regenerate.ts` never flipped status from 'expired' back to 'preview', permanent 410. Fixed.
3. **Unconditional update (commit)** — `commit.ts` unconditional `UPDATE ad_creatives status='approved'` + INSERT allowed concurrent double-commit + double-quota-charge. Fixed with `AND status != 'approved'` guard + `meta.changes` check.
4. **Idempotent failure (commit)** — `commit.ts` on retry did not return computed `finalUrls`, causing frontend crash. Fixed.
5. **Allowed regenerate on approved** — No guard; wasted Ideogram credits + UI-only enforcement. Fixed.
6. **Lost notes** — `select-and-preview.ts` accepted notes but never passed to Ideogram. Fixed.
7. **Second unconditional update (regenerate)** — `regenerate.ts` demote-to-preview UPDATE was also unconditional (same race pattern as fix #3, caught after guard #3 applied). Fixed with same guard pattern.

2. **WARNING (real) — R2-layer slide mixing race** (regenerate.ts + commit.ts interleave at R2 level)
   - `regenerate.ts` overwrites `preview/` objects one slide at a time over several seconds.
   - `commit.ts` can read `preview/` objects mid-overwrite and promote a MIX of old + new slides into a single committed `final/` pack.
   - **Impact**: Low-probability (commit window is narrow), logically inconsistent creative output (wrong/mixed images shipped), one legitimate quota charge applied.

Chose AES-GCM via new `META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` Cloudflare secret (matches existing `wrangler secret put` pattern for IDEOGRAM_API_KEY). Storage format: `base64(iv):base64(ciphertext)` in `integrations.token_encrypted`. Fresh random IV per encryption.
2. **Token expiry UX specified**: `GET /api/integrations/meta/status` returns `expiry_status`: active (>7d) / expiring_soon (≤7d) / expired. Expired token MUST fail-fast on sync without calling Meta API; UI MUST show re-auth banner, never silently fail.

4. Every new endpoint follows established ownership pattern: JOIN on `projects.user_id`, 404 (not 403) for IDOR, admin bypass.
5. Empty states specified explicitly: hub/angles/creatives MUST render with null KPIs + guidance message ("Connect Meta to see performance") — never require Meta connection to be useful, never error on missing data.
6. AI recommendation: single batched LLM call per project (not per-angle) bounds cost; rejects with `insufficient_data` (no LLM call) when zero performance data exists; 10s sync timeout.
7. Angle variation generation: new `angle_id` + `parent_angle_id` FK for lineage (not suffix naming, per proposal's open question #4 recommendation); variants start `status: pending_review`, not usable in creative commits until editor approval.

observations.title: sdd/landing-hub/design
observations.content:
# Design: landing-hub (SDD-5 of 5 — Final)

## Technical Approach

Hub is a read-mostly aggregation layer over SDD-1..4 data plus two new capabilities (Meta token storage, manual sync). All writes are user-triggered (no cron). New backend surface: `functions/api/integrations/*`, `functions/api/analytics/*`, `functions/api/angles/{id}/generate-variation`. New frontend: `LandingHubPage.tsx` + 5 card components + 3 modals.

**Two corrections to the proposal/spec, verified against actual code, applied here as binding decisions:**

1. **Migration number**: highest existing file is `0016_ad_creatives.sql`. Next free is **`0017`**, not `0018` as proposal stated.
2. **Table name collision (blocking)**: `migrations/0001_initial.sql` already defines `creative_performance` (keyed by `report_id → daily_reports`, columns `ad_name/score_1_10/decision`) and `angle_performance` (keyed by `brief_id`, columns `ctr_real/dias_activo/decision_final`) for the existing SDD-8 audit-report flywheel (`functions/api/audit/upload.ts`, `functions/api/audit/[[reportId]].ts`). These are live, in-use tables with different schemas and different semantics (manual CSV-audit ingestion, not Meta sync). Proposal's `ALTER TABLE creative_performance ADD COLUMN ...` would corrupt that table. **Decision: SDD-5 uses new table names `ad_creative_performance` and `angle_performance_rollup`.** Every reference to `creative_performance`/`angle_performance` in the 7 specs must map to these new names in tasks/apply — required spec correction.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Perf tables | New `ad_creative_performance` / `angle_performance_rollup` | Name collision with live SDD-8 audit tables |
| Token encryption | AES-GCM, raw 32-byte key via `META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` secret, no KDF | Verified zero encrypt/decrypt precedent in codebase (only digest/HMAC/verify/deriveBits). Key used directly as raw AES-256 key material |
| Sync atomicity | Guarded `UPDATE ... WHERE sync_status != 'running'` + `meta.changes` check | Mirrors `functions/api/creatives/commit.ts`'s 3rd-round Judgment Day fix (guarded-UPDATE pattern, not unconditional batch) |
| Angle variation | New thin endpoint, NOT calling `angulos/run.ts` | Read A7's actual code: it's a 4-LLM-call pipeline that overwrites the entire angle set (not additive/single-angle). New endpoint reuses only `callLLM`/`parseLLMJson`/`wrapUserData` utilities with a dedicated prompt |
| Hub data fetch | One aggregation endpoint, `Promise.all` of 4-5 scoped queries | Avoids N+1/waterfall, single ownership check |

## Data Flow

POST /sync claims via guarded UPDATE (409 if already running) → Meta API fetch/retry → per-ad upsert into `ad_creative_performance` → on any failure: release claim, sync_error set, sync_last_at UNCHANGED, 207 partial → on full success: rollup GROUP BY angle_id into `angle_performance_rollup` → UPDATE integrations sync_status='idle', sync_last_at=now. GET /hub does Promise.all[brand(R2), landings(D1), angles+rollup(D1+R2), creatives+perf(D1)].

## File Changes (16 files)

New: `migrations/0017_hub_integrations.sql`, `functions/_shared/crypto.ts`, `functions/_shared/meta-api.ts`, `functions/api/integrations/meta/{token,status,sync}.ts`, `functions/api/integrations/_shared/ownership.ts`, `functions/api/analytics/angles.ts`, `functions/api/analytics/creatives/[packId].ts`, `functions/api/analytics/recommend-angles.ts`, `functions/api/angles/[id]/generate-variation.ts`, `src/pages/LandingHubPage.tsx` + 5 cards + 3 modals. Modified: `functions/_shared/types.ts` (add `META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` to Env), `src/lib/api.ts`, `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`.

## Key Interfaces

- `encryptToken`/`decryptToken` in `functions/_shared/crypto.ts`: AES-GCM, fresh 12-byte IV per call, storage format `base64(iv):base64(ciphertext)`.
- `integrations` table gets `sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'idle'` column (not in original proposal) — used as the concurrency claim flag for the guarded-UPDATE 409 pattern.
- `ad_creative_performance`: UNIQUE(meta_ad_id), FKs to project_id/pack_id, columns spend_usd/impressions/clicks/ctr/conversions/cpa/hook_rate/synced_at.
- `angle_performance_rollup`: UNIQUE(project_id, angle_id).
- AI recommendation: single batched `callLLM` call per project (not per-angle), 10s timeout via Promise.race, `insufficient_data` short-circuit before any LLM call when all rows have conversions IS NULL.
- Generate variation: new `angle_id` + `parent_angle_id` FK, `status: 'pending_review'`, appended to `angles.json` via `writeCC` — no call into `angulos/run.ts`.

## Testing Strategy

Unit (crypto round-trip, expiry derivation), Integration (sync atomicity/409/ownership 404s/rollup math via Supertest+real D1), E2E (Playwright: hub empty-state, sync, analysis, variation-generation gating). **Gate: `npx wrangler pages functions build` MUST pass before verify** (SDD-3/4 lesson — TS errors invisible to tsc alone under Pages Functions module resolution).

## Migration / Rollout

Additive only, no existing table altered. Rollback: drop 0017 tables.

## Open Questions

- Spec correction needed: 3 of the 7 SDD-5 delta specs reference the colliding `creative_performance`/`angle_performance` names — must be corrected to `ad_creative_performance`/`angle_performance_rollup` in tasks phase.
- Confirm `META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` provisioned via `wrangler secret put` before deploy.
- No cron infra exists (verified: no `triggers` in wrangler.jsonc) — sync stays manual-only, confirming proposal's conclusion.

Full artifact: openspec/changes/landing-hub/design.md

observations.content:
**What**: SDD-5 landing-hub FULLY IMPLEMENTED across all 4 PRs (see prior state below), PLUS a post-verify corrective fix (sort param, commit 3db117d), PLUS this batch's Judgment Day Round 1 dual-review fix pass — all 5 confirmed issues (2 CRITICAL, 1 CRITICAL-confirmed-by-both, 2 WARNING-confirmed-by-both) resolved. This entry supersedes/merges all prior apply-progress fragments (#276 and earlier).

**Cumulative state — all phases done** (unchanged from prior entry): PR1 (afb6ee2) token mgmt, PR2 (068eb29/3a7e7d8) atomic Meta sync + rollup, PR3 (analytics/recommend-angles/generate-variation + creativos gate fix dc499c2), PR4 (frontend Hub + approve.ts), verify corrective fix (3db117d, sort param).

**Judgment Day Round 1 fix pass (THIS BATCH, repo path confirmed at /home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce, NOT /ecomerce)**:
1. CRITICAL — cross-tenant ad-sync hijack: `idx_ad_creative_performance_meta_ad` was `UNIQUE(meta_ad_id)` alone. Edited migration 0017 directly (not pushed to shared history, safe to edit in place) to scope it `UNIQUE(project_id, meta_ad_id)`; updated sync.ts's `ON CONFLICT(project_id, meta_ad_id)` to match. Commit 6e78fd8.
2. CRITICAL — sync claim leak: readCC calls (briefs.json/concepts.json) and the rest of sync.ts's post-claim body ran outside any error handling — an unexpected exception left `sync_status='running'` stuck forever (permanent 409 lockout). Wrapped the ENTIRE post-claim body in an outer try/catch; unanticipated errors now release the claim with `sync_error='internal_error'` and return 500. Same commit 6e78fd8.
3. CRITICAL (both reviewers) — lost-update race on angles.json: approve.ts and generate-variation.ts both did unconditional readCC-then-writeCC, racing each other / A7's angulos/run.ts. Added NEW additive helpers to command-center.ts — `readCCWithEtag`/`writeCCConditional` (R2 `onlyIf: { etagMatches }` CAS) — WITHOUT changing readCC/writeCC's existing signatures (12+ other consumers unaffected). Both endpoints now run a bounded-retry (3 attempts) read-modify-write loop, 409 `concurrent_modification` on exhausted retries. Commit c0ef7d2.
4. WARNING (both reviewers) — recommend-angles.ts only checked `Array.isArray()` on LLM output, no validation of angle_id membership or action enum. Added post-parse validation: every `angle_id` must be in the prompted set (`withData` ids), `action` must be KEEP/CUT/ITERATE; any invalid item rejects the WHOLE batch → 502 `llm_analysis_failed`. Commit ab36bef.
5. WARNING (both reviewers) — Meta access token sent as `?access_token=` URL query param in both token.ts (validation call) and meta-api.ts (fetchInsights) — leaks into proxy/CDN/access logs. Both now send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header instead. Commit eb9eff7.

**Why**: Judgment Day dual-review (blind independent review) flagged these 5 issues as confirmed real bugs; user directed a surgical fix pass fixing ONLY these 5, explicitly carrying forward all single-judge WARNING(real)/theoretical/SUGGESTION findings as documented known issues OUT OF SCOPE for this pass (rate limiting on generate-variation, pagination in meta-api's adaccounts fetch, hook_rate metric mislabeling, sync_error JSON blob shown raw to user, reject-deletes-angle audit trail loss, etc.).

**Where**: migrations/0017_hub_integrations.sql, functions/api/integrations/meta/sync.ts, functions/_shared/command-center.ts, functions/api/angles/[id]/approve.ts, functions/api/angles/[id]/generate-variation.ts, functions/api/analytics/recommend-angles.ts, functions/api/integrations/meta/token.ts, functions/_shared/meta-api.ts. Tests: functions/api/integrations/__tests__/sync.test.ts, functions/api/integrations/__tests__/token-header.test.ts (NEW), functions/api/angles/[id]/__tests__/approve.test.ts, functions/api/analytics/__tests__/generate-variation.test.ts, functions/api/analytics/__tests__/recommend-angles.test.ts.

**Learned**: (a) command-center.ts's readCC/writeCC are consumed by ~12 files — adding CAS as NEW additive functions (not changing existing signatures) was the surgical choice vs. a scoped bypass duplicating D1 bookkeeping in 2 files. (b) The repo has no git remote configured at all — "local only, do not push" is trivially satisfied. (c) Test convention in this repo: source-regression-guard (readFileSync + regex on the actual .ts source) combined with isolated-logic mirrors (reimplementing the algorithm in the test file) — no real D1/R2/CF Pages runtime in any test. (d) When a source comment mentions a forbidden pattern by name (e.g. explaining why `?access_token=` was removed), regex assertions checking "does not match" must strip `//` line comments first or they false-fail against the comment text itself.

**Verification results**: `npx tsx --test` = 503 pass / 0 fail (up from 444 baseline — 59 new/updated tests across 5 test files, 1 new file). `npx tsc --noEmit` = clean. `npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=/tmp/opencode/sdd5-jd-fix-build` = "Compiled Worker successfully". 5 commits, all local only, not pushed (repo has no remote): 6e78fd8, c0ef7d2, ab36bef, eb9eff7, 4c9df2d (test commit).

observations.title: JD gate: SDD-5 PR3 found broken angle-approval gating
observations.content:
**What**: Judgment Day review of win-comerce SDD-5 landing-hub PR3 (commit 1e2c0da) found PR3's "structural gating" claim for angle variants is FALSE.
**Why**: PR3 claimed generate-variation.ts's pending_review variants can't reach paid ad creation because they have no concepts.json entry. But functions/api/agents/creativos/run.ts (pre-existing A5 pipeline) selects topAngulos via `angles.angles.sort by prioridad).slice(0,6)` with NO status filter, then feeds them into concept generation and writes concepts.json. A variant copies `prioridad` from its parent, so it can rank into the top-6 slice and get promoted into concepts.json, which select-and-preview.ts (SDD-4) happily reads without checking angle approval status — meaning a freshly generated, unapproved angle variant CAN reach paid ad-creative generation with zero approval step.
**Where**: functions/api/agents/creativos/run.ts (line 79 topAngulos sort/slice, no status filter), functions/api/angles/[id]/generate-variation.ts (creates pending_review angles with parent's prioridad), functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts (reads concepts.json without checking source angle status).
**Learned**: Everything else in PR3 passed: 453/453 tests, tsc clean, wrangler build clean, all 4 endpoints correctly ownership-scoped (404 IDOR-safe via verifyProjectOwnership/fetchOwnedCreative), hub.ts genuinely has no N+1 (Promise.all bounded queries), LLM calls in recommend-angles.ts/generate-variation.ts are strictly project-scoped (no cross-tenant bleed), 10s timeout via Promise.race genuinely aborts on timeout/malformed JSON with graceful 502. No PR4 frontend files touched. The ONLY gap is the missing status filter in creativos/run.ts's topAngulos selection.
