observations.title: Engram: monorepo unificado bajo proyecto 'escorpia traza' vía .engram/config.json
observations.content:
**What**: Se unificó toda la memoria Engram del monorepo Escorpia/TraceExport bajo UN solo proyecto: `escorpia traza`. Se pinneó con `/.engram/config.json` en la raíz del monorepo con clave `{"project_name": "escorpia traza"}` (OJO: la clave es `project_name`, NO `project`).

**Why**: El monorepo no es un repo git; adentro tiene `backend/` y `frontend/` como repos git independientes (backend→VM, frontend→Vercel) y `mobile/`+`infra/` sin .git local (mobile se buildea por EAS, infra vive aparte). Engram resuelve proyecto por límite de repo git, así que desde la raíz tiraba `ambiguous_project` y fragmentaba la memoria en 3 buckets: `backend`(105), `frontend`(11), `escorpia traza`(76). Las features cruzan las 4 piezas (ej: mobile-app-v2), el límite git es de DEPLOY no de conocimiento → un solo proyecto.

**Where**: `/home/rodrigo/Documentos/wasa/wasa/Escorpia traza/.engram/config.json`. DB global: `~/.engram/engram.db` (SQLite, engram v1.17.1).

**Learned / gotchas**:
- Clave del config es `project_name` (con `project` da error "project_name is required"). Verificar con `mem_current_project` → debe dar `project_source: config`.
- Auditados los 116 obs de backend/frontend: 100% Escorpia (acopio/produccion/wsp-agent/observability/etc.), CERO de ecomerce/win-comerce. Merge seguro.
- El CLI `engram` v1.17.1 NO tiene comando `merge`; la herramienta MCP `mem_merge_projects` no está en el perfil de la sesión. Se hizo con SQL directo — SEGURO porque el trigger `obs_fts_update AFTER UPDATE` re-sincroniza el índice FTS5 (que SÍ indexa la columna `project`) automáticamente; embeddings van sobre content (no se invalidan).
- `mem_save` acepta `project` explícito si el nombre es un proyecto EXISTENTE (project_source=explicit_override) — no requiere recovery_token en ese caso.
- Cloud sync NO enrolado (`sync_enrolled_projects: 0`) → reasignar local no rompe sync remoto.
- Backup consistente previo (SQLite online backup API, incluye WAL): `~/.engram/engram.backup-20260703-203727.db`.
- Resultado: `escorpia traza` pasó de 76 a 194 obs. FTS integrity-check OK, 194/194 indexadas.
- Otros proyectos del usuario intactos: ecomerce(100), win-comerce(6), adicional(2).

observations.title: Acopio: gap paridad app vs frontend + decisiones
observations.content:
**What**: Auditoría de paridad de los 5 sub-flujos de Acopio entre la app Expo (fuente de verdad) y el frontend web (`[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones`). El backend ya expone TODOS los endpoints necesarios (save-validation, finalize-validation, /acopio/balanza/pesadas, documents con semaphore_status + validation_results_json, y constants/field-roles.ts como fuente de verdad). El gap es 100% frontend.

**Gaps por flujo**:
- Validación (CRÍTICO, reescribir): ValidationPanel.tsx usa MANUAL_FIELDS inventados (ruc_proveedor, zona_pesca…) que no existen en el catálogo canónico ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES. Falta: prellenado OCR por claves canónicas, prellenado manual por tipo (CÁMARA/BARCO) desde useCompanyConfig (GET /company/config — VERIFICAR que exista en backend), campos por rol (RELLENO/CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA vía ExtractedFieldDisplay), DocumentSemaphore con breakdown de reglas, gate "ver todos los docs", validación de TODOS los assets + finalize-validation, datos por embarcación.
- Documentos (ALTO): front es data-driven (mejor que app) pero le falta el gate de observación OBLIGATORIA en semáforo YELLOW/RED antes de DOC OK, y el DOC OK agregado cross-embarcaciones.
- Pesaje (ALTO): falta "Traer de balanza" (GET /acopio/balanza/pesadas + matching por proveedor+matrícula + prefill).
- Valorización (MENOR): front MÁS completo (resumen global, OC, estado pago). Solo falta % merma editable + enviar shrinkagePct en price mutation.
- Asignación (MENOR): front no auto-avanza PROGRAMADO→EN_PLANTA al asignar.

**Decisiones de negocio cerradas (2026-07-03)**:
- Cap de embarcaciones por cámara = 3 (front mantiene el límite; alinear la app después para que también lo respete).
- Documentos: migrar a SECCIONES ANIDADAS (docs de cámara + sección por embarcación) como la app, en vez del asset selector actual.
- Estrategia: NO copiar la app 1:1. Traer lo que falta preservando lo que el front ya hace mejor.

**Where**: frontend/src/components/acopio/{ValidationPanel,DocumentUploadPanel,ValorizacionPanel,AsignacionEmbarcaciones}.tsx, frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/{page,[arrivalId]/page}.tsx · mobile/app/(app)/acopio/*, mobile/components/acopio/*, mobile/constants/acopio-field-roles.ts, mobile/hooks/useCompanyConfig.ts · backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts

**Secuencia acordada**: 1) fundaciones compartidas (portar acopio-field-roles, useCompanyConfig, ExtractedFieldDisplay, DocumentSemaphore a web), 2) reescribir Validación, 3) balanza en Pesaje, 4) gate advertencias + DOC OK agregado en Documentos, 5) ajustes finos Valorización/Asignación.

**Learned**: El backend ya está completo; ninguna tarea requiere tocar backend salvo verificar GET /company/config. Artifact de auditoría publicado en la sesión.

observations.title: Judgment-day fundaciones acopio + alineación SEMAFORO
observations.content:
**What**: Judgment-day (2 jueces ciegos) sobre las fundaciones de acopio → APPROVED. Código de producción correcto y fiel (catálogo verbatim del backend, componentes espejo de mobile). Hallazgos eran gaps de test + 2 hardening chicos. Todos arreglados. Ahora 46 tests verdes (antes 41), tsc limpio.

**Fixes aplicados**:
- `isExtractedKey` → `Object.hasOwn` (evita falsos positivos por prototype chain; fix por TDD RED→GREEN).
- Test de contrato reforzado: valida el mapeo campo→rol COMPLETO (snapshot verbatim del backend), no solo los 8 tipos de doc.
- Tests agregados: CRUCE YELLOW, CRUCE sin ruleResult (no muestra ✗ espurio), VIGENCIA "vence hoy", sufijo días en semáforo.
- `useCompanyConfig`: queryKey scopeada por tenant (`['company-config', tenant]` leyendo sessionStorage) — blindaje anti-fuga cross-tenant en web.
- `DocumentSemaphore`: removido `'use client'` innecesario (ahora RSC-compatible).

**Decisión de colorimetría (usuario)**: ALINEAR al estándar SEMAFORO del proyecto (NO mantener paleta emerald/slate de mobile). Fuente única: `frontend/src/lib/status-colors.ts`.
- Agregados a status-colors.ts: `SEMAFORO_DOT` (bg-*-500 para puntos) y `SEMAFORO_ICON` (text-*-600 para íconos lucide de estado). Se usa `semaphoreToLevel(status, skipped)` ya existente.
- `DocumentSemaphore` y `ExtractedFieldDisplay` refactorizados para consumir SEMAFORO/SEMAFORO_DOT/SEMAFORO_ICON. Sin emerald/slate.
- PENDIENTE: los otros componentes acopio (ValidationPanel, ValorizacionPanel, DocumentUploadPanel, AsignacionEmbarcaciones) todavía tienen emerald/slate — alinear a SEMAFORO al reescribir cada uno en los puntos 1-5.

**Where**: frontend/src/lib/status-colors.ts, frontend/src/components/acopio/{DocumentSemaphore,ExtractedFieldDisplay}.tsx + sus .test, frontend/src/lib/acopio-field-roles.ts + .test, frontend/src/hooks/useCompanyConfig.ts

**Learned**: El proyecto ya tenía `semaphoreToLevel` + SEMAFORO justo para el motor de documentos — usarlo, no reinventar mapas de color. Ver [[acopio/parity-front-vs-app]].

observations.title: Session summary: escorpia traza
observations.content:
## Goal
Llevar el frontend de Acopio (`[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones`) a paridad funcional con el módulo acopio de la app mobile (prellenados, semáforo, datos extraídos, etc.). Backend ya está completo — el gap es 100% frontend.

## Instructions (preferencias/constraints del usuario)
- TDD estricto: test primero en cada pieza (RED→GREEN).
- Runner de unit tests del frontend = **Vitest + Testing Library** (se bootstrapeó; antes no había ninguno).
- Decisiones de negocio cerradas: cap de embarcaciones por cámara = **3** (front mantiene, alinear app luego); Documentos = migrar a **secciones anidadas** (docs de cámara + sección por embarcación).
- Colorimetría: **alinear al estándar SEMAFORO** del proyecto (`frontend/src/lib/status-colors.ts`), NO mantener la paleta emerald/slate de mobile.
- Estrategia: NO copiar la app 1:1 — traer lo que falta preservando lo que el front ya hace mejor (Valorización y el modelo data-driven de Documentos ya superan a la app).

## Discoveries
- El backend ya expone TODO lo necesario: save-validation, finalize-validation, `/acopio/balanza/pesadas`, documents con semaphore_status + validation_results_json, `GET /company/config` (verificado en company.controller.ts), y `constants/field-roles.ts` como fuente de verdad.
- El `ValidationPanel` actual del front está conceptualmente MAL: usa campos inventados (ruc_proveedor, zona_pesca…) fuera del catálogo canónico. Hay que reescribirlo.
- El proyecto ya tenía `semaphoreToLevel()` + `SEMAFORO` en status-colors.ts, pensados justo para el motor de documentos — usar eso, no reinventar.

## Accomplished
- Auditoría completa de los 5 sub-flujos (artifact publicado). Severidades: Validación CRÍTICO, Pesaje/Documentos ALTO, Valorización/Asignación MENOR.
- Bootstrapeado Vitest + Testing Library (vitest.config.ts, vitest.setup.ts, script `test`).
- Portadas con TDD las 4 fundaciones: `src/lib/acopio-field-roles.ts` (+isExtractedKey con Object.hasOwn), `src/hooks/useCompanyConfig.ts` (queryKey scopeada por tenant), `src/lib/lima-date.ts` (+daysUntil/limaTomorrow), `src/components/acopio/ExtractedFieldDisplay.tsx`, `src/components/acopio/DocumentSemaphore.tsx`, `src/types/acopio.ts`.
- Judgment-day (2 jueces ciegos) sobre las fundaciones → APPROVED. Fixes aplicados (gaps de test + hardening). Colorimetría de los 2 componentes nuevos alineada a SEMAFORO (agregados SEMAFORO_DOT y SEMAFORO_ICON a status-colors.ts).
- Estado final: 46 tests verdes, tsc limpio.

## Next Steps (en orden)
1. **Reescribir Validación** (punto 1, CRÍTICO) usando las fundaciones: prellenado OCR + config, campos por rol, gate "ver todos los docs", validación de TODOS los assets + finalize-validation, propagación cámara→embarcaciones. Copiar lógica de mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx.

- R1: 4 confirmados (seen-gate marcaba Visto aunque el popup se bloqueara; error de descarga tragado; save no invalidaba docs → semáforos stale; save durante loadingConfig sin defaults) → arreglados.
- R2: fixes verificados + 8 hardening aplicados: window.open sincrónico + win.closed + win.opener=null (anti reverse-tabnabbing); staleTime+refetchOnWindowFocus:false en query compartida ['acopio-arrival'] TANTO en el panel como en page.tsx (F1 — el observer de la página filtraba el fix); useCompanyConfig expone isError → canSave gatea configReady; anti double-finalize (canSave excluye isSuccess, setVal hace saveMutation.reset()); colores desde SEMAFORO; orden+placeholders de MANUAL_FIELDS espejo de mobile; keep-mounted por tab (visitedValidacion + hidden) para no perder edits/seen.

**Test de componente nuevo** `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` (3 tests): mockea window.open + next/navigation + @/lib/api; cubre seen-gate popup-bloqueado/éxito/fallo + aserción de opener=null. Total suite: 73 tests verdes, tsc 0, eslint 0, `next build` OK.

**Push**: commit `bbcdb4e` a `front-escrorpia` main (repo git independiente en frontend/). Vercel auto-deploya. **Backend NO tocado** — 0 cambios, sin redeploy de VM.

Si dos componentes observan el mismo queryKey y solo uno pone refetchOnWindowFocus:false, el otro sigue refetcheando al recuperar foco y actualiza la cache compartida. Hay que ponerlo en TODOS los observers del mismo key.

observations.title: sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: creative-performance-feedback (SDD-12)

### Current State

**select-and-preview.ts** (`functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts`):
- POST handler. Reads `ConceptsCC` from R2 (`concepts.json`) only — no read of `angle_performance_rollup`, `ad_creative_performance`, `AvatarCC`, or `BrandCC`.
- static format (line 74-91): builds ONE inline prompt string using `concept.text_hook` + `concept.descripcion` + optional user `notes`. Calls `generateImages({ apiKey, prompt, aspectRatio, styleType, numImages:1 })` — no `imageUrls` passed.
- carousel format (line 92-123): calls `buildCarouselPrompts(concept, sections)` then `generateCarouselImages(apiKey, prompts)`. No performance data, no `imageUrls`.

**carousel-builder.ts** (`functions/api/agents/landing/carousel-builder.ts`):
- `buildCarouselPrompts(concept, sections)` (pure function, no Env/D1/R2) builds 4 fixed prompts (pain/product/social-proof/CTA+price) from `Concept` fields + landing `sections_json` (pricing pack B, testimonials). No angle-performance input, no avatar/brand input.
- `generateCarouselImages(apiKey, prompts)` fans out `Promise.allSettled` over 4 `generateImages()` calls, `imageUrls` param never set.

**Ideogram wrapper** (`functions/_shared/ideogram.ts`): `IdeogramConfig.imageUrls?: string[]` IS already defined and IS forwarded to the real API call (`image_urls: config.imageUrls` in the request body, line 51-53) — the wrapper is fully wired. It is simply never invoked with a populated `imageUrls` array anywhere in the codebase (confirmed via grep — the only `imageUrls` identifiers elsewhere, e.g. `functions/api/agents/branding/run.ts:291`, are Ideogram *output* URLs stored for audit, not request-time style references). So this is a **pure call-site gap**, not a wrapper gap.

### Data Model / "Winning" Definition

- `angle_performance_rollup` (migration `0017_hub_integrations.sql`): PK `id`, `project_id`, `angle_id`, `spend_usd`, `impressions`, `clicks`, `ctr`, `conversions`, `cpa`, `hook_rate`, `last_updated`. UNIQUE(project_id, angle_id) — one row per angle per tenant, upserted by Meta sync.
- `ad_creative_performance`: PK `id`, `project_id`, `pack_id`, `meta_ad_id`, `spend_usd`, `impressions`, `clicks`, `ctr`, `conversions`, `cpa`, `hook_rate`, `synced_at`. UNIQUE(project_id, meta_ad_id) — deliberately NOT unique on bare `meta_ad_id` (cross-tenant safety, per migration comment).
- No single canonical "winning" metric column exists — `buildAnglesWithPerformance` (`functions/api/analytics/_shared/angles-with-performance.ts`) exposes a `sort` param (`ctr_desc` default, `conversions_desc`, `cpa_asc`) and pushes NULLs to the end. `recommend-angles.ts` treats "has performance data" as `spend_usd !== null || conversions !== null`. SDD-12 should reuse the SAME default (`ctr_desc`, null-safe) rather than invent a new "win score" — this is the established codebase convention (2 existing call sites already use it).
- Linkage: `Concept.angulo_id` → `Angle.id` → `angle_performance_rollup.angle_id`. Top-performing CREATIVE (for Ideogram `imageUrls` style reference) requires joining `ad_creative_performance` (top by ctr/conversions) → `pack_id` → `ad_creatives.concept_id`/`project_id` → the pack's `final/` (or `preview/`) R2 image key via `creativeFinalKey`/`creativePreviewKey` (`functions/api/creatives/_shared/storage.ts`).

### Avatar / Brand Data Location

- `AvatarCC` (R2, `avatar.json`, read via `readCC<AvatarCC>(env.STORAGE, projectId, 'avatar')`): `avatar_principal.top_dolores: Array<{texto, frecuencia}>`, `deseo_real`, `miedo_oculto` — exactly the "pain" fields needed for prompt enrichment.
- `BrandCC` (R2, `brand.json`): `color_palette: {primary, secondary, accent, neutral, cta}`, `tone_of_voice`, `brand_personality` — exactly the palette needed.
- Neither is currently read by `select-and-preview.ts` or `carousel-builder.ts`. `hub.ts` already demonstrates the exact `readCC<BrandCC>(...)` call pattern to copy.

### Multi-Tenant Scoping

Solid throughout: every D1 query for these tables is scoped `WHERE project_id = ?`, and `project_id` is always derived from an ownership-verified source (`landing.project_id` in select-and-preview, joined via `landings l JOIN projects p ON l.project_id = p.id WHERE l.id = ? AND (admin OR p.user_id = session.user.id)`). No new tenant-scoping mechanism needed — reuse `landing.project_id` already resolved in `select-and-preview.ts` line 44-51.

### Cold-Start Reality

- No seed/fixture data found for `angle_performance_rollup` / `ad_creative_performance` in migrations (both tables created empty in `0017`). Real row counts are runtime/production data not inspectable from static code — genuinely "unknown" without a live D1 query (flag as an explore limitation, not resolved).
- Existing cold-start precedent (MUST be mirrored, not reinvented): `angles-with-performance.ts` returns `{..., spend_usd: null, ..., message: 'Connect Meta to see performance'}` when no rollup row exists; `creatives/[packId].ts` returns `{..., message: 'No performance data yet'}` when no perf row exists. SDD-12's cold-start guard should follow this exact "row absent → null fields object, not an error" shape, and at the prompt-builder level simply skip the enrichment block entirely (fall back to today's prompt) when no rollup/perf row is found — no new error paths needed.

### Injection Points (file:line)

1. `functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts:56` — after `readCC<ConceptsCC>`, add parallel reads: `readCC<AvatarCC>(..., 'avatar')`, `readCC<BrandCC>(..., 'brand')`, and `env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM angle_performance_rollup WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY ctr DESC LIMIT 1')`.
2. `functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts:76-82` (static branch) and `:96` (carousel branch, call into `buildCarouselPrompts`) — thread the new "performance context" object into the prompt string / `buildCarouselPrompts` signature.
3. `functions/api/agents/landing/carousel-builder.ts:35` — `buildCarouselPrompts` signature needs a new optional 4th param (e.g. `context?: PerformanceContext`) to stay backward-compatible with the existing unit tests (`carousel-builder.test.ts`) that call it with 2 args.
4. `functions/_shared/ideogram.ts` — NO change needed; `imageUrls` is already a first-class `IdeogramConfig` field. Only the call sites in `select-and-preview.ts` (line 76-82, line 107) need to actually populate it.
5. New helper needed: resolving a top-performing pack's image into a URL Ideogram's servers can fetch. **Risk**: the only existing serving route for ad-creative images, `functions/api/creatives/assets/[[path]].ts`, requires an authenticated session cookie (`requireSession`) — Ideogram's backend cannot authenticate against it. Passing that private URL directly into `imageUrls` will fail. A signed R2 URL (mirroring `getSignedUrl()` in `command-center.ts`, currently only built for the fixed `CC_FILES` key set, not arbitrary ad-creative paths) or a new short-lived public proxy is required. This is a genuine new-code surface, not a wiring no-op.

### Risks / Unknowns

- **imageUrls style-reference requires a publicly-fetchable URL** — `getSignedUrl()` only supports `CC_FILES` keys today; needs extension (or a parallel helper) for `cc/{project}/ad-creatives/{concept}/{pack}/final/{file}` keys. Non-trivial, adds a new R2 signed-URL code path.
- **Cold-start row counts are unknown** (no way to query production D1 from static exploration) — must be validated at design/apply time, not assumed zero or nonzero.
- **`ad_creative_performance` links to a `pack_id`, not directly to a project's "best angle"** — reference-image selection and angle/hook-text selection are two independent queries against two different tables; the design must decide whether to require BOTH to have data before enriching, or degrade each independently.
- **`buildCarouselPrompts` is a pure, already-tested function** (`carousel-builder.test.ts`) — changing its signature is backward-compatibility-sensitive; must default the new param to `undefined`/unenriched to avoid breaking existing test suites.
- **`select-and-preview.ts`'s static-format prompt is inline, not delegated to a shared builder** — unlike carousel, there is no equivalent `buildStaticPrompt()` extraction point yet; recommend introducing a shared prompt-builder to avoid drift between static/carousel enrichment logic.
- Rough line estimate lands close to the review budget — chained delivery should be considered at `sdd-tasks` time.

### Rough Changed-Line Estimate

- New shared "performance context" helper (query angle_performance_rollup + ad_creative_performance + resolve reference image, cold-start-safe): ~60-90 lines + ~40-60 lines of tests.
- Signed-URL extension for ad-creative final assets: ~20-30 lines.
- `select-and-preview.ts` changes (reads + wiring into both branches + imageUrls): ~40-60 lines.
- `carousel-builder.ts` signature change + enrichment logic in the 4 prompt builders: ~30-50 lines + test updates (~30-50 lines) for new enrichment-path assertions and a cold-start regression test.
- **Total estimate: roughly 220-340 lines**, possibly 300-400+ if integration tests are extended. Close enough to the 400-line review budget that a single-PR delivery is plausible but NOT a safe default assumption — `sdd-tasks` should forecast this explicitly and consider a 2-slice split: PR1 = data-layer helper + cold-start guard (server-side only, testable in isolation), PR2 = wiring into select-and-preview.ts/carousel-builder.ts + imageUrls signed-URL plumbing.

### Approaches

1. **Inline enrichment in each call site** — read rollup/avatar/brand directly in `select-and-preview.ts`, pass raw data into `buildCarouselPrompts`.
   - Pros: minimal new files, fast to implement.
   - Cons: duplicates enrichment logic between static and carousel branches; harder to unit test in isolation from Env/D1/R2.
   - Effort: Low-Medium.

2. **Extract a shared `buildPerformanceContext(env, projectId, angleId)` helper** (recommended) — one function resolves {winning angle+hook, avatar pain, brand palette, reference image URL or null}, cold-start-safe (returns nulls, never throws), consumed by both static and carousel prompt paths.
   - Pros: single source of truth, independently unit-testable (like `angles-with-performance.ts`'s existing pattern), keeps `buildCarouselPrompts` pure/testable by accepting a plain data object instead of Env.
   - Cons: one more file to review; slightly more upfront design.
   - Effort: Medium.

### Recommendation

Approach 2 (shared performance-context helper). It mirrors the codebase's own established pattern (`angles-with-performance.ts`) for merging R2+D1 data with null-safe cold-start fallback, keeps `buildCarouselPrompts` a pure/testable function (critical since it already has passing unit tests with a 2-arg call signature), and gives `sdd-tasks` a natural PR-slice boundary (data layer vs. wiring) if the line-budget risk needs a chained-PR split.

### Risks (envelope)
- imageUrls needs a new signed-URL mechanism for ad-creative final assets (not just reuse of existing CC signed-URL helper).
- Cold-start row counts unverified (no production D1 access from static exploration).
- Line estimate (~220-340, possibly 400+) is close to the review budget; flag for sdd-tasks chained-PR forecast.
- `buildCarouselPrompts` signature change must stay backward-compatible with existing passing unit tests.
- Deciding whether text-enrichment and image-reference-enrichment degrade independently or as a single all-or-nothing gate needs a design-time decision.

### Ready for Proposal
Yes — scope is well-bounded and independent of WhatsApp (SDD-7..11). Orchestrator should note to sdd-propose: (1) reuse `ctr_desc` as the default "winning" sort per existing convention, (2) decide independent-degradation vs all-or-nothing for text vs. image enrichment, (3) budget for a possible 2-PR chained delivery given the ~220-340+ line estimate.

**Tooling note**: This exploration was executed without `mem_search`/`mem_get_observation` tools available in this session (only `mem_save` was exposed) — the SDD-7..11 plan and sdd-init context referenced in the task brief were NOT retrieved. Recommend the orchestrator confirm this exploration doesn't conflict with anything already decided in the broader 6-SDD chain plan before proceeding to sdd-propose.

**Filesystem note**: No Write/Edit tool was available in this executor's toolset, so the hybrid-mode openspec exploration file (`openspec/changes/sdd-12-creative-feedback/exploration.md`) could NOT be written to disk — only this Engram artifact was persisted. The full markdown content above should be written to that path by a phase with file-write access (note: no prior SDD 1-6 archive actually contains an exploration.md file, so there is no established filename convention to mirror beyond the general openspec change-folder layout).

observations.title: sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: SDD-12 Creative Performance Feedback

## Intent

Image generation for ad creatives is currently blind to the tenant's own results. Both prompt-building paths (static and carousel) use only Concept text, ignoring `angle_performance_rollup`, `ad_creative_performance`, avatar pains, and brand palette that the platform already collects per project. Ideogram's style-reference input (`imageUrls`) is fully wired in the shared wrapper but never populated. Result: each new creative starts from zero instead of building on the tenant's proven winners — lower creative quality and wasted ad spend on re-learning what already works.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Shared, cold-start-safe "performance context" helper: winning angle/hook (reusing the established `ctr_desc` null-safe convention), avatar pain points, brand palette, and top-performing creative reference image — all scoped by `project_id`.
- Enrich the static prompt in `select-and-preview` and the carousel prompts in `buildCarouselPrompts` with that context (backward-compatible signature).
- Populate Ideogram `imageUrls` with the tenant's top-performing creative as style reference.
- Cold-start guarantee: projects with zero performance rows behave exactly as today.

### Out of Scope
- WhatsApp / SDD-7..11 work — untouched.
- Changes to the Ideogram wrapper (`functions/_shared/ideogram.ts`) — call-site only.
- Subscription/checkout, quota, or plan changes.
- Meta sync pipeline or performance-rollup schema changes.
- New "win score" metrics — reuse existing sort conventions.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `creative-performance-feedback`: derive a per-project performance context (winning angle, avatar pain, brand palette, reference image) and inject it into creative image-generation prompts, degrading safely when data is absent.

### Modified Capabilities
- `ad-creative-api`: select-and-preview enriches static/carousel prompts and passes a style-reference image when available.
- `carousel-builder`: `buildCarouselPrompts` accepts optional performance context; unchanged behavior without it.

## Approach

One shared helper (mirroring `angles-with-performance.ts` patterns) resolves all enrichment inputs; both prompt paths consume it. Absence of data skips enrichment entirely — no new error paths. Deferred to design: (1) signed/public URL mechanism for private ad-creative assets (Ideogram cannot authenticate against the session-guarded asset route); (2) independent vs all-or-nothing degradation between text enrichment and image reference.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts` | Modified | Read context, enrich both branches, pass `imageUrls` |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/carousel-builder.ts` | Modified | Optional context param, enrichment in 4 prompts |
| New shared helper | New | Performance-context builder + reference-image URL resolution |
| Tests | New/Modified | Enrichment path + cold-start regression |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Ideogram cannot fetch private asset URLs | High | Design a short-lived signed-URL mechanism; defer exact shape to design |
| Breaking existing `buildCarouselPrompts` tests | Medium | New param optional; unenriched default preserves current output |
| ~220–340 changed lines near review budget | Medium | sdd-tasks forecasts; 2-slice chain (data layer, then wiring) ready |
| Enrichment degrades prompt quality for some tenants | Low | Enrichment is additive; cold-start fallback equals today's prompts |

## Rollback Plan

Code-only revert: remove helper invocation at both call sites and the `imageUrls` population; `buildCarouselPrompts` without context is identical to current behavior. No schema or data migration involved.

## Dependencies

- `angle_performance_rollup` / `ad_creative_performance` tables (migration 0017) — already deployed.
- Avatar/Brand Command Center files in R2 — already produced by Agents 2 and 5.
- Meta sync populating performance rows (absent rows are handled, not required).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Project with performance data: generated prompts include winning hook/angle, avatar pain, brand palette; `imageUrls` carries a fetchable reference image.
- [ ] Project with zero performance rows: prompts and API responses byte-equivalent to current behavior.
- [ ] Existing `buildCarouselPrompts` unit tests pass unmodified.
- [ ] Independent sources (rollup vs creative perf) degrade per the design-time policy without errors.
- [ ] No changes under WhatsApp, Ideogram wrapper, or checkout paths.

observations.title: sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/spec
observations.content:
# Spec: SDD-12 Creative Performance Feedback

## Domain: creative-performance-feedback (NEW capability, full spec)

### Requirement: Hybrid Winner Selection
The system MUST select a winning angle/creative for a project by filtering rows in `angle_performance_rollup` / `ad_creative_performance` to those with `conversions > 0` AND `cpa` at or below a configurable threshold, ordered by `ctr` desc with `hook_rate` as tiebreak. MUST NOT add new columns.
- Scenario: Winning creative identified — GIVEN qualifying rows exist WHEN context derived THEN highest-ctr qualifying row (tiebreak hook_rate) is winner.
- Scenario: Excessive CPA excluded — GIVEN conversions>0 but cpa above threshold WHEN evaluating THEN row MUST NOT be winner.
- Scenario: Cold-start — GIVEN zero qualifying rows WHEN context derived THEN falls back to current unenriched behavior, no error.

### Requirement: Text Enrichment Payload
When a qualifying winner exists, the system MUST assemble context of winning angle/hook, avatar pain points, and brand palette, scoped to project_id.
- Scenario: Full context assembled — GIVEN winner + avatar/brand data exist THEN context includes all three.
- Scenario: Partial source missing — GIVEN winner exists but avatar or brand data missing THEN that source omitted without error, others included.

### Requirement: Image Style Reference
When a qualifying winning creative exists, the system MUST be able to pass it as a style-reference image to the image generator.
- Scenario: Reference available — GIVEN winner has image asset WHEN generating new creative THEN image supplied as style reference.
- Scenario: No qualifying creative — GIVEN no winner WHEN generating THEN no reference supplied, generation proceeds as today.

### Requirement: Per-Tenant Isolation
The system MUST scope derivation exclusively to the requesting project_id; MUST NOT use other tenants' data.
- Scenario: Isolation enforced — GIVEN project A has winners, project B has none WHEN deriving for B THEN only B's data used (cold-start fallback).

## Domain: ad-creative-api (MODIFIED — delta, ADDED requirements)

### Requirement: Static Prompt Enrichment via Performance Context
`select-and-preview` MUST enrich the static prompt with performance context when a qualifying winner exists, and MUST pass the top creative's image as `imageUrls`.
- Scenario: Enriched generation — GIVEN qualifying winner THEN prompt includes angle/hook, avatar pain, brand palette AND imageUrls set.
- Scenario: Cold-start passthrough — GIVEN no qualifying winner THEN prompt/generator call byte-equivalent to current behavior.

### Requirement: Carousel Prompt Enrichment via Performance Context
`select-and-preview` MUST pass performance context to `buildCarouselPrompts` and supply winning creative as style reference where available.
- Scenario: Carousel enrichment applied — GIVEN qualifying winner THEN buildCarouselPrompts receives context, prompts reflect it.
- Scenario: Carousel cold-start — GIVEN no winner THEN buildCarouselPrompts called without context, output identical to current.

## Domain: carousel-builder (MODIFIED — delta, ADDED requirements)

### Requirement: Optional Performance Context Parameter
`buildCarouselPrompts` MUST accept an optional performance-context parameter (winning angle/hook, avatar pain, brand palette, reference-image info). MUST remain backward compatible — existing 2-arg call sites/tests MUST pass unmodified.
- Scenario: Called without context (existing tests) — GIVEN original 2 args THEN output identical to current, existing unit tests pass unmodified.
- Scenario: Called with context — GIVEN 3rd arg with context THEN all 4 slide prompts incorporate angle/hook, avatar pain, brand palette.
- Scenario: Context partially empty — GIVEN some fields empty/undefined THEN those fields omitted from prompt without error, present fields included.

## Files
- openspec/changes/sdd-12-creative-feedback/specs/creative-performance-feedback/spec.md (new full spec)
- openspec/changes/sdd-12-creative-feedback/specs/ad-creative-api/spec.md (delta, ADDED)
- openspec/changes/sdd-12-creative-feedback/specs/carousel-builder/spec.md (delta, ADDED)

# Design: SDD-12 Creative Performance Feedback

## Technical Approach

One new shared module, `functions/_shared/performance-context.ts`, resolves a per-project `PerformanceContext` (winning angle/hook, avatar pain, brand palette, signed reference-image URL). Both prompt paths consume it: `select-and-preview.ts` enriches the static prompt and passes `imageUrls`; `buildCarouselPrompts` gains an optional third parameter. Every signal is independently nullable; when all are null, output is byte-identical to today (cold-start guarantee). Winner rule = resolved hybrid: `conversions > 0 AND cpa <= threshold`, order `ctr` desc, `hook_rate` desc tiebreak, JS null-safe sort convention from `angles-with-performance.ts`. No schema change; Ideogram wrapper untouched (`imageUrls` already wired at `ideogram.ts:51-53`).

## Architecture Decisions

### Decision 1: Reference-image exposure — HMAC-signed query string on the existing asset route

**Choice**: Extend `functions/api/creatives/assets/[[path]].ts` to accept `?exp={unix}&sig={hex}` as an alternative to session auth. Signature = HMAC-SHA256 over `{fullAssetPath}:{exp}` with new `ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY` secret (WebCrypto, constant-time compare). Helper builds absolute URL from request origin.

| Alternative | Why rejected |
|---|---|
| `getSignedUrl` (command-center.ts) | **Non-functional**: casts the R2 binding to `createPresignedUrl`, which does not exist on Workers R2 bindings — the catch always returns `null` in production. Zero call sites (dead code). Also CC_FILES-scoped, not ad-creative keys. |
| R2 S3-API presigned URLs | Requires R2 account access keys (2 new secrets) + SigV4 signing (new dep or ~150 hand-rolled lines); exposes bucket endpoint. |
| Copy winner to public temp key | Write/delete lifecycle, orphaned objects on failure, second copy of a private asset. |

**Least exposure**: signature binds the exact 5-segment object path (one object readable, no listing); 10-minute TTL; session path unchanged otherwise; secret unset → signing disabled → `referenceImageUrl = null`.

### Decision 2: Degradation — independent partial

Each of the 4 signals degrades independently; formatters emit nothing for null fields. All-or-nothing rejected: a tenant with angle rollup but no committed pack would lose text enrichment for no reason; sources are independent (rollup, creative-perf + R2, avatar.json, brand.json). Resilience addition: at both call sites, if `generateImages` fails WITH `imageUrls` set, retry once without the reference — enrichment never makes generation less reliable than today.

### Decision 3: Winner resolution mechanics

- Threshold: `env.CREATIVE_CPA_MAX_USD` (plain var), parsed float, default 25.
- Winning angle: reuse `buildAnglesWithPerformance(env, projectId, 'ctr_desc')`, filter qualifying, tiebreak `hook_rate` in JS → `{nombre, hook_ejemplo}`.
- Reference image: `ad_creative_performance` JOIN `ad_creatives` (`status='approved'`), same filter/sort → `creativeFinalKey(project, concept_id, pack_id, firstFile(format))` → R2 `head()` existence check before signing.
- Avatar pain: `avatar.json` → `top_dolores` max `frecuencia`. Palette: `brand.json` → `color_palette`.

## Interfaces

```ts
interface PerformanceContext {
  winningAngle: { nombre: string; hook: string } | null
  avatarPain: string | null
  brandPalette: { primary: string; accent: string; cta: string } | null
  referenceImageUrl: string | null
}
buildPerformanceContext(env, projectId, origin): Promise<PerformanceContext>  // never throws; failed sub-source → null field + console.warn
buildCarouselPrompts(concept, sections, context?)                             // pure; 2-arg output byte-identical
generateCarouselImages(apiKey, prompts, referenceImageUrl?)                   // optional; undefined = today
```

Prompt composition: enrichment fragments appended LAST (after user notes) with caps (hook ≤120 chars, pain ≤140) so Ideogram's 1000-char truncation drops enrichment before concept text or user notes. Slide mapping: slide 1 += pain + winning hook, slide 2 += palette primary/accent, slide 3 unchanged, slide 4 += palette `cta`; static prompt += hook + pain + palette.

## Data Flow

select-and-preview → buildPerformanceContext(env, projectId, origin) → {D1: angle_performance_rollup via buildAnglesWithPerformance; D1: ad_creative_performance ⋈ ad_creatives (approved); R2: avatar.json, brand.json, head(final image)} → PerformanceContext → static prompt + imageUrls[signed URL] / buildCarouselPrompts(c, s, ctx) → generateCarouselImages(..., refUrl). Ideogram fetches `/api/creatives/assets/...?exp&sig` (HMAC branch, no session).

## File Changes

| File | Action | ~Lines |
|------|--------|-------|
| `functions/_shared/asset-signing.ts` | Create | ~55 |
| `functions/_shared/performance-context.ts` | Create | ~150 |
| `functions/api/creatives/assets/[[path]].ts` | Modify | +25 |
| `functions/api/creatives/select-and-preview.ts` | Modify | +30 |
| `functions/api/agents/landing/carousel-builder.ts` | Modify | +35 |
| `functions/_shared/types.ts` | Modify | +3 |
| `.dev.vars.example` | Modify | +2 |
| `functions/api/creatives/__tests__/performance-context.test.ts` | Create | ~90 |
| `functions/api/creatives/__tests__/carousel-builder.test.ts` | Modify | +40 (new 3-arg cases only) |

**Total ~430 lines → exceeds 400-line budget. Recommend 2-slice chain**: Slice 1 = signing + helper + asset-route branch + unit tests (~250); Slice 2 = call-site wiring + tests + E2E (~180).

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|-------|------|----------|
| Unit | Cold-start identity (all-null ctx → byte-equal prompts); fragment caps; winner filter/tiebreak incl. null metrics; signing valid/expired/tampered/path-swap | Existing runner in `functions/api/creatives/__tests__/`; existing 2-arg tests untouched |
| Build | Type + bundle integrity | `tsc -b`, `npx wrangler pages functions build` |
| E2E | Cold-start preview flow unchanged | Playwright; E2E env leaves `ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY` unset → image reference off → deterministic |

## Migration / Rollout

No schema change. One new optional secret (`ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY`) + optional var (`CREATIVE_CPA_MAX_USD`); unset secret = text-only enrichment. Rollback = code revert.

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Ideogram errors on unreachable `image_urls` (e.g. local dev origin) | R2 head-check before signing; retry-without-reference fallback; dev/E2E disable via unset secret |
| `regenerate.ts` also calls `buildCarouselPrompts` (2-arg) — regenerated slides unenriched, possible visual drift within a pack | Accepted v1 boundary per proposal scope; flag for sdd-tasks as follow-up candidate |
| Signed URL leakage (logs/referrer) | 10-min TTL, single-object scope, private working asset |
| Default CPA threshold (25 USD) arbitrary | Env-overridable; documented in `.dev.vars.example` |
| `getSignedUrl` dead code invites future misuse | Documented here; not used by this change |

## Open Questions

None blocking.

observations.title: Gotcha deploy: Vercel usa npm (no pnpm) → devDeps de test rompen con ERESOLVE
observations.content:
**What**: El push `bbcdb4e` (validación acopio) rompió el deploy de Vercel del frontend con `npm error ERESOLVE`. Causa: agregué devDependencies de testing (`@vitejs/plugin-react@^6`, `vitest@^4`) que arrastran `@rolldown/plugin-babel` pidiendo `@babel/core@^8`, y choca con `@babel/core@7` que ya trae `shadcn`.

**Why se escapó local**: el monorepo usa **pnpm** (resolver laxo de peer deps) y `next build` local pasó. Pero **el repo frontend se deploya STANDALONE en Vercel con npm** (tiene su propio `package-lock.json` commiteado, NO pnpm-lock), y npm es estricto → falla el install.

**Fix** (commit `e204578`): agregué `frontend/.npmrc` con `legacy-peer-deps=true` + regeneré `package-lock.json` con `npm install --package-lock-only` (respeta .npmrc, NO toca el node_modules de pnpm). Verificado: deploy Ready en 54s vía `vercel ls`; app.escorpia.com 307→/login (healthy), api 200.

**Regla para futuro**: antes de pushear cambios de `package.json` al frontend, validar con **npm** (no solo pnpm): `cd frontend && npm install --dry-run` debe pasar. Vercel CLI está instalado y logueado como `r0dr0x` (proyecto `rodrigos-projects-4319585b/front-escrorpia`); auditar deploys con `vercel ls` y `vercel inspect --logs <url>`. pnpm ignora `legacy-peer-deps` (es npm-only), así que el .npmrc no afecta el dev local.

observations.content:
# Archive Report: SDD-12 Creative Performance Feedback

**Change**: sdd-12-creative-feedback  
**Archived**: 2026-07-04  
**Artifact Store**: hybrid (Engram + openspec filesystem)  
**Status**: COMPLETE — PASS WITH WARNINGS (0 CRITICAL / 4 WARNING / 2 SUGGESTION from verify-report)  

## Traceability — Observation IDs

| Artifact | Engram ID | Topic Key |
|----------|-----------|-----------|
| Proposal | 310 | sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/proposal |
| Spec | 311 | sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/spec |
| Design | 312 | sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/design |
| Tasks | 313 | sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/tasks |
| Verify Report | 315 | sdd/sdd-12-creative-feedback/verify-report |

## Executive Summary

SDD-12 Creative Performance Feedback ships a unified performance-context system that enriches ad creative generation (both static and carousel) with the tenant's proven winners—winning angle/hook, avatar pain points, brand palette, and top-performing creative reference image—selected via hybrid filtering (`conversions > 0 AND cpa <= threshold`, tiebreak by `ctr` desc then `hook_rate` desc). The core innovation is HMAC-signed asset URLs on the existing `/api/creatives/assets/` route, enabling Ideogram to fetch private reference images without session auth. Implementation is production-ready with zero CRITICAL issues, 24/25 tasks complete (only E2E deferred as unsafe in sandbox), all three build/test gates passing (587 tests, `tsc -b` clean, `wrangler pages functions build` clean), and backward compatibility guaranteed (2-arg call sites unmodified). Judgment Day ran 2 rounds—Round 1 found cold-start semantics contradiction in spec, Round 2 blind judges APPROVED both the spec amendment and all hardening fixes. The change is ready for live deployment.

## What Shipped

### New Capability: creative-performance-feedback

A new shared capability that resolves per-project `PerformanceContext`:
- **Winning angle/hook**: via `buildAnglesWithPerformance(projectId, 'ctr_desc')`, filtered to rows with `conversions > 0 AND cpa <= CREATIVE_CPA_MAX_USD` (default 25, env-overridable), tiebreak by `hook_rate` desc in JS
- **Avatar pain**: from `avatar.json` top_dolores (max frecuencia)
- **Brand palette**: from `brand.json` color_palette (primary/accent/cta)
- **Reference image URL**: via D1 join (`ad_creative_performance` ⋈ `ad_creatives` status='approved'), same filter/sort, R2 head check, then HMAC-SHA256 signed 10-minute URL (only if `ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY` secret is set)

All four signals degrade independently — null field per missing source + console.warn, never throws. Cold-start (all-null context) produces byte-identical output to pre-SDD-12 behavior.

### Modified Capability: ad-creative-api

Two new requirements in `POST /api/creatives/select-and-preview`:
- **Static Prompt Enrichment**: winning angle/hook, avatar pain, brand palette appended AFTER user notes (capped: hook ≤120, pain ≤140); `imageUrls` set to signed reference URL when winner exists
- **Carousel Enrichment**: performance context passed to `buildCarouselPrompts`; `generateCarouselImages` receives `referenceImageUrl` when available

Both scenarios include cold-start degradation: enrichment fields omitted, `imageUrls`/reference undefined, output byte-identical to current when all context fields null.

### Modified Capability: carousel-builder

One new requirement:
- **Optional Performance Context Parameter**: `buildCarouselPrompts(concept, sections, context?)` accepts optional 3rd arg; when provided, slide 1 += pain + hook, slide 2 += palette primary/accent, slide 3 unchanged, slide 4 += palette cta, each field independently omitted if null; when omitted, output byte-identical to current 2-arg call (all existing tests pass unmodified)

## Key Architecture Decisions

### Decision 1: Reference-image exposure — HMAC-signed query string

**Chosen**: Extend `functions/api/creatives/assets/[[path]].ts` to accept `?exp={unix}&sig={hex}` as session-free auth.
- **Implementation**: HMAC-SHA256 over `{assetPath}:{exp}` (exp inside signed message, tamper-proof) + constant-time hex compare (WebCrypto); signature binds exact 5-segment object path (one object, no listing); 10-min TTL; invalid/expired signature = immediate 404 (fail-closed); unset `ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY` = signing disabled → all URLs null. Security review found no issues.

### Decision 2: Degradation — independent partial (not all-or-nothing)

Each of the 4 signals (angle, pain, palette, reference) degrades independently. Resilience addition: at both call sites, if `generateImages` fails WITH `imageUrls` set, retry once without reference—enrichment never makes generation less reliable than today.

### Decision 3: Winner resolution mechanics

- **Threshold**: `env.CREATIVE_CPA_MAX_USD` (default 25, float, env-overridable)
- **Angle**: reuse `buildAnglesWithPerformance(env, projectId, 'ctr_desc')`, filter `conversions>0 AND cpa<=threshold`, tiebreak `hook_rate` in JS
- **Reference image**: `ad_creative_performance` JOIN `ad_creatives` (status='approved'), same filter/sort, R2 head-check
- **Avatar/Brand**: independent R2 fetches, each try/catch → null + console.warn

## Task Completion & Verification

**Implementation Status**: 24/25 tasks complete (Phases 1-3 all complete; Phase 4: 4/5; Phase 5: complete)

**Only Deferred Task**: 4.2 Playwright E2E cold-start (unsafe in sandbox; unit coverage sufficient; tracked as follow-up)

**Build & Test Gates** (re-run independently 2026-07-04):
- Unit tests: 587/587 pass, 0 fail, 189 suites
- Type check: `tsc -b` → exit 0, no errors
- Worker build: `wrangler pages functions build` → success

## Spec Compliance (15 Scenarios)

All 15 scenarios across 3 spec files implemented. 13 with direct runtime test evidence; 1 by inspection + source-guard; 2 with design-driven wording drift (both amendments applied before archive).

**Compliance summary**: All scenarios PASS. 0 CRITICAL issues. 4 WARNING, 2 SUGGESTION (all documented in verify-report, none blocking).

## Judgment Day Outcome

**Process**: 2 rounds of blind review
- **Round 1**: CONDITIONAL PASS — found spec/design coherence issue (cold-start semantics); resolved via spec amendment
- **Round 2**: APPROVED (blind judge, no issues found)

All outstanding items documented; no blockers.

## Implementation Summary

**File changes**: ~945 lines (single-pr size:exception approved)
- 2 new files (~205 lines): `asset-signing.ts`, `performance-context.ts`
- 5 modified files (~95 lines tracked): `assets/[[path]].ts`, `select-and-preview.ts`, `carousel-builder.ts`, `types.ts`, `.dev.vars.example`
- 2 test files (~370 lines): `performance-context.test.ts` (new), `carousel-builder.test.ts` (3-arg cases)

**No schema changes**. One new optional secret (`ASSET_URL_SIGNING_KEY`) + optional var (`CREATIVE_CPA_MAX_USD` default 25).

## Deferred Follow-ups

1. **Task 4.2**: Playwright E2E cold-start case — defer to live-env (unit coverage sufficient)
2. **`regenerate.ts` v1 boundary**: Regenerated slides unenriched; document as future SDD candidate
3. **Spec wording**: Already amended in merged specs before archive

## Verdict

**STATUS**: ✅ COMPLETE AND CLOSED  
**GATES**: All pass (587/587 tests, tsc clean, build clean)  
**TASKS**: 24/25 (1 deferred, unit coverage sufficient, tracked as follow-up)  
**SECURITY**: No issues

Production-ready and approved for deployment.

observations.title: Fix prod: migración 017 faltante rompía /acopio/arrivals (500) → operaciones+app vacías
observations.content:
**What**: Incidente prod resuelto. Operaciones (web) y app (mobile) mostraban las llegadas de acopio vacías para TODA fecha, mientras el dashboard sí las mostraba.

**Root cause**: La migración `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/017_arrival_validated_at.sql` (agrega columnas `validated_at timestamptz` y `validated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id)` a `acopio_arrivals`) NUNCA se aplicó al tenant `perufrost`. El backend desplegado (commit `4b8cc7f`) hace `SELECT ... a.validated_at FROM acopio_arrivals` → PostgresError `column a.validated_at does not exist` → 500 en `GET /acopio/arrivals` → el frontend lo renderiza como "vacío" (swallow del error en useQuery). El dashboard funcionaba porque pega a `/admin/areas/:areaCode/kpis` (otro endpoint, no toca esa columna).

**Cómo se diagnosticó** (systematic-debugging, NO era el deploy de frontend — mobile ni se tocó): comparé los 3 paths de fetch, confirmé que la query SQL en sí es sana, y el dato decisivo salió de los LOGS del backend en la VM: `docker logs produccion-infra-backend-1 | grep 'validated_at does not exist'`.

**Acceso VM** (clave para el futuro): SSH `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 rodrigo@34.31.70.3` (NO root — root da Permission denied). Está documentado en `infra/DEPLOY.md`. Postgres: `docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=postgres_dev_password produccion-infra-postgres-1 psql -U trace_app -d erp_exportadores`. Tenants: `tenant_perufrost` (real, 141 arrivals) y `tenant_demo`. Multitenant → usar `SET search_path TO tenant_x, public;`.

**Fix aplicado**: corrí la 017 (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, idempotente) en tenant_perufrost Y tenant_demo. Verificado: columnas creadas en ambos; endpoint pasó de 500 a 200 (login demo reviewer@traceexport.com end-to-end, GET /acopio/arrivals → 200). perufrost confirmado consistente hasta la 017 (014 metadata, 015 weight_without_winch, 016 report_presets ya estaban).

**Gap de proceso (importante)**: las migraciones de vértebra (`backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/<code>/NNN_*.sql`) NO se aplican automáticamente en el deploy a tenants YA existentes — solo el tenant-template corre al provisionar un tenant nuevo. Regla: antes de desplegar backend que use columnas/tablas nuevas, aplicar la migración correspondiente en la VM manualmente. Verificar drift con: comparar el nº de migración más alto del repo vs las columnas reales en la BD.

**Nota menor**: tenant_demo no tiene `report_presets` (016) pero el código la guardea con un check de information_schema, y demo no está en uso productivo.

observations.title: Session summary: ecomerce
observations.content:
## Goal
Ejecutar SDD-12 `creative-performance-feedback` de punta a punta (primer SDD de la cadena aprobada SDD-7..12), como quick win independiente antes de SDD-7.

## Instructions
- Config de sesión cacheada: Automatic mode, hybrid store (Engram+openspec), single-pr con size:exception, verify-driven (strict_tdd=false, sin unit runner previo — se usó `npx tsx --test`).
- Commits: conventional, SIN atribución de IA. Commit en rama sin push (elección del usuario).
- Decisión de producto del usuario: dolor+paleta se enriquecen desde día 1 (winner-independiente); solo ángulo/hook ganador + imagen de referencia son performance-gated.

## Discoveries
- `ecomerce` (cwd) y `win-comerce` NO son el mismo árbol: los `functions/` comparten inode pero `openspec/` son separados. El repo git es `/home/rodrigo/Documentos/win-comerce`. Los subagentes escriben partido — hay que consolidar artefactos openspec en win-comerce.
- Los agentes sdd-explore/sdd-spec/etc a veces resuelven cwd a `ecomerce` en vez de `win-comerce`; verificar y consolidar.
- `getSignedUrl` en `functions/_shared/command-center.ts:276` es código muerto/roto: castea el binding R2 a `createPresignedUrl` (API de aws-sdk/S3, NO existe en bindings R2 de Workers), siempre null, cero call sites. SDD-12 lo reemplazó con HMAC firmado.
- Tablas `angle_performance_rollup` y `ad_creative_performance` (migration 0017) tienen ctr/conversions/cpa/hook_rate pero NO revenue/ROAS. El "ganador híbrido" se define con conversions>0 + cpa<=umbral, sin schema nuevo.

observations.title: sdd/balanza-pesaje/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: "Traer de balanza" en tab Pesaje (web)

### Current State

**Backend (done, no changes needed)**
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-balanza.service.ts` — `AcopioBalanzaService.listMatched(filters)` calls external balanza API (`BALANZA_API_URL`/`BALANZA_API_TOKEN`), matches each raw record to an `acopio_arrival_assets` row by normalized supplier name + registration/plate, and flags `yaImportado` by checking `acopio_weighing.report_number`.
- Route: `GET /acopio/balanza/pesadas?page&page_size&fecha_inicio&fecha_fin` → `{ data: PesadaMatched[], hasNext, page }`.
- `PesadaMatched` fields: `reporte, acumulado, pesadas, especie, idConexion, fechaInicio, proveedor, matricula, placaVehicular, embarcacion, tipoTransporte, tipo ('BARCO'|'CAMARA'|'DESCONOCIDO'), matchedAssetId, matchedAssetLabel, yaImportado`.
- Error codes surfaced from `getConfig()`/`fetchRaw()`:
  - `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` (503 ServiceUnavailableException) — env vars missing.
  - `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE` (502 BadGatewayException) — fetch threw (network/timeout, 20s AbortSignal).
  - `BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR` (502) — balanza responded non-2xx.
  These arrive as axios error responses with `{ code, message }` in the body (standard Nest exception filter shape per project convention).

**Mobile reference implementation**
- `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/pesaje/index.tsx` (`PesajeBandeja`) has a collapsible "Traer de balanza" section:
  - `useQuery(['balanza-pesadas', today], ...)`, `enabled: showBalanza` (on-demand fetch, not eager).
  - Pure helpers (currently inline in this file, not yet extracted to a testable module): `balanzaPrefillUrl(p)` (field mapping), `norm(s)` (string normalization), `matchPesadas(raw, arrivals)` (client-side re-match, used only for a MOCK fallback path — the real match comes from the backend already).
  - `onTapPesada(p)`: if `p.yaImportado` → alert "Ya importado"; if `!p.matchedAssetId` → alert "Sin coincidencia" with proveedor/matrícula detail; else navigate to prefilled form.
  - `balanzaPrefillUrl` mapping (mobile, dynamic form-engine target `acopio_pesaje`):
    - `reportNumber ← String(reporte)`
    - `grossWeight ← acumulado`
    - `batchNumber ← String(pesadas)`
    - `species ← especie`
    - `hopperId ← String(idConexion)`
    - `startTime ← fechaInicio.slice(11, 16)` (HH:mm)
  - Renders a list of pesadas with proveedor, matrícula/placa, tipo, acumulado, pesadas count, matched asset label, and a badge: green "Importado", red "Sin match", or chevron (tappable) when matched and available.
  - Has a `useMockData` fallback UI ("Usar datos de prueba") when `balanzaError` fires — likely NOT needed for the web MVP but worth noting as a precedent for degraded-mode UX.

**Web target integration point**
- File: `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx`.
- This is a client component (`'use client'`), single page, NOT the dynamic form engine — pesaje is hand-coded inline inputs bound to local `useState`.
- Relevant existing state (lines ~64-70): `selectedAssetId, grossW, tareW, reportNumber, startTime, endTime, hopperNumber`.
- `activeAssetId` (line 86) = `selectedAssetId ?? primaryAsset?.id ?? null` — this is the asset the auto-match must target.
- The Pesaje tab JSX block is `{tab === 'pesaje' && activeAsset && (...)}` starting at **line 279**. The form-only block (shown when `canWeigh && !weighing`, i.e. no weighing saved yet) is lines 287-350, containing the 6 inputs: Nº Balanza (`reportNumber`), Tolva Nº (`hopperNumber`, numeric string, later `parseInt`), Hora inicio (`startTime`), Hora fin (`endTime`), Peso bruto (`grossW`), Tara (`tareW`, NOT provided by balanza).
- Submit handler `weighingMutation.mutate({...})` (line 340) already maps `hopperNumber` → `weighingMetadata: { hopper_number: parseInt(hopperNumber) }` and posts to `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/weighing`. No change needed there — prefill only needs to populate the same state setters before submit.
- There is currently NO balanza fetch/query in this file at all — it must be added (a `useQuery(['balanza-pesadas', ...])`, `enabled` only when the tab is `pesaje` and canWeigh, similar to mobile's on-demand pattern but likely scoped by `arrival.arrival_date` rather than "today", since the arrival can be from a prior day).

**Existing read-only precedent**
- `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/dashboard/page.tsx` has `BalanzaPanel`, a read-only "Balanza en vivo" list. Reuse its query/error-state patterns (loading, error, empty states) but do NOT reuse its component directly — this new control is action-oriented (click → prefill), not a passive monitor. Colorimetry: reuse `SEMAFORO` from `frontend/src/lib/status-colors.ts` for status badges (imported/no-match/matched) instead of ad-hoc classes like mobile's hardcoded green/red hexes.

### Wiring: prefill → existing state setters

Given a chosen `PesadaMatched` (either auto-matched or picked from a fallback list), prefill would call:
```
setReportNumber(String(p.reporte))
setGrossW(String(p.acumulado))
setHopperNumber(String(p.idConexion))
setStartTime(p.fechaInicio.slice(11, 16))
// tareW is NOT touched — stays manual (balanza doesn't provide tara)
```
No new component state is strictly required beyond what already exists; only new state needed is UI state for the balanza fetch (`showBalanza` toggle, or auto-open) and the fallback-picker list open/closed state.

### Client-side auto-match logic needed

Since backend already returns `matchedAssetId` per pesada, the web does NOT need to reimplement `matchPesadas` (unlike mobile's MOCK-only fallback). Auto-match logic is simply:
```
const candidates = balanzaData.filter(p => !p.yaImportado)
const autoMatch = candidates.find(p => p.matchedAssetId === activeAssetId)
```
- If exactly one `autoMatch` exists → offer one-click "Traer de balanza" that prefills directly (or auto-prefills empty fields).
- If none matches `activeAssetId` but the list has other candidates (e.g. matched to sibling assets, or `matchedAssetId === null`) → show fallback picker list of same-day (or same arrival_date) pesadas, letting the user manually pick one.
- If a user picks a pesada whose `matchedAssetId !== activeAssetId` (mismatch) — open question: allow it (assume operator knows better) or block it. Not resolved here; flag for proposal.

### Edge cases to handle

1. **`BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` (503)** — integration disabled/env missing. Should render a neutral/disabled state ("integración no configurada"), not a retryable error — retrying will never succeed until ops configures env vars.
2. **`BALANZA_UNREACHABLE` / `BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR` (502)** — transient network/tunnel failure (Cloudflare quick-tunnel). Should be retryable (refresh button), and must NOT block manual entry — pesaje form must remain usable regardless of balanza status (matches mobile's `canWeigh` staying independent of balanza query state).
3. **No match** (`matchedAssetId === null` for all candidates, or none for this asset) — surface a message and let user either fall back to the picker (if other candidates exist) or just enter manually.
4. **`yaImportado === true`** — that pesada is already registered in `acopio_weighing`; must be excluded from selectable candidates or shown disabled with a badge, mirroring mobile's "Importado" badge — clicking should not silently overwrite an already-saved weighing.
5. **Multiple matches to the same `activeAssetId`** — possible if operator re-weighs, or balanza returns duplicate reports for the same identifiers. UX must let user choose which report to bring, not silently take the first.
6. **Already-saved weighing for this asset** (`weighing` truthy → `canWeigh && !weighing` is false) — the entire input+prefill block is currently hidden once weighing exists; "Traer de balanza" should likely be hidden/disabled too in that state (nothing to prefill into).
7. **Date scoping** — mobile always queries "today" (`limaToday()`); the web arrival can be for any `arrival_date`. Query filters (`fecha_inicio`/`fecha_fin`) should likely use `arrival.arrival_date`, not client "today", to correctly surface pesadas for arrivals reviewed on a later day.

### What to extract for TDD (mirror `acopio-validation.ts` pattern)

Create a new pure module, e.g. `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` (no React/react-query), containing:
- `findAutoMatch(pesadas: PesadaMatched[], activeAssetId: string): PesadaMatched | null` — filters `!yaImportado` and finds `matchedAssetId === activeAssetId`.
- `buildPrefillFromPesada(p: PesadaMatched): { reportNumber: string; grossW: string; hopperNumber: string; startTime: string }` — the field-mapping function (pure, easily unit-tested against the open mapping question below).
- `listSelectableCandidates(pesadas: PesadaMatched[]): PesadaMatched[]` — excludes `yaImportado`, for the fallback picker.
- Optionally a helper to classify balanza error codes into UX categories (`isConfigError(code)`, `isTransientError(code)`) for consistent handling of `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` vs `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE`/`BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR`.
Mirror `frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.ts` + its co-located `.test.ts` for structure/doc-comment style (Spanish comments, JSDoc explaining the "why", cites mobile as source of truth).

### Open field-mapping question (NOT resolved — surface to proposal)

Mobile maps into the dynamic form-engine schema (`acopio_pesaje` form fields: `reportNumber, grossWeight, batchNumber, species, hopperId, startTime`). The web inline form has a DIFFERENT, smaller field set: `reportNumber (Nº Balanza), hopperNumber (Tolva), startTime, endTime, grossW (bruto), tareW (tara)`. There is no web equivalent for `batchNumber` or `species` — those may need to be dropped, stored in `weighingMetadata`, or added as new fields (open question).

Candidate mapping to confirm in proposal phase:
| Balanza field | Candidate web target | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `acumulado` | `grossW` (bruto) | direct numeric mapping, confirmed by user's suggestion |
| `reporte` | `reportNumber` (Nº Balanza) | confirmed |
| `idConexion` | `hopperNumber` (Tolva) | confirmed; note web treats it as `parseInt` int, backend sends as number already |
| `fechaInicio` (slice HH:mm) | `startTime` (Hora inicio) | confirmed |
| — (not provided) | `tareW` (Tara) | stays manual — balanza does not report tara |
| `pesadas` (count) | no web target | mobile only carries into `batchNumber`, which the web form lacks — needs decision: drop, or store in `weighingMetadata` |
| `especie` | no web target | mobile carries into `species`, web form lacks it — same decision needed |
| `endTime` | not in balanza payload at all | web form has an `endTime` input with no balanza source; stays manual in both platforms |
| `proveedor`, `matricula`/`placaVehicular`, `embarcacion`, `tipo` | used only for matching/display, not prefilled into any pesaje field | |

The user still owes: whether `pesadas`/`especie` should be persisted (e.g., into `weighingMetadata` alongside `hopper_number`) or simply discarded on web, and whether mismatched manual picker selections (pesada matched to a different asset) should be allowed or blocked.

### Recommendation

1. Extract pure logic first into `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` with unit tests (TDD, per project convention) — covers auto-match, prefill mapping, candidate filtering, error classification.
2. Add a collapsible "Traer de balanza" block above the existing pesaje inputs (same visual area as `canWeigh && !weighing`), using `useQuery(['balanza-pesadas', arrivalId, arrival.arrival_date])` scoped by `arrival.arrival_date`, `enabled: tab === 'pesaje' && canWeigh && !weighing`.
3. Auto-run `findAutoMatch` on data load; if found, show a single-click "Prefill" button/banner; else render `listSelectableCandidates` as a picker list (reusing SEMAFORO badges for yaImportado/sin-match states); on pick, call the prefill setters.
4. Handle `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` as a disabled/neutral state (no retry), `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE`/`BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR` as transient with a manual refetch button — never block the manual entry path.

### Risks

- Field-mapping gap (`pesadas`, `especie` have no web target) is unresolved and could cause silent data loss vs mobile parity if not decided before implementation.
- Date-scoping choice (today vs `arrival.arrival_date`) affects whether operators reviewing yesterday's arrival can still find their balanza report — must confirm with product/user.
- Ambiguity on whether to allow overriding a mismatched match (pesada matched to a different asset) needs an explicit product decision before coding the picker UX.
- No tests currently exist for the mobile helpers (`balanzaPrefillUrl`, `matchPesadas`) — the web port is an opportunity to add tests but there's no existing baseline to diff parity against.

### Ready for Proposal
Yes — enough is known about backend contract, integration point, and state wiring to write a proposal. The field-mapping table above must be explicitly confirmed by the user during the proposal round before implementation starts.

observations.title: sdd/balanza-pesaje/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Balanza Pesaje (Web)

(Hybrid store: also written to `openspec/changes/balanza-pesaje/proposal.md`.)

## Intent

Web operators retype balanza tickets by hand into the Pesaje tab, and the web inline form is missing three canonical `acopio_pesaje` fields (`weightWithoutWinch`, `species`, `batchNumber`) that mobile already captures — causing transcription errors and web/mobile data-parity loss. Frontend-only change; backend `GET /acopio/balanza/pesadas` and `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/weighing` already support everything needed.

## Scope

### In Scope
- **Form parity**: add `weightWithoutWinch` (number), `species` (text), `batchNumber` (text) to the inline pesaje form in `operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` (tab === 'pesaje'); reconcile `hopperNumber` (number) → canonical `hopperId` (text).
- **"Traer de balanza"**: on-demand fetch (`enabled` only in pesaje tab, `canWeigh && !weighing`) scoped by `arrival.arrival_date` (`fecha_inicio`/`fecha_fin`), NOT limaToday. Auto-match `matchedAssetId === activeAssetId`; fallback picker of the day's pesadas with **override allowed** (operator may import any pesada); `yaImportado` rows badged and excluded from import.
- **Prefill mapping (locked)**: grossWeight←`acumulado`, reportNumber←`reporte`, startTime←`fechaInicio` (HH:MM), hopperId←`idConexion`, species←`especie`, batchNumber←`pesadas`. Manual-only: `tareWeight`, `weightWithoutWinch`, `endTime`.
- **Graceful degradation**: `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` (503) → neutral disabled state, no retry; `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE`/`BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR` (502) → transient banner + manual refetch. Manual entry is never blocked (tunnel is frequently down).
- **Pure core** in `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` (auto-match, prefill mapping, candidate filtering, error classification) + vitest unit tests — strict TDD, mirroring `acopio-validation.ts`.

### Out of Scope (Non-Goals)
- Backend or mobile changes; balanza matching algorithm (backend, done).
- Per-tenant balanza config (env-based today).
- Valorización/pricing fields.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `acopio-balanza-pesaje-web`: web pesaje form parity with canonical `acopio_pesaje` + on-demand balanza import with override and degraded modes.

### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Approach

TDD the pure module first; then wire UI: collapsible "Traer de balanza" block above the pesaje inputs using `useQuery(['balanza-pesadas', arrivalId, arrival_date])`; prefill fills existing `useState` setters. SEMAFORO colors from `lib/status-colors`; `<Link>` only; no hardcoded areaCode.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` (+ `.test.ts`) | New | Pure logic + unit tests |
| `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` | Modified | Parity fields + import control |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Balanza down during dev/verify (down now) | High | Test degraded paths; pure core needs no live tunnel |
| `hopperNumber`→`hopperId` breaks existing `weighingMetadata.hopper_number` display consumers | Med | Audit readers of weighing metadata in same page before rename |
| Override imports pesada matched to another asset | Low | Locked decision: allowed; show matched-label context before import |

## Rollback Plan

Frontend-only, no schema/API changes: revert the PR. Saved weighings remain valid (backend contract unchanged).

## Dependencies

- None new. Existing backend endpoints; frontend vitest already set up.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Web pesaje form submits all canonical `acopio_pesaje` fields accepted by `AcopioWeighingService.create`.
- [ ] Import prefills the six mapped fields; manual-only fields untouched.
- [ ] Past-day arrivals list their own date's pesadas.
- [ ] Balanza down → form fully usable, clear degraded state.
- [ ] `pnpm -F frontend exec vitest run` green for `balanza-pesaje` core.

## Proposal question round

All exploration open questions were resolved by locked product decisions (mapping, arrival-date scoping, override allowed). Residual assumption for user review: the `hopperId` rename keeps backward-compatible display of previously saved `hopper_number` metadata.
