observations.title: sdd/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: WhatsApp CRM Core (SDD-7 whatsapp-core)

### Current State

1. **0010_add_project_wa_user.sql is misleadingly named** — content is only `ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN wa_number TEXT`. No `project_wa_user` table exists. `projects.wa_number` = merchant's own WA CTA number for landing page `wa.me/` deep links (see functions/api/agents/landing/run.ts:261, functions/api/landings/[id].ts publish-gate). Zero relation to Cloud API webhooks/inbound messages.

2. **No existing contacts/conversations/messages/team schema anywhere** in the 18 migrations or functions/src — all net-new for SDD-7.

3. **leads table** (migrations/0014_leads.sql): id, landing_id (no FK, app-validated), nombre, celular (free text, required — the auto-link key), direccion, ciudad, utm_* , created_at. No phone normalization utility exists anywhere in repo — auto-link-by-phone will need format normalization (spaces/country code/+ prefix) designed explicitly. Public POST /api/leads, synchronous insert, rate-limited via KV RATE_LIMIT (10/min/IP/landing) — see openspec/specs/lead-tracking/spec.md, utm-parsing/spec.md.

4. **"CRM" naming collision**: src/pages/CRM*.tsx (CRMDashboard, CRMUsersPage, CRMUserDetail, CRMPlansPage, CRMSettingsPage, CRMModelsPage, CRMCachePage, CRMDiscountsPage) under adminOnly routes /crm/* (src/App.tsx:226-233) is win-comerce's INTERNAL SaaS-admin console (manage win-comerce's own subscription users/plans), NOT a customer CRM. SDD-7 inbox must use a different route namespace (e.g. /inbox or /whatsapp), not /crm/*.

5. **Meta token/encryption pattern to reuse**:
   - integrations table (migrations/0017_hub_integrations.sql): id, project_id, integration_type ('meta_ads'), token_encrypted, test_token_expiry, sync_status, sync_last_at, sync_error. UNIQUE(project_id, integration_type).
   - functions/_shared/crypto.ts: encryptToken/decryptToken, AES-GCM, 32-byte key from Cloudflare secret (currently META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY), format base64(iv):base64(ciphertext), fresh random 12-byte IV per call.
   - Endpoints: functions/api/integrations/meta/{token,status,sync}.ts (spec: openspec/specs/meta-token-management/spec.md, meta-ads-sync/spec.md).
   - Ownership: functions/api/integrations/_shared/ownership.ts verifyProjectOwnership() — returns false for both "not found" and "not owner" → caller returns 404 always (IDOR-safe, no 403 disclosure).
   - Concurrency: sync.ts uses guarded UPDATE (`sync_status != 'running'` + check `meta.changes`) claim pattern — reusable for webhook/dedup state machines.
   - Recommendation: do NOT reuse the `integrations` table itself for WA tokens (migration 0017's own comment explicitly documents avoiding table-collision reuse across unrelated features to prevent cross-tenant corruption) — reuse the encryption fn + ownership/claim patterns, but create a dedicated `whatsapp_integrations`/`whatsapp_channels` table (different lifecycle fields: webhook verify token, phone_number_id, business_account_id vs Meta Ads' test_token_expiry/sync_status).

6. **Multi-tenant model today**: tenant = `users` row (SaaS customer) with single global role enum 'user'|'admin' (functions/_shared/session.ts SessionUser). `projects.user_id` = single-owner FK (app-level only, D1 ALTER TABLE can't add FK). NO collaborators/team/project_members table exists anywhere. The wacrm owner/admin/agent/viewer team model is entirely net-new — nothing to port into, must be designed fresh (open question: scoped per-project vs new tenant/company abstraction above projects).

7. **Worker companion feasibility confirmed**: functions/api/creatives/_cleanup.ts:20 already documents "Cloudflare Pages Functions do NOT support a native `scheduled` export". No existing standalone Worker in repo — only root wrangler.jsonc (Pages target) with d1 binding DB (win-comerce-db), r2 binding STORAGE (win-comerce-assets), kv binding RATE_LIMIT. A sibling Worker can bind the SAME resource IDs in its own wrangler.toml/jsonc (bindings are resource-id scoped, not deploy-target scoped) — no existing template to copy from though.

### Recommendation
Dedicated `whatsapp_integrations` table (not reusing `integrations`), reusing crypto.ts encryption fn + ownership.ts pattern + guarded-UPDATE claim pattern. New route namespace outside /crm/*. Team model must be designed fresh in propose/design.

### Risks
- Team/role model net-new — biggest scope risk
- No phone normalization anywhere — auto-link will silently fail on format mismatch without explicit design
- /crm/* naming collision if inbox UI carelessly placed there
- Worker companion = second deploy target, no existing template, adds CI/deploy complexity
- Size: full slice (schema + ChannelAdapter + Meta adapter + webhook + send + auto-link + inbox UI + worker) very likely >400 lines. Natural 3-slice boundary: (a) schema+ChannelAdapter interface+Meta adapter webhook/send, (b) auto-link+Inbox UI polling, (c) Worker companion skeleton.

### Open Questions (for propose/design)
- Webhook verify token storage (new secret vs new column)
- Inbound message dedup key (Meta message ID uniqueness)
- Media handling: Meta media API → R2 retention policy
- Inbox polling interval vs Meta API rate limits
- Team model scope: per-project owner-based vs new company/tenant abstraction

observations.title: sdd/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: WhatsApp CRM Core (sdd-7-whatsapp-core)

File: openspec/changes/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/proposal.md (hybrid mode)

## Intent
Merchants sell via COD/WhatsApp, but win-comerce only captures leads (name + phone) and drops them: no way to receive/answer WhatsApp messages, no contact/conversation storage, no team access model. SDD-7 delivers the messaging foundation for the WhatsApp-CRM chain (SDD-8..11: AI qualification, orders, closer, aliclick).

**Why now (confirmed gaps)**: zero contacts/conversations/messages/team schema; `projects.wa_number` (migration 0010) is only a landing CTA number; no phone-normalization utility anywhere; Pages Functions cannot run cron/Queues; `/crm/*` routes taken by internal SaaS-admin console.

## Scope — In
1. `ChannelAdapter` TS interface; v1 impl = Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (webhook verify + inbound receive, outbound send).
2. Append-only migration `migrations/0019_whatsapp_core.sql` (**0019 — repo already at 0018, NOT 0010/0011 as earlier plan assumed**): contacts, conversations, messages, team roles (owner/admin/agent/viewer), all tenant-scoped by `project_id`. Concepts ported from wacrm (MIT), not code.
3. New dedicated `whatsapp_integrations` table + endpoints mirroring Meta token pattern (AES-GCM crypto.ts, ownership.ts 404-always, guarded-UPDATE claim). Do NOT overload `integrations` (0017's comment forbids cross-feature reuse).
4. Phone-normalization utility (E.164) + auto-link lead→contact by phone.
5. Inbox UI (React SPA) under new `/inbox` namespace (NOT /crm/*), polling only.
6. Companion Worker (separate deploy target, `workers/whatsapp-companion/`) for cron/queues, binding same D1/R2/KV resource IDs.

## Scope — Out
AI qualification (SDD-8), orders (SDD-9), closer (SDD-10), aliclick (SDD-11); Evolution/Baileys adapter (interface must allow, no impl); realtime (WS/DO); templates/broadcasts; media gallery UX.

**Delivery**: chained local slices, no GitHub push — (a) schema+token+adapter+webhook/send, (b) auto-link+inbox UI, (c) Worker companion.

## Capabilities (contract with sdd-spec)
New: `whatsapp-channel-gateway`, `whatsapp-token-management`, `crm-conversations`, `crm-team-roles`, `lead-contact-linking`, `inbox-ui`, `worker-companion`.
Modified: `lead-tracking` (leads gain contact linkage on normalized-phone match).

## Approach
- Adapter: `verifyWebhook(request)`, `parseInbound(payload) → InboundMessage[]`, `send(outbound) → providerMessageId`; adapter selected per `whatsapp_integrations.channel_type`.
- Data: every table carries `project_id` (app-level FK, D1 pattern); messages append-only with `provider_message_id` for dedup; conversations carry status + assignee.
- Auth: webhook public (Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 + verify token); all other endpoints reuse existing x-api-key/session auth + `verifyProjectOwnership`.
- Worker boundary: request-path logic stays in Pages Functions; Worker handles only scheduled/queue consumers.

## Affected Areas
migrations/0019_whatsapp_core.sql (New) | functions/api/whatsapp/** (New) | functions/_shared/phone.ts (New) | src/App.tsx + src/pages/Inbox*.tsx (Modified/New, /inbox routes) | workers/whatsapp-companion/** (New deploy target) | functions/_shared/crypto.ts + ownership.ts (Reused, unmodified).

## Risks
- Team model net-new → scope creep (Med): v1 = per-project membership table, no company abstraction.
- Phone format mismatch breaks auto-link (Med): E.164 utility + tests.
- Webhook spoofing (Med): signature verification + verify token.
- Second deploy target complexity (Med): Worker isolated in slice (c).
- >400 lines total (High): chained slices.

## Rollback
Each slice = local commit on own branch → revert. Migration additive (new tables; at most one nullable column on leads). Worker: `wrangler delete`. No existing behavior modified outside /inbox route registration.

## Dependencies
Meta WhatsApp Cloud API app + phone number (test OK); encryption key secret (reuse META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY vs new WHATSAPP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY — design decision).

## Success Criteria
Inbound webhook creates contact+conversation+message rows tenant-isolated; outbound send persists with provider message id; lead auto-links on normalized phone; /inbox polling behind existing auth; companion Worker deploys and runs scheduled handler on shared D1; WA token AES-GCM only, ownership 404-safe.

## Open Questions (deferred to design)
Webhook verify-token storage (secret vs column); inbound dedup (UNIQUE provider_message_id vs claim); media→R2 retention; polling interval vs rate limits; team model (net-new tables vs extending users; per-project vs company); lead link shape (leads.contact_id vs link table).

observations.title: sdd/balanza-pesaje/spec
observations.content:
# acopio-balanza-pesaje-web Specification

(Hybrid store: also written to `openspec/changes/balanza-pesaje/specs/acopio-balanza-pesaje-web/spec.md`.)

## Purpose

Web pesaje form on the operations page MUST capture the full canonical `acopio_pesaje` field set (parity with mobile) and MUST offer an on-demand "Traer de balanza" import that prefills matched fields from the balanza API, with graceful degradation when the balanza is unreachable or unconfigured.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Canonical Pesaje Field Capture
The web pesaje form (tab `pesaje` in `operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx`) MUST capture `reportNumber`, `grossWeight`, `tareWeight`, `weightWithoutWinch`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `hopperId` (text), `species`, and `batchNumber`, and MUST submit them to `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/weighing`.

#### Scenario: Full manual submission
- GIVEN an operator on the pesaje tab with no balanza data imported
- WHEN they fill all nine canonical fields and submit
- THEN the request payload includes all nine fields with `hopperId` as text

#### Scenario: Legacy hopperNumber input removed
- GIVEN the form previously exposed a numeric `hopperNumber` field
- WHEN the form renders today
- THEN only the text `hopperId` field is present, and any legacy `hopper_number` display value is still readable for historical weighings

### Requirement: On-Demand Balanza Fetch Scoped by Arrival Date
The "Traer de balanza" control MUST call `GET /acopio/balanza/pesadas?fecha_inicio=<arrival.arrival_date>&fecha_fin=<arrival.arrival_date>` only when the operator triggers it on the pesaje tab, and MUST scope the query by the arrival's own date, not the current date.

#### Scenario: Past-day arrival queries its own date
- GIVEN an arrival with `arrival_date` earlier than today
- WHEN the operator triggers "Traer de balanza"
- THEN the request uses the arrival's `arrival_date` for both `fecha_inicio` and `fecha_fin`, not today's date

### Requirement: Auto-Match Prefill
WHEN the fetch returns a pesada where `matchedAssetId === activeAssetId && !yaImportado`, the system MUST auto-prefill `grossWeight`, `reportNumber`, `startTime`, `hopperId`, `species`, and `batchNumber` from that pesada, and MUST leave `tareWeight`, `weightWithoutWinch`, and `endTime` untouched.

#### Scenario: Auto-match happy path
- GIVEN a pesada with `matchedAssetId` equal to the active asset and `yaImportado: false`
- WHEN the fetch resolves
- THEN `grossWeight`, `reportNumber`, `startTime`, `hopperId`, `species`, `batchNumber` are prefilled per the locked mapping (`acumulado`, `reporte`, `fechaInicio` as HH:MM, `idConexion`, `especie`, `pesadas`)
- AND `tareWeight`, `weightWithoutWinch`, `endTime` remain empty or unchanged

### Requirement: Manual Override Picker
WHEN no auto-match exists, the system MUST show a picker listing the day's pesadas; the operator MUST be able to import any non-`yaImportado` pesada into the active asset, using the same field mapping as auto-match.

#### Scenario: No auto-match shows picker
- GIVEN the fetch returns pesadas with no `matchedAssetId === activeAssetId` entry
- WHEN the fetch resolves
- THEN a picker lists all pesadas for the day

#### Scenario: Operator imports a non-matched pesada
- GIVEN the picker is shown
- WHEN the operator selects an importable pesada
- THEN the six mapped fields are prefilled from that pesada into the active asset's form

#### Scenario: Already-imported pesada is not importable
- GIVEN a pesada in the list has `yaImportado: true`
- WHEN the picker renders
- THEN that pesada is badged as imported and its import action is disabled

### Requirement: Graceful Degradation on Balanza Errors
WHEN the balanza fetch fails with `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE` or `BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR` (502), the system MUST show a transient degraded-state message and MUST keep the form fully usable for manual entry. WHEN it fails with `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED` (503), the system MUST show a distinct neutral disabled-state message without retry. WHEN the fetch succeeds with an empty list, the system MUST show a "sin pesadas para esta fecha" message.

#### Scenario: Transient balanza failure
- GIVEN the fetch returns `BALANZA_UNREACHABLE` or a 502 `BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR`
- WHEN the error is received
- THEN a degraded banner is shown and all form fields remain editable and submittable

#### Scenario: Balanza not configured
- GIVEN the fetch returns 503 `BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED`
- WHEN the error is received
- THEN a neutral disabled-state message is shown, distinct from the transient-failure message, with no automatic retry

#### Scenario: Empty result set
- GIVEN the fetch succeeds with an empty array
- WHEN the response is received
- THEN the UI shows "sin pesadas para esta fecha"

### Requirement: Import Does Not Discard Operator Edits
An import MUST overwrite only the six mapped fields at the moment of import. Manual fields and any subsequent operator edits to any field after import MUST be preserved through form submission.

#### Scenario: Edits after import are preserved
- GIVEN an import has prefilled the six mapped fields
- WHEN the operator edits any field (mapped or manual) after import
- THEN the edited value, not the imported value, is present in the payload on submit

Spec phase complete for sdd-7-whatsapp-core (hybrid mode). Full delta/new spec files written under openspec/changes/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/specs/:

## NEW capabilities (full specs)
- whatsapp-channel-gateway: ChannelAdapter contract (verifyWebhook/parseInbound/send), Meta Cloud API GET verify handshake, X-Hub-Signature-256 verification, provider_message_id dedup, outbound send + persistence, per-tenant isolation.
- whatsapp-token-management: new whatsapp_integrations table (NOT reusing integrations), new secret WHATSAPP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, AES-GCM, POST/GET/DELETE /api/whatsapp/integration endpoints, 404-always ownership pattern mirroring meta-token-management.
- crm-conversations: tenant-scoped contacts/conversations/messages (append-only messages), GET conversations list (tenant-isolated + empty list), GET conversation messages (polling cursor), POST send reply (role + ownership enforced).
- crm-team-roles: project_members table (project_id, user_id, role), roles owner/admin/agent/viewer, full permission matrix (view all; send: owner/admin/assigned-agent only; assign: owner/admin only; integration connect: owner/admin only; team mgmt: owner only), conversation assignment, membership removal revokes access immediately.
- lead-contact-linking: E.164 normalization utility with per-project configurable default country (default Peru +51), bidirectional auto-link (lead→contact on creation, inbound WA contact→lead on creation), unparseable phone never blocks write, strictly per-project isolation.
- inbox-ui: /inbox route (distinct from /crm/* admin console), session-auth guarded, empty-state when no whatsapp_integrations row prompting connect, polling refresh, role-aware UI (viewer read-only, agent compose only if assigned).
- worker-companion: workers/whatsapp-companion/ separate deploy target sharing same D1/R2/KV binding IDs, scheduled/queue-only (no public CRM HTTP routes), independently deployable/removable without affecting Pages Functions.

## MODIFIED capability (delta, ADDED section only — no existing behavior changed)
- lead-tracking: ADDED "Auto-Link Hook on Lead Arrival" requirement — POST /api/leads triggers bidirectional auto-link attempt after existing synchronous insert; link failure/no-match MUST NOT affect the 200 response or lead persistence.

All requirements use RFC 2119 keywords; every requirement has >=2 Given/When/Then scenarios covering happy path + edge case (dedup, IDOR/ownership 404, cross-tenant isolation, role boundaries, cold-start/empty-state). Matched existing repo spec style (meta-token-management, lead-tracking) — tables for permission matrices/field rules, --- separators not needed since one requirement per file section works via ### headers.

Files written: openspec/changes/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/specs/{whatsapp-channel-gateway,whatsapp-token-management,crm-conversations,crm-team-roles,lead-contact-linking,inbox-ui,worker-companion,lead-tracking}/spec.md

Open items deferred to design (per proposal's Open Questions): webhook verify-token storage location, exact dedup index (UNIQUE constraint vs guarded-UPDATE), media/R2 retention, polling interval value, project_members vs company-abstraction confirmation (spec assumes project_members, no company abstraction, per locked decision #2).

observations.title: sdd/balanza-pesaje/design
observations.content:
# Design: Balanza Pesaje (Web)

(Hybrid store: also written to `openspec/changes/balanza-pesaje/design.md`.)

## Technical Approach

Frontend-only. A pure, React-free core module (`balanza-pesaje.ts`, mirroring `acopio-validation.ts`) owns matching, prefill mapping, candidate filtering, and error classification — built strict-TDD first. The pesaje tab is extracted from `operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` into a `PesajePanel` component (precedent: `ValidationPanel`) that adds the three missing canonical fields and a collapsible "Traer de balanza" import block backed by an on-demand react-query.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Alternatives / Tradeoff | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pesaje tab structure | Extract `PesajePanel` component owning form state + weighing mutation | Inline edit: less churn, but component tests would need to render the whole 5-tab page (brittle, heavy mocks) | Testability with the exact `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` harness; page.tsx is already ~500 lines; panel owns its 9-field state cleanly |
| `weighing` read query location | Stays in `page.tsx`, passed to panel as prop | Move into panel — but `shrinkage_pct` feeds the valorización tab too | Single observer, no duplicate fetch; panel receives `weighing` and renders read-only summary |
| hopperNumber→hopperId | New writes send top-level `hopperId: string` (backend merges as `weighingMetadata.hopperId`); stop writing `hopper_number`; display via `getHopperDisplay(metadata)` = `hopperId ?? hopper_number` | Dual-write both keys — rejected: pollutes new rows with legacy key | Grep confirms `hopper_number` has zero readers (frontend or backend); only the removed write path used it. Legacy rows stay readable through the fallback |
| Balanza fetch trigger | `useQuery(['balanza-pesadas', arrivalId, arrivalDate])` with `enabled: importOpen && tab==='pesaje' && canWeigh && !weighing`, `retry: false` | Auto-fetch on tab open — rejected: tunnel frequently down, wasted 20s timeouts | On-demand per spec; manual "Reintentar" button calls `refetch()` for 502s only |
| Prefill application | One-shot: apply `buildPesajePrefill` to setters at import moment (auto-match on first resolve, or picker click); `hasPrefilled` flag prevents re-apply | Controlled re-sync on refetch — rejected: would clobber operator edits (spec violation) | Spec: import overwrites only the 6 mapped fields at import time; later edits win |
| Error taxonomy | `classifyBalanzaError(err)` reads axios `err.response.data.code` first, falls back to status (503→NOT_CONFIGURED, 502→UNREACHABLE), else generic | Status-only — rejected: 502 is ambiguous (UNREACHABLE vs HTTP_ERROR) | Backend error filter emits `{ success:false, code, message }`; code is authoritative |

## Data Flow

    [Traer de balanza click] → importOpen=true
      → useQuery GET /acopio/balanza/pesadas?fecha_inicio=arrival_date&fecha_fin=arrival_date
        ├─ error → classifyBalanzaError → banner (warn 502 + retry | neutral 503, no retry); form untouched
        ├─ []    → "Sin pesadas para esta fecha"
        └─ data  → findAutoMatch(pesadas, activeAssetId)
                     ├─ match → buildPesajePrefill → setters (6 fields, once)
                     └─ null  → picker: listSelectablePesadas; yaImportado badged (SEMAFORO.neutral) + disabled
    [Registrar pesaje] → POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/weighing
        { grossWeight, tareWeight, weightWithoutWinch?, reportNumber?, startTime?, endTime?, hopperId?, species?, batchNumber? }

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` | Create | `PesadaMatched` type (mirror backend interface, 15 fields), `findAutoMatch`, `buildPesajePrefill`, `listSelectablePesadas`, `classifyBalanzaError`, `getHopperDisplay` |
| `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.test.ts` | Create | Vitest unit suite (TDD first) |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/PesajePanel.tsx` | Create | Extracted pesaje tab: 9 inputs, import block, degraded states, weighing mutation |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/PesajePanel.test.tsx` | Create | Component tests, `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` harness |
| `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` | Modify | Replace inline pesaje block with `<PesajePanel>`; drop pesaje form state; add `weighing_metadata` to `Weighing` type |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```ts
export interface PesajePrefill { // all form-ready strings
  grossWeight: string    // String(acumulado)
  reportNumber: string   // String(reporte)
  startTime: string      // first HH:MM in fechaInicio (regex /\b(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/, zero-padded); '' if absent
  hopperId: string       // String(idConexion)
  species: string        // especie
  batchNumber: string    // String(pesadas)
}
export function findAutoMatch(pesadas: PesadaMatched[], activeAssetId: string): PesadaMatched | null
export function listSelectablePesadas(pesadas: PesadaMatched[]): PesadaMatched[] // all; UI disables yaImportado
export function classifyBalanzaError(err: unknown): { code: 'BALANZA_NOT_CONFIGURED'|'BALANZA_UNREACHABLE'|'BALANZA_HTTP_ERROR'|'BALANZA_ERROR'; message: string }
export function getHopperDisplay(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string | null
```

UI copy (es-CL, existing convention): degraded 502 banner amber (`SEMAFORO.warn`), 503 neutral gray (`SEMAFORO.neutral`), imported badge neutral. No hardcoded areaCode; `<Link>` only.

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| Unit (vitest, TDD-first) | auto-match (match/yaImportado/none), prefill mapping + HH:MM edge cases (ISO, `dd/mm HH:MM`, missing), error classification by code/status/network, hopper display fallback | Pure functions, no mocks |
| Component | manual submit sends 9 fields with `hopperId` text; auto-prefill on resolve; picker with disabled imported rows; 3 error states keep form editable; post-import edits win in payload | Mock `@/lib/api` + `next/navigation` per `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` |
| Manual/E2E | Playwright visual check (skill rule); degraded path verifiable live (balanza down now) | `pnpm -F frontend dev` |

## Migration / Rollout

No migration. Legacy `weighing_metadata.hopper_number` rows remain readable via `getHopperDisplay`. Revert = revert PR.

## Open Questions

- [ ] Exact `fechaInicio` wire format unconfirmed (tunnel down); prefill parser is format-tolerant by design — verify against live payload during apply.

observations.content:
**What**: Ciclo SDD completo de `balanza-pesaje` (frontend-only) — "Traer de balanza" en el tab Pesaje web + paridad del form. Deployado a prod (Vercel Ready, commits ca04288/0f1dc6c/6160cd6 en front-escrorpia).

**Alcance**: (1) "Traer de balanza" on-demand en el tab Pesaje (`operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx`): fetch `/acopio/balanza/pesadas` por `arrival_date`, auto-match del activo (findAutoMatch) + lista con override (cualquiera importable), badges yaImportado, degradación 502/503/504→UNREACHABLE(retry)/NOT_CONFIGURED(body code)/vacío. (2) Paridad del form de pesaje: agregados weightWithoutWinch/species/batchNumber; reconciliado hopperNumber→hopperId (display legacy vía getHopperDisplay). Extraído `PesajePanel.tsx`; la query de weighing queda en page.tsx (alimenta valorización). Core puro en `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` (TDD).

**Mapeo LOCKED** (decisión usuario): grossWeight←acumulado, reportNumber←reporte, startTime←fechaInicio(HH:MM), hopperId←idConexion, species←especie, batchNumber←pesadas. Manuales (nunca balanza): tareWeight, weightWithoutWinch, endTime. Decisiones: fecha=arrival_date (no hoy); override=cualquiera de la lista.

**Judgment-day (2 rondas)**: R1 encontró 1 CRITICAL — `<PesajePanel>` sin `key` → al cambiar de activo el form mantenía valores → **escribía los pesos del activo A en el B** (bug de integridad en trazabilidad). Fix: `key={activeAsset.id}` (remonta) + refactor de raíz al **patrón overlay** (prefill derivado por useMemo sobre [pesadas, arrivalAssetId] + ediciones del usuario en state separado; effective = edits[k] ?? prefill?.[k] ?? ''). Esto elimina el anti-patrón de setState dentro de queryFn, hace que las ediciones ganen y que el auto-match recompute por activo. Otros fixes: query key propia (colisión con panel dashboard), findAutoMatch null en múltiples matches, classifyBalanzaError por body code, buildPesajePrefill null-safe, guard de carga del weighing (anti doble-registro). R2 CLEAN. 115 tests, tsc/lint OK, next build OK.

**Gotcha reutilizable**: el patrón overlay (prefill useMemo + edits) es el mismo de ValidationPanel — evita el lint React-Compiler `set-state-in-effect` Y resuelve "edits win" + recompute por prop. Es el patrón canónico para "prellenar un form editable desde datos async" en este frontend.

**Pendiente**: check visual del happy-path (tarea 5.4) cuando la balanza vuelva (tunnel efímero estaba caído). Follow-up backend fuera de scope: `areas.service.ts` lee solo `hopperId` → pesajes legacy con `hopper_number` no muestran tolva en la vista de recepciones del dashboard. observations.title: sdd/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/design
observations.content:
Design phase complete for sdd-7-whatsapp-core (hybrid mode). Full document: openspec/changes/sdd-7-whatsapp-core/design.md. All proposal Open Questions resolved; all 7 locked decisions baked in.

## Architecture Decisions (12)
1. Webhook tenant routing by PATH: /api/whatsapp/webhook/:integrationId — GET handshake has no payload, so a single URL can't resolve the verify token; payload phone_number_id cross-checked as defense-in-depth.
2. Verify token = per-integration plaintext column webhook_verify_token, server-generated crypto.randomUUID() at connect, returned once in POST response.
3. Signature key = per-integration app_secret_encrypted (AES-GCM, same WHATSAPP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY) — merchants bring their own Meta app. CRITICAL: adds app_secret to POST /api/whatsapp/integration body → additive amendment needed in whatsapp-token-management spec field table.
4. Inbound dedup = UNIQUE(project_id, provider_message_id) + INSERT OR IGNORE (not guarded-UPDATE — pure idempotency, not a claim state machine). SQLite unique ignores NULLs so failed sends don't collide.
5. New secret WHATSAPP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (locked); crypto.ts reused unmodified (key is a param).
6. Phone normalization = hand-rolled ~60-line functions/_shared/phone.ts (E.164, dial map PE:51/MX:52/CO:57, default from projects.country, fallback +51, never throws → null). libphonenumber-js rejected: Pages bundles ALL functions into one Worker (~110KB metadata tax). Same signature allows later swap.
7. Lead link = leads.contact_id + leads.phone_normalized nullable columns (no link table); leads scope resolves via leads.landing_id → landings.project_id join (0014 convention — leads has NO project_id).
8. One conversation per contact: UNIQUE(project_id, contact_id); inbound reopens.
9. Team = project_members(id, project_id, user_id, role owner|admin|agent|viewer, UNIQUE(project_id,user_id)); migration backfills owner from projects.user_id via lower(hex(randomblob(16))); projects/index.ts seeds owner on create; global users.role='admin' = owner-equivalent. No company layer → NO crm-team-roles spec delta.
10. CRM endpoints session-cookie only; WIN_API_KEY rejected (no user identity → role matrix unevaluable). Webhook is the only public route.
11. Media: insert message row (media_status pending) → ctx.waitUntil fetchMedia → R2 key whatsapp/{project_id}/{message_id}; retention unbounded v1, lifecycle rule documented follow-up.
12. Inbox polling 5s thread / 15s list — polls own D1 API, zero Meta rate-limit exposure.

## Schema (migrations/0019_whatsapp_core.sql, append-only)
Tables: whatsapp_integrations (UNIQUE project_id, idx phone_number_id, status connected/disconnected, token_encrypted, app_secret_encrypted, webhook_verify_token, phone_number_id, business_account_id), wa_contacts (UNIQUE(project_id, wa_id), idx (project_id, phone_normalized), lead_id), wa_conversations (UNIQUE(project_id, contact_id), idx (project_id,last_message_at DESC) and (project_id,assignee_user_id), status, assignee_user_id), wa_messages (append-only, UNIQUE(project_id, provider_message_id), idx (conversation_id, created_at), direction/sender_user_id/msg_type/body/media_r2_key/media_status), project_members + owner backfill, ALTER leads ADD contact_id, phone_normalized + index. Convention matched to 0017: TEXT PKs, app-level FKs, unixepoch().

## Key contracts
ChannelAdapter in functions/_shared/whatsapp/adapter.ts: verifyWebhook(rawBody, request, creds) constant-time HMAC; parseInbound(payload)→InboundMessage[] pure; send(msg, creds)→providerMessageId; fetchMedia(mediaId, creds). Meta impl meta-adapter.ts (Graph v21.0). getAdapter(channel_type) registry. GET handshake lives in route, not adapter.
Role middleware functions/api/whatsapp/_shared/membership.ts: session → project_members lookup per-request (removal = instant revoke) → no row = 404 (IDOR-safe), insufficient role = 403; agent send requires conversation.assignee_user_id === caller.

## Worker companion (workers/whatsapp-companion/)
scheduled-only (no fetch export → no public routes), cron */15 min, sweep: batch(100) leads WHERE phone_normalized IS NULL → normalize + bidirectional auto-link (also satisfies spec clause "normalizes after creation"). Binds SAME resource ids: D1 6757a93c-b517-4a49-ad4e-f4e6f57b4dac, R2 win-comerce-assets, KV 17833025c6184c4c9e2dc6a08f69f65a. Imports ../../functions/_shared/phone.ts (pure module). Independent wrangler deploy/delete.

## Slices (locked #7)
A: migration + phone.ts + adapter + integration endpoints + webhook + membership middleware. B: conversations/messages/assign/members APIs + auto-link hooks (leads.ts, projects/index.ts) + /inbox UI (src/App.tsx routes + InboxPage). C: worker companion.

## Residual risks
CRITICAL: whatsapp-token-management spec needs additive app_secret field amendment before tasks freeze. WARNING: hand-rolled normalization edge cases (AR 9-infix, MX legacy 1); outbound send-succeeds/persist-fails gap (SDD-8 outbox); R2 media growth; Pages bundle growth.

- FIX B: corrected/added retry-semantics docstring in workers/whatsapp-companion/src/index.ts runSweep: auto-link is BEST-EFFORT ONE-SHOT like functions/api/leads.ts; once mark-attempted UPDATE lands the row is terminal (attempted=1) and a normalized-but-link-failed lead is NOT re-linked (reverse direction covered by webhook Slice A/B); only a throw before/at the mark-attempted write leaves the row retryable.

observations.content:
## Exploration: Documentos gate (observation on YELLOW/RED) + DOC OK aggregate parity

### Current State

**Web `DocumentUploadPanel.tsx`** (`frontend/src/components/acopio/DocumentUploadPanel.tsx`):
- Props: single `arrivalAssetId` (one asset at a time — camara OR one vessel, selected via tabs in the parent page).
- "Aprobar" button (line ~194-201) is ALWAYS enabled when `!readOnly && !latest.is_approved` — no semaphore/observation check at all. Approving a RED/YELLOW doc with no observation is currently possible in the UI.
- Observation input (line 230-251) exists and calls `observationMutation` (`PATCH /acopio/documents/:id/observation`) but is purely optional free text, saved independently, never required before approve.
- `allApproved` (line 123) = `uploadedCount >= requiredTypes.length && approvedCount >= requiredTypes.length` for the CURRENT asset only. Does NOT check `semaphore_status`/`review_observation` at all, and does NOT know about sibling vessels when viewing the camara asset.
- "Confirmar DOC OK" button (line 292-317) is `disabled={confirmDocOkMutation.isPending || !uploadedCount}` — NOT gated on `allApproved` (only visually styled `variant={allApproved ? 'default' : 'outline'}`), and NOT gated on unobserved warnings at all (mobile's `hasUnobservedWarnings` concept doesn't exist on web).
- Does not import/use `DocumentSemaphore`/`SemaphoreRules` (only a local inline `SemaphoreChip`) or `status-colors.ts` SEMAFORO constants — a smaller duplicate exists locally instead of reusing `DocumentSemaphore.tsx`.
- Used from `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` (line 244-249): one `DocumentUploadPanel` mounted per `activeAsset.id`, switched via an asset-selector (camara tab vs each vessel tab). There is NO combined/aggregate view showing camara + all vessels docs together on web (unlike mobile, see below).

**Mobile source of truth** (`mobile/app/(app)/acopio/documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx`):
- `DocRow` component: approve/unapprove via checkbox, always clickable regardless of semaphore — mobile ALSO does not block the per-document approve action itself on YELLOW/RED. The gate is enforced ONLY at the DOC OK confirmation step, not at approve time.
- Per-document observation `TextInput`, saved via same `PATCH /observation` endpoint, optional to type but tracked.
- Aggregation logic (lines 448-472): `hasUnobservedWarnings` = count of docs (camara's own AND nested vessel docs, via `VesselDocsSection`/`onWarningsChange`) where `upload_confirmed_at && (semaphore_status IN (YELLOW,RED)) && !review_observation?.trim()`.
- `canConfirmDocOk = allUploadedApproved && !hasUnobservedWarnings && !confirmDocOkMutation.isPending` (line 517) — this is the exact YELLOW/RED-observation gate for gap #1, and it blocks the DOC OK button (not the individual approve action).
- `allUploadedApproved` requires: `totalApproved > 0 && camaraAllApproved && allVesselsApproved` where `allVesselsApproved` folds over ALL vessel statuses reported by nested `VesselDocsSection` children via `onStatusChange` — i.e., mobile presents ONE screen per camara (`documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx` where assetId = camara) that lists the camara's own docs AND every assigned vessel's docs nested below, with ONE combined "Confirmar DOC OK" footer button for the whole aggregate. Vessels are NOT confirmed independently on mobile — DOC OK is only ever confirmed at the camara/asset level shown by this one screen (for BARCO transport type, `assetId` = the single vessel and there's no camara wrapper).
- `deduplicateDocs()` helper picks the "active" doc per type (approved > confirmed > most recent) — relevant for TDD extraction since web doesn't have an equivalent (web just uses `docs[docs.length - 1]` as "latest", which is NOT the same dedup priority — potential existing divergence bug, doc history order edge case).

**Backend** (`backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts`, wired in `acopio.controller.ts` lines 413-445):
- `approveDocument(documentId)` — unconditionally sets `is_human_approved = true`. NO server-side check of `semaphore_status` or `review_observation` whatsoever. The YELLOW/RED-observation gate is 100% CLIENT-SIDE (and currently only implemented in mobile, not web, not backend).
- `saveObservation(documentId, observation, reviewedBy)` — just writes `review_observation`, no validation tied to semaphore.
- `confirmDocOk(arrivalAssetId)` (lines 489-554) — checks (a) all camara's own docs (`parent_entity_id = arrivalAssetId`) are `is_human_approved = true`, (b) ALL vessel docs where `acopio_arrival_assets.parent_camara_asset_id = arrivalAssetId` are also approved (join), (c) at least one confirmed doc exists. **Backend already aggregates camara + nested vessels for the approval count** — so calling `confirm-doc-ok` on the camara asset ID from web already validates the same aggregate mobile computes client-side. BUT backend does NOT check `review_observation` for YELLOW/RED docs at all — the observation gate is purely a UX nicety in mobile today; nothing stops a direct API call (or a differently-behaving web UI) from confirming DOC OK with unobserved RED docs.
- Confirmed via `acopio.controller.ts`: `PATCH documents/:docId/approve`, `PATCH documents/:docId/unapprove`, `PATCH documents/:docId/observation`, `POST arrival-assets/:id/confirm-doc-ok` all exist exactly as referenced by both web and mobile — no missing endpoints. **This is a frontend-only gap; no backend endpoint work is required for parity**, UNLESS the proposal decides the observation gate should also be enforced server-side (see open questions).

**Foundations already available on web**: `DocumentSemaphore.tsx` (`SemaphoreBadge`, `SemaphoreRules`), `status-colors.ts` (`SEMAFORO`, `semaphoreToLevel`) — web should reuse these in `DocumentUploadPanel` instead of the local `SemaphoreChip`, mirroring what mobile does with `SemaphoreBadge`/`SemaphoreRules` from `mobile/components/acopio/DocumentSemaphore`.

### Affected Areas
- `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocumentUploadPanel.tsx` — needs: (1) approve gate or at minimum DOC-OK gate requiring observation on YELLOW/RED docs, (2) fix `allApproved`/confirm-button gating to match mobile's `canConfirmDocOk` logic, (3) swap local `SemaphoreChip` for shared `DocumentSemaphore`/`SemaphoreBadge`.
- `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` — the per-asset-tab structure means the camara tab's `DocumentUploadPanel` only fetches its OWN docs, not vessel docs, so it cannot compute the true aggregate (`hasUnobservedWarnings`, `allVesselsApproved`) without also querying `/acopio/arrival-assets/:id/vessels` like mobile does. This is a structural gap, not just a component gap — may need to lift vessel-fetching logic up to the page or pass it into the panel.
- New `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` (or similar, TDD target, mirrors `acopio-validation.ts` naming convention) — pure functions to extract: `hasUnobservedWarning(doc)`, `canApprove(doc)` (if approve-time gate desired), `computeVesselStatus(docs)`, `canConfirmDocOk({ camaraDocs, vesselStatuses, vesselWarnings })`.
- `frontend/src/types/acopio.ts` — already has `EntryDocumentRow`/`SemaphoreStatus`/`ArrivalAssetRow`; no schema change needed, reuse as-is.
- No backend changes identified as required (see open question on server-side enforcement).

### Approaches

1. **Client-side-only gate, mirror mobile exactly** — Port mobile's `hasUnobservedWarnings`/`canConfirmDocOk`/`deduplicateDocs` logic into a new `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts`, wire it into `DocumentUploadPanel` (or a new wrapper that also fetches vessels when the active asset is a camara anchor), gate only the "Confirmar DOC OK" button (not the per-document Approve button), exactly matching mobile UX.
   - Pros: True parity with mobile (source of truth), no backend risk, testable pure functions, smallest behavior surface change.
   - Cons: Does not close the loophole of confirming DOC OK via direct API/other client without observation (still unenforced server-side); requires restructuring how the operaciones page passes vessel data into the panel for the camara case.
   - Effort: Medium.

2. **Same as (1) but also block the per-document Approve action itself when semaphore is YELLOW/RED and no observation is present** (stricter than current mobile behavior).
   - Pros: Closes the gate earlier (fail fast at approve time, not just at DOC OK time); prevents a "silently approved with no observation, then confirmed" state entirely.
   - Cons: Diverges from mobile's actual behavior (mobile allows approving without observation, only blocks DOC OK) — breaks stated parity target; needs explicit product sign-off since it changes behavior beyond what mobile does today.
   - Effort: Medium (same code paths, slightly stricter conditions).

3. **Full parity including server-side enforcement** — Add the same `review_observation` check inside `AcopioDocumentsService.confirmDocOk` (reject with 400 if any approved-but-unobserved YELLOW/RED doc exists among camara+vessels), in addition to the client-side gate.
   - Pros: Closes the API-bypass loophole; defense in depth; matches project convention of NestJS domain exceptions (`BadRequestException({ code: ... })` per CLAUDE.md).
   - Cons: Backend change touches a shared aggregate query already covering camara+vessels — needs careful testing to not regress `confirmDocOk`'s existing pending-approval checks; increases scope beyond "frontend-focused" as briefed.
   - Effort: Medium-High (backend + frontend).

### Recommendation

Approach 1 (mirror mobile exactly, client-side, DOC-OK-button gate only) for the initial PR since the brief is explicitly frontend-focused and mobile is the parity source of truth. Recommend flagging Approach 3's server-side hardening as a fast-follow/tech-debt item rather than blocking this PR, since it is a real gap (nothing stops an unobserved RED doc from reaching DOC_OK via direct API call) but is out of scope for the stated frontend gap-closing goal.

### Risks
- The web page's asset-tab architecture (one `DocumentUploadPanel` per asset, no combined camara+vessels fetch) means implementing the exact mobile aggregate requires restructuring data-fetching at the page or panel level (need to fetch `/acopio/arrival-assets/:id/vessels` when on the camara tab) — this is more than a copy-paste of mobile's pure logic; some component/page reshaping is required.
- `allApproved`/`latest` selection in web currently uses `docs[docs.length - 1]` while mobile uses `deduplicateDocs()` (approved > confirmed > most-recent priority) — these can disagree on which doc is "active" per type when there are multiple upload attempts, a pre-existing latent inconsistency that should be fixed alongside this change to avoid mismatched approve/DOC-OK state.
- Confirming DOC OK is NOT server-enforced against the observation rule — any direct API caller (or a bug in the client gate) can still push a RED/unobserved doc to DOC_OK. Should be explicitly called out to the user/product as accepted residual risk if approach 1 or 2 is chosen without approach 3.
- No automated tests currently exist for `DocumentUploadPanel`; TDD extraction into a `lib/` module (per convention of `acopio-validation.ts`) is required to get any real coverage — the component itself is not easily unit-testable (react-query + DOM).

### Open Product Questions (resolve in propose round)
1. Is the observation gate meant to block only the "Confirmar DOC OK" action (mobile's actual behavior), or should it also block the per-document "Aprobar" action itself (stricter, diverges from mobile)?
2. Does "DOC OK" require ALL documents approved (current backend behavior — 100% required), or is partial approval with only YELLOW-not-RED tolerated? (Current backend/mobile logic: 100% approved required, no exception for GREEN vs YELLOW — YELLOW/RED only adds the *observation* requirement, not an approval exception.)
3. Should GREEN documents ever require an observation? Current logic (mobile): no — only YELLOW/RED trigger `hasUnobservedWarnings`. Confirm this stays true for web.
4. For CAMARA arrivals with multiple vessels, should the web keep the current per-asset-tab UX (confirm camara and each vessel independently, as it does today) or should it adopt mobile's single-aggregate-screen model (one DOC OK button for camara+all vessels together)? This affects both the "aggregate DOC OK" gap #2 scope and whether `confirm-doc-ok` should be called on the camara asset id only or also independently on each vessel.
5. Should the server-side loophole (approach 3) be closed in this change or deferred? If deferred, should the UI at least surface a warning when the backend rejects `confirm-doc-ok` due to unapproved children not visible in the current panel (mismatch between client-visible "allApproved" and actual backend validation across camara+vessels)?
6. Multiple docs per type / re-upload: should re-approving after a re-upload reset `review_observation` to force a fresh check, or should the prior observation persist across re-uploads? (Currently `saveObservation` is independent of upload lifecycle — a stale observation from a prior RED doc could remain attached after a new upload replaces it.)

### Ready for Proposal
Yes. Backend endpoints already exist and require no schema/API changes for Approach 1 (recommended). Open questions 1-6 above should be resolved with the user/product owner before writing the design, since they materially change scope (client-only vs. client+server enforcement) and UX (per-asset vs. aggregate-screen confirmation model).

observations.title: sdd/documentos-gate-docok/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Documentos DOC OK Gate + Aggregate Web Screen

(Also written to `openspec/changes/documentos-gate-docok/proposal.md` — hybrid mode.)

## Intent

Web today allows confirming "DOC OK" with YELLOW/RED documents lacking a `review_observation` — mobile blocks this client-side (`hasUnobservedWarnings`/`canConfirmDocOk`), web has no gate at all, and the backend enforces nothing (direct API can push unobserved RED → DOC_OK). Close the parity gap on web AND close the server-side loophole.

## Proposal question round

Completed with the user. Locked decisions (do not re-open):
1. Gate blocks ONLY the DOC OK confirm action — not per-document approve (mobile parity).
2. Web adopts mobile's aggregate model: one screen for CÁMARA + nested vessels, one combined DOC OK confirm (diverges from current per-asset tabs).
3. Backend `confirmDocOk` MUST reject unobserved YELLOW/RED docs (`DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION`) — server-side hardening in scope.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Backend: enforcement in `confirmDocOk` (`backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts`) — reject when any camara or nested-vessel document is YELLOW/RED without trimmed `review_observation`. Domain error `{ code: 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION' }`. TDD (Jest unit + e2e).
- Frontend: aggregate documentos view — camara + vessels (`GET /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/vessels`) in one screen with one DOC OK confirm.
- Frontend: gate UI — disabled confirm + visible reason when unobserved warnings exist; reuse `DocumentSemaphore`/`SEMAFORO` (drop local `SemaphoreChip`).
- Pure core `canConfirmDocOk(docs)`-style module in `frontend/src/lib/` (vitest, mirrors `acopio-validation.ts`).

### Out of Scope
- Schema/migration changes (uses existing `review_observation`, `semaphore_status`, `is_human_approved`).
- Balanza/pesaje and validación flows.
- Gating per-document approve.
- GREEN docs never require observation (mobile rule kept).

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `acopio-doc-ok-gate`: DOC OK confirmation requires observation on all YELLOW/RED documents (client + server enforcement).

### Modified Capabilities
- None (no existing openspec specs).

## Approach

Exploration Approach 3 (client + server). Backend first (TDD): extend the existing camara+vessels aggregate query in `confirmDocOk` with the observation check. Frontend: extract pure gate functions (port mobile's `hasUnobservedWarnings`/`canConfirmDocOk`; decide `deduplicateDocs` alignment in design), then lift vessel fetching to the documentos panel/page and render the aggregate with one gated confirm.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact |
|------|--------|
| `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` | Modified — observation check in `confirmDocOk` |
| `backend` tests (unit/e2e) | New |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocumentUploadPanel.tsx` + operaciones `[arrivalId]/page.tsx` | Modified — aggregate view, gated confirm |
| `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` (new) + vitest | New |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Backend rejection strands old in-flight web clients without gate UI | Med | Deploy backend + frontend closely; UI surfaces domain error message |
| Web `docs[length-1]` vs mobile `deduplicateDocs()` divergence picks wrong "active" doc | Med | Resolve in design; prefer porting `deduplicateDocs` |
| Aggregate restructure regresses per-asset tabs UX | Med | Keep upload flows per asset; only confirmation aggregates |

## Rollback Plan

Two independent reverts: backend commit revert + redeploy on VM (34.31.70.3); frontend revert → Vercel redeploy. No data migration to undo.

## Dependencies

- Existing endpoints only (`/vessels`, `confirm-doc-ok`, `/observation`) — no API additions.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `confirm-doc-ok` returns `DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION` for unobserved YELLOW/RED (camara or vessel doc); passes with observations present.
- [ ] Web shows camara + vessels in one screen; confirm disabled with reason until gate passes.
- [ ] Backend Jest + frontend vitest green; existing `confirmDocOk` approval checks unregressed.

observations.title: sdd/documentos-gate-docok/spec
observations.content:
# Spec: Acopio Doc OK Gate

(Also written to `openspec/changes/documentos-gate-docok/specs/acopio-doc-ok-gate/spec.md` — hybrid mode.)

# Acopio Doc OK Gate Specification

## Purpose

Define the DOC OK confirmation gate for acopio arrival assets (cámaras and their nested vessels): documents with semaphore YELLOW or RED must carry a reviewer observation before DOC OK can be confirmed, enforced identically on client and server, with one aggregate web screen combining cámara + vessels for a single confirm action.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Active Document Selection Per Type
For any document type with multiple `entry_documents` rows for the same asset, the system MUST select exactly one "active" document per type using a single shared rule: prefer approved over non-approved; among equal approval state, prefer `upload_confirmed_at` set; among remaining ties, prefer most recently created. Only the active document's `semaphore_status`/`review_observation` count toward gate evaluation and approval checks. Client and server MUST implement this identically (no divergent tie-break, e.g. last-inserted-row order vs precedence rule).
- Scenario: Duplicate rows for one type — approved GREEN row + newer unapproved RED row with no observation → only approved row is active; RED unapproved row does not block DOC OK.
- Scenario: Re-upload flips status — active GREEN doc re-uploaded produces new active RED doc with no observation → blocks confirm until observed.

### Requirement: DOC OK Confirm Requires Observation on Warnings
The system MUST block ONLY the "Confirmar DOC OK" action (never per-document approve/unapprove) when any active document of the target cámara or nested vessels has semaphore YELLOW/RED and empty/whitespace `review_observation`. GREEN never requires observation. Applies uniformly client + server.
- Scenario: Confirm blocked by unobserved warning; enabled once every warning doc gets a non-empty observation.
- Scenario: All-GREEN asset requires no observation — confirm succeeds without any observation.

### Requirement: Aggregate Gate Across Cámara and Nested Vessels
For a cámara, the gate MUST evaluate the cámara's own active documents AND every nested vessel's (`parent_camara_asset_id`) active documents. One unobserved warning anywhere blocks the cámara's DOC OK confirm.
- Scenario: Vessel-only warning (cámara all GREEN/approved, one vessel has active RED unobserved doc) blocks the cámara confirm client- and server-side.

### Requirement: One Aggregate Web Screen with Single Confirm
Web documentos view for a cámara MUST show cámara + all nested vessels' documents in one screen with exactly one combined "Confirmar DOC OK" action (mobile parity). Uploads/per-document approve/observation stay scoped per asset — only confirmation aggregates.
- Scenario: Aggregate screen renders both the cámara's and vessels' documents; uploading to a vessel only affects that vessel's rows.

### Requirement: Server-Side Confirm Enforcement
`confirmDocOk` MUST reject with domain error `{ code: 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION' }` when any active document (cámara or nested vessel) is YELLOW/RED without trimmed `review_observation`, regardless of caller (UI or direct API — closes the loophole). Runs IN ADDITION to the existing "all approved" check. No schema changes — reuses `review_observation`, `semaphore_status`, `is_human_approved`.
- Scenario: Direct API call with an active RED approved-but-unobserved doc is rejected with `DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION`; asset status does not change.
- Scenario: Server allows confirm to `DOC_OK` when all active docs approved and every warning doc has a non-empty observation.

## Notes for Design/Tasks
- Backend `confirmDocOk` today counts ALL non-deleted rows via `is_human_approved = false` without per-type dedup — this can double-count when an approved row and a newer pending row coexist for the same type. Design phase MUST resolve whether to add per-type active-doc selection to the existing approval check too, or scope it to the new observation check only.
- Frontend mobile reference implements gate logic inline in `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx` (`deduplicateDocs`, `hasUnobservedWarnings`, `canConfirmDocOk`-equivalent inline booleans) — web must port equivalent pure functions into `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts`.

observations.title: sdd/documentos-gate-docok/design
observations.content:
# Design: Documentos DOC OK Gate + Aggregate Web Screen

(Also written to `openspec/changes/documentos-gate-docok/design.md` — hybrid mode.)

## Technical Approach

Three layers, one rule. (1) Pure core `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` ports mobile's gate predicate (mobile `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/documentos/[assetId]/index.tsx` is behavior source of truth). (2) The documentos tab composes camara + vessel upload panels with ONE gated confirm. (3) Backend `confirmDocOk` adds an observation check over the same camara+vessel scope it already aggregates. No schema change, no new endpoints.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Options | Tradeoff | Chosen |
|---|---|---|---|
| Canonical active-doc rule | web `docs[length-1]` / mobile `deduplicateDocs` / backend "all rows" | `length-1` picks newest even when an older approved doc exists (web never deletes on re-upload → duplicates are real); "all rows" over-blocks | **Mobile rule, formalized as strict ordering** per `(asset, document_type)`: `is_approved DESC, upload_confirmed IS NOT NULL DESC, created_at DESC` → first row = active. Mandatory for pure core AND backend SQL (`DISTINCT ON`). Mobile's timestamp-equality tie-break regularized to this ordering. |
| Aggregate UI | restructure tab / new route / new sibling components | Restructure risks per-asset upload UX regression; new route breaks asset-selector context | **New `DocOkConfirm` component** + composition inside existing documentos tab. Extract confirm footer OUT of `DocumentUploadPanel` (uploads/approve/observation stay per-asset). |
| Gate inputs | hardcoded doc-type lists (mobile) / catalog-driven | Web already fetches `/acopio/catalog/document-types` | Pure core takes `requiredTypes: string[]` per asset — catalog-driven, stays pure. |
| Backend error | plain `Error` (current) / domain exception | Global filter formats domain codes | `throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION', message })` AFTER existing approval checks (error precedence preserved). Existing plain `Error`s untouched. |
| Deploy order | backend-first / frontend-first | Backend-first makes old web clients show raw axios "400" text (no graceful handling today) | **Frontend first**, backend second. |

## Data Flow

    documentos tab (CAMARA arrival)
      ├─ DocumentUploadPanel(camara)          — uploads/approve/obs, per asset
      ├─ DocumentUploadPanel(vessel×N)        — one per vessel from GET /arrival-assets/:camaraId/vessels
      └─ DocOkConfirm
           useQueries(['acopio-docs', id])    — same keys as panels → shared cache, no double fetch
           → acopio-documentos-gate (pure)    — selectActiveDocs → canConfirmDocOk
           → POST /confirm-doc-ok ──────────→ confirmDocOk(): approvals ✓ → observation check ✓ → DOC_OK
                                              ↳ 400 DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION → rendered reason

BARCO direct: single `DocumentUploadPanel` + `DocOkConfirm` with one asset input.

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` | Create | Pure core. Types mirror `EntryDocumentRow` via `Pick`. |
| `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.test.ts` | Create | vitest, mirrors `acopio-validation.test.ts`. |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocOkConfirm.tsx` | Create | Gated confirm + reason hints (mobile parity: "Faltan N observaciones" / "Faltan N por aprobar"); handles domain error. |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocOkConfirm.test.tsx` | Create | Mirrors `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` (mock next/navigation, @/lib/api, QueryClientProvider). |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocumentUploadPanel.tsx` | Modify | Remove confirm footer + local `SemaphoreChip` (use `SemaphoreBadge`); replace `docs[length-1]` with `selectActiveDocs`. |
| `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` | Modify | documentos tab: CAMARA → camara panel + vessel panels + one `DocOkConfirm`; else panel + `DocOkConfirm`. |
| `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` | Modify | Observation check in `confirmDocOk`. |
| `backend` unit spec + e2e | Create | Jest. |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```ts
type GateDoc = Pick<EntryDocumentRow, 'document_type' | 'is_approved'
  | 'upload_confirmed_at' | 'semaphore_status' | 'review_observation' | 'created_at'>

export function selectActiveDocs(docs: GateDoc[]): GateDoc[]        // canonical rule
export function countUnobservedWarnings(docs: GateDoc[]): number    // active ∧ uploaded ∧ (YELLOW|RED) ∧ !review_observation?.trim()
export function hasUnobservedWarnings(docs: GateDoc[]): boolean
export interface AssetDocsInput { requiredTypes: string[]; docs: GateDoc[] }
export function canConfirmDocOk(assets: AssetDocsInput[]): {
  canConfirm: boolean; unobservedWarnings: number; pendingApproval: number; missing: number
} // canConfirm = totalApproved > 0 ∧ every asset approved === requiredTypes.length ∧ warnings === 0
```

Backend predicate (single query, TenantDbService search_path):

```sql
WITH scope AS (
  SELECT id FROM acopio_arrival_assets
  WHERE (id = $1 OR parent_camara_asset_id = $1) AND deleted_at IS NULL
), active_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ed.parent_entity_id, ed.document_type_code)
         ed.semaphore_status, ed.review_observation, ed.extraction_triggered_at
  FROM entry_documents ed JOIN scope s ON s.id = ed.parent_entity_id
  WHERE ed.parent_entity_type = 'acopio_arrival_asset' AND ed.deleted_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY ed.parent_entity_id, ed.document_type_code,
           ed.is_human_approved DESC, (ed.extraction_triggered_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, ed.created_at DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM active_docs
WHERE extraction_triggered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND semaphore_status IN ('YELLOW','RED')
  AND (review_observation IS NULL OR btrim(review_observation) = '')
```

count > 0 → `BadRequestException({ code: 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION', message: 'Documentos con advertencias requieren observación antes de confirmar DOC OK' })`. GREEN/NULL semaphore never blocks.

Frontend error handling: on 400 read `err.response?.data`; if `code === 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION'` (or any `message`) render under the button; invalidate `['acopio-docs', *]`.

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| FE unit (vitest) | `selectActiveDocs` (approved beats newer; confirmed beats unconfirmed; newest wins), warnings (YELLOW no obs, RED whitespace obs, GREEN/NULL never), `canConfirmDocOk` matrix incl. multi-asset | Pure, table-driven; TDD |
| FE component (vitest) | `DocOkConfirm`: disabled + "Faltan N observaciones"; enabled when observed+approved; renders server 400 message | `ValidationPanel.test.tsx` pattern |
| BE unit (Jest) | `confirmDocOk` throws domain code when query returns count>0; passes at 0; approval errors keep precedence | Mock `TenantDbService` |

observations.content:
**What**: SDD `documentos-gate-docok` completo y deployado a prod (frontend+backend). Gate de observación obligatoria en DOC OK + vista agregada + enforcement server-side.

**Alcance entregado**:
- **Frontend** (front-escrorpia, commit `12a718c`, Vercel Ready): `lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` (core puro: selectActiveDocs con regla canónica, hasUnobservedWarnings, canConfirmDocOk), `DocOkConfirm.tsx` (confirm agregado cámara+embarcaciones, gateado, fail-closed), `DocumentUploadPanel.tsx` (acciones por fila usan doc más reciente; no borra observación al guardar sin editar), tab documentos agregada en page.tsx.
- **Backend** (back-escorpia, commit `8f4d535`, VM rebuild OK): `confirmDocOk` rechaza `DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION` si un doc activo YELLOW/RED no tiene review_observation. Las checks de aprobación (cámara/barcos) dedupean por doc ACTIVO por tipo vía DISTINCT ON con la MISMA regla canónica que el frontend. 4 códigos de dominio registrados en error-codes.ts.

**Regla canónica de doc activo (cliente Y backend, idéntica)**: is_approved DESC, upload_confirmed_at/extraction_triggered_at IS NOT NULL DESC, created_at DESC, **id DESC** (tiebreaker determinístico). Nota: frontend `upload_confirmed_at` == backend `extraction_triggered_at` (mapeado en listByArrivalAsset).

**Decisiones producto (usuario)**: gate solo en DOC OK (no per-approve); vista agregada como mobile; cerrar loophole server-side.

**Judgment-day (2 jueces)**: R1 encontró 1 regresión (mi cambio a selectActiveDocs en DocumentUploadPanel ocultaba resubidas sobre aprobados) + reales. Arreglé 5 contenidos: revertir panel a doc más reciente, tiebreaker id, no-wipe observación, registrar error codes, fail-closed en error de carga. Core SQL verificado CORRECTO por ambos (leftmost ORDER BY OK, cliente/server coinciden). 140 tests front + 294 back verdes, tsc/lint/build OK.

**DIFERIDOS (follow-ups, OK del usuario)**:
1. **Completitud server-side**: confirmDocOk NO valida que todos los tipos REQUERIDOS estén subidos (un tipo nunca subido pasa por API directa). El frontend sí lo checkea (canConfirmDocOk.missing). Requiere join document_type_catalog + context del transporte. Pre-existente, fuera del scope del loophole de observación.
2. **Tests SQL con DB real**: el dedup DISTINCT ON solo tiene aserciones de shape (mock), no ejecución contra Postgres. No hay harness e2e acopio (sin DATABASE_URL). Follow-up: pg-mem o schema de test.
3. **insertFromSync** no encola extracción → docs de mobile nunca tienen extraction_triggered_at → bypassean el gate de observación. Bug pre-existente de sync.
4. Backend `areas.service.ts` lee solo hopperId (del cambio balanza anterior) — legacy hopper_number no muestra tolva en recepciones dashboard.

**Deploy VM**: `ssh rodrigo@34.31.70.3`, `cd /opt/traceexport/produccion-back && git pull`, `cd /opt/traceexport/produccion-infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.vm.yml up -d --no-deps --build backend worker scheduler` (los 3 comparten produccion-back). El build tarda >5min y el SSH da timeout 143 PERO completa — verificar con `docker compose ps` (healthy) + logs "Nest application successfully started".

# Verification Report: documentos-gate-docok

(Also written to `openspec/changes/documentos-gate-docok/verify-report.md` — hybrid mode.)

**Verdict**: FAIL — 1 CRITICAL, 4 WARNING, 3 SUGGESTION. Verified 2026-07-04, full spec-driven mode + Strict TDD module.

## Gate Outputs (all executed by verify)
- `pnpm -F frontend exec vitest run` → 139/139 passed (11 files; 20 gate + 4 DocOkConfirm tests included)
- `pnpm -F frontend exec tsc --noEmit` → clean, exit 0
- `pnpm -F frontend lint` → 11 errors/55 warnings, ALL pre-existing in unrelated files; 0 issues in touched files (file list verified)
- `pnpm -F backend test` → 288/288 passed (24 suites; 25 in acopio-documents.service.spec.ts)
- Targeted backend coverage: confirmDocOk covered EXCEPT lines 524 (VESSEL_DOCS_NOT_APPROVED) and 572 (NO_CONFIRMED_DOCUMENTS)
- Backend e2e: not run (no DATABASE_URL/harness — matches apply-progress)

## Key Verifications
- Canonical active-doc ordering IS identical client/server for the observation gate: frontend `selectActiveDocs` (`is_approved DESC, upload_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL DESC, created_at DESC`) vs backend `DISTINCT ON ... ORDER BY is_human_approved DESC, (extraction_triggered_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, created_at DESC`; fields map 1:1 via mapRow.
- DocumentUploadPanel now uses `selectActiveDocs` (no `docs[length-1]`); approve/delete/observation target the active doc; confirm footer + SemaphoreChip removed, SemaphoreBadge reused. No regression found.
- page.tsx documentos tab: CAMARA → camara panel + N vessel panels + single DocOkConfirm; non-CAMARA → panel + DocOkConfirm. `/arrival-assets/:id/vessels` endpoint exists (acopio.controller.ts:383).
- All plain Errors in confirmDocOk replaced with BadRequestException domain codes (4 codes).
- TDD evidence table present; RED/GREEN re-verified by execution; assertion quality clean (one deliberate SQL-shape assertion, WARNING-level).
- Tasks 18/20 [x]; 4.4/4.5 e2e skipped (justified), 5.2 orchestrator delivery step.
- No persona/Rioplatense slang in code/UI/comments; es-PE locale is pre-existing convention.

## CRITICAL (blocks archive)
1. **Server approval checks bypass the canonical active-doc rule — spec R1/S1 violated server-side.** `confirmDocOk` steps 1–2 count ALL non-deleted `is_human_approved=false` rows without per-type dedup. Spec requires active-doc selection for "gate evaluation AND approval checks", client+server identical, with explicit scenario: approved GREEN + newer unapproved RED → RED dup must NOT block DOC OK. Reality: client (deduped) enables confirm; server rejects with CAMARA/VESSEL_DOCS_NOT_APPROVED. UX dead end: the superseded dup is invisible in DocumentUploadPanel (renders only the active doc), so it can't be approved/deleted from UI; web re-upload never deletes old rows so this state is real. No covering server test. Fix: apply the same DISTINCT ON per-type dedup to the two approval-count queries + unit tests. Spec's note flagged this for design; design left approval checks untouched — spec wins.

## WARNING
1. Backend e2e gap (4.4/4.5): DISTINCT ON SQL never executed against real Postgres; unit tests mock TenantDbService and assert SQL text shape. Classified FOLLOW-UP, not blocker.
2. Refactored error branches untested: lines 524/572 changed HTTP 500→400 with zero coverage.
3. Task 5.2 (deploy-order PR note: frontend first) pending — orchestrator.
4. SQL-shape assertion coupling in backend test 4.

## SUGGESTION
1. DocOkConfirm.test.tsx only covers isCamara=false; add camara-aggregate component test.
2. Backend DISTINCT ON tie on equal created_at nondeterministic; add `id DESC` tail.
3. Mobile deduplicateDocs alignment (already logged follow-up).

## Recommendation
Return to sdd-apply for a contained fix: per-type dedup in confirmDocOk approval queries + unit tests (also cover the two untested error branches). Then re-verify.

# Archive Report: documentos-gate-docok

**Status**: COMPLETE AND DEPLOYED  
**Date Archived**: 2026-07-04  
**Project**: escorpia traza  
**Artifact Store Mode**: Engram-primary (openspec folder structure not synced during implementation; noted for future hybrid consistency)

## Change Summary

**Change Name**: `documentos-gate-docok`  
**Capability Delivered**: `acopio-doc-ok-gate` — DOC OK confirmation requires observation on all YELLOW/RED documents (client + server enforcement).

**Scope**: Web + Backend enforcement gate for acopio arrival asset document approval. Single aggregate screen for cámara + nested vessels with one combined DOC OK confirm action. Server-side hardening to close loophole where direct API could bypass observation requirement.

## Implementation Status

- **Frontend** (Vercel Ready, commit `12a718c`):
  - `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts`: Pure core gate functions (selectActiveDocs, hasUnobservedWarnings, canConfirmDocOk with canonical active-doc rule)
  - `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocOkConfirm.tsx`: Gated confirm UI (disabled with reason until gate passes)
  - `frontend/src/components/acopio/DocumentUploadPanel.tsx`: Refactored to use selectActiveDocs; removed confirm footer
  - `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx`: documentos tab refactored for aggregate view (cámara + vessels in one screen)
  - Tests: 139/139 vitest passed (20 gate + 4 component tests included); tsc clean; lint zero issues in touched files

- **Backend** (VM deployed, commit `8f4d535`):
  - `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts`: confirmDocOk observation check (DISTINCT ON per-type active doc, matches client rule identically)
  - Error codes: 4 domain codes registered (CAMARA_DOCS_NOT_APPROVED, VESSEL_DOCS_NOT_APPROVED, NO_CONFIRMED_DOCUMENTS, DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION)
  - Tests: 288/288 jest passed (24 suites; confirmDocOk has dedicated unit + integrated coverage; untested error branches fixed per judgment-day)
  - Deploy: VM rebuild successful, Nest application started clean

- **Verification & Judgment-Day**: Initial verify report showed 1 CRITICAL (approval checks bypass active-doc rule) + 4 WARNING. Fixed during apply phase: per-type dedup added to approval-count queries, id DESC tie-breaker added for determinism, error codes registered, fail-closed on load error. All 140 frontend + 294 backend tests green post-fix.

## Traceability — Observation IDs

| Artifact | Observation ID | Topic Key | Summary |
|----------|----------------|-----------|---------|
| Proposal | #337 | sdd/documentos-gate-docok/proposal | Scope, approach, rollback plan, risks |
| Specification | #339 | sdd/documentos-gate-docok/spec | 5 requirements: active-doc selection, observation gate, aggregate scope, web screen, server enforcement |

| Verify Report | #343 | sdd/documentos-gate-docok/verify-report | Initial FAIL (1 CRITICAL). Fixed during apply phase per user/judgment-day sign-off. |
| Archive Report | **(this)** | sdd/documentos-gate-docok/archive-report | Final cycle closure and deferred follow-ups |

## Technical Decisions (Locked, No Changes Post-Deploy)

1. **Canonical Active-Doc Rule** (Client ≡ Server): `is_approved DESC, upload_confirmed_at/extraction_triggered_at IS NOT NULL DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC`. Prevents mobile/web divergence. Covers scenario: approved doc + newer unapproved doc = only approved doc blocks (correct). Applied to both gate check AND approval checks.

2. **Gate Scope**: DOC OK confirm ONLY (not per-document approve). Gate evaluates cámara + nested vessels (`parent_camara_asset_id`) aggregate.

3. **Web Aggregate Model**: One screen for cámara + all vessels with one gated confirm (mobile parity). Uploads and per-document approve remain per-asset.

4. **Server Enforcement**: `BadRequestException({ code: 'DOC_OK_REQUIRES_OBSERVATION', message })` after existing approval checks (error precedence preserved). Direct API calls now rejected, closing pre-existing loophole.

5. **Deploy Order Executed**: Frontend first (Vercel), then backend (VM), per design. Both live; no rollback needed.

2. **DB-Backed SQL Integration Tests**: DISTINCT ON dedup only shape-asserted (mocked); no Postgres-backed test. No existing acopio e2e harness. Candidate: pg-mem or schema test fixtures.

3. **insertFromSync Enqueue Gap**: Mobile-synced docs never enqueued for extraction → no `extraction_triggered_at` → bypass observation gate. Pre-existing sync bug.

4. **Legacy Hopper Divergence**: `areas.service.ts` reads only weighing_metadata hopperId (from balanza change) → legacy hopper_number weighings show no tolva in receipts dashboard. Pre-existing, out of scope.
