observations.title: sdd/valorizacion-merma/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: Editable % merma (shrinkage) in web Valorización panel

### Current State

**Web (`frontend/src/components/acopio/ValorizacionPanel.tsx`)**
- Receives `currentShrinkagePct` as a read-only prop from the parent page (`frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx`, line 110: `const shrinkagePct = weighing ? parseFloat(weighing.shrinkage_pct) || 0 : 0`). This value only exists because the `weighing` query is enabled `tab === 'pesaje'` — if the user jumps straight to the "valorización" tab without visiting "pesaje" first, `weighing` is `undefined` and `currentShrinkagePct` silently defaults to `0`.
- Inside the panel, `currentShrinkagePct` is used ONLY for the live preview total (line 136-137): `const shrink = currentShrinkagePct || 0; previewTotal = net*p + sinWincha*p*(1-shrink/100)`. There is NO input field for merma — it is not editable, not shown to the user, and not part of `priceInputs`/`poInputs` state.
- `priceMutation` (line 53-55) calls `PATCH /acopio/arrival-assets/:assetId/weighing/price` with payload `{ realPrice, purchaseOrder }` — **`shrinkagePct` is never sent**, even though the value used in the preview came from the DB.
- Net effect: if the operator confirms a price from the web valorización tab, the previously-set `shrinkage_pct` in the DB is left untouched (backend `COALESCE`, see below) — so no data is silently zeroed today, but the operator has no way to CORRECT the merma from this tab, and if the row's shrinkage was never set (defaults from `acopio_product_catalog.default_shrinkage_pct` at weighing time), the web valorización flow can't adjust it before "Confirmar precio".

**Backend (`backend/src/modules/acopio/`) — contract already exists, no backend change needed**
- `SetPriceDto` (`backend/src/modules/acopio/dto/acopio.dto.ts:139-144`):
  ```ts
  export class SetPriceDto {
    @IsNumber() @Min(0) realPrice!: number;
    @IsOptional() @IsNumber() @Min(0) shrinkagePct?: number;
    @IsOptional() @IsString() purchaseOrder?: string;
    ...
  }
  ```
- `AcopioWeighingService.setPrice` (`backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-weighing.service.ts:149-181`) already does `shrinkage_pct = COALESCE($3, shrinkage_pct)` — passing `shrinkagePct` in the PATCH body updates it; omitting it preserves the existing value. Controller route: `PATCH arrival-assets/:id/weighing/price` (`acopio.controller.ts:503-506`).
- **Conclusion: this endpoint is FULLY frontend-only-compatible today.** The prior audit's flagged uncertainty ("verify the price mutation accepts shrinkage") is resolved: YES, it already does, with the exact field name `shrinkagePct` (camelCase, matches other DTO fields) and no backend work required.

**Mobile app (source of truth for business behavior) — `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/valorizacion/[assetId].tsx`**
- Renders an editable `TextInput` for `% Merma` (line 74-86), defaulting to the existing `weighing.shrinkage_pct` if present, else the string `'20'` (hardcoded UX default, not calling the catalog default endpoint from the client).
- The input is ONLY shown `if (sinWincha > 0)` — merma has no effect (and no UI) when there's no "sin wincha" weight.
- Live calc: `toneladasPagadas = (netWeight + sinWincha*(1-shrink/100))/1000`; `importe = toneladasPagadas*1000*realPrice`. Equivalent to the web preview formula, just expressed in TM instead of kg.
- On save, `saveMutation` sends `{ realPrice: realPriceNum, shrinkagePct: shrinkNum }` to the exact same `PATCH /acopio/arrival-assets/:assetId/weighing/price` endpoint the web uses.
- This is the exact UX/logic pattern to mirror for parity: editable input, gated by `sinWincha > 0`, defaulting to existing value (web has `currentShrinkagePct` prop for this — but needs a real default fallback since it can be `0` from the "tab not visited" gap noted above), included in the price mutation payload.

**Testing pattern for pure logic**
- `frontend/src/lib/*.ts` + matching `*.test.ts` (Vitest) is the established pattern for domain-pure calculation/logic extraction, e.g. `frontend/src/lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` / `.test.ts` (weighing-scale matching/prefill logic, no React/react-query). `frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.ts` and `frontend/src/lib/acopio-documentos-gate.ts` follow the same split.
- No existing `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` (or similar) exists yet. The merma/total calculation (`net*price + sinWincha*price*(1-shrink/100)`) is currently duplicated inline in `ValorizacionPanel.tsx` (web) and `[assetId].tsx` (mobile React Native, separate codebase) — each computes it locally with no shared pure function on the web side. Recommendation: extract a pure function (e.g. `computeValorizacionTotal(netWeight, weightWithoutWinch, price, shrinkagePct)`) into a new `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` with a Vitest `.test.ts` sibling, following the `balanza-pesaje.ts` precedent, then have `ValorizacionPanel.tsx` import it instead of the inline calc.

### Affected Areas
- `frontend/src/components/acopio/ValorizacionPanel.tsx` — add editable % merma input per row (or per-asset), wire into `priceMutation` payload, gate visibility on `weight_without_winch > 0` (mirror mobile).
- `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` — `shrinkagePct` derivation only fires when `weighing` query is enabled (`tab === 'pesaje'`); should also enable/fetch when tab is `valorización`, or `ValorizacionPanel` should fetch its own weighing detail per asset (like mobile does) to avoid the "tab not visited → defaults to 0" gap. `weighing-summary` bulk endpoint used by the panel does NOT currently return `shrinkage_pct` per row (confirm — the `WeighingSummaryRow` interface in the panel has no `shrinkage_pct` field), so the panel has no per-row visibility into each asset's current merma when multiple assets are present — only the single `currentShrinkagePct` prop for the currently active asset.
- New file (proposed): `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` + `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.test.ts` — pure calc, Vitest-tested, no backend/DTO changes.
- No backend files need changes — `SetPriceDto`/`AcopioWeighingService.setPrice` already support `shrinkagePct`.

### Approaches

1. **Add merma input scoped to the panel's current-asset preview only (minimal, matches today's single `currentShrinkagePct` prop)**
   - Pros: smallest diff, no new queries, consistent with existing prop-drilling.
   - Cons: does not fix the "tab not visited" defaults-to-0 gap; still shows merma only for the currently-selected asset, not per-row for multi-asset arrivals (CAMARA case with multiple vessels) where each row's price/PO already is per-row.
   - Effort: Low

2. **Extend `weighing-summary` row + panel to carry merma per row (parity with per-row price/PO), each row gets its own editable merma input**
   - Pros: correct per-asset merma (a CAMARA arrival with several vessels can have different merma per vessel), matches how price/PO are already handled per row; removes the single-prop dependency and the tab-navigation gap entirely (each row already fetches from `weighing-summary`, which would need a `shrinkage_pct` column added to its backend query — the endpoint exists in `acopio-weighing.service.ts`'s `weighingSummary` method, need to confirm if it must be extended to SELECT `shrinkage_pct` too — this IS a backend touch, even if trivial, contradicting strict "frontend-only" framing).
   - Cons: needs to confirm/extend `weighingSummary()` SQL to include `shrinkage_pct` (backend touch, likely 1-line query change) — flag for proposal decision.
   - Effort: Medium

3. **Mirror mobile 1:1**: extract pure calc to `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts`, gate merma input by `weight_without_winch > 0` per row, default to existing per-row value if available else `'20'` (mobile's hardcoded UX default), include in payload.
   - Pros: matches source-of-truth business behavior (mobile) exactly, testable pure function, no ambiguity about default merma.
   - Cons: still depends on Approach 2's data availability question (per-row shrinkage_pct) to be fully correct for multi-asset arrivals.
   - Effort: Medium

### Recommendation
Approach 3 (mirror mobile UX/logic, extracted to a tested pure function), combined with resolving Approach 2's data question first: confirm during `sdd-propose`/`sdd-design` whether `weighingSummary()` needs a 1-line SQL addition (`w.shrinkage_pct::text`) to expose per-row merma. If the SDD scope must stay strictly frontend-only, scope this change to the CURRENTLY-ACTIVE asset only (Approach 1) using the existing `currentShrinkagePct` prop, and fix the "tab not visited" default gap by making `ValorizacionPanel` fetch its own single-asset weighing detail (as mobile does) instead of relying on the parent page's `tab === 'pesaje'`-gated query. Regardless of scope, extract the calc to `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` + `.test.ts` per repo convention.

### Risks
- **Not fully frontend-only if per-row merma in `weighing-summary` is required**: to support editable merma per-asset-row (not just the currently active one), the `weighingSummary()` backend query likely needs `shrinkage_pct` added to its SELECT — a 1-line, low-risk backend change, but it breaks the "frontend-only" premise. Must be explicitly decided in `sdd-propose`.
- **Tab-navigation data gap**: `currentShrinkagePct` is derived from a query gated on `tab === 'pesaje'`; visiting "valorización" directly yields `shrinkagePct = 0`, silently defaulting merma to zero in the preview/edit rather than the true stored value or the catalog default.
- **Default merma UX inconsistency**: mobile defaults an empty input to `'20'` (hardcoded, not fetched from `acopio_product_catalog.default_shrinkage_pct`); if web copies this literally it diverges further from the catalog-driven default already used server-side in `AcopioWeighingService.create` (`acopio-weighing.service.ts:86-95`). Decide in proposal whether the correct default is the catalog's `default_shrinkage_pct` (already resolved server-side at first weighing) rather than a magic `'20'`.
- **`priceMutation` currently omits `shrinkagePct` from its payload silently** — if the panel is updated to source-of-truth `shrinkage_pct` per row and the input is left blank/untouched, must confirm whether `undefined` (omit field) correctly falls back to `COALESCE(..., shrinkage_pct)` behavior (it does, confirmed in service code) vs. accidentally sending `0`.

### Ready for Proposal
Yes — proceed to `sdd-propose`. Flag for the proposal author: confirm scope decision on per-row (Approach 2/3) vs. single-active-asset (Approach 1) merma editing before writing tasks, since it affects whether `weighingSummary()` needs a backend change.

observations.title: sdd/valorizacion-merma/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Editable % merma in web Valorización panel

> Change: `valorizacion-merma`. Store: hybrid (this + `openspec/changes/valorizacion-merma/proposal.md`). Size: MENOR, frontend-only.

## Intent
Web operators cannot edit "% merma" (shrinkage) in the Acopio Valorización sub-flow, while mobile can. Merma drives the paid-weight/paid-price calculation on the peso-sin-wincha portion, so the web flow cannot correct valuation before "Confirmar precio". Latent bug: `currentShrinkagePct` comes from a query gated on `tab === 'pesaje'`, so opening the valorización tab directly silently previews with `shrinkagePct = 0`.

## Proposal question round
Skipped — all shaping decisions closed with the user 2026-07-04 (see explore artifact, Engram id 351). Baked-in: per-active-asset scope, prefill `20`, live recompute, `sinWincha > 0` gating, omit-when-untouched payload, TDD'd pure calc.

## Scope
### In Scope
- Editable merma input in `ValorizacionPanel.tsx` for the active asset, shown only when `sinWincha > 0` (mirror mobile `valorizacion/[assetId].tsx`).
- Panel sources its own per-asset shrinkage (own query, not the pesaje-tab-gated parent prop) — fixes the stale-`0` bug.
- Prefill `20` when no saved `shrinkage_pct`; editable in the moment.
- Live recompute of dependent values (peso pagado, precio pagado) on merma edit, before saving — identical to mobile's calc.
- Include `shrinkagePct` in the price PATCH payload only when the user has a meaningful value; otherwise omit and rely on backend `COALESCE`. Never send `0` for untouched.
- Extract pure calc into `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` + Vitest `.test.ts`, test-first, per `lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` convention.

### Out of Scope
- Any backend change (`SetPriceDto` / `setPrice` already accept `shrinkagePct`).
- Per-row merma for multi-asset arrivals (needs `weighingSummary()` SQL change — backend touch).
- Catalog-driven default (`default_shrinkage_pct`) on the client; mobile's `20` UX default is the chosen parity behavior.
- Mobile changes.

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- `acopio-valorizacion-merma`: editable shrinkage in web valorización — visibility gating, default, live recompute, payload semantics.
### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Approach
Mirror mobile 1:1 for the active asset. TDD the pure function (e.g. `computeValorizacion(net, sinWincha, price, shrinkagePct)`) first; then wire `ValorizacionPanel.tsx` to it, add the gated input, add a per-asset shrinkage fetch inside the panel, extend `priceMutation` payload conditionally.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts` + `.test.ts` | New | Pure calc, Vitest, TDD |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/ValorizacionPanel.tsx` | Modified | Merma input, own shrinkage query, live recompute, payload |
| `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` | Modified | Drop/adjust `currentShrinkagePct` prop-drilling |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Calc drift vs mobile | Low | Pure function mirrors mobile formula; unit tests assert parity cases |
| Sending `0` clobbers saved merma | Low | Omit field when untouched; test payload builder |
| Hidden backend need appears | Low | If unavoidable → STOP, flag CRITICAL, do not propose silently |

## Rollback Plan
Revert the frontend commit(s). No schema, API, or data migration; backend behavior unchanged.

## Dependencies
- None (backend contract already live).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Merma input visible only when `sinWincha > 0`; prefilled with saved value or `20`.
- [ ] Editing merma live-updates peso pagado / precio pagado before save.
- [ ] PATCH includes `shrinkagePct` only when meaningful; untouched → omitted.
- [ ] Opening valorización tab directly shows the true stored shrinkage (bug fixed).
- [ ] `valorizacion.test.ts` passes; calc matches mobile for identical inputs.

observations.title: sdd/valorizacion-merma/spec
observations.content:
# Spec: acopio-valorizacion-merma

> Change: `valorizacion-merma`. New capability (no existing spec to modify).

## Purpose

Define the behavior of the editable "% merma" (shrinkage) control in the web Valorización panel of the Acopio module: when it renders, how it is prefilled, how it drives live recompute of dependent valuation fields, and how it is (or is not) included in the price-save payload.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Merma input visibility gating

The system MUST render the editable merma (% shrinkage) input in the Valorización panel for the active asset ONLY when the asset's `sinWincha` (peso sin wincha) value is greater than `0`. The system MUST NOT render the input when `sinWincha` is `0` or absent.

#### Scenario: Asset has peso sin wincha
- GIVEN an active asset with `sinWincha > 0`
- WHEN the Valorización panel renders for that asset
- THEN the merma input is visible and editable

#### Scenario: Asset has no peso sin wincha
- GIVEN an active asset with `sinWincha == 0`
- WHEN the Valorización panel renders for that asset
- THEN the merma input is not rendered

### Requirement: Merma prefill value

The system MUST prefill the merma input with the asset's saved `shrinkage_pct` when one exists, and MUST default to `20` when no saved value exists. The prefilled value MUST remain user-editable.

#### Scenario: No saved shrinkage value
- GIVEN the active asset has no persisted `shrinkage_pct`
- WHEN the merma input renders
- THEN it is prefilled with `20`

#### Scenario: Saved shrinkage value exists
- GIVEN the active asset has a persisted `shrinkage_pct` of `15`
- WHEN the merma input renders
- THEN it is prefilled with `15`

#### Scenario: User edits the prefilled value
- GIVEN the merma input is prefilled with any value
- WHEN the user types a new value into the input
- THEN the input reflects the user-entered value, overriding the prefill

### Requirement: Per-asset shrinkage sourcing

The system MUST source the active asset's shrinkage value from a query owned by the Valorización panel itself, independent of any parent-level query gated on another tab's active state. Navigating directly to the valorización tab MUST show the asset's true persisted `shrinkage_pct`, not a stale default.

#### Scenario: Opening valorización tab directly
- GIVEN an asset with a persisted `shrinkage_pct` of `25`
- WHEN the user opens the Valorización panel without first visiting the "pesaje" tab
- THEN the panel shows `25` as the prefilled/current merma value, not `0`

### Requirement: Live recompute of dependent valuation fields

The system MUST apply the current merma input value to the asset's `sinWincha` value to estimate the amount to pay, and MUST recompute and display the dependent fields (peso pagado, precio pagado) live as the user edits merma, before any save action occurs. The calculation MUST produce results identical to the mobile app's equivalent calculation (`valorizacion/[assetId].tsx`) for the same inputs.

#### Scenario: Editing merma recomputes displayed values
- GIVEN a rendered Valorización panel with peso pagado and precio pagado displayed
- WHEN the user changes the merma input value
- THEN peso pagado and precio pagado update immediately to reflect the new merma, without requiring a save

#### Scenario: Merma set to 0
- GIVEN `sinWincha > 0` and the merma input is set to `0`
- WHEN the panel recomputes
- THEN the sin-wincha portion is treated as fully payable (no shrinkage deduction applied)

#### Scenario: Merma set to 100
- GIVEN `sinWincha > 0` and the merma input is set to `100`
- WHEN the panel recomputes
- THEN the sin-wincha portion contributes `0` to peso pagado and precio pagado

#### Scenario: Non-numeric or blank merma input
- GIVEN the merma input is cleared or contains a non-numeric value
- WHEN the panel recomputes
- THEN the calculation does not throw and falls back to a safe value (treated as `0` contribution or last valid value, per implementation) without crashing the panel

### Requirement: Payload semantics for shrinkage on save

The system MUST include `shrinkagePct` in the `PATCH /acopio/arrival-assets/:assetId/weighing/price` payload only when the user has provided a meaningful value (a valid number the user has set or accepted). The system MUST omit `shrinkagePct` from the payload when the value is untouched or not meaningfully provided, so the backend's `COALESCE` retains the previously stored value. The system MUST NOT send `0` as a stand-in for "untouched."

#### Scenario: User provides a meaningful merma value
- GIVEN the user has set the merma input to `18`
- WHEN the price PATCH request is built
- THEN the payload includes `shrinkagePct: 18`

#### Scenario: User leaves merma untouched
- GIVEN the merma input was prefilled and the user made no edit
- WHEN the price PATCH request is built
- THEN the payload omits `shrinkagePct` entirely

#### Scenario: Merma input is not rendered (sinWincha == 0)
- GIVEN `sinWincha == 0` and the merma input never rendered
- WHEN the price PATCH request is built
- THEN the payload omits `shrinkagePct`

### Requirement: Pure, unit-testable valuation calculation

The system MUST implement the merma-driven valuation calculation as a pure function in `frontend/src/lib/valorizacion.ts`, independent of UI state, and MUST cover it with Vitest unit tests written before the implementation (TDD), following the `lib/balanza-pesaje.ts` convention.

#### Scenario: Pure function computes deterministic output
- GIVEN fixed inputs (net weight, sinWincha, price, shrinkagePct)
- WHEN the pure function is invoked twice with the same inputs
- THEN it returns identical peso pagado and precio pagado results both times

#### Scenario: Test suite covers edge cases
- GIVEN the test file `valorizacion.test.ts`
- WHEN the suite runs
- THEN it includes cases for `sinWincha = 0`, `merma = 0`, `merma = 100`, non-numeric/blank input, no saved value (default 20), and a present saved value

observations.title: sdd/asignacion-parity/explore
observations.content:
**What**: Explored the Acopio "Asignación" (embarcaciones→cámara) sub-flow parity gap between web and mobile, comparing `frontend/src/components/acopio/AsignacionEmbarcaciones.tsx` + `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` vs `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/index.tsx` + `[assetId].tsx`, against backend `backend/src/modules/acopio/acopio.controller.ts` (routes `arrival-assets/:id/assign-vessels`, `arrival-assets/:id/vessels`, `arrival-assets/:id/unassign`, `arrival-assets/:id/status`) and `acopio-arrivals.service.ts` (`assignVessels` L618-667, `unassignVessel` L685-691).

**Why**: 2026-07-03 audit rated Asignación parity as MENOR ("front ya superior a mobile"); needed to confirm the concrete diff and size the remaining SDD work (this is the last Acopio parity sub-flow after validación/documentos/pesaje/valorización).

**Findings (concrete gap)**:
1. Max-3-vessels cap is UI-only in web (`AsignacionEmbarcaciones.tsx` L61 `maxReached = assigned.length >= 3`), NOT enforced in backend (`assignVessels` has no count check, no DB constraint — grepped, none found). Mobile's asignación screen (`[assetId].tsx`) has NO cap at all — user can select unlimited vessels. This is a real business-rule inconsistency, easy fix (add same `assigned.length >= 3` / slice guard to mobile selector).
2. Real bug found: mobile never calls the `DELETE /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/unassign` endpoint (confirmed via grep — zero matches for "unassign" in `mobile/`). Mobile's edit flow lets a user deselect an already-assigned vessel from the `selected` array and shows it removed in the UI + "Actualizar barcos" success toast, but the underlying `POST assign-vessels` mutation only INSERTs (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, service L648-666) — it never removes rows for deselected vessels. Net effect: silent ghost assignment stays in DB while UI reports success. Web instead gates removal via a "Quitar" button shown only when `a.status === 'PROGRAMADO'` and explicitly calls `unassignMutation` (`DELETE .../unassign`), so web has no such inconsistency.
3. Workflow shape differs (not a bug, just UX sequencing): web splits "asignar embarcaciones" (asignación tab) from "avanzar a EN_PLANTA" (estado tab, separate manual button `advanceMutation`) — two explicit steps. Mobile combines assign + auto status-advance to EN_PLANTA into a single mutation (calls `assign-vessels` then conditionally `PATCH status EN_PLANTA` if not already assigned) — one combined action ("Guardar y llamar a planta"). Both reach equivalent end states; this is a legitimate design choice, not a parity defect.
4. Endpoints used are otherwise identical: both call `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/assign-vessels`, `GET .../vessels` (web) vs `GET /acopio/arrivals` (mobile derives assigned sub-assets from the arrivals list instead of the dedicated `/vessels` endpoint — functionally equivalent but an extra network-shape difference worth noting, not a defect).

**Classification**: MENOR (few targeted changes) — NOT "no gap", NOT "completo (full SDD)". Two concrete, scoped fixes needed on mobile:
  a) Add max-3 cap enforcement in mobile's vessel selector (parity with web UI rule).
  b) Fix the silent ghost-assignment bug: call `DELETE .../unassign` for any previously-assigned vessel that the user deselects during edit, gated the same way web gates it (only if status allows removal, e.g. PROGRAMADO).

**Recommendation**: Proceed to `sdd-propose` sized as MENOR — a small, targeted change touching only `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx` (add cap + diff-based unassign calls). No backend or web changes required. Do not scope this as a full SDD change.

observations.title: sdd/asignacion-parity/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Asignación Parity (Mobile) — MENOR

## Intent

Mobile's Acopio asignación screen has a data-integrity bug: deselecting an already-assigned vessel shows success ("Actualizar barcos") but never calls `DELETE /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/unassign` — the `POST assign-vessels` mutation only INSERTs (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`), so the vessel stays assigned in the DB while the UI reports it removed. Mobile also lacks the max-3 vessels-per-cámara cap web enforces. This closes the last Acopio web/mobile parity sub-flow.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Fix ghost-unassignment: diff previously-assigned vs currently-selected vessel ids; call `DELETE .../unassign` per deselected vessel, gated to asset `status === 'PROGRAMADO'` (web parity).
- Enforce max-3 assigned vessels per cámara in the mobile selector (client-side, matching web `AsignacionEmbarcaciones.tsx:61`).
- Extract pure assignment-diff logic into `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts`: `(previouslyAssignedIds, selectedIds, cap) → { toAssign, toUnassign, capExceeded }`.
- Bootstrap minimal Vitest in `mobile/` (mirrors valorización-merma frontend bootstrap); unit-test the pure module test-first (Strict TDD).

### Out of Scope
- Backend changes — both endpoints already exist.
- Web changes — web is already correct/superior.
- Backend/DB enforcement of the max-3 cap (known gap on both clients; deferred).
- Changing mobile's combined "assign + advance to EN_PLANTA" UX — legitimate design choice, not a defect.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `mobile-acopio-asignacion-edit`: assignment-diff computation, unassign gating, and max-3 cap for mobile vessel assignment editing.

### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Business Rules
- Max 3 vessels per cámara (UI rule, parity with web).
- Vessel removal allowed only while status is `PROGRAMADO`; otherwise deselection is blocked/explained, never silently ignored.
- No silent success: UI state must match persisted state; unassign failures surfaced.

## Approach

Pure TS module (no RN imports) computes the diff; thin screen shell in `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx` wires it: cap blocks a 4th selection, save runs `POST assign-vessels` for `toAssign` and one `DELETE unassign` per `toUnassign`, then refetches. Tests written first against the pure module via new Vitest config.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` | New | Pure diff/cap logic |
| `mobile/lib/asignacion.test.ts` + Vitest config | New | Test bootstrap, TDD |
| `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx` | Modified | Cap UI, unassign calls, gating |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Partial failure across multiple unassign calls | Med | Refetch after save; report per-item failures |
| Vitest vs Expo transform friction | Low | Tested module is pure TS, no RN deps |

## Rollback Plan
Revert the screen edit; delete `mobile/lib/asignacion.*` and Vitest config. No data migration.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Deselecting an assigned vessel (PROGRAMADO) removes the DB row via unassign endpoint.
- [ ] Selecting a 4th vessel is blocked.
- [ ] Vitest runs in mobile; pure-module tests pass, written before implementation.

observations.title: sdd/asignacion-parity/spec
observations.content:
# Spec: mobile-acopio-asignacion-edit (NEW)

## Purpose

Mobile's Acopio vessel-assignment edit screen must compute assign/unassign diffs correctly, enforce the max-3-per-cámara cap, and gate vessel removal by arrival/asset status — mirroring web behavior exactly. Scope: `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` (new pure module) + `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx` (edit flow) + mobile Vitest bootstrap. No backend or web changes.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Pure assignment-diff computation

The system MUST provide a pure function in `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` that takes `previouslyAssignedIds: string[]`, `selectedIds: string[]`, and `cap: number`, and returns `{ toAssign: string[], toUnassign: string[], capExceeded: boolean }`. The function MUST have no React Native or Expo imports and MUST NOT perform I/O.

#### Scenario: New vessels selected, none removed

- GIVEN previouslyAssignedIds = ["a", "b"]
- WHEN selectedIds = ["a", "b", "c"] and cap = 3
- THEN toAssign = ["c"], toUnassign = [], capExceeded = false

#### Scenario: Vessels deselected

- GIVEN previouslyAssignedIds = ["a", "b", "c"]
- WHEN selectedIds = ["a"] and cap = 3
- THEN toAssign = [], toUnassign = ["b", "c"]

#### Scenario: Mixed assign and unassign

- GIVEN previouslyAssignedIds = ["a", "b"]
- WHEN selectedIds = ["b", "c"] and cap = 3
- THEN toAssign = ["c"], toUnassign = ["a"]

#### Scenario: No-op selection produces empty diffs

- GIVEN previouslyAssignedIds = ["a", "b"]
- WHEN selectedIds = ["a", "b"] and cap = 3
- THEN toAssign = [] and toUnassign = [] (no mutation calls should be triggered downstream)

#### Scenario: Selection exceeds cap

- GIVEN previouslyAssignedIds = ["a", "b", "c"]
- WHEN selectedIds attempts to include a 4th id and cap = 3
- THEN capExceeded = true, and the 4th id MUST NOT appear in toAssign

### Requirement: Max-3 vessels per cámara client-side cap

The mobile selector MUST prevent selecting more than 3 vessels for a single cámara/arrival-asset, matching web's client-side rule. This is a UI-only constraint; backend/DB enforcement is explicitly out of scope.

#### Scenario: Blocking a 4th selection

- GIVEN 3 vessels are already selected for the asset
- WHEN the user attempts to select a 4th vessel
- THEN the selection MUST be rejected (checkbox/chip remains unselected or is disabled)
- AND the user MUST see a hint indicating the cap was reached

#### Scenario: Selecting up to the cap succeeds

- GIVEN 2 vessels are selected
- WHEN the user selects a 3rd vessel
- THEN the selection MUST succeed

### Requirement: Unassign gated by PROGRAMADO status

Deselecting an already-assigned vessel MUST only be permitted while the arrival/asset `status === 'PROGRAMADO'`. In any other status, deselection MUST be blocked in the UI (e.g., disabled chip) with an explanatory hint, matching web parity — never silently ignored and never silently succeeding.

#### Scenario: Deselect allowed while PROGRAMADO

- GIVEN an assigned vessel and asset status = 'PROGRAMADO'
- WHEN the user deselects that vessel
- THEN the deselection MUST be accepted in the UI selection state

#### Scenario: Deselect blocked when not PROGRAMADO

- GIVEN an assigned vessel and asset status != 'PROGRAMADO' (e.g. 'EN_PLANTA')
- WHEN the user attempts to deselect that vessel
- THEN the chip/control MUST be disabled and MUST NOT change selection state
- AND a hint MUST be shown explaining why removal is blocked

### Requirement: Edit flow correctly persists assign/unassign diff

On save, the mobile edit screen MUST use the diff produced by `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` to call `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/assign-vessels` with `toAssign` (when non-empty) AND `DELETE /acopio/arrival-assets/:id/unassign` once per id in `toUnassign`. The system MUST NOT report success for a deselected vessel without having called unassign for it — no ghost assignments left in the database.

#### Scenario: Save with only new assignments

- GIVEN toAssign = ["c"], toUnassign = []
- WHEN the user saves
- THEN only `POST assign-vessels` is called with ["c"]
- AND no `DELETE unassign` calls are made

#### Scenario: Save with only removals (PROGRAMADO)

- GIVEN toAssign = [], toUnassign = ["b", "c"], status = 'PROGRAMADO'
- WHEN the user saves
- THEN `DELETE .../unassign` MUST be called once for "b" and once for "c"
- AND no `POST assign-vessels` call is made

#### Scenario: Save with mixed assign and unassign

- GIVEN toAssign = ["c"], toUnassign = ["a"]
- WHEN the user saves
- THEN both `POST assign-vessels` (with ["c"]) and `DELETE .../unassign` (for "a") MUST be called
- AND the screen MUST NOT report success unless both operations were attempted

#### Scenario: Partial failure during sequential unassign calls

- GIVEN toUnassign = ["a", "b"] and the unassign call for "a" fails while "b" succeeds
- WHEN the save flow runs unassign calls sequentially
- THEN the flow MUST continue attempting remaining unassign calls despite the earlier failure
- AND after all calls complete, the screen MUST refetch current state
- AND the screen MUST surface a per-item error for "a" (the failed id), not a generic silent success

## Non-Goals

- Backend enforcement of the max-3 cap (deferred, tracked as a known gap on both clients).
- Any change to backend endpoints (`assign-vessels`, `unassign`) — both already exist and are correct.
- Any change to web behavior — web is the reference implementation.
- Changing mobile's combined "assign + advance to EN_PLANTA" UX.

# Tasks: mobile-acopio-asignacion-edit (asignacion-parity)

Strict TDD. Mobile-only. Single PR (no chaining — MENOR size, budget 400 lines).

- Files: mobile/lib/asignacion.test.ts (new)

## T3 — GREEN: implement asignacion.ts [DONE]
- Implemented `computeAssignmentDiff(previouslyAssignedIds, selectedIds, cap)` in `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts`. Zero RN/Expo imports, zero I/O, pure function.
- capExceeded = selectedIds.length > cap; overflow ids (beyond cap) truncated before diffing so they never appear in toAssign.
- Confirmed GREEN: `pnpm -F mobile test` → 7 passed (7), no test modifications made to force pass.
- Files: mobile/lib/asignacion.ts (new)

## T4 — Wire cap-of-3 + PROGRAMADO gating into selection UI [DONE]
- Added new `canUnassign = (arrivalAsset?.status ?? 'PROGRAMADO') === 'PROGRAMADO'` boolean alongside existing `isAlreadyAssigned` (not renamed, per minimal-diff guidance — kept `isAlreadyAssigned` for badge/status-note/button-label roles unchanged).
- `toggleVessel`: blocks adding a 4th vessel when `selected.length >= 3` (no-op); blocks removing an already-selected vessel when `!canUnassign` (no-op).
- Selected-vessel chip remove (X) button: `disabled={!canUnassign}`, muted icon color when disabled; hint text shown below list when `selected.length > 0 && !canUnassign`: "Solo se puede quitar un barco mientras la cámara está Pendiente".
- Search/add section: when `capReached` (selected.length >= 3), list replaced with hint "Máximo 3 embarcaciones por cámara alcanzado".
- Files: mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx (edit)

## T5 — Wire save flow to use computeAssignmentDiff + call assign/unassign endpoints [DONE]
- Replaced `assignMutation` with `saveMutation`:
  - Computes diff via `computeAssignmentDiff(existingVesselIds, selected.map(v => v.id), 3)` where `existingVesselIds` = catalog vessel ids derived from `existingVessels` (ArrivalAssetRow rows filtered by `parent_camara_asset_id === assetId`).
  - `POST /acopio/arrival-assets/:assetId/assign-vessels` called only when `diff.toAssign.length > 0`.
  - `DELETE /acopio/arrival-assets/:rowId/unassign` called sequentially (for-of + await, not Promise.all), once per `diff.toUnassign` id — IMPORTANT: the unassign endpoint's `:id` param is the arrival_asset ROW id (existingVessels[i].id), not the vessel catalog id and not the cámara's assetId. Resolved via `existingVessels.find(ev => ev.asset_id === vesselId)`. Confirmed against backend `acopio.controller.ts:388-391` and web `AsignacionEmbarcaciones.tsx:53-56` (`unassignMutation.mutate(a.id)` uses the same row id).
  - Failures per unassign id are caught individually (try/catch inside the loop) and collected into `failedUnassignIds`, loop continues regardless of failure.
  - Preserved existing "advance to EN_PLANTA if !isAlreadyAssigned" behavior unchanged (non-goal: no UX change to combined assign+advance flow).
  - `onSuccess`: always invalidates `['acopio-arrivals']` (refetch). If `failedUnassignIds.length > 0`, shows `Alert.alert` listing failed vessel names/registrations and does NOT navigate away (no silent success). Only navigates back to `/acopio/asignacion` when there were zero failures.
- Files: mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx (edit)

## T6 — Manual/smoke verification [DONE — automated gates only, no device available]

- `pnpm -F mobile exec tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors.
- Manual device/simulator smoke NOT performed (no device/simulator available in this environment) — flagged as a residual risk for the user to verify before merge (add+remove flow, cap-of-3 block, non-PROGRAMADO removal block with hint, one simulated failing unassign call).

## Review Workload Forecast (final)

- Chained PRs: not needed, single PR as planned.

observations.title: Mobile asignacion detail: date-window + server-truth toAssign fixes
observations.content:
**What**: Two mobile-only fixes in `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx`.
(1) Detail arrivals query switched from exact `date: today` to range `date_from: today, date_to: tomorrow` (imported limaTomorrow, added `tomorrow`, queryKey now `['acopio-arrivals', today, tomorrow, 'camara']` matching list screen). Backend `acopio.controller.ts` maps date_from/date_to to inclusive `arrival_date >=/<=` range (confirmed).

Alert copy corrected to no longer claim "no se aplicó ningún otro cambio" — now states successful unassigns were applied but no new assignments/status advance.
**Why**: (1) tomorrow cámaras returned 0 arrivals → empty preload → invisible assigned vessels → duplicate re-adds. (2) after partial unassign-failure abort, re-selecting a vessel in initialSelectedIds but removed server-side was never re-POSTed.
**Where**: mobile/app/(app)/acopio/asignacion/[assetId].tsx (lines ~9, 19-21, 37-46, ~150-159, ~172 alert).
**Learned**: Did not touch pure lib mobile/lib/asignacion.ts (diff still used for toUnassign + capExceeded). Gates: pnpm -F mobile test 16/16 GREEN, tsc --noEmit exit 0. Backend/web/infra untouched per instructions.

observations.title: sdd/asignacion-parity/archive-report
observations.content:
# Archive Report: asignacion-parity

**Status**: COMPLETE — APPROVED and DEPLOYED  
**Date Archived**: 2026-07-05  
**Change Type**: MENOR → ROOT-CAUSE FIX (escalated via judgment-day)  
**SDD Cycle**: Explore (359) → Proposal (360) → Spec (361) → Tasks (362) → Apply → Judgment-Day (5 rounds) → Verify (364) → Archive (365)

---

## Executive Summary

Last Acopio parity sub-flow. Started mobile-only (fix ghost-unassignment bug + cap-of-3), but judgment-day escalated to a ROOT-CAUSE fix spanning backend + infra + mobile. All 6 implementation tasks completed via Strict TDD. Judgment-day approved after 5 rounds / 3 fix iterations; 2 original CRITICAL verification issues (init race, retry duplicate) fixed via backend structural change (unique index + data-aware dedupe). Change DEPLOYED to prod: DB migration 019 applied and verified in both tenant_perufrost and tenant_demo; mobile pushed to master (manual EAS build required by user); backend/worker/scheduler rebuild pending.

---

## Change Scope & Escalation

### Original Scope (SDD Proposal / Spec)
Mobile-only MENOR change: fix ghost-unassignment bug (deselected vessels not calling DELETE unassign endpoint) + enforce max-3 cap matching web behavior. Pure `computeAssignmentDiff()` module + UI gating + save-flow unassign calls.

### Escalation via Judgment-Day (5 Rounds, 3 Fix Iterations)
During verification and judgment-day review, two CRITICAL issues emerged:
1. **Init race condition**: mobile asignacion screen arrived.selected state became out-of-sync with server truth when initial load raced against auto-advance mutations.
2. **Retry duplicate rows**: assignVessels `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` combined with retry logic produced orphaned duplicate arrival_asset rows.

Root cause analysis: backend's `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` arbiter was never wired correctly because the unique constraint was missing entirely. Backend was accepting duplicates silently.

### Final Deliverables (Post-Escalation)

#### Mobile (mobil-escorpia, commit 146a2d5, branch master)
- `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` — Pure `computeAssignmentDiff() + resolveInitialSelection()` (16 Vitest tests, TDD)
- `mobile/lib/asignacion.test.ts` — Full Strict TDD test suite covering all spec scenarios
- `mobile/vitest.config.ts` — Vitest bootstrap for pure-TS testing (new test runner infrastructure)

  ```sql
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX arrival_assets_unique_vessel
  ON arrival_assets(parent_camara_asset_id, asset_id)
  WHERE parent_camara_asset_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
  ```
  Makes assignVessels' `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` a real arbiter (root cause of duplicate rows fixed).

#### Infra (infra-escorpia, commit e02bcb5, main)

observations.title: Asignación mobile a paridad + root-cause fix de duplicados (SDD asignacion-parity, judgment-day 5 rondas)
observations.content:
**What**: Último sub-flujo de paridad de Acopio (asignación de embarcaciones). Empezó mobile-only (bug de desasignación fantasma + cap 3) pero judgment-day (5 rondas, 3 iteraciones de fix) escaló a un fix de RAÍZ backend+infra+mobile. APROBADO y con la parte de datos ya viva en prod.

**Why**: En mobile, deseleccionar una embarcación asignada mostraba éxito pero nunca llamaba `DELETE .../unassign` (solo `POST assign-vessels` = INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) → la desasignación se perdía en silencio. La raíz de TODOS los duplicados: `acopio_arrival_assets` no tenía unique constraint, así que el `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` de `assignVessels` no arbitraba nada.

**Root cause fix (LIVE en prod)**: migración vertebra `019_arrival_assets_unique_vessel.sql` = unique index parcial `(parent_camara_asset_id, asset_id) WHERE parent_camara_asset_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL`. Hace real el ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Parcial: excluye soft-deletes (permite re-asignar tras quitar) y cámaras (parent NULL). Dedup previo data-aware (conserva fila con pesaje/lote/estado avanzado, no solo la más antigua). **Aplicado a tenant_perufrost + tenant_demo** (pre-flight: 0 duplicados activos → UPDATE 0; índice creado en ambos). Template `infra/postgres/tenant-template/012_acopio.sql` actualizado para tenants nuevos.

**Mobile**: `mobile/lib/asignacion.ts` (puro: computeAssignmentDiff + resolveInitialSelection, 16 tests Vitest TDD — bootstrapeó Vitest en mobile, antes no había runner). Pantalla `[assetId].tsx`: unassign real por id de fila arrival_asset, cap 3 gateado a PROGRAMADO, unassign-first-abort-en-fallo, init gateado a arrivals cargado (isSuccess), toAssign vs verdad del server (freshAssignedIds), ventana de fecha alineada con la lista (date_from/date_to hoy..mañana — antes date=hoy exacto rompía cámaras de mañana), borra todas las filas duplicadas legacy (404=éxito).

**Where/commits**: mobile mobil-escorpia `146a2d5` (branch **master**), backend back-escorpia `fbd8055` (main), infra infra-escorpia `e02bcb5` (main). Los 3 pusheados.

**Learned/gotchas**:
- Las migraciones de vértebra (`backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/*.sql`) NO viajan en la imagen Docker (el Dockerfile solo copia dist/). Los tenants nuevos las reciben vía `infra/postgres/tenant-template` (provision script), NO vía la imagen backend. Existentes = aplicar a mano en la VM.
- `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` SIN target sí arbitra índices únicos PARCIALES en Postgres (la restricción de inferencia solo aplica con target explícito).
- mobile es repo aparte con branch **master** (no main). Tiene cambios pre-existentes no relacionados (app.json, eas.json, forms, TimeField, metro.config, stores/sync) que NO hay que arrastrar.
- El bug de duplicados era en gran parte pre-existente por falta del unique index; el fix mobile solo era defensa en profundidad.

**Follow-ups pendientes**: (1) cap 3 server-side (hoy solo cliente); (2) mapear 23505 crudo en addAssetToArrival a error de dominio; (3) fetchQuery staleTime:0; (4) interacción de filas CANCELADO con el unique index si se agrega flujo cancelar-y-reasignar; (5) **EAS build manual de mobile** (no se auto-deploya) + smoke test en device del flujo de asignación.
