observations.title: Estado de git stash en mobile tras EAS build de asignacion (recuperar sin conflicto)
observations.content:
Contexto (2026-07-05): para que el EAS build del fix de asignación (mobil-escorpia commit `146a2d5`, branch master) saliera limpio, se stashearon los cambios de WIP no relacionados del working tree de `mobile`.

**Estado de los stashes en `mobile/` (repo mobil-escorpia, branch master):**
- `stash@{0}` = "WIP mobile no relacionado a asignacion (6 archivos)" → contiene SOLO 6 archivos: `app.json`, `app/(app)/forms/[formId].tsx`, `components/forms/fields/TimeField.tsx`, `metro.config.js`, `stores/sync.ts`, `.env.example`.
- `stash@{1}` = "WIP-pre-fix-segmentation-2026-06-26" → WIP viejo pre-existente, NO tocado en esta sesión.

**Dejado en el working tree a propósito** (config de conectividad al dominio, NO stasheada): `eas.json` (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL = https://api.escorpia.com en preview/production, tenant perufrost) + `plugins/network_security_config.xml`. Estos dos quedan modificados sin commitear para que el APK apunte al dominio HTTPS y no a la IP cruda `http://34.31.70.3:3000` que tiene el eas.json commiteado.

**Recuperación SIN conflicto**: `cd mobile && git stash pop` → devuelve los 6 archivos limpio (ninguno está en el working tree, por eso no conflictúa). El cajón se reorganizó a propósito para que sea un solo `pop` (antes tenía los 8 incluyendo los 2 de conexión ya restaurados, lo que causaba conflicto en `eas.json`/`network_security_config.xml`).

**Posibles conflictos futuros a vigilar**:
- Si se commitea `eas.json` (dominio) antes de hacer `git stash pop`, el pop del `stash@{0}` NO trae eas.json (ya no está ahí), así que ok. Pero si en el futuro se re-stashea eas.json, cuidado con mezclar la versión IP-cruda commiteada vs la de dominio.
- `stash@{1}` (junio) sigue pendiente; si alguien hace `git stash pop` dos veces, el segundo trae ese WIP viejo — revisar antes de aplicarlo.
- El eas.json COMMITEADO en master todavía tiene la IP cruda `http://34.31.70.3:3000`; el cambio a dominio vive solo en el working tree (sin commitear). Si se quiere permanente, hay que commitearlo.

Ver [[sdd/asignacion-parity/summary]] y [[mobile/eas-build/asignacion-parity]].

observations.title: sdd/catalogos-vista-general-camara/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: Vista "base de datos general" de recepciones en Catálogos (agrupada por cámara)

### Current State

**Frontend catálogos hoy** (`frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/catalogos/page.tsx`):
- Enruta por vértebra: si el área es `acopio` → `AcopioCatalogos.tsx` (editor de maestros: proveedores/activos/productos/recepción/tipos-doc, con tabs, búsqueda simple `normalize()` + filter, sin paginación de servidor, sin agrupación visual).
- Si es otra vértebra → `GenericCatalogViewer.tsx` (visor de solo lectura genérico, por tabla, con expand/collapse y paginación server-side vía `/admin/areas/:areaCode/catalog-tables` y `/admin/areas/:areaCode/catalog-tables/:tableId/data`). NINGUNO de los dos junta múltiples fuentes documentales en una sola tabla ancha ni soporta color-coding por grupo ni filtro de rango de fechas.

**Backend — modelo de datos real** (vértebra `acopio_materia_prima`, migraciones en `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/*.sql`):
- `acopio_arrivals` — cabecera de cada arribo: `transport_type_id` (BARCO/CAMARA), `supplier_id`, `product_id`, `plate_number` (placa de la cámara/furgón), `arrival_date`, `arrival_time`, `reception_point_id`.
- `acopio_arrival_assets` — uno o más "activos" (embarcaciones) por arribo. Campo clave: `parent_camara_asset_id` (FK a sí misma) + `asset_role` ENUM `DIRECT | CAMARA_ANCHOR | VESSEL` (migraciones 002 y 013). Un arribo tipo CAMARA crea una fila `CAMARA_ANCHOR` (no es embarcación, es el "ancla" documental/trazabilidad) y cada embarcación real que llegó dentro de esa cámara es una fila `VESSEL` con `parent_camara_asset_id` apuntando al ancla. Además `batch_number`, `lot_id`, `metadata` (jsonb con eslora, inmarsat, arte_pesca, representante_armador, dni_titular, numero_guia, ruc_transportista, dni_conductor, placa_furgo, muelle_descarga, fechas de captura/producción/congelación/vencimiento, códigos de habilitación sanitaria por vessel/muelle/produce, etc.)
- `acopio_weighing` — pesos y precio: `gross_weight`, `tare_weight`, `weight_without_winch` (antes `wincha_weight`, migración 015 corrigió el nombre), `real_price`, `shrinkage_pct`, `purchase_order`, `payment_status` (`POR_GENERAR|PENDIENTE|PAGADO`), `report_number`.
- `document_type_catalog` + `entry_documents` (motor genérico de documentos, migración 007, reemplazó las tablas legacy `acopio_document_type_catalog`/`acopio_entry_documents` eliminadas en 009): `extraction_fields` es JSONB flexible por tipo de documento (PERMISO_PESCA, ZARPE, SANIPES_EMBARCACION, SANIPES_CAMARA, GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA, GUIA_REMITENTE, ACTA_FISCALIZACION, CERT_PROCEDENCIA, etc.), y `ai_extracted_json`/`human_corrected_json` guardan los valores extraídos por IA (n8n) por documento. `entry_documents.parent_entity_id` referencia `acopio_arrival_asset.id`.

**Ya existe la agrupación por cámara en el modelo**: `acopio_arrival_assets.parent_camara_asset_id` (todas las embarcaciones que llegaron juntas en una misma cámara comparten el mismo `parent_camara_asset_id`) y `acopio_arrivals.plate_number` (la placa de la cámara/furgón está en la cabecera del arribo, compartida por todos sus `arrival_assets`). Es decir, agrupar visualmente "lo que llegó junto" = agrupar por `arrival_id` (o por `parent_camara_asset_id` cuando el asset_role es VESSEL).

**Ya existe una consulta SQL que junta casi TODOS los campos pedidos por el usuario en una sola fila ancha**, pero solo como export a Excel, no como vista interactiva:
- `AcopioArrivalsService.exportToExcel()` (`backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-arrivals.service.ts:737`) + `EXPORT_COLUMNS` (línea 709) — columnas seleccionables (`GET /acopio/export/columns`), incluye `plate_number`, `lot_code`, pesos, `real_price`, `shrinkage_pct`, `total_importe` (calculado), `payment_status`. Falta `certificado_procedencia` y `orden_compra` explícitos como columna (orden_compra existe en `acopio_weighing.purchase_order` pero no está en `EXPORT_COLUMNS`).
- `AcopioArrivalsService.exportMpPerufrost()` (línea 1272) — junta representante/armador, DNI, guía transportista (RUC/DNI conductor/razón social/placa furgón), muelle, códigos de habilitación sanitaria (vessel/muelle/produce), planta (nombre + código), fechas de captura/producción/congelación/vencimiento — vía LEFT JOIN a subquery agregada sobre `entry_documents` con `MAX(CASE WHEN document_type_code = 'X' THEN ai_extracted_json->>'campo' END)`.
- `AcopioArrivalsService.exportReporteTolvas()` (línea 1100) — junta eslora, INMARSAT, arte de pesca, equipo satelital, celular, armador, fecha zarpe, fecha acta fiscalización — mismo patrón de agregación.
- Todas estas queries ya filtran por rango de fechas `from`/`to` sobre `a.arrival_date` y ya excluyen `asset_role = 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'` (para no listar el ancla como si fuera una embarcación).

Endpoints backend: `GET /acopio/arrivals` (lista jerárquica arrival→assets, con filtros `date|dateFrom|dateTo|status|lotId|productId`), `GET /acopio/export/excel(+materia-prima|+tolvas|+mp-perufrost)`, `GET /acopio/export/columns`, `GET/POST/DELETE /acopio/report-presets` (el usuario ya puede guardar combinaciones de columnas — sistema de presets ya existe).

### Confirmación explícita sobre el campo "Resolución" del permiso de pesca

**NO EXISTE.** Se buscó `resoluci` (case-insensitive) en todo `backend/` y no aparece ninguna columna, campo de `extraction_fields`, ni referencia a un campo "Resolución" asociado a `PERMISO_PESCA` o a ningún documento. El `extraction_fields` actual de `PERMISO_PESCA` en `document_type_catalog` (definido por última vez en la migración `003_document_types.sql`, no tocado después) es:
```json
[
  {"key":"matricula","label":"Matrícula de la Embarcación","type":"text","required":true},
  {"key":"representante_armador","label":"Representante / Armador","type":"text","required":true},
  {"key":"dni_titular","label":"DNI del Titular","type":"text","required":true},
  {"key":"fecha_vencimiento","label":"Fecha de Vencimiento","type":"date","required":false}
]
```
No falta agregarlo al "modelo/esquema" en el sentido de una migración SQL — `extraction_fields` es JSONB flexible, así que agregar el campo "Resolución" es solo un `UPDATE document_type_catalog SET extraction_fields = ... WHERE code = 'PERMISO_PESCA'` (patrón idéntico a las migraciones 010/012/015). No requiere `ALTER TABLE`. Ojo: una migración anterior (004, sobre la tabla legacy ya eliminada `acopio_document_type_catalog`) sí tenía un campo `numero_permiso` para PERMISO_PESCA que la migración 003/010 (tabla nueva `document_type_catalog`) NO conserva — y sin embargo el código de export (`exportReporteTolvas`, línea 1176) todavía lee `ai_extracted_json->>'numero_permiso'`. Esto sugiere un gap PREEXISTENTE (no reportado por el usuario): el campo `numero_permiso` puede no estarse extrayendo actualmente porque no está en `extraction_fields` de la tabla vigente. Vale la pena confirmarlo con el usuario/n8n en la fase de propuesta, junto con agregar "Resolución".

### Reusar vs construir nuevo

**Reusar:**
- El patrón de agregación SQL con `MAX(CASE WHEN document_type_code = 'X' THEN ai_extracted_json->>'campo' END) ... GROUP BY parent_entity_id` ya resuelto en `exportMpPerufrost`/`exportReporteTolvas` — es la base de la query que alimentaría la nueva vista.
- `EXPORT_COLUMNS` + `GET /acopio/export/columns` + sistema de `report-presets` — ya hay un concepto de "columnas seleccionables por el usuario", se puede extender a la vista on-screen en vez de reinventar.
- `acopio_arrival_assets.parent_camara_asset_id` / `asset_role` / `acopio_arrivals.plate_number` como clave de agrupación visual por color — no requiere cambios de esquema.
- Componentes UI: `Table`/`TableHeader`/`TableRow` de `@/components/ui/table`, `Input`+`Search` para filtro de texto (patrón `normalize()`/`matchText()` de `AcopioCatalogos.tsx`), `Skeleton` para loading — reusar look & feel.
- Patrón de query con `useQuery` de TanStack Query ya usado en ambos componentes de catálogo.

**Construir nuevo:**
- Un endpoint backend nuevo tipo `GET /acopio/arrivals/database-view` (o similar) que devuelva JSON paginado (no Excel) con la misma proyección ancha, filtros de fecha por rango y filtros por columna, en vez de streamear un `.xlsx`.
- Componente frontend nuevo (no encaja en `GenericCatalogViewer` genérico ni en el editor de `AcopioCatalogos`): tabla ancha con scroll horizontal, filtro por columna, selector de rango de fechas, y coloreado de fila por grupo (color determinístico derivado de `arrival_id` o `plate_number`/cámara).
- Definir dónde vive esta nueva vista dentro de `[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/catalogos/` (¿tab nueva dentro de `AcopioCatalogos`? ¿página separada?) — pendiente de decidir en la fase de propuesta, respetando la convención de layouts del proyecto (nunca hardcodear `acopio` como area slug en rutas/redirects).

### Preguntas abiertas para la fase de propuesta

1. ¿La vista debe ser SOLO lectura (como `GenericCatalogViewer`) o también editable (como `AcopioCatalogos`)? El pedido original solo menciona visualización/filtro/búsqueda.
2. ¿Paginación server-side (como `GenericCatalogViewer`, recomendado dado que ya hay `LIMIT 10000` en los exports) o carga completa en cliente?
3. ¿La agrupación por color debe basarse en `arrival_id` (agrupa TODO lo que llegó en el mismo arribo, incluyendo BARCO directo) o específicamente en cámara (`plate_number` / `parent_camara_asset_id`, ignorando arribos tipo BARCO que no tienen cámara)? El pedido dice "cámara = contenedor/placa de cámara frigorífica", lo que sugiere que solo aplica a arribos tipo CAMARA.
4. Confirmar con el usuario si el campo "Resolución" del permiso de pesca es un campo de texto simple o tiene un formato/patrón validable (p.ej. "R.D. N° 000-2024-...") para decidir si amerita una `validation_rule` tipo `pattern` además del `extraction_field`.
5. Confirmar si `numero_permiso` (gap preexistente detectado, no reportado por el usuario) debe corregirse en la misma propuesta o es un ticket aparte.
6. ¿La nueva vista debe seguir alimentando/reemplazando los exports Excel existentes (`export/excel`, `export/excel/mp-perufrost`, `export/excel/tolvas`) o coexistir como una feature separada de solo visualización?
7. ¿Certificado de procedencia y orden de compra (ya existen como dato: `document_type_code = 'CERT_PROCEDENCIA'` en `entry_documents`, y `acopio_weighing.purchase_order`) deben incluirse como columnas nuevas en la vista, dado que hoy no aparecen en `EXPORT_COLUMNS`?

### Ready for Proposal
Sí. El modelo de datos y los endpoints/queries base ya existen; el trabajo de sdd-propose puede enfocarse en: (a) el nuevo endpoint JSON paginado reusando el patrón de agregación de `exportMpPerufrost`, (b) el nuevo componente de tabla con color-coding y filtros, (c) el `UPDATE` de `extraction_fields` para agregar "Resolución" a PERMISO_PESCA, y (d) resolver las 7 preguntas abiertas con el usuario antes de comprometerse a un diseño final.

### Skills cargadas
`traceexport-form-engine`, `traceexport-gs1-trazabilidad`, `traceexport-backend`, `traceexport-new-module` (no existe `traceexport-frontend` como skill separado en este entorno; las convenciones de frontend/Next.js App Router se tomaron de `CLAUDE.md` del proyecto).

observations.title: sdd/catalogos-vista-general-camara/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: General Database View of Acopio Receptions (grouped by camera)

## Intent

Data for a single arrival is fragmented across screens and Excel exports (vessel, supplier, weights, transport/sender guides, provenance certificate, fishing permit, Produce/Dicapi, plant, process dates, zarpe, inspection act). Users cannot visually audit "what arrived together" without exporting. Deliver ONE interactive wide table in the Catálogos tab showing all receptions, with rows color-grouped by shared camera (refrigerated truck), per-column filters/search, and date-range filtering.

## Scope

### In Scope
- New backend endpoint `GET /acopio/arrivals/general-view`: paginated JSON wide rows reusing the `MAX(CASE WHEN document_type_code...)` aggregation over `entry_documents` (same pattern as `exportMpPerufrost`/`exportReporteTolvas`); filters: date range, per-column, text search; excludes `asset_role = 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'`; returns grouping keys (`arrival_id`, `parent_camara_asset_id`, `plate_number`).
- New frontend component (tab inside `[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/catalogos` for the acopio vertebra): wide table, horizontal scroll, date-range picker, per-column filter/search, deterministic row color per camera group.
- Inline editing gated by permissions (see Business Rules).
- Data migration (pattern 010/012/015): `UPDATE document_type_catalog` adding `resolucion` (free text, optional) to `PERMISO_PESCA.extraction_fields`.
- New columns `certificado_procedencia` (from `entry_documents`) and `orden_compra` (`acopio_weighing.purchase_order`).

### Out of Scope
- Excel exports (Perufrost, Tolvas, generic) — untouched, no refactor.
- Pre-existing `numero_permiso` bug — user fixes separately.
- Camera data model — already exists, no schema changes.
- Mobile.

## Business Rules (confirmed)
- Color grouping by REAL camera only (`parent_camara_asset_id`); direct-boat arrivals get neutral rows, never grouped.
- Group colors use a distinct pastel palette — NEVER semáforo green/amber/red (those mean status per UI rule).
- Editing: backend enforces `@RequiresWrite('acopio')` (`role_tool_access.can_write`); admin always; supervisor/encargado only if RBAC grants write. Frontend hides edit affordances without write permission (note: `AcopioCatalogos.tsx` has no client gating today — this view adds it).
- Guards: `JwtAuthGuard, TenantDataGuard` + `@RequiresTool('acopio')`.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `acopio-general-database-view`: wide-table interactive view of all receptions with camera grouping, filters, permission-gated inline edit.

### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact |
|------|--------|
| `backend/src/modules/acopio/` (controller + service) | New endpoint |
| `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/016_*.sql` | New data migration |
| `frontend/src/components/acopio/` + `catalogos/page.tsx` | New component + tab wiring |

## Proposal question round (decisions taken, flagged for user review)
1. Server-side pagination with filters sent to backend (exports already cap at LIMIT 10000).
2. `resolucion` = free text, no pattern validation (no documented standard found).
3. Include `certificado_procedencia` + `orden_compra` as columns (explicitly requested).
4. Column visibility: reuse existing `report-presets` persistence for on-screen column selection; fallback if rejected: fixed columns + horizontal scroll.

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Wide aggregation slow on large tenants | Med | Server-side pagination; index check in design |
| Inline edit writing to wrong source (JSONB doc vs column) | Med | Design phase maps each column to its writable source; read-only for ambiguous ones |
| RBAC write semantics differ from user intent ("admin only"?) | Low | Flagged for checkpoint review |

## Rollback Plan
Revert frontend tab + endpoint (additive, no consumers). Migration rollback: `UPDATE` removing `resolucion` from `extraction_fields` (JSONB, no schema change).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] All receptions in date range render in one table; rows of same camera share one color; boat arrivals neutral.
- [ ] Per-column filter + search + date range work server-side with pagination.
- [ ] Users without `can_write` on acopio see read-only; writes rejected server-side.
- [ ] `resolucion` appears as extraction field for PERMISO_PESCA.
- [ ] Excel exports byte-identical in behavior.

observations.title: Fixed cross-document field collision in acopio validation (docFieldKey namespacing)
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed a real data-corruption bug in the acopio validation save flow (backend `acopio-documents.service.ts` saveValidation(), frontend `ValidationPanel.tsx`/`acopio-validation.ts`, mobile `validacion/[arrivalId].tsx`). Multiple document types for the same arrival asset can define fields with the identical name (e.g. `fecha_vencimiento` in PERMISO_PESCA, SANIPES_EMBARCACION, SANIPES_CAMARA; `matricula` in ZARPE/PERMISO_PESCA/SANIPES_EMBARCACION; `numero_certificado`/`fecha_emision` in CERT_PROCEDENCIA/SANIPES_EMBARCACION). The old code stored/sent these under a flat per-asset key, so editing one document's field silently overwrote the other's value in the UI state AND in the backend diff/review logic — a permit expiry date could get replaced by a SANIPES expiry date, flipping a semaphore green incorrectly.
**Why**: Discovered via judgment-day (dual blind adversarial review) after making all ValidationPanel field roles (RELLENO/CRUCE/VIGENCIA/AUDITORIA) editable per user request — the editable-everything change widened the blast radius of a latent bug.
**Where**: `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` (getEditableKeys lookup by composite key), `backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/acopio-field-roles.ts` (new `docFieldKey(docType,key)` helper), `frontend/src/components/acopio/ValidationPanel.tsx`, `mobile/constants/acopio-field-roles.ts`, `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx`.
**Learned**: Pattern to reuse: namespace client state/payload keys as `${documentTypeCode}:${fieldKey}` whenever a canonical field-name catalog is shared across multiple document/entity types for the same parent. Backend still flattens back to bare keys for `acopio_arrival_assets.metadata` (exports like Tolvas/MP Perufrost read bare keys) — this means metadata itself can still have last-write-wins collisions for shared field names; two export queries (`numero_certificado` in Materia Prima export, `fecha_vencimiento` in MP Perufrost export) were fixed to read the correctly-scoped value instead. Also added backward-compat fallback: if a client sends a bare (non-namespaced) key and it's NOT ambiguous for that asset's actual documents, it's still accepted — needed because backend deploys don't wait for mobile's separate EAS build.

observations.title: R2 bucket CORS never updated after frontend moved to Vercel
observations.content:
**What**: Document uploads from the production web app failed with "Failed to fetch" (browser blocks the direct PUT to the R2 presigned URL). Root cause: the tenant's R2 bucket (`traceexport-{slug}`, e.g. `traceexport-perufrost`) CORS policy only allowed `http://localhost:8081` and `http://localhost:3001` as AllowedOrigins — never updated when the frontend moved from the VM to Vercel (`https://app.escorpia.com`). Mobile uploads worked fine because native app fetches aren't subject to browser CORS.
**Why**: Frontend migrated to Vercel in an earlier session; nothing updated the R2 bucket CORS config to match.
**Where**: R2 bucket CORS is NOT managed in any repo/script — it was set manually (probably via Cloudflare dashboard) at some point. Fixed live via a one-off Node script using `@aws-sdk/client-s3` `PutBucketCorsCommand` run inside the backend container (has R2 S3-compatible credentials as env vars: S3_ENDPOINT, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, S3_BUCKET).
**Learned**: If document upload ever breaks again with "Failed to fetch" specifically (not an axios/API error, but the raw fetch() PUT to the presigned URL), check R2 bucket CORS first before assuming a backend/API bug. Only `perufrost` and `demo` tenants exist; only perufrost's bucket was fixed. No code path provisions R2 CORS for new tenants — `infra/scripts/provision-tenant.sh` should probably do this but currently doesn't.

observations.title: DNI_ARMADOR vs dni_titular — two separate things in acopio permiso de pesca
observations.content:
**What**: There are two distinct, easy-to-confuse things: (1) `dni_titular` — an AI-extraction field that used to live in PERMISO_PESCA's `ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES`/extraction_fields (removed this session, replaced by `numero_permiso` + `eslora`); (2) `DNI_ARMADOR` — a completely separate REQUIRED DOCUMENT TYPE in `document_type_catalog` ("DNI del Titular del Permiso", a physical DNI photocopy upload), required for BARCO/BARCO_EN_CAMARA. Removing the extraction field did NOT remove the document upload requirement — user had to report it separately ("sigue apareciendo... Sin subir" in the Documentos tab) before it was deactivated.
**Why**: User wanted to stop requesting DNI as a document/data point since the business no longer needs it; the fix required touching both the extraction-field catalog AND the document-type catalog separately.
**Where**: `document_type_catalog` row `code='DNI_ARMADOR'` set `is_active=false` (both live DB for tenant_perufrost and new migration `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/021_deactivate_dni_armador.sql` for future tenants). Both the admin catalog list and the per-arrival Documentos tab read the same `listDocumentTypes()` query filtered by `is_active=true`, so one DB change fixed both UI surfaces.
**Learned**: When a user says "remove field X", check whether there's ALSO a same-named-sounding but structurally separate document-type requirement — don't assume the extraction-field fix covers the document-upload-requirement too.

observations.title: Judgment-day (dual blind review) caught real bugs across 3 rounds on acopio changes
observations.content:
**What**: User asked to verify a large batch of acopio module changes (form fixes, validation editability, field-role catalog changes) via the judgment-day skill (two blind parallel reviewer agents + synthesis + fix + re-judge). Round 1 found a severe cross-document field collision bug (see "Fixed cross-document field collision..." memory) plus an export reading a removed field. Round 2 (after fixing round 1) found the export fix was query-correct but the data was never populated (form never collected it) AND found metadata-flatten could still collide for exports. Round 3 closed those gaps.
**Why**: The changes were made ad-hoc (not through the project's SDD process) and touched backend+frontend+mobile+DB migrations+live VPS deploys — high risk of subtle regressions across repos that automated tests alone wouldn't catch (tests were updated to match new behavior, not independently verify correctness).
**Learned**: For this kind of multi-repo, deploy-affecting change, budget for 2-3 judgment-day rounds, not one — the first round rarely surfaces everything, especially issues that only manifest when tracing a full data flow (UI → backend → DB → export) rather than reviewing a diff in isolation. Each round found DIFFERENT categories of bugs (logic bug → data-population gap → export layer gap), suggesting judges are more effective at spotting issues in their own "layer" of the change than issues spanning multiple layers at once.

observations.title: Simplified acopio PesajePanel (weighing form) UX
observations.content:
**What**: In `frontend/src/components/acopio/PesajePanel.tsx`: renamed the "Nº Balanza" label to "N° de reporte" (it was always bound to `reportNumber`/`Informe N°`, mislabeled as if it were the physical scale's ID — confused operators). Removed the Tara input and its display in the read-only summary (tara is always 0 for tenant Perufrost — still sent as fixed `0` in the payload, just not shown/editable). Removed the Especie input (species is already captured when the arrival is created via the materia-prima selector; showing it again during pesaje was redundant — if balanza import still provides it, it's sent silently without a visible field). Removed the "La merma final se aplica según el producto al guardar" hint text (redundant per user, the displayed weight is already understood as final).
**Why**: Direct user feedback after using the real app — labeling/redundancy issues, not correctness bugs.
**Where**: `frontend/src/components/acopio/PesajePanel.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/acopio/PesajePanel.test.tsx` (updated fixtures, removed the now-inapplicable "operator clears species" test).
**Learned**: Mobile has an equivalent pesaje screen (`mobile/app/(app)/acopio/pesaje/index.tsx`) that was NOT touched this session — user was asked if they want parity there and hadn't answered yet when session closed. Worth checking next session.

observations.title: Session summary: escorpia traza
observations.content:
## Goal
Fix a batch of user-reported bugs/UX issues across TraceExport's acopio module (backend, frontend web, mobile): "Nueva llegada" form gaps, document upload silent failures, Estado tab bypassing validation, ValidationPanel editability, PERMISO_PESCA field extraction, DNI_ARMADOR document requirement, PesajePanel confusing/redundant fields. Then independently verify everything via judgment-day (dual blind review) since it wasn't done through SDD.

## Instructions / preferences learned
- User wants thorough adversarial verification (judgment-day) for risky multi-repo changes, and is willing to go 2-3 rounds until genuinely clean — confirmed this explicitly ("seguir arreglando ahora, ronda 3").
- User tests against the live VPS (34.31.70.3), not local dev — always check/deploy there, not just push code.
- User reports bugs in short, colloquial Spanish bursts often bundling multiple issues in one message — parse carefully, each sentence can be its own distinct bug.

## Discoveries
- See saved memories: cross-document field collision (docFieldKey namespacing), R2 bucket CORS gap after Vercel migration, DNI_ARMADOR vs dni_titular distinction, judgment-day multi-round effectiveness.
- `acopio_nueva_llegada` form was missing a materia-prima/product selector; backend's product fallback query had a UNION ALL/ORDER BY scoping bug that could silently pick the wrong product (e.g. Anchoveta instead of Pota).
- `DocumentUploadPanel.tsx` swallowed all upload errors silently (empty catch, no response.ok check) — now surfaces the real error.
- Estado tab's generic "Avanzar" button could reach DOC_OK without the document-completeness check that the dedicated DocOkConfirm flow enforces — now gated behind an explicit "Forzar avance" with confirm.
- `VesselAutocomplete.tsx` had a bug where selecting a vessel then typing a character would wipe the input (reactive useEffect fighting its own onChange).

## Accomplished
- Backend: productCode fix, getEditableKeys/composite-key namespacing for saveValidation, PERMISO_PESCA field-roles change (dni_titular→numero_permiso+eslora), exportMpPerufrost/exportMateriaPrimaCompleta export fixes, representative_doc data-entry gap closed (updateAsset/listAssets), DNI_ARMADOR document type deactivated, backward-compat fallback for pre-EAS-rebuild mobile clients. All deployed to VPS, healthy.
- Frontend: NewArrivalDialog (searchable vessel picker, auto reception point, removed arrivalCode), DocumentUploadPanel error surfacing, Estado tab gating, ValidationPanel all-roles-editable + docFieldKey namespacing, AcopioCatalogos vessel form gets representativeDoc field, PesajePanel simplification (label fix, removed tara/especie/redundant message). All pushed to main (Vercel auto-deploys).
- Mobile: mirrored field-roles/validacion namespacing changes, pushed (needs EAS build to reach devices — not done this session).
- 3 rounds of judgment-day review; final verdict APPROVED. Test suites green throughout: backend 298/298, frontend 166/166, mobile 16/16, contract test OK.
- User confirmed final state works as expected ("funciona aparentemente como debería").

## Next steps
- Mobile PesajePanel equivalent (`mobile/app/(app)/acopio/pesaje/index.tsx`) likely has the same Nº Balanza/tara/especie issues — user hadn't confirmed whether to fix it when session closed.
- Mobile app needs an EAS build/OTA update to actually receive all the mobile-side fixes from this session (docFieldKey namespacing, form field changes) — code is pushed but not yet live on devices.
- `infra/scripts/provision-tenant.sh` doesn't provision R2 bucket CORS for new tenants — only `perufrost`'s bucket was fixed; a third tenant would hit the same "Failed to fetch" bug.
- Known, accepted (not fixed, by design per user's explicit "make everything editable" decision): `human_corrected_json` replace-not-merge on re-review can revert prior corrections to other fields; CRUCE fields being editable lets an operator force a semaphore green by typing the expected reference value.

## Relevant files
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` — saveValidation namespacing, backward-compat fallback
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-arrivals.service.ts` — quickCreate product fallback, exportMpPerufrost/exportMateriaPrimaCompleta fixes
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts` + mirrors in frontend/mobile — PERMISO_PESCA field changes, docFieldKey
- `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/020_permiso_pesca_numero_eslora.sql`, `021_deactivate_dni_armador.sql`
- `frontend/src/components/acopio/{NewArrivalDialog,VesselAutocomplete,DocumentUploadPanel,ValidationPanel,ExtractedFieldDisplay,PesajePanel,AcopioCatalogos}.tsx`
- `frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/acopio-field-roles.ts`
- `frontend/src/app/[tenant]/area/[areaCode]/operaciones/[arrivalId]/page.tsx` — Estado tab gating
- `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx`, `mobile/constants/acopio-field-roles.ts`, `mobile/components/acopio/ExtractedFieldDisplay.tsx`

observations.title: sdd/catalogos-vista-general-camara/spec
observations.content:
# acopio-general-database-view Specification

## Purpose
One interactive, paginated, wide table in Catálogos (`acopio` area) exposing every field captured across the acopio pipeline (arrival → documents → weighing → pricing), grouped by real camera, filterable/searchable per column, with permission-gated inline edit.

## Requirement: Complete Column Coverage
The system MUST expose, as table columns, every field currently captured in the acopio pipeline, sourced from the tables/fields below (verified against code and migrations, not the informal user list).

| Stage / Source | Columns |
|---|---|
| Arrival header (`acopio_arrivals`) | arrival_code, transport_type_code, supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, product_name, estimated_quantity, estimated_boxes, arrival_date, arrival_time, reception_point, notes, created_at, **plate_number** (camera-only), **camera_docs_approved** (camera-only) |
| Arrival asset (`acopio_arrival_assets`+`acopio_intake_assets`) | asset_name, asset_registration, status, lot_code, grade_code, estimated_price, batch_number, **parent_camara_asset_id** (camera-only, grouping key), representative_name, representative_doc, permit_number, contact_number |
| Asset metadata / doc-sourced fields (COALESCE metadata→document) | **numero_permiso** (label "Número de Permiso / Resolución Directoral" — this is the field the user referred to as "resolución"; no separate `resolucion` field exists or is needed), representante_armador, eslora, matricula, fecha_vencimiento, **numero_guia, ruc_transportista, dni_conductor, razon_social_transporte, placa_furgo** (camera-only, GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA), **muelle_descarga, codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria_muelle, punto_partida** (camera-only, GUIA_REMITENTE), codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria_vessel, codigo_habilitacion_sanitaria (SANIPES_EMBARCACION/CAMARA), inmarsat, arte_pesca, tiene_equipo_satelital, equipo_satelital_detalle, numero_celular, fecha_captura, fecha_produccion, fecha_congelacion, fecha_vencimiento_producto, fecha_zarpe (ZARPE), fecha_acta (ACTA_FISCALIZACION, camera-only), **numero_formato, fecha_desembarque** (camera-only, FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE), **certificado_procedencia** (NEW, CERT_PROCEDENCIA.numero_certificado) |
| Document status | docs_total, docs_approved (aggregated from `entry_documents.is_human_approved`) |
| Weighing (`acopio_weighing`) | report_number, gross_weight, tare_weight, net_weight (calc), weight_without_winch, start_time, end_time, hopper_id |
| Pricing/valorization (`acopio_weighing`) | real_price, shrinkage_pct, total_importe (calc), payment_status, **orden_compra** (NEW, `purchase_order`) |

Rows with `asset_role = 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'` MUST be excluded (documentary anchor, not a real reception).

No new field or migration is added for "resolución" — confirmed to be `numero_permiso`, already present since migration 020.

#### Scenario: Full pipeline data renders
- GIVEN an arrival with header, documents, weighing, and pricing data
- WHEN the user opens the general database view
- THEN one row shows all populated columns above without needing Excel export

#### Scenario: Camera-only fields blank for direct-boat arrivals
- GIVEN a direct BARCO arrival with no camera
- WHEN its row renders
- THEN camera-only columns (plate_number, GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA/SANIPES_CAMARA/GUIA_REMITENTE/ACTA_FISCALIZACION/FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE fields) show empty, not error

## Requirement: Per-Column Filter and Search
The system MUST allow filtering/searching on EVERY exposed column, not a subset. MVP implementation uses a uniform substring (ILIKE) filter per column for all types (text, enum/status, numeric, date); type-aware exact/range filtering per column is a documented future enhancement, not required for this change.

#### Scenario: Filter by an uncommon column
- GIVEN the table is loaded
- WHEN the user filters by `orden_compra` or `certificado_procedencia`
- THEN only matching rows return, server-side, paginated

#### Scenario: Filter with no matches
- GIVEN a filter value matching no rows
- WHEN applied
- THEN the table shows an empty state, not an error

## Requirement: Date-Range Filtering
The system MUST provide ONE global date-range selector scoped to `arrival_date` (reusing the existing export convention). Confirmed with the user (2026-07-05): independent per-field date-range filters for fecha_captura, fecha_produccion, fecha_congelacion, fecha_vencimiento, fecha_zarpe, fecha_acta, etc. are explicitly OUT of scope for this change — the global arrival_date range is sufficient for MVP. Per-field date ranges are a documented future enhancement (would ride on the same per-column filter mechanism if built later), not a gap in this change.

#### Scenario: Global date range narrows result set
- GIVEN arrivals across multiple months
- WHEN the user sets the global arrival-date range
- THEN only arrivals within range are queried server-side

#### Scenario: Empty date range
- GIVEN no date range is set
- WHEN the view loads
- THEN all rows (paginated) return, unrestricted by date

## Requirement: Camera Color Grouping
Rows MUST be visually grouped by color keyed on `parent_camara_asset_id`/`plate_number` (real camera only). Direct-boat rows MUST render neutral, ungrouped. Colors MUST NOT reuse semáforo green/amber/red.

#### Scenario: Same camera, same color
- GIVEN 3 vessels share one `parent_camara_asset_id`
- WHEN rendered
- THEN all 3 rows share one distinct pastel color

#### Scenario: Direct boat arrival
- GIVEN a BARCO direct arrival (no camera)
- WHEN rendered
- THEN its row has the neutral/default style

## Requirement: Permission-Gated Inline Edit
Inline editing MUST be enabled only when the acting user has `can_write` on the `acopio` tool (`@RequiresWrite('acopio')` server-side; frontend hides edit affordances otherwise). Columns whose write source is ambiguous (JSONB `entry_documents` vs relational tables like `acopio_weighing`) are read-only in this version.

#### Scenario: Write-permitted user edits
- GIVEN a supervisor with RBAC `can_write=true` on acopio
- WHEN they edit a cell
- THEN the write succeeds and is persisted

#### Scenario: Read-only user blocked
- GIVEN a user without `can_write` on acopio
- WHEN they view the table
- THEN no edit affordance renders, and a direct API write attempt returns 403 `INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS`

## Requirement: AcopioController RolesGuard Retrofit
`AcopioController` MUST enforce `@RequiresTool('acopio')`/`@RequiresWrite('acopio')` decorators via `RolesGuard` in `@UseGuards`, matching the convention used elsewhere (e.g. `AreasController`). This was a pre-existing gap (decorator declared but never enforced) fixed as part of this change, since the new endpoints rely on the same guard for permission gating.

#### Scenario: Role without acopio tool access is blocked
- GIVEN a role with no `acopio` row in `role_tool_access`
- WHEN it calls any `AcopioController` route
- THEN it receives 403 `ROLE_TOOL_DENIED`

#### Scenario: Existing roles unaffected
- GIVEN system roles (owner/admin/supervisor/operador/visor/gerencia) that already had `acopio` access seeded
- WHEN they call existing acopio routes
- THEN behavior is unchanged (200, same permissions as before)

observations.title: sdd/catalogos-vista-general-camara/design
observations.content:
# Design: General Database View of Acopio Receptions (grouped by camera)

## Technical Approach
One new read endpoint returning paginated wide JSON rows (one row per non-anchor `acopio_arrival_asset`), built from a whitelist-driven column registry that also powers per-column filtering, sorting, and the frontend column metadata. One new thin write endpoint for inline edits that delegates to existing services. One JSONB data migration (022). New frontend component rendered as a tab inside `AcopioCatalogos`.

## Full column inventory (pipeline coverage — source of each column)

Row grain: vessel/direct asset (`aa.asset_role <> 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'`). Grouping keys returned but hidden: `arrival_id`, `arrival_asset_id`, `parent_camara_asset_id`.

| Stage | Columns | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Arrival | arrival_date, arrival_time, arrival_code, transport_type_code, supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, product_name, product_code, estimated_quantity, estimated_boxes, plate_number (camera plate), reception_point_name, notes, validated_at, created_at | `acopio_arrivals` + catalogs (pattern of `exportToExcel`) |
| Asset | asset_name, asset_registration, status, lot_code, grade_code, batch_number, estimated_price (precio nueva llegada), armador_nombre (`ia.representative_name`), armador_doc | `acopio_arrival_assets` + `acopio_intake_assets` + lots |
| Asset metadata (camera-arrival extras) | eslora, inmarsat, arte_pesca, tiene_equipo_satelital, equipo_satelital_detalle, numero_celular, fecha_captura, fecha_produccion, fecha_congelacion, fecha_vencimiento_producto, cod_hab_vessel, cod_hab_produce | `aa.metadata->>'…'` (Tolvas/Perufrost pattern) |
| Docs — vessel level | ZARPE: fecha_zarpe · PERMISO_PESCA: numero_permiso, representante_armador, eslora_permiso, fecha_vencimiento_permiso, **resolucion (new)** · SANIPES_EMBARCACION: numero_certificado, cod_hab_sanitaria, fecha_emision, fecha_vencimiento · CERT_PROCEDENCIA: numero_certificado (**certificado_procedencia**), fecha_emision · ACTA_FISCALIZACION: fecha_acta · FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE: numero_formato, fecha_desembarque · GUIA_REMITENTE: muelle_descarga, cod_hab_muelle, punto_partida | `entry_documents` aggregated `MAX(CASE WHEN document_type_code=… THEN …)` GROUP BY `parent_entity_id` |
| Docs — camera level | GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA: numero_guia, ruc_transportista, dni_conductor, razon_social_transporte, placa_furgo · SANIPES_CAMARA: numero_certificado, camara_instalacion, cod_hab_camara, fecha_emision, fecha_vencimiento | Same docs CTE joined TWICE: on `aa.id` AND on `COALESCE(aa.parent_camara_asset_id, aa.id)` — camera docs hang off the CAMARA_ANCHOR that rows exclude |
| Validation | docs_total, docs_approved, camera_docs_approved | doc_counts subquery (as in `list()`) + `a.camera_docs_approved` |
| Weighing | report_number, hopper_id (`weighing_metadata->>'hopperId'`), start_time, end_time, gross_weight, tare_weight, net_weight (gross−tare), weight_without_winch | `acopio_weighing` |
| Pricing/payment | real_price, shrinkage_pct, peso_sin_wincha_merma, peso_total_recepcionado, peso_total_pagado, total_importe, orden_compra (`purchase_order`), payment_status | `acopio_weighing` + computed formulas copied verbatim from `exportMateriaPrimaCompleta` |
| Plant | planta_nombre, planta_cod | `organization_master` (Perufrost pattern) |

Doc-field value precedence: `COALESCE(aa.metadata->>'TYPE:key', docs.human_corrected, docs.ai_extracted)` — matches `saveValidation()` namespaced-metadata contract.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Alternatives rejected | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Read endpoint | `GET /acopio/arrivals/general-view` (+ `/general-view/columns`) in `AcopioController`/`AcopioArrivalsService` | New module | Same tool, same service already owns the aggregation pattern |
| Query shape | CTE: `docs` agg + `wide` projection; filters/sort/LIMIT-OFFSET + `COUNT(*) OVER()` applied over `wide` | Filtering raw tables | Filters address column aliases uniformly; one round trip |
| Per-column filter, no injection | `GENERAL_VIEW_COLUMNS` registry `{key, label, type, sqlExpr, editable}`; params `f_<key>=<text>`; unknown keys → 400 `INVALID_FILTER_COLUMN`; predicate always `sqlExpr::text ILIKE '%'||$n||'%'` with bound param; `from`/`to` range on `arrival_date`; `sortBy` whitelisted, default `arrival_date DESC, COALESCE(parent_camara_asset_id, aa.id), aa.created_at` (keeps camera groups contiguous) | JSON filter DSL; dynamic SQL from client strings | Column names never come from user input — only registry keys; values always parametrized |
| Inline edit | New `PATCH /acopio/arrivals/general-view/rows/:arrivalAssetId` body `{edits:[{columnKey,value}]}`, method-level `@UseGuards(RolesGuard)` + `@RequiresWrite('acopio')`; service routes per registry: doc fields → `AcopioDocumentsService.saveValidation()` (composite `TYPE:key`), price fields → `AcopioWeighingService.setPrice`/`markPaymentStatus` | Adding `@RequiresWrite` to existing endpoints; direct UPDATEs | Existing mobile/web flows untouched; single audited whitelisted write surface. NOTE: AcopioController lacks `RolesGuard` today → `@RequiresTool` is not enforced there (pre-existing gap); new endpoints add the guard at method level |
| canEdit signal | Response includes `permissions.canEdit` computed server-side (same `role_tool_access` query/cache as `RolesGuard.loadAccessForRoles`) | New global permissions endpoint; client role inference (`usePermissions` has roles only, not tool access) | Always in sync with the guard that enforces writes |

### Editable columns v1 (everything else read-only)
- All doc-extracted fields in `ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES` (incl. new `resolucion`) → via saveValidation.
- `real_price`, `orden_compra`, `shrinkage_pct` → `setPrice`; `payment_status` → `markPaymentStatus`.
- Read-only (ambiguous/derived/risky): weights (status-machine coupling), computed totals, identity/relational columns, `estimated_price`, `batch_number`, `notes`, plant, asset metadata extras (write source ambiguous: `ia.metadata` vs `aa.metadata`).

## Migration 022 (data-only)
`022_permiso_pesca_resolucion.sql`: full-replacement `UPDATE document_type_catalog SET extraction_fields = '[matricula, numero_permiso, representante_armador, eslora, resolucion(text, required:false), fecha_vencimiento]' WHERE vertebra_code='acopio_materia_prima' AND code='PERMISO_PESCA'` (pattern 020; idempotent). No validation_rules change (free text). Sync `resolucion:'RELLENO'` in `backend/src/modules/acopio/constants/field-roles.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/acopio-field-roles.ts`, `mobile/constants/acopio-field-roles.ts` + contract test. Rollback: re-run 020's UPDATE.

## Frontend
- New `frontend/src/components/acopio/AcopioGeneralDatabase.tsx` (+ `useGeneralView` hook), added as tab "Base de datos general" inside `AcopioCatalogos.tsx` (already tabbed; page wiring in `catalogos/page.tsx` unchanged, no hardcoded area slugs).
- Wide table: `overflow-x-auto`, sticky header, columns from `/general-view/columns`; TanStack Query with `placeholderData: keepPreviousData`; server pagination controls.
- Filters: debounced (400ms) input under each header → `f_<key>` params; date-range picker (two date inputs) → `from`/`to`.
- Camera color: deterministic — hash `parent_camara_asset_id` (char-code sum mod palette) into 8 pastel row classes (sky/violet/cyan/indigo/fuchsia/teal/blue/purple `*-50`; NEVER semáforo green/amber/red per UI rule); `parent_camara_asset_id IS NULL` (DIRECT) → white/neutral. First row of each group shows plate badge.
- Edit flow: if `permissions.canEdit` false → entire table read-only (plain cells, no affordance). If true → editable cells (per column metadata) click-to-edit input, PATCH on blur/Enter, invalidate query on success; 403 → toast + revert.

## Testing
| Layer | What |
|---|---|
| Unit | filter builder (whitelist rejection, param binding), color hash determinism, edit routing per columnKey |
| Integration | endpoint pagination/filters/date range; PATCH rejected without can_write (403 ROLE_WRITE_DENIED); saveValidation delegation writes namespaced metadata |
| Contract | field-roles parity test updated for `resolucion` |
| E2E/manual | Playwright: grouped colors, per-column filter, read-only vs editable rendering |

## Migration/Rollout
Additive only. Rollback: remove tab + endpoints; migration rollback = re-apply 020 field list.

## Open Questions / Risks
- `resolucion` may semantically overlap `numero_permiso` (labeled "Número de Permiso (Resolución Directoral)" since 020) — decision confirmed, but flag to user at review; n8n extraction prompt must also learn the field (n8n reads `extraction_fields`? assumption to verify).
- Pre-existing: `@RequiresTool('acopio')` unenforced on AcopioController (no RolesGuard) — out of scope, reported.
- Wide query cost on large ranges: mitigated by mandatory pagination (pageSize cap 100) and `idx_acopio_arrivals_date`; verify `entry_documents(parent_entity_id)` index exists before apply.

observations.title: Post-judgment-day fixes for Vista General cámara (6 issues)
observations.content:
## Post-Judgment-Day Surgical Fixes (batch on top of PR1+PR2+PR3)

**Branch**: `feat/acopio-general-view-jd-fixes` (off `feat/acopio-general-view-inline-edit`, tip 2c9756c) — commit **848a901**, local only, NOT pushed.

Applied the 6 confirmed judgment-day findings for `catalogos-vista-general-camara`, Strict TDD (RED test added/extended before each fix, then GREEN).

### Fixes
1. (CRITICAL) Camera-level doc columns now write to the CAMARA_ANCHOR asset. `AcopioGeneralViewEditService.applyEdits` fetches `parent_camara_asset_id` and groups doc edits by target entity id: camera-scoped types (`GUIA_TRANSPORTISTA`, `SANIPES_CAMARA` — new `CAMARA_SCOPED_DOCUMENT_TYPES` set + `isCamaraScopedDocumentType()` in constants/general-view-columns.ts) route to `parent_camara_asset_id ?? arrivalAssetId`; vessel-scoped keep own id. One saveValidation call per distinct target. Anchor shares arrival_id with vessels, so arg1 stays `asset.arrival_id`.
2. (CRITICAL) Price no-op guard: `priceGroupHasChange()` compares incoming real_price/shrinkage_pct/purchaseOrder against fetched `current` weighing row; if all unchanged, skip `setPrice` entirely (was resetting payment_status PAGADO->PENDIENTE on unchanged blur).
3. Value validation before delegating (`validateEditValue`): payment_status must be exactly PENDIENTE|PAGADO (mirrors SetPaymentStatusDto); real_price/shrinkage_pct reject '' (Number('')===0 trap), non-finite, and mirror CHECK/DTO ranges (shrinkage 0..100 per migration 018/001, real_price>=0 per SetPriceDto). Now 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, not 500.
4. `AcopioDocumentsService.saveValidation` gained optional `options.skipFlatFlatten`; general-view edit path passes `true` so composite-key writes don't flatten to bare keys and clobber asset-level columns (eslora, armador_nombre). All other callers unchanged (default false).
5. Numeric sort: `resolveGeneralViewSortExpression()` (helpers/general-view-query.helper.ts) returns typed ORDER BY expr per registry type — `("col")::numeric` for numbers, `::date` for dates, plain text otherwise. arrivals.service `generalView` uses it. Filter/projection text repr unchanged.
6. RBAC write boundary: added `@RequiresWrite('acopio')` to EVERY mutation handler in AcopioController (catalog POST/PATCH/DELETE, lots, arrivals, arrival-assets status/cancel/assign/unassign, documents confirm/approve/unapprove/delete/observation/n8n-result, request-upload, confirm-doc-ok, save-validation, finalize-validation, weighing create/price/payment-status, report-presets). GET/export stay `@RequiresTool` only.

### Files
- src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-general-view-edit.service.ts (issues 1,2,3,4)
- src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts (issue 4 — skipFlatFlatten)
- src/modules/acopio/constants/general-view-columns.ts (CAMARA_SCOPED_DOCUMENT_TYPES)
- src/modules/acopio/helpers/general-view-query.helper.ts (issue 5)
- src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-arrivals.service.ts (issue 5 wiring)
- src/modules/acopio/acopio.controller.ts (issue 6)
- specs: acopio-general-view-edit.service.spec.ts (+13 unit), general-view-query.helper.spec.ts (+sort expr), test/acopio-general-view.e2e-spec.ts (sort fixture + camera/eslora/validation e2e), test/acopio-roles-guard.e2e-spec.ts (+4 #6 regression)

### Test evidence (fresh)
- Unit: `npm test` → 27 suites, **336/336 pass** (was 323).
- E2E (real Postgres, DATABASE_URL set, `--runInBand --forceExit`): acopio-roles-guard + acopio-general-view → **25/25 pass**. observations.title: Fix: Validación de acopio no mostraba corrección guardada al reabrir
observations.content:
**What**: El panel/pantalla de Validación (acopio) prellenaba el form solo desde `n8n_extraction_result` (OCR crudo) + defaults de config, nunca desde `arrival_metadata` (donde `saveValidation()` sí persiste correctamente la corrección humana). Reabrir después de guardar mostraba la extracción original, como si nunca se hubiera guardado.

**Why**: Reporte directo del usuario tras verificar en la app. Investigado con systematic-debugging + verificado contra DB real en la VM (34.31.70.3).

**Where**:
- `backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts` (`saveValidation()` — flatten de `extractedFields` a dos pasadas, order-independent)
- `frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.ts` (`buildInitialValues()` — merge de `arrival_metadata`)
- `mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx` + nuevo `mobile/lib/acopio-validation.ts` (espejo de web, extraído con test propio)
- `mobile/vitest.config.ts` (alias `@` agregado)

**Learned**:
1. El endpoint de listado de documentos nunca exponía `human_corrected_json` al cliente — pero no hizo falta tocarlo: `arrival_metadata` (que sí viaja) ya contenía el dato correcto.
2. `saveValidation()` persiste cada campo extraído DOS veces: compuesto (`"DOC:key"`) y plano (duplicado para exports legacy tipo Tolvas/MP Perufrost). Rehidratar la copia plana ciegamente reintroduce ese eco en el próximo guardado y pisa la corrección compuesta fresca — hay que filtrar por "tiene gemelo compuesto en esta misma metadata", NO por "está en el catálogo" (eso rompía campos manuales de BARCO como `muelle_descarga`/`fecha_acta`, que casualmente comparten nombre con claves de catálogo de otro tipo de documento).
3. El flatten compuesto→plano en el backend debe hacerse en DOS pasadas separadas por tipo de clave (planas primero, compuestas después) para ser independiente del orden de iteración — una sola pasada con spread al final NO alcanza, porque el last-writer-wins ocurre DENTRO del loop, no en el spread externo.
4. `judgment-day` (5 rondas, jueces ciegos) fue clave: rondas 2 y 4 encontraron regresiones reales introducidas por el fix de la ronda anterior (over-filtering en R2, order-dependence en R4) que un solo pase de review no habría atrapado.
5. Este bug era un gap arquitectural compartido por web Y mobile, no una regresión de uno solo — ambos tenían la misma lógica de prellenado duplicada sin leer `arrival_metadata`.
6. El repo backend tenía trabajo ajeno sin commitear en la rama `feat/acopio-general-view-inline-edit` — el fix se aisló con `git worktree` sobre `main` para no mezclarlo.

Deploy: backend pusheado a `main` (834bb0a) y desplegado en la VM, verificado `https://api.escorpia.com/health` → 200. Frontend (a86ea5e) y mobile (08d2657) commiteados; frontend corre en Vercel (no VM), mobile no corre en VM. Detalle completo en PROGRESO.md sesión 2026-07-05.

observations.title: Session summary: escorpia traza
observations.content:
## Goal
Diagnosticar y arreglar un bug reportado por el usuario: en el panel de Validación de acopio, los datos corregidos por un operador se guardaban pero al reabrir el panel volvían a mostrar la extracción de IA original — como si nunca se hubiese guardado nada.

## Instructions
- El usuario pidió explícitamente "fix directo + TDD" sin pasar por SDD (bugfix acotado con causa raíz clara, no ameritaba proposal/spec/design/tasks).
- Pidió `judgment-day` después del fix para verificación adversarial antes de dar por cerrado.
- Al final pidió "todo impoluto" — es decir, no dejar warnings/suggestions abiertos aunque no fueran bloqueantes; se resolvieron todos los hallazgos hasta CLEAN.
- Cerrar con: commit en los 3 repos, deploy en la VM, archivar en PROGRESO.md, guardar en Engram.

## Discoveries
- `arrival_metadata` (expuesto al cliente) contiene la corrección humana persistida por `saveValidation()`, pero ni el panel web ni la pantalla mobile la leían nunca para el prellenado — solo usaban `n8n_extraction_result` (OCR crudo).
- El backend persiste cada campo extraído dos veces (compuesto `"DOC:key"` + plano, para lectores legacy de exports). Rehidratar la copia plana sin filtro reintroduce un eco stale que pisa correcciones frescas en el siguiente guardado.
- Filtrar "clave plana que está en el catálogo" (en vez de "clave plana que tiene gemelo compuesto en esta misma metadata") rompe campos manuales de BARCO (`muelle_descarga`, `fecha_acta`, etc.) que casualmente coinciden de nombre con claves de catálogo de otro tipo de documento.
- El flatten compuesto→plano del backend debe ser en dos pasadas segregadas por tipo de clave para ser order-independent; con una sola pasada, el orden real que producen los clientes (compuesta primero, plana después) hacía perder el fix.
- El repo backend tenía trabajo ajeno sin commitear en una rama feature (`feat/acopio-general-view-inline-edit`) — se aisló el fix con `git worktree` sobre `main` para no mezclarlo.
- `mobile/vitest.config.ts` no heredaba el alias `@` de tsconfig — hubo que agregarlo para que el nuevo test de mobile pudiera importar con `@/...`.
- El frontend de este proyecto corre en Vercel (no en la VM); mobile no corre en la VM (EAS build aparte) — solo el backend necesitaba deploy manual en la VM.

## Accomplished
- ✅ Diagnóstico completo del bug (root cause: `arrival_metadata` nunca leído en el prellenado).
- ✅ Fix en 3 repos con TDD, pasado por `judgment-day` 5 rondas (jueces ciegos) hasta veredicto CLEAN:
  - Backend: `acopio-documents.service.ts` — flatten de dos pasadas, order-independent. Test de regresión con el orden real de payload.
  - Frontend: `acopio-validation.ts` — merge de `arrival_metadata` con guardas correctas (compositeFlatTwins + gate de catálogo solo para compuestas). 37 tests.
  - Mobile: mismo fix + invalidación de queries + reset de latch `isInitialized` en `onSuccess`. Lógica extraída a `mobile/lib/acopio-validation.ts` (nuevo, espejo de web) con 20 tests propios.
- ✅ Commits pusheados: backend `main` `834bb0a`, frontend `main` `a86ea5e`, mobile `master` `08d2657`.
- ✅ Deploy en VM: backend/worker/scheduler rebuildeados sin downtime, verificado `https://api.escorpia.com/health` → 200 y logs de Nest sin errores.
- ✅ Archivado en `PROGRESO.md` (sesión 2026-07-05).
- ✅ Guardado en Engram (bugfix memory + este resumen).

## Next Steps
- Ninguno pendiente de este bug — cerrado end-to-end (código, tests, deploy, docs, memoria).
- Nota aparte (no urgente, mencionado por un juez): `saveValidation()` no valida que `arrivalAssetId` pertenezca a `arrivalId` antes de escribir — un mismatch silencioso podría perder el UPDATE de metadata sin que el endpoint lo reporte. Pre-existente, no introducido por este fix.

## Relevant Files
- backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.ts — saveValidation(), flatten de dos pasadas
- backend/src/modules/acopio/services/acopio-documents.service.spec.ts — test "eco plano stale"
- frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.ts — buildInitialValues(), merge de arrival_metadata
- frontend/src/lib/acopio-validation.test.ts — suite completa (37 tests, incluye simulateBackendMetadataMerge)
- mobile/app/(app)/acopio/validacion/[arrivalId].tsx — screen refactorizado, ahora usa el lib
- mobile/lib/acopio-validation.ts — módulo nuevo, espejo de frontend
- mobile/lib/acopio-validation.test.ts — 20 tests nuevos
- mobile/vitest.config.ts — alias @ agregado
- PROGRESO.md — sesión 2026-07-05 documentada al final

observations.title: sdd/catalogos-vista-general-camara/verify-report
observations.content:
# Verification Report

**Change**: catalogos-vista-general-camara
**Mode**: Strict TDD (full artifacts: spec + design + tasks + apply-progress)
**Verified state**: backend on `feat/acopio-general-view-inline-edit` (tip of stack = PR1 `dcc1114` + PR2 `8b02019` + PR3 `2c9756c`); frontend on `feat/acopio-general-view-frontend` (`9a01eb9`). All local, unpushed. User's uncommitted `acopio-documents.service.ts` + spec left untouched (verified via `git status` before/after).

## Verdict: PASS WITH WARNINGS

Implementation matches the corrected spec/design; independent fresh test runs are green. Two spec-artifact discrepancies (stale `resolucion` requirement; per-column date-range descope) require spec amendment, not code fixes, before archive.

## Fresh Independent Test Evidence (this run, not apply-agent reports)

| Suite | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Backend unit | `npm test` (stack tip) | 27/27 suites, 323/323 tests PASS |
| Backend e2e | `npm run test:e2e` with `DATABASE_URL` set (real Postgres, tenant demo) | 3/4 suites pass; 37/38 tests. ONLY failure = pre-existing `app.e2e-spec.ts` "GET /auth/me con cookie válida" (`res.body.email` undefined) — unrelated to acopio, NOT aggravated (gap b confirmed) |
| Backend e2e (no DATABASE_URL) | suites correctly self-skip | by design |
| Frontend vitest | `npx vitest run` | 16/16 files, 197/197 PASS |
| Frontend build | `npm run build` (Next 16 + tsc) | Clean, exit 0 |
| Frontend lint | pre-existing toolchain breakage (`eslint-module-utils/resolve`) | not attributable to change |

## Spec Compliance Matrix

| Requirement / Scenario | Evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Complete column coverage (~75 cols, all pipeline stages) | `general-view-columns.ts` registry covers spec table (arrival, asset, metadata, vessel-level docs, camera-level docs joined twice via `COALESCE(parent_camara_asset_id, aa.id)`, docs_total/approved, weighing, pricing, plant). `CAMARA_ANCHOR` excluded (`aa.asset_role <> 'CAMARA_ANCHOR'`) | ✅ (e2e "expone numero_permiso..." + columns endpoint test) |
| Camera-only fields blank for direct arrivals | e2e "las columnas de cámara solo aparecen si el arribo tiene cámara real" PASSED | ✅ |
| Per-column filter/search on every column | whitelist `f_<key>` → `"alias"::text ILIKE $n`, unknown key → 400 INVALID_FILTER_COLUMN; e2e filter + empty-state + security tests PASSED | ✅ (see WARNING W2 on type-awareness) |
| Global arrival_date range | e2e date-range test PASSED; live browser check in apply | ✅ |
| Per-column DATE-RANGE control on each date field | NOT implemented (backend supports only substring `f_<key>`; no `f_<key>_from/_to`) — explicitly descoped by user in PR4 instructions, flagged in apply-progress | ❌ spec gap → C1 |
| Camera color grouping (pastel, no semáforo, neutral direct) | `cameraRowColorClass()` unit tests (5) + component test assert grouped `bg-*-50` vs neutral; deterministic hash | ✅ code/tests; ⚠️ no live visual check (zero camera fixtures in local seed) → W3 |
| Inline edit gated by RBAC | `@RequiresWrite('acopio')` method-level + class-level `RolesGuard`; `permissions.canEdit` computed server-side; e2e: visor 403 ROLE_WRITE_DENIED, admin edits doc-sourced + real_price persist, INVALID_EDIT_COLUMN for read-only/unknown keys — all PASSED | ✅ |
| `numero_permiso` exposed | registry col labeled "Número de Permiso (Resolución Directoral)", editable via PERMISO_PESCA docRoute; e2e covers expose+filter+edit | ✅ |
| `resolucion` field requirement (spec) | ZERO `resolucion` references in backend/frontend/mobile code (rg clean); no migration 022 created — correction "numero_permiso already covers it" applied in tasks/design notes but SPEC ARTIFACT NEVER AMENDED | ❌ stale spec → C2 |

## RolesGuard Retrofit Regression Analysis (PR1)

- Guard added class-level to `AcopioController` only; regression e2e: admin (2 routes) + visor (read-only path) still 200; no-access role 403 — PASSED fresh.
- n8n integration UNAFFECTED: real callback is `POST /documents/n8n-callback` (DocumentEngineController) + deprecated forwarder `POST /acopio/n8n-callback` in separate `AcopioWebhookController` — both use `N8nCallbackSecretGuard` (shared secret, no JWT/RolesGuard). The JWT route `PATCH /acopio/documents/:docId/n8n-result` inside AcopioController is deprecated and already required JWT before PR1.
- Tenant template `011_rbac_v2.sql` seeds `role_tool_access` with `acopio` for all system roles (owner/admin/supervisor/operador rw, visor/gerencia read) → fresh tenants not locked out. Tenant-created custom roles WITHOUT an acopio row now get 403 where they silently got 200 before — this is the intended security fix, but is a behavior change to mention in the PR description (W4).

## Pending Gaps Reviewed

- **(a) validated_at/validated_by drift**: RESOLVED as environment-only. Migration `backend/src/modules/vertebra/migrations/acopio_materia_prima/017_arrival_validated_at.sql` (commit `78d43f3`, on `main` and all branches) adds BOTH columns idempotently (`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`). Repo is NOT missing a migration; local Docker tenant schema just hadn't applied vertebra migration 017.
- **(b) `/auth/me` e2e failure**: confirmed still failing identically, sole failure of 38, unrelated to this change, not aggravated.
- **(c) Phase 5 open items**: 5.1 (live visual camera grouping) still blocked on fixture data — unit/component covered; 5.4 (post-merge full regression) — this verify run IS a full fresh regression on the stacked tip (all 3 backend PRs together) + frontend, but a re-run after actual merge to main is still recommended.

## TDD Compliance (Strict TDD)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| TDD evidence reported | ✅ apply-progress PR4 has full RED/GREEN/REFACTOR table; PR1 documents RED (200 before fix) → GREEN (403) |
| Test files exist | ✅ all listed files present in commits |
| GREEN confirmed by fresh execution | ✅ all pass now |
| Assertion quality audit | ✅ no tautologies/`expect(true)`/orphan `toBeDefined` found in the 7 new test files; e2e asserts persisted values via GET readback |
| Coverage tooling | not run (informational only) |

## Issues

**CRITICAL (block archive until resolved — resolution is spec amendment, not code):**
- C1: Spec requirement "per-column date-range control on every date field" unimplemented and untested. User explicitly descoped in PR4 instructions; spec artifact must be amended (or the requirement scheduled as follow-up change) before archive.
- C2: Spec artifact still mandates `resolucion` field + JSONB migration for PERMISO_PESCA; superseded by user correction (`numero_permiso` covers it, zero residual code references). Spec must be amended to record the correction.

**WARNING:**
- W1: Tasks 5.1 / 5.4 unchecked (verification-category, not implementation). 5.4 substantially mitigated by this run; re-run post-merge.
- W2: Spec asked type-aware filters (exact for enums, numeric range for weights/prices); delivered uniform ILIKE substring for all columns. Both spec filter scenarios still pass.
- W3: Camera color grouping never seen live with real camera data (seed has zero `parent_camara_asset_id` rows) — covered by unit + component tests only.
- W4: RolesGuard retrofit changes behavior for custom tenant roles lacking `role_tool_access` acopio rows (403 now). Intended, but call out in PR1 description.

**SUGGESTION:**
- S1: `numero_formato`/`fecha_desembarque` are read-only (FORMATO_DESEMBARQUE outside ACOPIO_FIELD_ROLES Phase 1 scope) — consistent with design, consider for a future editable-columns v2.
- S2: Pre-existing failures worth separate tickets: `/auth/me` e2e, frontend eslint toolchain.

**Next**: amend spec (C1/C2) → judgment-day (post-apply adversarial review is recommended for this stack) → push/PR chain → post-merge regression (5.4) → sdd-archive.

observations.title: Change catalogos-vista-general-camara — estado hasta deploy (juicio final saltado en ronda 2)
observations.content:
**Qué**: Ciclo SDD completo para la feature "Vista General de Acopio" — tabla ancha en `catalogos` (área acopio) que une arrival, documentos (incl. cámara), pesaje y valorización, agrupada por color según cámara real (`parent_camara_asset_id`/`plate_number`), con filtros por columna, filtro global de rango de fecha (`arrival_date`), edición inline gateada por RBAC `can_write` sobre el tool `acopio`, y exposición de `numero_permiso` (NO se creó campo `resolucion` nuevo — es el mismo dato, ya existente desde migración 020). Incluye retrofit de `RolesGuard` en `AcopioController` (bug preexistente: `@RequiresTool` nunca se ejecutaba).

**Por qué**: Pedido del usuario para tener un catálogo único auditable de todas las recepciones de acopio, en vez de datos fragmentados en múltiples pantallas/exports Excel.

**Dónde — artefactos SDD en Engram** (topic_key `catalogos/vista-general-camara`): explore, proposal, spec (ya corregido: sin `resolucion`, sin filtros de fecha por campo — solo global), design, tasks, apply-progress (id 381), verify-report (id 384, PASS con 2 hallazgos de artefacto ya corregidos).

**Dónde — código, 4 PRs stacked-to-main**:
- Backend (`backend/`, repo git propio): `feat/acopio-roles-guard-fix` (dcc1114, RolesGuard) → `feat/acopio-general-view-read-endpoint` (8b02019, GET /acopio/arrivals/general-view + /columns) → `feat/acopio-general-view-inline-edit` (2c9756c, PATCH .../rows/:id) → `feat/acopio-general-view-jd-fixes` (848a901, 6 fixes de judgment-day).
- Frontend (`frontend/`, repo git propio): `feat/acopio-general-view-frontend` (9a01eb9) — tab "Base de datos general" en `AcopioGeneralDatabase.tsx`, verificado en browser real.

**Judgment Day — Ronda 1**: 2 jueces en paralelo (jd-judge-a/fable, jd-judge-b/opus) encontraron 2 CRITICAL + 4 WARNING(real) confirmados (uno de los CRITICAL solo lo vio un juez pero lo verifiqué yo mismo leyendo el código, confirmado real):
1. CRITICAL — ediciones de documentos a nivel cámara escribían en la embarcación en vez del asset ancla (`parent_camara_asset_id`), corrompiendo silenciosamente datos compartidos entre embarcaciones de la misma cámara.
2. CRITICAL — editar cualquier campo del grupo de precio (incluso sin cambio real, por un simple blur) reseteaba `payment_status` de PAGADO a PENDIENTE.
3. WARNING real — `payment_status` sin validar → 500 crudo en vez de 400 de dominio.
4. WARNING real — edición de campos de documento sobreescribía columnas de solo lectura no relacionadas (`eslora`, `armador_nombre`) por colisión de claves planas en `saveValidation`.
5. WARNING real — el retrofit de RolesGuard solo protegía el endpoint nuevo; las rutas de mutación viejas de acopio seguían escribibles por roles de solo lectura.
6. WARNING real — limpiar una celda numérica mandaba `''`, esquivaba el guard de NaN, 500 crudo.

**Fix aplicado** (commit 848a901, rama `feat/acopio-general-view-jd-fixes`): los 6 corregidos con TDD estricto. 336/336 unit, 46/47 e2e (la única falla es preexistente y no relacionada, `GET /auth/me`). Detalle técnico: nuevo `CAMARA_SCOPED_DOCUMENT_TYPES`/`isCamaraScopedDocumentType()` para resolver la entidad destino correcta; `priceGroupHasChange` evita escrituras no-op; `validateEditValue` rechaza con 400 antes de delegar; `saveValidation` acepta `options.skipFlatFlatten` (opt-in, no rompe otros callers); `resolveGeneralViewSortExpression` tipa el ORDER BY (`::numeric`/`::date`) sin tocar la proyección/filtro en texto; `@RequiresWrite('acopio')` agregado a TODAS las rutas de mutación existentes del controller.

**Ronda 2 de judgment-day: NO se completó — decisión explícita del usuario de saltarla** ("tranqui no necesita juez"), pasando directo a comitear/pushear/deployar/archivar. Los 6 fixes quedaron sin re-juzgar por un segundo par de jueces ciegos (se habían lanzado pero el usuario los mató antes de terminar). Riesgo residual: no hay confirmación adversarial independiente de que los 6 fixes sean correctos y no regresivos — solo la palabra del propio agente que los aplicó + la suite de tests.

**Gotcha descubierto en paralelo**: mientras se trabajaba esta feature, el usuario commiteó directamente a `main` de backend su propio fix (`834bb0a`, "corrige que la validación no se veía tras guardar" sobre `acopio-documents.service.ts` — el mismo archivo que toca el fix #4 de judgment-day vía `skipFlatFlatten`) y cambios de CI/CD (self-hosted runner para deploy, `0f7526f`/`2330d6e`/`037574c`). Esto significa que main avanzó por debajo de las ramas del feature — hace falta rebase antes de mergear (en curso al momento de este save).

**Siguiente paso en curso**: agente delegado (agentId no relevante para memoria) ejecutando: rebase de `feat/acopio-general-view-jd-fixes` sobre `main` actualizado → tests → merge `--ff-only` → push a `origin main` (repo backend, GitHub `R0DR0X/back-escorpia`) → mismo merge/push para frontend (`R0DR0X/front-escrorpia`, sin rebase necesario) → deploy real a VM de producción `34.31.70.3` (repos `/opt/traceexport/produccion-{back,front,infra}`, `docker-compose.vm.yml`, rebuild de `backend worker scheduler` juntos + `frontend`, healthcheck). Después de confirmar deploy sano: correr `sdd-archive`.

**Learned**: (1) `numero_permiso` YA es el campo "Resolución del permiso de pesca", no crear campos nuevos sin verificar extraction_fields existentes primero. (2) En este monorepo cada paquete (`backend/`, `frontend/`, `infra/`) es su propio repo git independiente — no hay git raíz. (3) El deploy a producción es real y automatizable mencionado en `traceexport-devops`: hay un self-hosted runner de CI que puede triggerearse por push a main (agregado por el propio usuario durante esta sesión) — verificar si el push a main ya dispara deploy automático antes de asumir que hace falta el paso manual de SSH.
